title: Ziyarat Ashura
description: This Ziyarat is recited for Imam Hussain(as) on the day of Ashura & everyday. Highly Recommended for solutions to all major problems, if recited continiously for 40 days
footer:
Salat After Ziyarat
You may then offer a two-unit prayer and when you finish, you may say the Dua stated below:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيكَ يَا خِيَرَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ خَيرَتِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O choicest of Allah and son of His choicest.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khiyarata allahi wabna khiyaratihi

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful
and son of the chief of the Prophets’ successors.
Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah
the doyenne of the women of the worlds.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ثَارَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ ثَارِهِ وَٱلْوِتْرَ ٱلْمَوْتُورَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah, son of His vengeance, and the unavenged so far.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya thara allahi wabna tharihi walwitra almawtura

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ ٱلأَرْوَاحِ ٱلَّتِي حَلَّتْ بِفِنَائِكَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you and upon the souls that resided in your courtyard.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa `ala al-arwahi allati hallat bifina'ika

lines.arabic: عَلَيْكُمْ مِنِّي جَمِيعاً سَلاَمُ ٱللَّهِ أَبَداً
lines.english: Peace of Allah be upon all of you from me forever
as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.
lines.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu

lines.english: O Abu-`Abdullah,
unbearable is the sorrow
and excruciating and unbearable is the misfortune of you
for us and for all the people of Islam.
Excruciating and unbearable has been your misfortune

lines.arabic: فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ أَهْلِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ
lines.english: in the heavens for all the inhabitants of the heavens.

lines.arabic: فَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً أَسَّسَتْ أَسَاسَ ٱلظُّلْمِ وَٱلْجَوْرِ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ
lines.english: So, may Allah curse the people who laid the basis of persecution and wronging against you, O Members of the Household.
lines.transliteration: fala`ana allahu ummatan assasat asasa alzzulmi waljawri `alaykum ahla albayti

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً دَفَعَتْكُمْ عَنْ مَقَامِكُمْ
lines.english: May Allah curse the people who drove you away from your position
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan dafa`atkum `an maqamikum

lines.arabic: وَأَزَالَتْكُمْ عَنْ مَرَاتِبِكُمُ ٱلَّتِي رَتَّبَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِيهَا
lines.english: and removed you away from your ranks that Allah has put you in.
lines.transliteration: wa azalatkum `an maratibikum allati rattabakum allahu fiha

lines.english: May Allah curse the people who slew you.
May Allah curse those who paved the way for them to do so
and who made possible for them to fight against you.
I repudiate them in the presence of Allah and You
lines.transliteration: bari'tu ila allahi wa ilaykum minhum

lines.english: and I repudiate their devotees, followers, and loyalists.
lines.transliteration: wa min ashya`ihim wa atba`ihim wa awliya'ihim

lines.english: O Abu-`Abdullah,
I am at peace with those who are at peace with you

lines.arabic: وَحَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حَارَبَكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ
lines.english: and I am at war against those who have fought against you up to the Resurrection Day.
lines.transliteration: wa harbun liman harabakum ila yawmi alqiyamati

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ آلَ زِيَادٍ وَآلَ مَرْوَانَ
lines.english: May Allah also curse the family of Ziyad and the family of Marwan.
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ala ziyadin wa ala marwana

lines.english: May Allah also curse the descendants of Umayyah altogether.
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu bani umayyata qatibatan

lines.english: May Allah also curse the son of Marjanah.
May Allah also curse `Umar the son of Sa`d.
May Allah also curse Shimr.
May Allah also curse the people who saddled up, gave reins to their horses,
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan asrajat wa aljamat

lines.english: and masked their faces in preparation for fighting against you.
May my father and mother be ransoms for you.
Extremely insufferable is my commiserations with you;

lines.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي أَكْرَمَ مَقَامَكَ وَأَكْرَمَنِي بِكَ
lines.english: so, I beseech Allah Who has honored your position and honored me because of you
lines.transliteration: fa'as'alu allaha alladhi akrama maqamaka wa akramani bika

lines.english: to endue me with the chance to avenge you

lines.arabic: مَعَ إِمَامٍ مَنْصُورٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: with a (Divinely) supported leader from the Household of Muhammad,
lines.transliteration: ma`a imamin mansurin min ahli bayti muhammadin

lines.english: peace of Allah be upon him and his Household.
O Allah, (please) make me illustrious in Your sight

lines.arabic: بِٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
lines.english: in the name of al-Husayn, peace be upon him, in this world and in the Hereafter.
O Abu-`Abdullah,

lines.arabic: إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَإِلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ
lines.english: I do seek nearness to Allah, to His Messenger,
lines.transliteration: inni ataqarrabu ila allahi wa ila rasulihi

lines.english: to the Commander of the Faithful, to Fatimah,
lines.transliteration: wa ila amiri almu'minina wa ila fatimata

lines.english: to al-Hasan, and to you by means of loyalty to you
lines.transliteration: wa ila alhasani wa ilayka bimuwalatika

lines.english: and by means of repudiation of those who fought against you
and incurred your hostility,

lines.arabic: وَبِٱلْبَرَاءَةِ مِمَّنْ أَسَّسَ أَسَاسَ ٱلظُّلْمِ وَٱلْجَوْرِ عَلَيْكُمْ
lines.english: and repudiation of those who laid the basis of persecution and wronging against you all.
lines.transliteration: wa bilbara'ati mimman assasa asasa alzzulmi waljawri `alaykum

lines.english: I also repudiate, in the presence of Allah and His Messenger,
lines.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi wa ila rasulihi)

lines.english: those who laid the basis of all that,
established their foundations on it,

lines.arabic: وَجَرَىٰ فِي ظُلْمِهِ وَجَوْرِهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعلىٰ أَشْيَاعِكُمْ
lines.english: and continued in wronging and persecuting you and your adherents.
lines.transliteration: wa jara fi zulmihi wa jawrihi `alaykum wa `ala ashya`ikum

lines.english: In the presence of Allah and you all do I repudiate these.
lines.transliteration: bari'tu ila allahi wa ilaykum minhum

lines.english: And I seek nearness to Allah and then to you all
lines.transliteration: wa ataqarrabu ila allahi thumma ilaykum

lines.english: by means of declaring loyalty to you and to your loyalists
and declaring repudiation of your enemies
and those who incur animosity of you
and repudiation of their adherents and followers.
lines.transliteration: wa bilbara'ati min ashya`ihim wa atba`ihim

lines.english: I am verily at peace with those who have been at peace with you,
I am at war against those who fought against you,
loyalist to those who have been loyalist to you,
and enemy of those who have shown enmity towards you.
So, I beseech Allah Who has endued me with the honor of recognizing you
and recognizing your loyalists
and Who conferred upon me with repudiation of your enemies,

lines.arabic: أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مَعَكُمْ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
lines.english: to include me with you in this world and in the Hereafter
lines.transliteration: an yaj`alani ma`akum fi alddunya wal-akhirati

lines.arabic: وَأَنْ يُثَبِّتَ لِي عِنْدَكُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ
lines.english: and to make firm step of honesty for me with you
lines.transliteration: wa an yuthabbita li `indakum qadama sidqin

lines.english: in this world and in the Hereafter.

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُهُ أَنْ يُبَلِّغَنِيَ ٱلْمَقَامَ ٱلْمَحْمُودَ لَكُمْ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: I also beseech Him to make me attain the praiseworthy status that you enjoy with Allah
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluhu an yuballighani almaqama almahmuda lakum `inda allahi

lines.english: and to bestow upon me with the chance to take my own vengeance
with a leader of true guidance who is (Divinely) sustained
and expressing the truth from among you.
I also beseech Allah in your names
and in the name of the standing that you enjoy with Him
to recompense me for my commiserations for you
with the most favorite thing that He ever gives as compensation for misfortunes that has afflicted anyone.
(Your) misfortune has been so astounding
and so catastrophic for Islam
and for all the heavens and the entire earth.
O Allah, (please) make me in this situation of mine

lines.arabic: مِمَّنْ تَنَالُهُ مِنْكَ صَلَوَاتٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ
lines.english: one of those who receive blessings, mercy, and forgiveness from You.
lines.transliteration: mimman tanaluhu minka salawatun wa rahmatun wa maghfiratun

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ مَحْيَايَ مَحْيَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) make me live my lifetime in the same way as Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household lived
lines.transliteration: allahumma ij`al mahyaya mahya muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

lines.english: and make me die on the same principles on which Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household died.
lines.transliteration: wa mamati mamata muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

lines.english: O Allah, this day
has been regarded as blessed day by the descendants of Umayyah
and by the son of the liver-eater woman,
the accursed and son of the accursed
by the tongue of You and by the tongue of Your Prophet,
Allah’s peace be upon him,
on every occasion and in every situation,

lines.arabic: وَقَفَ فِيهِ نَبِيُّكَ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.english: which Your Prophet, Allah’s peace be upon him, attended.
lines.transliteration: waqafa fihi nabiyyuka salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ وَمُعَاوِيَةَ وَيَزيدَ بْنَ مُعَاوِيَةَ
lines.english: O Allah, pour curses upon Abu-Sufyan, Mu`awiyah, and Yazid son of Mu`awiyah.
lines.transliteration: allahumma il`an aba sufyana wa mu`awiyata wa yazida bna mu`awiyata

lines.english: May Your curse be upon them incessantly and everlastingly.

lines.arabic: وَهٰذَا يَوْمٌ فَرِحَتْ بِهِ آلُ زِيَادٍ وَآلُ مَرْوَانَ
lines.english: This is the day on which the family of Ziyad and the family of Marwan gloated
lines.transliteration: wa hadha yawmun farihat bihi alu ziyadin wa alu marwana

lines.english: because they had killed al-Husayn, Allah’s blessings be upon him.
So, O Allah, pour frequent curses upon them
and double for them the painful chastisement.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ فِي هٰذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ
lines.english: O Allah, I do seek nearness to You on this day,
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni ataqarrabu ilayka fi hadha alyawmi

lines.english: on this occasion,
and on all the days of my lifetime,
by repudiating these and invoking Your curses upon them,
and by declaring loyalty to Your Prophet and Your Prophet’s Household,
lines.transliteration: wa bilmuwalati linabiyyika wa ali nabiyyika

lines.english: peace be upon him and them.
You may then repeat the following Laan ** one hundred times (or once)

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ ظَلَمَ حَقَّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآخِرَ تَابِعٍ لَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنِ ٱلْعِصَابَةَ ٱلَّتِي جَاهَدَتِ ٱلْحُسَيْنَ وَشَايَعَتْ وَبَايَعَتْ وَتَابَعَتْ عَلَى قَتْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْهُمْ جَمِيعاً
lines.english: O Allah, curse the first oppressor who oppressed the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and the last follower who followed him in that. O Allah, curse the gang that fought al-Husayn and followed, pledged allegiance, and participated in killing him. O Allah, curse them all.
lines.transliteration: allahumma il`an awwala zalimin zalama haqqa muhammadin wa ali muhammadin wa akhira tabi`in lahu `ala dhalika. allahumma il`ani al`isabata allati jahadati alhusayna wa shaya`at wa baya`at wa taba`at `ala qatlihi. allahumma il`anhum jami`an

lines.english: You may then repeat the following salam ** one hundred times (or once)

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah
and upon the souls that gathered in your courtyard.
Peace of Allah be upon you from me forever
as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.
lines.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu

lines.arabic: وَلاَ جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ ٱلْعَهْدِ مِنِّي لِزِيَارَتِكُمْ
lines.english: May Allah not cause this (visit) to be the last of my visit to you (all).
lines.transliteration: wa la ja`alahu allahu akhira al`ahdi minni liziyaratikum

lines.english: Peace be upon al-Husayn,
upon `Ali ibn al-Husayn,
upon the sons of al-Husayn,
and upon the companions of al-Husayn.
You may then say the following

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ خُصَّ أَنْتَ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ بِٱللَّعْنِ مِنِّي
lines.english: O Allah, pour special curses on the foremost persecutor
lines.transliteration: allahumma khussa anta awwala zalimin billa`ni minni

lines.english: and begin with him first,
and then pour curses on the second, the third, and the fourth.
O Allah, curse Yazid fifthly,

lines.arabic: وَٱلْعَنْ عُبَيْدَ ٱللَّهِ بْنَ زِيَادٍ وَٱبْنَ مَرْجَانَةَ
lines.english: and curse `Ubaydullah ibn Ziyad, the son of Marjanah,
`Umar ibn Sa`d, Shimr,

lines.arabic: وَآلَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ وَآلَ زِيَادٍ وَآلَ مَرْوَانَ
lines.english: the family of Abu-Sufyan, the family of Ziyad, and the family of Marwan
lines.transliteration: wa ala abi sufyana wa ala ziyadin wa ala marwana

lines.english: up to the Resurrection Day.
You may then prostrate yourself and say the following words
O Allah, all praise be to You;
the praise of those who thank You for their misfortunes.
All praise be to Allah for my great misfortune.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱرْزُقْنِي شَفَاعَةَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ يَوْمَ ٱلْوُرُودِ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) grant me the intercession of al-Husayn on the Day of Coming (to You)
lines.transliteration: allahumma irzuqni shafa`ata alhusayni yawma alwurudi

lines.english: and make for me with You a firm step of honesty
with al-Husayn and the companions of al-Husayn

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذينَ بَذَلُوٱ مُهَجَهُمْ دُونَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
lines.english: who sacrificed their souls in defense of al-Husayn, peace be upon him.

title: Ziyarat Taziya (Ashura Day)
description: Salutation of Condolence Recited in last hours of 'Ashura Day. It is recommended to stand up and address and offer condolences to the Holy Prophet, Imam Ali, Lady Fatimah al-Zahra, Imam al-Hasan, and the Holy Imams from the offspring of Imam al-Husayn on the astounding misfortunes that befell the Ahlulbayt on the Day of 'Ashura.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ صِفْوَةِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha adama sifwati allahi
lines.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Adam, the select of Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوحٍ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha nuhin nabiyyi allahi
lines.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Noah, the prophet of Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِبْرَاهيمَ خَليلِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ibrahima khalili allahi
lines.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Abraham, the intimate friend of Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ كَلِيمِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa kalimi allahi
lines.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Moses, who received direct communication from Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيسَىٰ رُوحِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Jesus, the Spirit of Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَبِيبِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha muhammadin habibi allahi
lines.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Muhammad, the most beloved by Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عَلِيٍّ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنينَ وَلِيِّ اللّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha `aliyyin amiri almu'minina waliyyi allahi
lines.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of `Ali, the Commander of the Believers and the intimate servant of Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱلشَّهيدِ سِبْطِ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha alhasani alshshahidi sibti rasuli allahi
lines.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of al-Hasan, the martyr and grandson of Allah’s Messenger!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O son of Allah’s Messenger!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ ٱلْبَشِيرِ ٱلنَّذِيرِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O son of the bringer of glad tidings and the warner
and son of the chief of the prophets’ successors!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka yabna fatimata sayyidati nisa‘i al`alamina
lines.english: Peace be on you, O son of Fatimah, the doyenne of the women of the world!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O Abu-`Abdullah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يا خِيَرَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ خِيَرَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khiyarata allahi wabna khiyaratihi
lines.english: Peace be on you, O select of Allah and the son of His select ones!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يا ثَارَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ ثَارِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya thara allahi wabna tharihi
lines.english: Peace be on you, O revenge of Allah and the son of His revenge!
Peace be on you, O unique (in suffering tribulations) and the oppressed!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلإِمَامُ ٱلْهَادِي ٱلزَّكِيُّ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O guide, pure leader!

lines.arabic: وَعَلىٰ أَرْوَاحٍ حَلَّتْ بِفِنَائِكَ وَأَقَامَتْ فِي جِوَارِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa `ala arwahin hallat bifina'ika wa aqamat fi jiwarika
lines.english: and on the souls of those who presented themselves in your camp, resided in your vicinity,
and came with the visitors of you.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنِّي مَا بَقيتُ وَبَقِيَ ٱللَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka minni ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
lines.english: (Incessant) peace be upon you, from me, as long as I am alive and as long as there are day and night.
Verily, astounding has been the calamity for us

lines.transliteration: wa jalla almusabu fi almu'minina walmuslimina
lines.english: and unbearable has been the adversity for the believers, Muslims,
for all the inhabitants of the heavens,
and for the inhabitants of the layers of the earth.

lines.transliteration: fa'inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji`una
lines.english: So, we are Allah’s and verily unto Him we return.

lines.transliteration: wa salawatu allahi wa barakatuhu wa tahiyyatuhu `alayka
lines.english: And Allah’s peace, blessings, and benedictions be upon you,
upon your forefathers; the pure, the pious, and the elite,
and upon their offspring; the guides and well-guided.
Peace be upon you O my master, upon them,
upon your soul, upon their souls,
upon the soil in which you are buried, and upon the soil in which they are buried.
O Allah, (please do) shed over them mercy, pleasure (of You),
happiness, and bounty.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, my master Abu-`Abdullah;
O Son of the Seal of the Prophets,
son of the Chief of the Prophets’ successors,
and son of the doyenne of the women of the world.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا شَهِيدُ يَا بْنَ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O martyr, son of the martyr,

lines.arabic: يَا أَخَا ٱلشَّهيدِ يَا أَبَا ٱلشُّهَدَاءِ
lines.transliteration: ya akha alshshahidi ya aba alshshuhada'i
lines.english: brother of the martyr, and father of the martyrs.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْهُ عَنِّي فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) convey to him on behalf of me at this hour,
on this day,
at this moment,
and at all time
abundant greetings and salutations.

lines.arabic: سَلاَمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.transliteration: salamu allahi `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace, mercy, and blessings of Allah be upon you,
O son of the master of the nations,
and upon those whom were martyred with you by such incessant greetings
that endure as long as there are day and night.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
lines.english: Peace be upon al-Husayn, the son of `Ali, the martyr.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
lines.english: Peace be upon `Ali, the son of al-Husayn, the martyr.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala al`abbasi bni amiri almu'minina alshshahidi
lines.english: Peace be upon al-`Abbas, the son of the Commander of the Believers, the martyr.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلشُّهَداءِ مِنْ وُلْدِ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala alshshuhada'i min wuldi amiri almu'minina
lines.english: Peace be upon the martyrs from among the descendants of the Commander of the Believers.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Messenger!

lines.arabic: أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ٱلْعَزَاءَ فِي وَلَدِكَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.transliteration: ahsana allahu laka al`aza'a fi waladika alhusayni
lines.english: May Allah confer upon you excellent consolation concerning the (tragedy) of al-Husayn, your son.
Peace be upon you, O Fatimah!

lines.arabic: أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَكِ ٱلْعَزَاءَ فِي وَلَدِكِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.transliteration: ahsana allahu laki al`aza'a fi waladiki alhusayni
lines.english: May Allah confer upon you excellent consolation concerning the (tragedy) of al-Husayn, your son.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Believers!

lines.arabic: أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ٱلْعَزَاءَ فِي وَلَدِكَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.transliteration: ahsana allahu laka al`aza'a fi waladika alhusayni
lines.english: May Allah confer upon you excellent consolation concerning the (tragedy) of al-Husayn, your son.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْحَسَنُ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan!

lines.arabic: أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ٱلْعَزَاءَ فِي أَخِيكَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.transliteration: ahsana allahu laka al`aza'a fi akhika alhusayni
lines.english: May Allah confer upon you excellent consolation concerning the (tragedy) of al-Husayn, your son.

lines.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: O my master, Abu-`Abdullah!
I am now Allah’s and your guest
and Allah’s and your neighbor!

lines.transliteration: wa likulli dayfin wa jarin qiran
lines.english: Each guest and neighbor must receive hospitality!
My hospitality at this time

lines.transliteration: an tas'ala allaha subhanahu wa ta`ala
lines.english: is that you may beseech Almighty Allah

lines.arabic: أَنْ يَرْزُقَنِي فَكَاكَ رَقَبَتِي مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
lines.transliteration: an yarzuqani fakaka raqabati min alnnari
lines.english: to release me from Hellfire.
Verily, He is Hearer of prayers, Nigh, and Responsive.

title: Ziyarat Aal-e-Yasin
description: Ziarah Aal-e-Yaseen is an important Ziarah of Imam-e-Zaman (peace be upon him). It is actually a Hadith Qudsi (direct saying of Allah(swt)) as reported in Mafatih-al-Jinnan. According to the traditions, 'Aal-e-Yaseen' is equivalent to 'Aal-e-Muhammad(peace be upon them)' and is the correct pronunciation (Qira'at) of verse 37:130 of the Holy Quran. Whenever you want to pay attention to God through us and also to us, recite the following as God has said:
footer: Significance: It is also recommended to be recited to obtain relief from oppression. The chain of narrators is: Al-Tabarsi narrates that Mohammad son of Abdullah al-Hemyari received this Ziyarah in a written letter from Imam Mahdi (a) during the minor occultation.

lines.english: Peace be upon the Household of Yasin.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا دَاعِيَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَبَّانِيَّ آيَاتِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya da`iya allahi wa rabbaniyya ayatihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O caller to Allah and interpreter of His Verses.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَابَ ٱللَّهِ وَدَيَّانَ دِينِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya baba allahi wa dayyana dinihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O door to Allah and applier of His religion.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَلِيفَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَنَاصِرَ حَقِّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khalifata allahi wa nasira haqqihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O viceroy of Allah and backer of His right.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ وَدَلِيلَ إِرَادَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi wa dalila iradatihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Argument of Allah and sign of His volition.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا تَالِيَ كِتَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَتَرْجُمَانَهُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya taliya kitabi allahi wa tarjumanihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O reciter of the Book of Allah and its interpreter.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ فِي آنَاءِ لَيْلِكَ وَأَطْرَافِ نَهَارِكَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka fi ana'i laylika wa atrafi naharika
lines.english: Peace be upon you at the hours of Your night and the two ends of Your day.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَقِيَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya baqiyyata allahi fi ardihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O herald of Allah on His lands.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مِيثَاقَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي أَخَذَهُ وَوَكَّدَهُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya mithaqa allahi alladhi akhadhahu wa wakkadahu
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O covenant of Allah that He has made and confirmed.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي ضَمِنَهُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya wa`da allahi alladhi daminahu
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Promise of Allah that He has assured.
Peace be upon you, O appointed pennon,
poured knowledge,
aid, and expansive mercy.
This is verily a promise that shall never be belied.
Peace be upon you whenever you rise (to undertake the mission).
Peace be upon you whenever you sit.
Peace be upon you whenever you recite and elucidate.
Peace be upon you whenever you profess Allah’s Godhead and profess His All-greatness.
Peace be upon you whenever you praise Allah and implore for His forgiveness.
Peace be upon you whenever you begin and end your day.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ فِي ٱللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
lines.english: Peace be upon you in the night when it draws a veil
and the day when it shines in brightness.
Peace be upon you, O entrusted leader.
Peace be upon you, O favored and expected.
Peace be upon you to the ultimate meaning of peace.
I solicit you, O my master,

lines.arabic: أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: anni ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
lines.english: to testify to me that I bear witness that there is no god but Allah;
One and Only Lord and having no associate,
and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

lines.transliteration: la habiba illa huwa wa ahluhu
lines.english: There is no one more beloved by Allah than him and his household.
And I solicit you, O my master, to testify to me that I bear witness
that `Ali the Commander of the Faithful is His argument,
al-Hasan is His argument.
al-Husayn is His argument,
`Ali the son of al-Husayn is His argument,
Muhammad the son of `Ali is His argument,
Ja`far the son of Muhammad is His argument,
Musa the son of Ja`far is His argument,
`Ali the son of Musa is His argument,
Muhammad the son of `Ali is His argument,
`Ali the son of Muhammad is His argument,
and al-Hasan the son of `Ali is His argument.
I also bear witness that you are verily the argument of Allah.
You all are the first and the last.

lines.arabic: وَأَنَّ رَجْعَتَكُمْ حَقٌّ لاَ رَيْبَ فِيهَا
lines.transliteration: wa anna raj`atakum haqqun la rayba fiha
lines.english: And (I bear witness) that your (promised) Return is undoubtedly true
“On the day when its belief avails not a soul
which theretofore believed not,
nor in its belief earned good by works,”
death is true,

lines.transliteration: wa anna nakiran wa nakiran haqqun
lines.english: and Nakir and Nakir are true.
And I bear witness that the Raising for death is true,
the Resurrection is true,
the Discriminating Bridge is true.
the Watchtower is true,
the Balance (of deeds) is true,
the Gathering is true,
the Reckoning is true,
Paradise and Hell are true,
and the promise of Paradise and the threat with Hell are true.
O My master! Certainly wretched is he who opposes you
and certainly happy is he who obeys you.
So, testify to me all that which I have besought you to testify.
I am verily an ally of you
and denouncing your enemy.
The truth is only that which you accept,
the wrong is only that which you disallow,
the good is only that which you enjoin,
and the evil is only that which you forbid.
My soul is thus believing in Allah;
One and Only Lord and having no associate,
and also in His Messenger, in the Commander of the Faithful,

lines.transliteration: wa bikum ya mawlaya awwalikum wa akhirikum
lines.english: and in you all, O my master, from the beginning to the end.
I have prepared myself to back you
and my love is sincerely dedicated to you.
Respond! Respond!

title: Ziyarat Waritha
description: This ziyarat Warith ( Imam as the inheritor from all previous prophets )is recited on thursday nights & even every day. It is also a means to seek needs when recited with specific intentions.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ صَفْوَةِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha adama safwati allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam the choice of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوحٍ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha nuhin nabiyyi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah the prophet of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ibrahima khalili allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham the intimate friend of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ كَلِيمِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa kalimi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses the spoken by Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيسَىٰ رُوحِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus the spirit of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَبِيبِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha muhammadin habibi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad the most beloved by Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Muhammad the well-chosen Prophet.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ عَلِيٍّ ٱلْمُرْتَضَىٰ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of `Ali the well-pleased.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah the luminous lady.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ خَدِيـجَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Khadijah the grand lady.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ثَارَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ ثَارِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya thara allahi wabna tharihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah, son of His vengeance,
and the unavenged so far.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

lines.arabic: وَأَطَعْتَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ حَتَّىٰ أَتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
lines.transliteration: wa ata`ta allaha wa rasulahu hatta ataka alyaqinu
lines.english: and obeyed Allah and His Messenger until death came upon you.
So, may Allah curse the people who slew you.
May Allah curse the people who persecuted you.

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً سَمِعَتْ بِذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَتْ بِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan sami`at bidhalika faradiyat bihi
lines.english: May Allah curse the people who were pleased when they had heard of that.

lines.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: O my Master, O Abu-`Abdullah!

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ كُنْتَ نُوراً فِي ٱلأَصْلاَبِ ٱلشَّامِخَةِ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu annaka kunta nuran fi al-aslabi alshshamikhati
lines.english: I bear witness that you were light in the sublime loins
and purified wombs;
the impurities of the Ignorance Era could not object you to filth

lines.transliteration: wa lam tulbiska min mudlahimmati thiyabiha
lines.english: nor could it dress you its murky clothes.

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka min da`a'imi alddini
lines.english: I also bear witness that you are one of the mainstays of the religion
and the supports of the faithful believers.

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka al-imamu albarru alttaqiyyu
lines.english: I also bear witness that you are the God-fearing, pious,
pleased, immaculate,
guide, and well-guided Imam.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ ٱلأَئِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ كَلِمَةُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna al-a'immata min wuldika kalimatu alttaqwa
lines.english: And (I bear witness) that the Imams from your progeny are the spokesmen of piety,
the signs of guidance,
the firmest handle (of Islam),
and the decisive Argument against the inhabitants of the world.
And I call Allah, His angels,
His Prophets, and His Messenger
to witness for me that I believe in you all and in your Return,
I have full confidence in the laws of my religion and in the seals of my deeds,
my heart is at peace with you all,
and all my affairs are based on your commands.
May Allah’s benedictions be on your souls,
your bodies, your forms,
the present and the absent from you,
and the apparent and the invisible from you.
Then, you may throw yourself on the tomb, kiss it, and say these words:

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi yabna rasuli allahi
lines.english: My father and mother be sacrificed for you, O son of the Messenger of Allah!

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya aba `abdillahi
lines.english: My father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Abu `Abdullah!
Extremely terrible was the calamity
and astounding is the misfortune that you suffered upon us
and upon all the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.

lines.transliteration: fala`ana allahu ummatan asrajat wa aljamat
lines.english: Therefore, Allah may curse the people who saddled up, gave rein to their horses,
and prepared themselves to kill you.

lines.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: O my Master, O Abu `Abdullah!
I moved towards your sanctuary
and came to your shrine

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلشَّأْنِ ٱلَّذِي لَكَ عِنْدَهُ
lines.english: beseeching Allah in the name of the standing that you enjoy with Him
and the position that you occupy with Him

lines.arabic: أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: an yusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: to send blessings on Muhammad and on the Household of Muhammad

lines.arabic: وَأَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مَعَكُمْ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa an yaj`alani ma`akum fi alddunya wal-akhirati
lines.english: and to keep me with you in this world and in the Hereafter.
Ziyarah of `Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him)

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Prophet of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the commander of the faithful.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of al-Husayn the martyr.
Peace be upon you, O martyr.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمَظْلُومُ وَٱبْنُ ٱلْمَظْلُومِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O wronged and harassed and the son of the wrong and harassed.
Curse of Allah be on those who killed you.
Curse of Allah be on those who persecuted you.

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً سَمِعَتْ بِذٰلِكَ فَرَضَيِتْ بِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan sami`at bidhalika faradiyat bihi
lines.english: Curse of Allah be on those who heard this even but rested satisfied.
You should then throw yourself on the tomb, kiss it, and say the following words:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ وَلِيِّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waliyya allahi wabna waliyyihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O intimate servant of Allah and the son of His intimate servant.
Extremely terrible was the calamity
and astounding is the misfortune that you suffered, upon us
and upon all Muslims.
So, curse of Allah be on those who killed you

lines.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi wa ilayka minhum
lines.english: and I disavow them in the presence of Allah and You.
Ziyarah of all Martyrs (Shuhada')

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَوْلِيَاءَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّائَهُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ya awliya'a allahi wa ahibba'ahu
lines.english: Peace be upon all of you, O friends and dears of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَصْفِيَاءَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَوِدَّاءَهُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ya asfiya'a allahi wa awidda'ahu
lines.english: Peace be upon all of you, O choice of Allah and sincerely attached to Him.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Allah’s religion.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of the Messenger of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ فَاطِمَةَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ya ansara fatimata sayyidati nisa'i al`alamina
lines.english: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Fatimah the doyenne of the women of this world.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Abu Muhammad,
al-Hasan the son of `Ali, the saintly and sincere.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Abu-`Abdullah.
My father and mother be sacrificed for you.

lines.arabic: طِبْتُمْ وَطَابَتِ ٱلأَرْضُ ٱلَّتِي فِيهَا دُفِنْتُمْ
lines.transliteration: tibtum wa tabat al-ardu allati fiha dufintum
lines.english: Verily, pure be you and pure be the soil in which you were buried.
You attained great success.

lines.arabic: فَيَا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ مَعَكُمْ فَأَفُوزَ مَعَكُمْ
lines.english: Would that I were with you so that I could also share the accomplishment with you.
Ziyarah Abal Fadhl 'Abbas (peace be upon him)
Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْکَ اَیُّہَا الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ الْمُطِیْعُ لِلّٰہِ وَ لِرَسُوْلِہٖ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ayyuha al`abdu alssalihu almuti`u lillahi wa lirasulihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant of Allah and obedient to Him and to His Messenger.
I bear witness that you did jihad,

lines.arabic: وَ نَصَحْتَ وَ صَبَرْتَ حَتّٰی اَتٰیکَ الْیَقِیْنُ
lines.transliteration: wa nasahta wa sabarta hatta ataka alyaqinu
lines.english: were patient and sincere until death came to you.

lines.arabic: لَعْنَ اﷲُ الظَّالِمِیِن لَکُمْ مِنَ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ وَالْآخِرِیْنَ وَ اَلْحِقْہُمْ بِدَرَکِ الْجَحِیْمِ.
lines.transliteration: la`ana allahu alzzalimina lakum mina al-awwalina wal-akhirina wa alhiqhum bidaraki aljahimi
lines.english: Allah’s curse be on the group who killed you from the first to the last & may they be in hell forever.
You may then offer a two-unit prayer and when you finish, you may say the following words:

lines.transliteration: allahumma inni sallaytu wa raka`tu wa sajadtu
lines.english: O Allah, I have offered a prayer, genuflected, and prostrated myself
for Your sake purely without setting any partner with You
since all prayers, genuflection, and prostration
suit none except You.

lines.arabic: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
lines.transliteration: li'annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: Because You are Allah, there in n0 god save You.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings on Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and convey to them my best greetings and compliments
and convey to me their replies.
O Allah, these two units of prayer
are present from me to my master
al-Husayn the son of `Ali, peace be upon both of them.
O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on him,
accept my effort, and reward me for it
in the best rewarding that I anticipate and hope from You

lines.transliteration: wa fi waliyyika ya waliyya almu'minina
lines.english: and from Your saint, O Guardian of the faithful!

Direct yourself towards the Ha'ir (i.e. Imam al-Husayn’s shrine) with tranquility and solemnity. As you walk, try to make short steps, for Allah the All-exalted shall record for you the reward of going on hajj (holy pilgrimage to Mecca) and going on ‘Umrah (recommended pilgrimage to Mecca). Try to be pious-hearted with tearful eyes. Repeat as many times as possible the Takbir statement (saying allahu Akbar—Allah is the Most Great), the Tahlil statement (saying la ilaha illa (a)llahu—There is no god but Allah), statements of praising Allah, statements of invoking blessings on the Holy Prophet and his Household in general and blessings on Imam al-Husayn in particular, and statements of cursing those who killed him and those who were the main reason behind it.
At the door of the Hai'r, you may stop and say the following words:
Allah is verily the Most Great.
Very much thanks is due to Allah.

lines.transliteration: wa subhana allahi bukratan wa asilan
lines.english: All praise be to Allah in morns and eves.
All praise is due to Allah Who has guided us to this

lines.arabic: وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْ لاَ أَنْ هَدَانَا ٱللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: wa ma kunna linahtadiya lawla an hadana allahu
lines.english: and we would not have found the way had it not been that Allah guided us.
Certainly, the apostles of our Lord brought the truth.
Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O seal of the prophets.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Messengers.
Peace be upon you, O most beloved by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O commander of the faithful.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Prophets’ successors.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا قَائِدَ ٱلْغُرِّ ٱلْمُحَجَّلِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O leader of the white-forehead and white-footed ones (on the Day of Resurrection).
Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah
the doyenne of the women of this world.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ ٱلأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you and upon the Imams from your progeny.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَصِيَّ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O successor of the commander of the faithful.
Peace be upon you, O veracious and martyr.
Peace be upon you, O Angels of Allah
who reside in this holy shrine.
Peace be upon you, O my Lord’s Angels
who surround the tomb of al-Husayn, peace be upon him.
Peace be upon all of you forever

lines.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
lines.english: as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu-Abdullah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the commander of the faithful.
I am your slave and son of your slave and bondmaid.
I confess of my servantship to you, acquit from being opposite to you,
accede to any one who accedes to you, and antagonize an yone who antagonizes you.
I direct towards your holy shrine, seek shelter with your (burial) place
and seeking nearness to you through directing to you.
O Messenger of Allah, may I enter?
O Prophet of Allah, may I enter?
O Commander of the faithful, may I enter?
O Chief of the prophets’ successors, may I enter?

lines.arabic: أَأَدْخُلُ يَا فَاطِمَةُ سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya fatimatu sayyidata nisa'i al`alamina
lines.english: O Fatimah the doyenne of the women of the world, may I enter?

lines.arabic: أَأَدْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: O my master Abu `Abdullah, may I enter?

lines.arabic: أَأَدْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya yabna rasuli allahi
lines.english: O my master and son of the Messenger of Allah, may I enter?
If you feel that your heart has become submissive and your eyes have become tearful, then that will be the sign of permission to enter. You then should enter and say these words:
All praise is due to Allah the One, the Unique,
the Single, the Absolute,
Who has guided me to be loyal to you,
given me exclusively the chance to visit your tomb,
and made it easy for me to direct to you.
Ziyarat Ameenallah
Ziyarat of Imam Ali (as)
This Ziyarah is highly esteemed. Allamah al-Majlisi, says this form is the best in text and chain of authority and is recommended to recite at all the holy shrines.
Significance

It is narrated on the authority of Jabir (ibn `Abdullah al-Ansari) on the authority of Imam al-Baqir (‘a) that Imam Zayn al-Abidin (‘a), once, visited the holy tomb of Imam `Ali (‘a). He stood at the tomb, wept, and pronounced the following words:

Imam al-Baqir (‘a) then added, “Indeed, any one of our adherents (Shi`ah) who pronounces these words at the tomb of Ameer al-Mu'mineen (‘a) or the tomb of one of the Imams (‘a) shall certainly have his prayer lifted up on a ladder of light, carrying the seal of the Holy Prophet’s ring, and it shall be kept so until it will be delivered to the Riser from Muhammad’s Household (namely, Imam al-Mahdi) who will receive the reciter of that prayer with good tidings, greetings, and honor.”

The Ziyarah of Ameenullah is considered one of the general forms of Ziyarah of Imam `Ali (as), one of the forms of Ziyarah on the Eid al-Ghadir Day, and one of the comprehensive forms of Ziyarah that can be said at all the shrines of the Holy Imams.
FROM SAHIFA MAHDI
ZIYARAT AMEENULLAH AND ITS BENEFITS
We have mentioned Ziyarat Ameenullah for a few reasons:

1. Imam al-Baqir (a.s) says, “Indeed, any one of our adherents (Shi`ah) who pronounces these words at the tomb of Amir al-Mu'minin (a.s) or the tomb of one of the Imams (a.s) shall certainly have his prayer lifted up on a ladder of light, carrying the seal of the Holy Prophet’s ring, and it shall be kept so until it will be delivered to the Riser from Muhammad’s Household (namely, Imam al-Mahdi (a.s)) who will receive that person with good tidings, greetings, and honor.”
2. This Ziyarat is one of those Ziyarats that has been recited by Imam Mahdi (A.S.) himself, as mentioned in the incident of the visitation of Haj Ali Baghdadi.
3. Imam Mahdi (A.S.), in the incident of meeting Haj Ali Baghdadi, clearly states that and emphasis that: this Ziyarat is the best of all Ziyarats.

A significant point that can be comprehended from that incident is that this Ziyarat belongs to the group of comprehensive and general Ziyarats that can be recited for all the Imams and in the shrines of each one of them; just as his holiness recited this Ziyarat in the holy shrines of Imam Kazim and Imam Jawad (peace be upon them) in the city of Kazmayn. In fact, this point has been clearly stated even in the narration of Imam Baqir (A.S.)
Late Mohaddis e Qummi says: This Ziyarat hold absolute authority, and has arrived in all the books of supplications and Ziyarats.

Allama Majlisi (R.A.) considers this Ziyarat as the best of all Ziyarats in terms of text and the chain of authority; he adds: it is appropriate to recite his Ziyarat in all the holy shrines; just as it has been narrated with reliable authenticity by Jabir, from Imam Baqir (A.S.),
Imam Sajjad (A.S.) went for the Ziyarat of Imam Ali (A.S.), stopped near his grave, wept, and then recited it:

It is worth mentioning that the Ziyarah of Aminullah is considered one of the general forms of Ziyarah of Imam `Ali (a.s), one of the private forms of Ziyarah on the Eid al-Ghadir Day, and one of the comprehensive forms of Ziyarah that can be said at all the shrines of the Holy Imams (a.s).

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا اَمِیْنَ اللّٰهِ فِیْ اَرْضِهٖ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya amina allahi fi ardihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O trustee of Allah on His lands
and argument of Allah against His servants.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ جَاهَدْتَ فِی اللّٰهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهٖ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu annaka jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
lines.english: I bear witness that you strove for the sake of Allah as it ought to be striven,
acted upon His Book,
and followed the instructions of His Prophet,
peace of Allah be upon him and his Household,
until Allah called you to be in His vicinity.
So, He grasped you to Him by His will
and put your enemies under the claim

lines.arabic: مَعَ مَالَكَ مِنَ الْحُجَجِ الْبَالِغَۃِ عَلٰی جَمِیْعِ خَلْقِهٖ
lines.transliteration: ma`a ma laka min alhujaji albalighati `ala jami`i khalqihi
lines.english: although you have inclusive claims against all of His creatures.
O Allah, (please do) cause my soul to be fully tranquil with Your decrees,
satisfied with Your acts,
fond of mentioning and praying to You,
bearing love for the choicest of Your intimate servants,
beloved in Your lands and heavens,
steadfast against the affliction of Your tribulations,
thankful for Your graceful bounties,
always bearing in mind Your incessant gifts,
longing for the gladness of meeting You,
supplied with piety for the day of Your rewarding,
pursuing the morals of Your intimate servants,
quitting the conducts of Your enemies,

lines.arabic: مَشْغُوْلَۃً عَنِ الدُّنْیَا بِحَمْدِكَ وَ ثَنَاۤئِكَ۔
lines.english: and distracted from this world by praising and thanking You.

lines.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ قُلُوْبَ الْمُخْبِتِیْنَ اِلَیْكَ وَالِهَۃٌ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inna quluba almukhbitina ilayka walihatun
lines.english: O Allah, the hearts of those humbling themselves to You are fascinated,
the paths of those desiring for You are open,
the sings of those directing to You are evident,
the hearts of those having recognition of You are resorting to You,
the voices of those beseeching You are mounting up to You,
the doors of responding to them are wide open,
the prayer of him who speaks to You confidentially is responded,

lines.arabic: وَ تَوْبَۃَ مَنْ اَنَابَ اِلَیْكَ مَقْبُوْلَۃٌ
lines.transliteration: wa tawbata man anaba ilayka maqbulatun
lines.english: the repentance of him who turns to You modestly is admitted,

lines.arabic: وَ عَبْرَۃَ مَنْ بَكٰی مِنْ خَوْفِكَ مَرْحُوْمَۃٌ
lines.transliteration: wa `abrata man baka min khawfika marhumatun
lines.english: the tear of him who weeps on account of fear from You is compassionated,

lines.arabic: و وَ الْاِغَاثَۃَ لِمَنِ اسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ مَوْجُوْدَۃٌ
lines.english: the aid of him who seeks Your aid is available,

lines.arabic: وَ الْاِعَانَۃَ لِمَنِ اسْتَعَانَ بِكَ مَبْذُوْلَۃٌ
lines.english: the help of him who seeks Your help is obtainable,
Your promises to Your servants are fulfilled,
the slips of him who implore You to excuse him are forgivable,
the deeds of those who act for You are preserved,

lines.arabic: وَ اَرْزَاقَكَ اِلَی الْخَلَاۤئِقِ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ نَازِلَۃٌ
lines.transliteration: wa arzaqaka ila alkhala'iqi min ladunka nazilatun
lines.english: Your sustenance to the creatures are descending from You,
Your gifts for further conferrals are reaching them,
the sins of those imploring Your forgiveness are forgiven,
the requests of Your creatures are granted by You,
the prizes of those begging You are offered,
Your gifts for further conferrals are uninterrupted,
the dining tables for those seeking Your feeding are prepared,
and the springs of quenching their thirst are brimful.
O Allah, (so) respond to my prayer,
accept my thanksgiving for You,

lines.arabic: وَ اجْمَعْ بَیْنِیْ وَ بَیْنَ اَوْلِیَاۤئِیْ
lines.english: and join me to my masters,
[I beseech You] in the name of Muhammad, `Ali,
Fatimah, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn.
You are verily the only source of my boons,
the ultimate goal of my wishes,

lines.arabic: وَ غَایَۃُ رَجَاۤئِیْ فِیْ مُنْقَلَبِیْ وَ مَثْوَايَ۔
lines.transliteration: wa ghayatu raja'i fi munqalabi wa mathwaya
lines.english: and the target of my hope in my recourses and settlement.
In the book of Kamil al-Ziyarat, the following statements are added to this form of Ziyarah:

lines.arabic: اَنْتَ اِلٰهِیْ وَ سَیَّدِیْ وَ مَوْلَايَ
lines.transliteration: anta ilahi wa sayyidi wa mawlaya
lines.english: You are verily my God, Master, and Lord.
(Please) forgive our friend,
prevent our enemies against us,
distract them from harming us,
give prevalence to the Word of Truth
and make it the supreme,
and frustrate the word of falsehood
and make it the lowliest.
Verily, You have power over all things.
Farewell Ziyaarat to be Recited after Ziyaarat-e-Ameenullah

The author says: I have seen in the book ‘Al-Iqbaal’ and the book ‘Sahifa al-Saadeqiyyah’ written by late Sayed ibn Taaoos (r.a.) and in two manuscripts in which a farewell ziyaarat to be recited after ziyaarat-e-Ameenullah, narrated by Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) has been mentioned.

Jaabir says: When I informed Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) about the ziyaarat of Ameenullah as narrated by Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.), he (a.s.) said: “Whenever you decide to depart from the shrine of the Holy Imams (a.s.) then add in it this supplication after Ziyaarat-e-Ameenullah:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا الْاِمَامُ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهٗ اَسْتَوْدِعُكَ اللهَ وَ عَلَيْكَ السَّلَامُ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُہٗ.
lines.transliteration: assalaamo a’layka ayyohal emaamo wa rahmatul laahe wa barakaatohu as-tawde-o’kal laaha wa a’laykas salaamo wa rahmatul laahe wa barakaatoh.
lines.english: Peace be on you, O the Imam and mercy of Allah and His blessings, I entrust you with Allah and upon you is peace and mercy of Allah and His blessings.

lines.arabic: اٰمَنَّا بِالرَّسُوْلِ وَ بِمَا جِئْتُمْ بِهٖ وَ دَعَوْتُمْ اِلَيْهِ.
lines.transliteration: aamannaa bir-rasoole wa bemaa jeatum behi da-a’wtum elayhe.
lines.english: We believe in the Messenger, and in whatever you have come with and called to.

lines.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْهُ اٰخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِيْ وَلِيَّكَ.
lines.transliteration: allaahumma laa taj-a’lho aakheral a’hde min zeyaaratee waliyyaka.
lines.english: O Allah! Do not make this my last visitation of Your master.

lines.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنِيْ ثَوَابَ مَزَارِهِ الَّذِيْ اَوْجَبْتَ لَهٗ وَ يَسِّرْ لَنَا الْعَوْدَ اِلَیْہِ اِنْ شَآءَ اللهُ تَعَالٰى‏.
lines.transliteration: allaahumma laa tahrimnee sawaaba mazaarehil lazee awjabta lahu wa yassir lanal a’wda elayhe in shaaa allaaho ta-a’alaa.
lines.english: O Allah! Do not deprive me of the reward of his shrine which You have decided for him and make our returning to visit it easy for us, if Allah – the High – wish.

title: Ziyarat Jamia Kabeera
description: Ziyarat al-Jamiah al-Kabirah (The Comprehensive Salutation) is the most detailed and eloquent Ziyarat of the Holy Imams (as), narrated by Imam Ali al-Hadi (as). It is considered the Greatest Salutation as it summarizes the virtues and status of the Ahlul Bayt (as).

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يا أَهْلَ بَيْتِ النُّبُوَّةِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O family of the Prophet,
the site of the Divine Message,
the place where the angels come,
the place where the Revelation descended,
the source of mercy,
the storehouse of knowledge,
the ultimate in forbearance,
the pillars of generosity,
the leaders of nations,
the masters of blessings,
the essence of the righteous,
the supports of the choice ones,
the masters of the servants (of Allah),
the signs of the cities,
the doors to faith,
the trustees of the All-beneficent (All-merciful),
the lineage of the Prophets,
the elite of the Messengers,
and the family of the best (one selected) by the Lord of the worlds,
and the mercy of Allah and His blessings (be on you),
Peace be on the Imams of true guidance,
the lamps in the darkness,
the signs of piety,
the ones endowed with intellect,
and the ones possessed of reason,
the cave (refuge) of mankind,
the heirs of the Prophets,
the sublime example,
the excellent invitation (to Allah),

lines.arabic: وَحُجَجِ اللهِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الدُّنْيا وَالآخِرَةِ وَالأُولَى
lines.transliteration: wa hujaji allahi `ala ahli alddunya wal-akhirati wal-ula
lines.english: and the arguments of Allah against the people of this world, the Hereafter and the first (world),
and the mercy of Allah and His blessings (be on you).
Peace be on the places (where one gains) recognition of Allah,
the abodes of the blessings of Allah,
the mines of the wisdom of Allah,
the preservers of the secret of Allah,
the bearers of the Book of Allah,
the successors of the Prophet of Allah,

lines.arabic: وَذُرِّيَّةِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa dhurriyyati rasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: and the offspring of the Messenger of Allah, peace of Allah be upon him and his family,
and the mercy of Allah and His blessings (be on you).
Peace be on the ones who call to Allah,
the ones who guide to the pleasure of Allah,
the ones who are established in the command of Allah,
the ones who are perfect in the love of Allah,
the ones who are sincere in (proclaiming) the Oneness of Allah,
the ones who manifest the command of Allah and His prohibition,
and His honored servants,

lines.arabic: الَّذِينَ لا يَسْبِقُونَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ وَهُمْ بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ
lines.transliteration: alladhina la yasbiqunahu bil-qawli wa hum bi-amrihi ya`maluna
lines.english: who do not precede Him in speech and act according to His command,
and the mercy of Allah and His blessings (be on you).
Peace be on the Imams who call (to Allah),
the leading guides,
the masterly-rulers,
the defenders-protectors,
the people of the Remembrance (Quran),
the ones possessed of authority,
and the remainder of Allah and His best ones,
His party, the container of His knowledge,

lines.transliteration: wa hujjatihi wa siratihi wa nurihi wa burhanihi
lines.english: His argument, His path, His light and His proof,
and the mercy of Allah and His blessings (be on you).

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu
lines.english: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone without any partner,

lines.arabic: كَما شَهِدَ اللهُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَشَهِدَتْ لَهُ مَلائِكَتُهُ وَأُولُو الْعِلْمِ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
lines.transliteration: kama shahida allahu linafsihi wa shahidat lahu mala'ikatuhu wa ulu al`ilmi min khalqihi
lines.english: even as Allah has borne witness for Himself, and His angels and the ones possessed of knowledge have borne witness for Him,

lines.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
lines.transliteration: la ilaha illa huwa al`azizu alhakimu
lines.english: there is no god but He, the Almighty, the Wise.
And I bear witness that Muhammad is His chosen servant,
His approved Messenger,

lines.arabic: أَرْسَلَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ
lines.transliteration: arsalahu bilhuda wa dini alhaqqi liyuzhirahu `ala alddini kullihi wa law kariha almushrikuna
lines.english: He sent him with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it prevail over all religions, though the polytheists may be averse.
And I bear witness that you are the Imams of true guidance,
the rightly-guided ones, the infallible ones, the honored ones,
the near ones (to Allah), the pious ones,
the truthful ones, the chosen ones,
those who obey Allah, those who stand by His command,
those who act according to His will and those who have attained His honor.
He chose you for His knowledge,
approved you for His Unseen,
selected you for His secret,
picked you by His power,
honored you with His guidance,
made you exclusive to His proof,
chosen you for His light,
upheld you by His Spirit,
and He was pleased with you (to be) the successors in His earth,
Arguments against His creation,
helpers for His religion,
preservers of His secret,
containers of His knowledge,
depositories of His wisdom,
interpreters of His Revelation,
pillars of (proclaiming) His Oneness,
witnesses over His creation,
signs for His servants,
lighthouses in His lands,
and proofs for His path.
Allah safeguarded you from error,
kept you safe from seditions (trials),
cleansed you of un-cleanliness (impurity),

lines.transliteration: wa adhhaba `ankumu alrrijsa wa tahharakum tathiran
lines.english: removed the abomination from you and purified you with a thorough purification.
So, you magnified His Majesty,
exalted His standing,
extolled His generosity,
persistently remembered Him,
ratified His covenant,
furbished the pledge to obey Him,

lines.transliteration: wa nasahtum lahu fi alssirri wal`alaniyati
lines.english: sincerely invited (people) to Him in private and in public,

lines.arabic: وَدَعَوْتُمْ إِلَى سَبِيلِهِ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa da`awtum ila sabilihi bilhikmati walmawdizati alhasanati
lines.english: called to His way with wisdom and fair exhortation,
sacrificed your lives for His pleasure,

lines.arabic: وَصَبَرْتُمْ عَلَى مَا أَصابَكُمْ فِي جَنْبِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa sabartum `ala ma asabakum fi janbihi
lines.english: remained patient against what afflicted you in His cause,
upheld the prayer,
gave the poor-rate,
enjoined the good,
forbade the evil,

lines.transliteration: wa jahadtum fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
lines.english: and strove for Allah with a strive that is His right,
until you declared His mission,
clarified His obligations,
uprooted His limits,
promulgated the laws of His judgments,
instituted His traditions,

lines.arabic: وَصِرْتُمْ فِي ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ إِلَى الرِّضا
lines.transliteration: wa sirtum fi dhalika minhu ila al-rida
lines.english: and by that you achieved His pleasure,
submitted to His decree,

lines.transliteration: wa saddaqtum min rusulihi man mada
lines.english: and confirmed the truth of the past Messengers of Him.
The truth is only that which you are pleased with,
the falsehood is only that which you have disliked,
the right is only that which you have enjoined,
the wrong is only that which you have forbidden,
the true friend is only he whom you have befriended,
the true enemy is only he whom you have opposed,
the beloved is only that which you have loved,
the hated is only that which you have hated.
Before Allah, I dissociate myself from your enemies,
in this world and in the Hereafter,

lines.arabic: وَمِنَ الْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ وَحِزْبِهِمُ الظَّالِمِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa mina aljibti walttaghuti walshhayatini wa hizbihimu alzhalimina
lines.english: and from the Jibt, the Taghut, the Satans, and their party of oppressors,
those who are cursed by Allah because of you.
I am a believer in your return and in your coming back,
a confirmer of your restoration,
waiting for your command, anticipating your state,
adhering to your words, a believer in your secret and in your public,

lines.transliteration: wa shahidikum wa gha'ibikum wa awwalikum wa akhirikum
lines.english: in your witness and in your absent, in your first and in your last,

lines.transliteration: wa mufawwidun fi dhalika kullihi ilaykum
lines.english: and I entrust all that to you,
and I submit in it along with you,
my heart is submitted to you,
and my opinion follows yours,
my support is prepared for you,

lines.arabic: حَتَّى يُحْيِيَ اللهُ تَعَالَى دِينَهُ بِكُمْ
lines.transliteration: hatta yuhyiya allahu ta`ala dinahu bikum
lines.english: until Allah, the Exalted, revives His religion through you,
and returns you in His days,
and makes you prevail for His justice,
and establishes you in His earth.
So, with you, with you, not with anyone other than you,

lines.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِكُمْ وَتَوَلَّيْتُ آخِرَكُمْ بِمَا تَوَلَّيْتُ بِهِ أَوَّلَكُمْ
lines.transliteration: amantu bikum wa tawalaytu akhirakum bima tawalaytu bihi awwalakum
lines.english: I believe in you and follow the last of you even as I follow the first of you.

lines.arabic: وَأَبْرَأُ إِلَى اللهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ مِنْ أَعْدائِكُمْ
lines.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi `azza wa jalla min a`da'ikum
lines.english: I dissociate myself before Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, from your enemies,

lines.arabic: وَمِنَ الْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ وَالشَّياطِينِ وَحِزْبِهِمُ الظَّالِمِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa mina aljibti walttaghuti walshhayatini wa hizbihimu alzhalimina
lines.english: and from the Jibt, the Taghut, the Satans, and their party of oppressors.

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتُمْ وَأُمِّي وَنَفْسِي وَأَهْلِي وَمالِي
lines.transliteration: bi-abi antum wa ummi wa nafsi wa ahli wa mali
lines.english: May my father, mother, soul, family, and property be a sacrifice for you.
He who intends Allah begins with you,
and he who proclaims His Uniqueness accepts (it) from you,
and he who searches for Him turns to you.
O my masters, I cannot count your praise,

lines.transliteration: wa la ablughu mina almadhi kunhakum
lines.english: and I cannot reach the essence of praising you,
and the extent of describing you.
You are the light of the best ones,
and the guides of the righteous,
and the arguments of the Compeller.

lines.transliteration: bikum fataha allahu wa bikum yakhtimu
lines.english: Through you Allah began and through you He ends,
and through you He sends down the rain,

lines.arabic: وَبِكُمْ يُمْسِكُ السَّماءَ أَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa bikum yumsiku alssama'a an taqa`a `ala al-ardi illa bi-idhnihi
lines.english: and through you He holds the sky from falling on the earth except by His permission,

lines.transliteration: wa bikum yunaffisu alhamma wa yakshifu alddurra
lines.english: and through you He removes the grief and dispels the distress.

lines.arabic: وَعِنْدَكُمْ مَا نَزَلَتْ بِهِ رُسُلُهُ وَهَبَطَتْ بِهِ مَلائِكَتُهُ
lines.transliteration: wa `indakum ma nazalat bihi rusuluhu wa habatat bihi mala'ikatuhu
lines.english: With you is what His Messengers brought and His angels descended with.

lines.transliteration: wa ila jaddikum bu`itha alrruhu al-aminu
lines.english: To your grandfather (the Prophet) the Trustworthy Spirit was sent.

lines.transliteration: bi-abi antum wa ummi wa nafsi
lines.english: May my father, mother, and soul be a sacrifice for you.

lines.arabic: طِبْتُمْ وَطابَتِ الأَرْضُ الَّتِي فِيهَا دُفِنْتُمْ
lines.transliteration: tibtum wa tabat al-ardu allati fiha dufintum
lines.english: You are pure and the earth in which you are buried is pure.
You have attained a great victory.

lines.arabic: يا وَلِيَّ اللهِ إِنَّ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ اللهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ذُنُوباً لا يَأْتِي عَلَيْهَا إِلاَّ رِضَاكُمْ
lines.transliteration: ya waliyya allahi inna bayni wa bayna allahi `azza wa jalla dhunuban la ya'ti `alayha illa ridakum
lines.english: O friend of Allah, indeed between me and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, there are sins that cannot be removed except by your pleasure.
So, by the right of Him who entrusted you with His secret,
and assigned to you the command over His creation,
and joined the obedience to you with His obedience,

lines.transliteration: lamma istawhabtum dhunubi wa kuntum shufa`a'i
lines.english: please ask for the forgiveness of my sins and be my intercessors.
For I am obedient to you.
He who obeys you has indeed obeyed Allah,
and he who disobeys you has indeed disobeyed Allah,
and he who loves you has indeed loved Allah,

lines.transliteration: wa man abghadakum faqad abghada allaha
lines.english: and he who hates you has indeed hated Allah.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي لَوْ وَجَدْتُ شُفَعاءَ أَقْرَبَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الأَخْيارِ الأَئِمَّةِ الأَبْرارِ لَجَعَلْتُهُمْ شُفَعائِي
lines.transliteration: allaahumma inni law wajadtu shufa`a'a aqraba ilayka min muhammadin wa ahli baytihi al-akhyari al-aimmati al-abrari laja`altuhum shufa`a'i
lines.english: O Allah! If I could find intercessors nearer to You than Muhammad and his excellent family, the pious Imams, I would have made them my intercessors.

lines.arabic: فَبِحَقِّهِمُ الَّذِي أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ عَلَيْكَ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُدْخِلَنِي فِي جُمْلَةِ الْعارِفِينَ بِهِمْ وَبِحَقِّهِمْ
lines.transliteration: fabihaqqihimu alladhi awjabta lahum `alayka as'aluka an tudkhilani fi jumlati al`arifina bihim wa bihaqqihim
lines.english: So, by the right which You have assigned to them, I ask You to include me among the group of those who recognize them and their right,
and among the group of those who are shown mercy because of their intercession.
Surely, You are the most Merciful of the merciful.

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً كَثِيراً
lines.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina wa sallama tasliman kathiran
lines.english: And Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad and his pure family and many salutations.

lines.transliteration: wa hasbuna allahu wa ni`ma al-wakilu
lines.english: And Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Trustee.

title: Ziyarat Aimmatul Momineen
description: This form of ziyarah can be said during visiting all the Holy Imams in all months and days. In his book of Misbah al-Za'ir, Sayyid Ibn Tawus has reported this form of ziyarah from the Holy Imams (peace be upon them).

lines.english: Recite this when you do Ghusl for performing the ziyarah,
In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),
in the way of Allah (I proceed),
and on the creed of the Messenger of Allah.
O Allah, (please do) cleanse me from the filth of sins
and the dirt of defects,
purify me with the water of repentance,
dress me the garb of protection (against sinning),

lines.arabic: وَأَيِّدْنِي بِلُطْفٍ مِنْكَ يُوَفِّقُنِي لِصَالِحِ ٱلأَعْمَالِ
lines.transliteration: wa ayyidni bilutfin minka yuwaffiquni lisalihi al-a`mali
lines.english: and aid me with Your compassion on account of which You may lead me to (doing) righteous deeds.
You are verily the Lord of great favor.
When you approach the gate of the shrine, you may say the following words:

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي وَفَّقَنِي لِقَصْدِ وَلِيِّهِ
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi waffaqani liqasdi waliyyihi
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who has led me to come to His intimate servant
and to visit His argument-person (against creatures)
and has allowed me to enter the precinct of him (i.e. His intimate servant);

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ يَبْخَسْنِي حَظِّي مِنْ زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa lam yabkhasni hazzi min ziyarati qabrihi
lines.english: thus, He has not deprived me of the opportunity to visit the tomb of him
and to stay at the patio of his shrine
and at the courtyard of his grave.

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَسِمْنِي بِحِرْمَانِ مَا أَمَّلْتُهُ
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yasimni bihirmani ma ammaltuhu
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who has not decided for me the deprivation of that which I hope,
has not prevented me against that for which I have longed

lines.transliteration: wa la qata`a raja'i fima tawaqqa`tuhu
lines.english: and has not disappointed me as regards that which I have anticipated;
rather, He has dressed me good health from Him,
bestowed upon me with His grace,
and granted me His honoring.
If you enter the shrine, you may stop at the pure tomb and say the following words:
Peace be upon you, O the Imams of the believers,
the chiefs of the pious,
the heads of the truthful,
the princes of the righteous,
the leaders of the good-doers,
the epitomes of the truly guided ones,
the light for the cognizant,
the inheritors of the Prophets,
the choicest of the Prophet’s successors,
the sunlight of the devout ones,
the full moons of the vicegerents (of the Prophets),
the (true) servants of the All-beneficent,
the partners of the Qur’an,
the course to the (true) faith,
the essences of the realities,
and the interceders for the beings.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
I bear witness that You are the doors to Allah,
the clues to (attaining) His mercy,
the keys to His forgiveness,
the clouds of His pleasure,
the lanterns of the gardens of His Paradise,
the carriers of His distinguishing Book,
the hoarders of His knowledge,
the keepers of His secret,
and the place of the descent of His revelation.
The trusts of prophethood are possessed by you.
So are the charges of the Divine Message.
You are Allah’s trustees, well-beloved,
servants, and choicest ones.
You are also the supporter of (the creed of) His Oneness,
the pillars of glorifying Him,
the callers to (the belief in) His Books,
the guardians over His beings,
and the custodians of His trusts.

lines.arabic: لاَ يَسْبِقُكُمْ ثَنَاءُ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةِ فِي ٱلإِخْلاَصِ وَٱلْخُشُوعِ
lines.transliteration: la yasbiqukum thana'u almala'ikati fi al-ikhlasi walkhushu`i
lines.english: Neither the praising of the angels with all of its sincerity and reverence can precede Yours

lines.transliteration: wa la yudaddukum dhu ibtihalin wa khudu`in
lines.english: nor can any earnest suppliant and pious one compare himself to Yours.

lines.arabic: أَنَّىٰ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِي تَوَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ رِيَاضَتَهَا بِٱلْخَوْفِ وَٱلرَّجَاءِ
lines.transliteration: anna wa lakumu alqulubu allati tawalla allahu riyadataha bilkhawfi walrraja'i
lines.english: How can that be! While your hearts are these which Allah Himself has schooled with means of fear and hope for Him,
made containers of thanksgiving and praising Him,
secured against even accidental inattentiveness,

lines.transliteration: wa saffaha min su'i shawaghili alfatrati
lines.english: and purified from the evil of languor.
More exactly, the inhabitants of the heaves seek nearness [to Allah] through their love for you
and disavowal of your enemies,
and through persistent weeping for your misfortunes
and imploring for Allah’s forgiveness for your adherents and supporters.
I, hereby, ask Allah, my Creator, to witness for me,
and I ask His angels and Prophets to witness for me, too
and I ask you, too, O my masters, to witness for me
that I have full faith in your (divinely commissioned) leadership,
I fully believe in your Imamate,
I confess of your successorship (to prophethood),
I am aware of your unmatched rank,
I am certain of your infallibility,
I submit to your leadership,
I seek nearness to Allah through my love for you
and disavowal of your enemies,

lines.arabic: عَالِمٌ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ طَهَّرَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلْفَوَاحِشِ
lines.transliteration: `alimun bi'anna allaha qad tahharakum min alfawahishi
lines.english: I know for sure that Allah has purified you from indecencies,

lines.transliteration: ma zahara minha wa ma batana
lines.english: whether open or secret,

lines.transliteration: wa min kulli ribatin wa najasatin
lines.english: and from all suspicions, filth,
all ill deeds, and ignominy.

lines.arabic: وَمَنَحَكُمْ رَايَةَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّتِي مَنْ تَقَدَّمَهَا ضَلَّ
lines.transliteration: wa manahakum rayata alhaqqi allati man taqaddamaha dalla
lines.english: And He has granted you the pennon of the truth that whoever foregoes shall have missed the right way
and whoever lags behind shall have slipped.

lines.arabic: وَفَرَضَ طَاعَتَكُمْ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَسْوَدٍ وَأَبْيَضٍ
lines.transliteration: wa farada ta`atakum `ala kulli aswadin wa abyadin
lines.english: He has imposed the obedience to you upon all beings, be them black or white.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكُمْ قَدْ وَفَيْتُمْ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَذِمَّتِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annakum qad wafaytum bi`ahdi allahi wa dhimmatihi
lines.english: I also bear witness that you have verily fulfilled your pledge and promise to Allah

lines.arabic: وَبِكُلِّ مَا ٱشْتَرَطَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي كِتَابِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa bikulli ma ishtarata `alaykum fi kitabihi
lines.english: and carried out all that which He stipulated on you in His Book.
You also called for (following) His Path,
exerted all your efforts in seeking His pleasure,

lines.arabic: وَحَمَلْتُمُ ٱلْخَلاَئِقَ عَلَىٰ مِنْهَاجِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةِ وَمَسَالِكِ ٱلرِّسَالَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa hamaltum alkhalaiqa `ala minhaji alnnubuwwati wa masaliki alrrisalati
lines.english: led the beings to the course of Prophethood and the paths of the Divine Message,
and dealt with them according to the norm of the Prophets
and the customs of the Prophets’ successors.
Nonetheless, none of your instructions was carried out,
and none lent you any ear.
So, Allah’s blessings be upon your souls and your bodies.

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya hujjata allahi
lines.english: May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you, O Argument of Allah.
You were certainly fed by the breast of faith,
weaned on the illumination of Islam,
nourished on the utter certitude,
dressed the garments of infallibility,
chosen and inherited the knowledge of the Book,
and prompted the decisive speech.

lines.arabic: وَأُوضِحَ بِمَكَانِكَ مَعَارِفُ ٱلتَّنْزِيلِ وَغَوَامِضُ ٱلتَّأْوِيلِ
lines.transliteration: wa udiha bimakanika ma`arifu alttanzili wa ghawamidu altta'wili
lines.english: Through your position were the knowledge of the Divine Revelation and the mysteries of the interpretation (of the Qur’an) made clear.
To you was the pennon of the truth delivered.
You were charged with guiding the beings.
