To you was the pledge of Imamate given exclusively.
You were assigned to preserve the religious law.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ أَنَّكَ وَفَيْتَ بِشَرَائِطِ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu ya mawlaya annaka wafayta bishara'iti alwasiyyati
lines.english: I also bear witness, O my master, that you met all the qualifications of successorship,

lines.arabic: وَقَضَيْتَ مَا لَزِمَكَ مِنْ حَدِّ ٱلطَّاعَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa qadayta ma lazimaka min haddi altta`ati
lines.english: settled all your obligations as regards the obedience (to Allah),
carried successfully all the burdens of Imamate,

lines.arabic: وَٱحْتَذَيْتَ مِثَالَ ٱلنُّبُوَّةِ فِي ٱلصَّبْرِ وَالِٱجْتِهَادِ
lines.transliteration: wahtadhayta mithala alnnubuwwati fi alssabri walijtihadi
lines.english: and followed the example of prophethood in endurance, exertion of all possible efforts,
giving advice to the servants,
suppressing your rage, and pardoning the people.
You were also determined to act fairly with the creatures
and to be just in all issues.

lines.arabic: وَوَكَّدْتَ ٱلْحُجَجَ عَلَىٰ ٱلأُمَّةِ بِٱلدَّلاَئِلِ ٱلصَّادِقَةِ وَٱلشَّرِيعَةِ ٱلنَّاطِقَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa wakkadta alhujaja `ala al-ummati bilddala'ili alssadiqati walshshari`ati alnnatiqati
lines.english: You confirmed all the claims (of Allah) on the community through irrefutable proofs and through the speaking law

lines.arabic: وَدَعَوْتَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ ٱلْبَالِغَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa da`awta ila allahi bilhikmati albalighati walmaw`izati alhasanati
lines.english: and called to the way of Allah with wisdom and fair exhortation.

lines.arabic: فَمَنَعْتَ مِنْ تَقْوِيمِ ٱلزَّيْغِ وَسَدِّ ٱلثُّلَمِ
lines.transliteration: famana`ta min taqwimi alzzayghi wa saddi alththulami
lines.english: You thus stood against any rise of doubt and worked on rectifying all furrows,

lines.transliteration: wa islahi alfasidi wa kasri almu`anidi
lines.english: mending the wrong, beating the stubborn evildoer,

lines.transliteration: wa ihya'i alssunani wa imatati albida`i
lines.english: reviving the norms (of the Prophets), and annihilating the heresies

lines.transliteration: hatta faraqta alddunya wa anta shahidun
lines.english: until you departed this life as martyr

lines.arabic: وَلَقِيتَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَأَنْتَ حَمِيدٌ
lines.transliteration: wa laqita rasula allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa anta hamidun
lines.english: and met the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his Household, as praiseworthy.
May the blessings of Allah continue on you incessantly and increasingly.

lines.arabic: يَا سَادَتِي يَا آلَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: ya sadati ya ala rasuli allahi
lines.english: O my masters! O Household of Allah’s Messenger!

lines.arabic: إِنِّي بِكُمْ أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ جَلَّ وَعَلاَ
lines.transliteration: inni bikum ataqarrabu ila allahi jalla wa `ala
lines.english: In your names do I seek nearness to Allah the All-majestic and All-elevated

lines.arabic: بِٱلْخِلاَفِ عَلَىٰ ٱلَّذِينَ غَدَرُوٱ بِكُمْ وَنَكَثُوٱ بَيْعَتَكُمْ
lines.transliteration: bilkhilafi `ala alladhina ghadaru bikum wa nakathu bay`atakum
lines.english: by dissenting from those who betrayed you, breached their allegiance to you,

lines.transliteration: wa jahadu wilayatakum wa ankaru manzilatakum
lines.english: denied your leadership, renounced your position,

lines.arabic: وَخَلَعُوٱ رِبْقَةَ طَاعَتِكُمْ وَهَجَرُوٱ أَسْبَابَ مَوَدَّتِكُمْ
lines.transliteration: wa khala`u ribqata ta`atikum wa hajaru asbaba mawaddatikum
lines.english: gave up their obedience to you, abandoned the love for you,

lines.arabic: وَتَقَرَّبُوٱ إِلَىٰ فَرَاعِنَتِهِمْ بِٱلْبَرَاءَةِ مِنْكُمْ وَٱلإِعْرَاضِ عَنْكُمْ
lines.transliteration: wa taqarrabu ila fara`inatihim bilbara'ati minkum wal-i`radi `ankum
lines.english: curried favor with their tyrant rulers through disavowing and rejecting you,

lines.arabic: وَمَنَعُوكُمْ مِنْ إِقَامَةِ ٱلْحُدُودِ وَٱسْتِيصَالِ ٱلْجُحُودِ
lines.transliteration: wa mana`ukum min iqamati alhududi wastisali aljuhudi
lines.english: prevented you from carrying out the religious laws, eradicating atheism,

lines.transliteration: wa sha`bi alssad`i wa lammi alshsha`athi
lines.english: setting right the split, rejoining the scattered,

lines.transliteration: wa saddi alkhalali wa tathqifi al-awadi
lines.english: meeting the deficiency, straightening the crookedness,

lines.arabic: وَإِمْضَاءِ ٱلأَحْكَامِ وَتَهْذِيبِ ٱلإِسْلاَمِ وَقَمْعِ ٱلآثَامِ
lines.transliteration: wa imda'i al-ahkami wa tahdhibi al-islami wa qam`i al-athami
lines.english: executing the divine laws, refining Islam, and restraining sins;
they stirred up the dust of wars and seditions against you,
unsheathed the swords of malice against you,
rent your coverings,
bought wines with the khumus levy that is decided for you exclusively,

lines.arabic: وَصَرَفُوٱ صَدَقَاتِ ٱلْمَسَاكِينِ إِلَىٰ ٱلْمُضْحِكِينَ وَٱلسَّاخِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa sarafu sadaqati almasakini ila almudhikina walssakhirina
lines.english: and paid the alms that are decided for the poor to the clowns and jokers.

lines.arabic: وَذٰلِكَ بِمَا طَرَّقَتْ لَهُمُ ٱلْفَسَقَةُ ٱلْغُوَاةُ وَٱلْحَسَدَةُ ٱلْبُغَاةُ
lines.transliteration: wa dhalika bima tarraqat lahumu alfasaqatu alghuwatu walhasadatu albughatu
lines.english: All that was because of the urging practices of the licentious, the aberrant, the envious, and the oppressors;
the people of breach, treachery, rebellion, and deceit;
whose hearts are evil-smelling due to the filth of polytheism,
and whose bodies are suffocated with the dirt of atheism.

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ أَضَبُّوٱ عَلَىٰ ٱلنِّفَاقِ وَأَكَبُّوٱ عَلَىٰ عَلاَئِقِ ٱلشِّقَاقِ
lines.transliteration: alladhina adabbu `ala alnnifaqi wa akabbu `ala `ala'iqi alshshiqaq
lines.english: It is they who embraced hypocrisy and buckled down to dissension.

lines.arabic: فَلَمَّا مَضَىٰ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱخْتَطَفُوٱ ٱلْغِرَّةَ وَٱنْتَهَزُوٱ ٱلْفُرْصَةَ وَٱنْتَهَكُوٱ ٱلْحُرْمَةَ
lines.transliteration: falamma mada almustafa salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi ikhtatafu alghirrata wa intahazu alfursata wa intahaku alhurmata
lines.english: So, when the Chosen Prophet, Allah’s peace be upon him and his Household, passed away, they seized the opportunity, took the occasion, and violated the sanctity.
They left him bed-ridden

lines.arabic: وَأَسْرَعُوٱ لِنَقْضِ ٱلْبَيْعَةِ وَمُخَالَفَةِ ٱلْمَوَاثِيقِ ٱلْمُؤَكَّدَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa asra`u linaqdi albay`ati wa mukhalafati almawathiqi almu'akkadati
lines.english: and hurried to preach their allegiance, break the covenants that had been confirmedly taken from them,

lines.arabic: وَخِيَانَةِ ٱلأَمَانَةِ ٱلْمَعْرُوضَةِ عَلَىٰ ٱلْجِبَالِ ٱلرَّاسِيَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa khiyanati al-amanati alma`rudati `ala aljibali alrrasiyati
lines.english: betray the Trust that had been offered to the unshakable mountains

lines.arabic: وَأَبَتْ أَنْ تَحْمِلَهَا وَحَمَلَهَا ٱلإِنْسَانُ ٱلظَّلُومُ ٱلْجَهُولُ
lines.transliteration: wa abat an tahmilaha wa hamalaha al-insanu alzzalumu aljahulu
lines.english: but they (i.e. the mountains) refused to undergo; rather, man, the wronging and ignorant, accepted to assume it.
Man is actually dissenting, obstinate to committing grave sins,
and disdaining from submission to that whose end result is praiseworthy.

lines.arabic: فَحُشِرَ سِفْلَةُ ٱلأَعْرَابِ وَبَقَايَا ٱلأَحْزَابِ إِلَىٰ دَارِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةِ وَٱلرِّسَالَةِ
lines.transliteration: fahushira siflatu al-a`rabi wa baqaya al-ahzabi ila dari alnnubuwwati walrrisalati
lines.english: Hence, the lowly Bedouins and the rest of the parties (who had allied each other against the Holy Prophet) were gathered to the abode of the prophethood, Divine Message,
Divine Revelation and angels,
the center of the authority of the (divinely commissioned) leadership (of the Holy Imams),
and the core of the Prophet’s successorship, inheritance, and Imamate.

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ نَقَضُوٱ عَهْدَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ فِي أَخِيهِ عَلَمِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
lines.transliteration: hatta naqadu `ahda almustafa fi akhihi `alami alhuda
lines.english: They therefore preached the covenant (that they had made) to the Chosen Prophet as regards the leadership of his brother, the sign of true guidance (namely, Imam `Ali)

lines.arabic: وَٱلْمُبَيِّنِ طَرِيقَ ٱلنَّجَاةِ مِنْ طُرُقِ ٱلرَّدَىٰ
lines.transliteration: walmubayyini tariqa alnnajati min turuqi alrrada
lines.english: who alone can distinguish the path of salvation from these of perdition,

lines.arabic: وَجَرَحُوٱ كَبِدَ خَيْرِ ٱلْوَرَىٰ فِي ظُلْمِ ٱبْنَتِهِ وَٱضْطِهَادِ حَبِيبَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa jarahu kabida khayri alwara fi zulmi ibnatihi wa idtihadi habibatihi
lines.english: and they injured the heart of the best of beings (namely, the Holy Prophet) when they oppressed and wronged his daughter; the much-loved one to him,

lines.arabic: وَٱهْتِضَامِ عَزِيزَتِهِ بَضْعَةِ لَحْمِهِ وَفِلْذَةِ كَبِدِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa ihtidami `azizatihi bad`ati lahmihi wa fildhati kabidihi
lines.english: aggrieved his dearest one; the part of his flesh and the piece of his heart,

lines.transliteration: wa khadhalu ba`laha wa saghgharu qadrahu
lines.english: disappointed her husband, belittled him,

lines.transliteration: wa istahallu maharimahu wa qata`u rahimahu
lines.english: violated his sanctities, ruptured relations of kinship with him,

lines.transliteration: wa ankaru ukhuwwatahu wa hajaru mawaddatahu
lines.english: denied his fraternity (with the Holy Prophet), neglected his love for him,
defied their (obligatory) obedience to him, denied his leadership (over them),
gave even the slaves the opportunity to seize his position of leadership,

lines.arabic: وَقَادُوهُ إِلَىٰ بَيْعَتِهِمْ مُصْلِتَةً سُيُوفَهَا مُقْذِعَةً أَسِنَّتَهَا
lines.transliteration: wa qaduhu ila bay`atihim muslitatan suyufaha muqdhi`atan asinnataha
lines.english: and led him to swear allegiance to them under unsheathed swords and directed spears

lines.transliteration: wa huwa sakhitu alqalbi ha'iju alghadabi
lines.english: while he was extremely irritated and enormously wrathful,
but very patient and self-possessed.

lines.arabic: يَدْعُونَهُ إِلَىٰ بَيْعَتِهِمُ ٱلَّتِي عَمَّ شُومُهَا ٱلإِسْلاَمَ
lines.transliteration: yad`unahu ila bay`atihim allati `amma shumuha al-islama
lines.english: They were asking him to swear allegiance to their rulership whose misfortune prevailed in Islam absolutely

lines.transliteration: wa zara`at fi qulubi ahliha al-athama
lines.english: and planted sins in the hearts of the Muslims.
They therefore acted insubordinately towards Salman, banished al-Miqdad,

lines.transliteration: wa nafat jundubaha wa fataqat batna `ammariha
lines.english: exiled Jundub, tore the abdomen of `Ammar,

lines.arabic: وَحَرَّفَتِ ٱلْقُرْآنَ وَبَدَّلَتِ ٱلأَحْكَامَ وَغَيَّرَتِ ٱلْمَقَامَ
lines.transliteration: wa harrafat alqur'ana wa baddalat al-ahkama wa ghayyarat almaqama
lines.english: distorted the (true interpretation of the) Qur’an, misrepresented the religious laws, changed the place of al-maqam,
gave free hand to the Released Ones to dispose of the khumus tax,

lines.arabic: وَسَلَّطَتْ أَوْلاَدَ ٱللُّعَنَاءِ عَلَىٰ ٱلْفُرُوجِ وَٱلدِّمَاءِ
lines.transliteration: wa sallatat awlada allu`ana'i `ala alfuruji walddima'i
lines.english: set up the descendants of the accursed ones as absolute rulers over the honors and blood (of Muslims),
intermixed the lawful with the unlawful,
belittled faith and Islam,

lines.arabic: وَهَدَمَتِ ٱلْكَعْبَةَ وَأَغَارَتْ عَلَىٰ دَارِ ٱلْهِجْرَةِ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَرَّةِ
lines.transliteration: wa hadamat alka`bata wa agharat `ala dari alhijrati yawma alharrati
lines.english: demolished the (Holy) Ka`bah, raided the abode of the (Holy Prophet’s) immigration on the day of al-Harrah Raid,

lines.arabic: وَأَبْرَزَتْ بَنَاتِ ٱلْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَٱلأَنْصَارِ لِلنَّكَالِ وَٱلسَّوْرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa abrazat banati almuhajirina wal-ansari lilnnakali walssawrati
lines.english: subjected the daughters of the Emigrants and the Supporters to punishment and humiliation,
caused them to dress the garments of disgrace and scandal,

lines.arabic: وَرَخَّصَتْ لأَهْلِ ٱلشُّبْهَةِ فِي قَتْلِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ ٱلصَّفْوَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa rakhkhasat li'ahli alshshubhati fi qatli ahli bayti alssafwati
lines.english: and allowed the suspicious people to massacre the choice Household (of the Holy Prophet),

lines.transliteration: wa ibadati naslihi wa istisali sha'fatihi
lines.english: to eradicate his (i.e. the Holy Prophet) offspring, to eliminate his progeny,

lines.transliteration: wa sabyi haramihi wa qatli ansarihi
lines.english: to capture his harem, to kill his supporters,

lines.transliteration: wa kasri minbarihi wa qalbi mafkharihi
lines.english: to destroy his minbar, to turn over his object of pride,

lines.transliteration: wa ikhfa'i dinihi wa qat`i dhikrihi
lines.english: to conceal his religion, and to cut off his mention.

lines.arabic: يَا مَوَالِيَّ فَلَوْ عَايَنَكُمُ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ وَسِهَامُ ٱلأُمَّةِ مُغْرَقَةٌ فِي أَكْبَادِكُمْ
lines.transliteration: ya mawaliyya falaw `ayanakum almustafa wa sihamu al-ummati mughraqatun fi akbadikum
lines.english: O my masters, had the Chosen Prophet seen how the lances of the community (of him) were infixed in your hearts,
how their spears were inserted into your throats,
and how their swords are covered with your blood,

lines.arabic: يَشْفِي أَبْنَاءُ ٱلْعَوَاهِرِ غَلِيلَ ٱلْفِسْقِ مِنْ وَرَعِكُمْ
lines.transliteration: yashfi abna'u al`awahiri ghalila alfisqi min wara`ikum
lines.english: while the sons of whores were quenching their thirst of licentiousness from your godliness,
their thirst of atheism from your faith,

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتُمْ بَيْنَ صَرِيعٍ فِي ٱلْمِحْرَابِ قَدْ فَلَقَ ٱلسَّيْفُ هَامَتَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa antum bayna sari`in fi almihrabi qad falaqa alssayfu hamatahu
lines.english: and one of you was thrown down in the niche while his head is split by sword,

lines.arabic: وَشَهِيدٍ فَوْقَ ٱلْجَنَازَةِ قَدْ شُكَّتْ أَكْفَانُهُ بِٱلسِّهَامِ
lines.transliteration: wa shahidin fawqa aljanazati qad shukkat akfanuhu bilssihami
lines.english: another one was martyred and during his funeral procession arrows heavily stuck his coffin,

lines.arabic: وَقَتِيلٍ بِٱلْعَرَاءِ قَدْ رُفِعَ فَوْقَ ٱلْقَنَاةِ رَأْسُهُ
lines.transliteration: wa qatilin bil`ara'i qad rufi`a fawqa alqanati ra'suhu
lines.english: another one was slain and his body was left in the wasteland while his head was raised on a spearhead,

lines.arabic: وَمُكَبَّلٍ فِي ٱلسِّجْنِ قَدْ رُضَّتْ بِٱلْحَدِيدِ أَعْضَاؤُهُ
lines.transliteration: wa mukabbalin fi alssijni qad ruddat bilhadidi a`da'uhu
lines.english: another one was enchained in the prison while fetters slept in his limbs,

lines.arabic: وَمَسْمُومٍ قَدْ قُطِّعَتْ بِجُرَعِ ٱلسُّمِّ أَمْعَاؤُهُ
lines.transliteration: wa masmumin qad qutti`at bijura`i alssummi am`a'uhu
lines.english: another one was poisoned and poison cut his intestine into parts,

lines.arabic: وَشَمْلُكُمْ عَبَادِيدُ تُفْنِيهِمُ ٱلْعَبِيدُ وَأَبْنَاءُ ٱلْعَبِيدِ
lines.transliteration: wa shamlukum `abadidu tufnihim al`abidu wa abna'u al`abidi
lines.english: and your people are thus scattered; they were terminated by the slaves and the slaves’ sons!

lines.arabic: فَهَلِ ٱلْمِحَنُ يَا سَادَتِي إِلاَّ ٱلَّتِي لَزِمَتْكُمْ
lines.transliteration: fahal almihanu ya sadati illa allati lazimatkum
lines.english: Are ordeals other than those which escorted you?
Are misfortunes other than those which afflicted you?
Are catastrophes other than those which affected you?
Are disasters other than those which distressed you?
Allah’s blessings be upon you
and upon your souls and your bodies.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
You may then move to the side of the feet and say the following words:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ صِفْوَةِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha adama sifwati allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam, the choice of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوحٍ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha nuhin nabiyyi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah, the prophet of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ibrahima khalili allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham, the intimate friend of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ كَلِيمِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa kalimi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses, the spoken to by Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيسَىٰ رُوحِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus, the spirit of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَبِيبِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha muhammadin habibi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad, the beloved of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha amiri almu'minina waliyyi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the Commander of the Believers, the intimate servant of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ الْحَسَنِ الزَّكِيِّ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of al-Hasan, the pure.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ الْحُسَيْنِ الشَّهيدِ الصِّدّيقِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha al-husayni al-shahidi al-siddiqi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of al-Husayn, the martyr, the truthful.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
You may then kiss the tomb and say the following words:

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتُمْ وَأُمِّي يَا آلَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi antum wa ummi ya ala almustafa
lines.english: May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you, O Household of the Chosen Prophet.

lines.arabic: إِنَّا لاَ نَمْلِكُ إِلاَّ أَنْ نَطُوفَ حَوْلَ مَشَاهِدِكُمْ
lines.transliteration: inna la namliku illa an natufa hawla mashahidikum
lines.english: We have nothing to do more than circumambulating your shrines
so as to console your souls

lines.arabic: عَلَىٰ هٰذِهِ ٱلْمَصَائِبِ ٱلْعَظِيمَةِ ٱلْحَالَّةِ بِفِنَائِكُمْ
lines.english: for such grave misfortunes that afflicted you
and unbearable hardships that distressed you;

lines.arabic: ٱلَّتِي أَثْبَتَتْ فِي قُلُوبِ شِيعَتِكُمُ ٱلْقُرُوحَ
lines.transliteration: allati athbatat fi qulubi shi`atikumu alquruha
lines.english: such hardships that fixed wounds in the hearts of your adherents,
installed injuries in their interiors,
and implanted pains in their chests.

lines.arabic: فَنَحْنُ نُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ أَنَّا قَدْ شَارَكْنَا أَوْلِيَاءَكُمْ وَأَنْصَارَكُمُ
lines.transliteration: fanahnu nushhidu allaha anna qad sharakna awliya'akum wa ansarakum
lines.english: So, we ask Allah to witness for us that we have participated with your allies and supporters

lines.arabic: ٱلْمُتَقَدِّمِينَ فِي إِرَاقَةِ دِمَاءِ ٱلنَّاكِثِينَ وَٱلْقَاسِطِينَ وَٱلْمَارِقِينَ
lines.transliteration: almutaqaddimina fi iraqati dima'i alnnakithina walqasitina walmariqina
lines.english: who passed in time, in the bloodshed of the preachers, the wrongdoers, and the apostates

lines.arabic: وَقَتَلَةِ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ سَيِّدِ شَبَابِ أَهْلِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
lines.transliteration: wa qatalati abi `abdi allahi sayyidi shababi ahli aljannati `alayhi alssalamu
lines.english: and of those who slain Abu-`Abdullah the chief of the youth of Paradise, peace be upon him
on that day in Karbala' yet in intentions and hearts

lines.arabic: وَٱلتَّأَسُّفِ عَلَىٰ فَوْتِ تِلْكَ ٱلْمَوَاقِفِ ٱلَّتِي حَضَرُوٱ لِنُصْرَتِكُمْ
lines.transliteration: waltta'assufi `ala fawti tilka almawaqifi allati hadaru linusratikum
lines.english: and in feeling sorry for missing these situations that your allies and supporters witnessed and backed you.
Peace from us be upon you.
Allah’s mercy and blessings, too, be upon you.
You may then stand between the tomb and the kiblah direction and say the following words:

lines.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذي تَوَحَّدَ بِالْعِزِ وَالْبَقاءِ
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi tawahhada bil-`izzi wal-baqa'
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who is the Only One in magnificence and permanence,

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا ٱلْقُدْرَةِ ٱلَّتِي صَدَرَ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَالَمُ مُكَوَّناً
lines.transliteration: allahumma ya dha alqudrati allati sadara `anha al`alamu mukawwanan
lines.english: O Allah! O Lord of the power due to which the world has been brought into existence,

lines.arabic: مَبْرُوءاً عَلَيْهَا مَفْطُوراً تَحْتَ ظِلِّ ٱلْعَظَمَةِ
lines.english: created, and originated under the shadow of magnificence.
So, the witnesses of Your making in it have witnessed

lines.arabic: بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
lines.transliteration: bi'annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: that You are Allah; there is no god save You,
the Maker, Creator, and Originator of it.
You have invented it from no precedent sample,
on account of nothing,
in nothing,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ لِوَحْشَةٍ دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْكَ إِذْ لاَ غَيْرُكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la liwahshatin dakhalat `alayka idh la ghayruka
lines.english: not for feeling of loneliness that You may experience because there in none save You,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ حَاجَةٍ بَدَتْ لَكَ فِي تَكْوِينِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la hajatin badat laka fi takwinihi
lines.english: not for any need that caused You to make it,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ لٱِسْتِعَانَةٍ مِنْكَ عَلَىٰ ٱلْخَلْقِ بَعْدَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa la listi`anatin minka `ala alkhalqi ba`dahu
lines.english: and not for the reason that it may help You create more after it.
Rather, You have formed it so that it would act as proof
(on the fact) that You are too far above being made.
So, the fair-minded cannot deny You
and the sound knowledgeable cannot refute You.
I thus beseech You by the honor of sincere belief in Your Oneness,
the holiness of abidance by Your Book,
and the Household of Your Prophet

lines.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ آدَمَ بَدِيعِ فِطْرَتِكَ وَبِكْرِ حُجَّتِكَ
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala adama badi`i fitratika wa bikri hujjatika
lines.english: to send blessings upon Adam the example on Your creation, the foremost of Your Argument,

lines.transliteration: wa lisani qudratika walkhalifati fi basitatika
lines.english: the spokesman of Your omnipotence, and the representative of You on Your lands
and upon Muhammad the choicest of Your choice,
the evidence on the recognition of You,
the profound, and the trustee on Your most hidden secrets
due to Your grace that You have bestowed upon him out of Your aid;

lines.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ مَنْ بَيْنَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ وَٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ وَٱلأَوْصِيَاءِ وَٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa `ala man baynahuma min alnnabiyyina walmukarramina wal-awsiya'i walssiddiqina
lines.english: and (send blessings) upon the Prophets, the honored ones, the Prophets’ successors, and the truthful ones who came between these two;
and to forgive me for the sake of this Imam, my leader.
You may then put your cheek on the pure tomb and say the following supplicatory words:

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِمَحَلِّ هٰذَا ٱلسَّيِّدِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَبِمَنْزِلَتِهِ عِنْدَكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma bimahalli hadha alssayyidi min ta`atika wa bimanzilatihi `indaka
lines.english: O Allah, (I beseech You) by the position of this chief as regards his obedience to You and by the rank of him with You,

lines.arabic: لاَ تُمِتْنِي فُجَاءَةً وَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي تَوْبَةً
lines.transliteration: la tumitni fuja'atan wa la tahrimni tawbatan
lines.english: do not grasp my soul suddenly, do not deprive me of repentance,

lines.arabic: وَٱرْزُقْنِي ٱلْوَرَعَ عَنْ مَحَارِمِكَ دِيناً وَدُنْياً
lines.transliteration: warzuqni alwara`a `an maharimika dinan wa dunyan
lines.english: make me stop at the worldly and religious matters that You have deemed forbidden,
make my engagement in the affairs of my Next World distract me from the affairs of this worldly life,

lines.transliteration: wa waffiqni lima tuhibbu wa tarda
lines.english: lead me successfully to all that which You please and like,
and keep me away from following my own whims
and being seduced by abortive acts and deceitful expectations.
O Allah, (please do) make all my speech apposite,
all my deeds correct,

lines.transliteration: walssidqa walwafa'a fi damani wa wa`di
lines.english: and all my pledges and covenants truthful and honest,

lines.transliteration: walhifza wal-inasa maqrunayni bi`ahdi wa wa`di
lines.english: add fulfillment and amiability to my oaths and promises,

lines.transliteration: walbirra wal-ihsana min sha'ni wa khuluqi
lines.english: add righteousness and good-doing to my conduct and morals,
grant me comprehensive safety,
make good health encompass and include me,

lines.transliteration: wa latifa sun`ika wa `awnika masrufan ilayya
lines.english: make Your kind making and aid direct towards me,

lines.transliteration: wa husna tawfiqika wa yusrika mawfuran `alayya
lines.english: make Your granting of success and prosperity flow towards me abundantly,
make me live, O my Lord, with happiness,
grasp my soul as martyr,

lines.transliteration: wa tahhirni lilmawti wa ma ba`dahu
lines.english: and purify me for death and what is beyond.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَٱجْعَلِ ٱلصِّحَّةَ وَٱلنُّورَ فِي سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي
lines.transliteration: allahumma waj`al alssihhata walnnura fi sam`i wa basari
lines.english: O Allah, add health and light to my hearing and sight,
add straightness and goodness to my courses,

lines.transliteration: walhuda walbasirata fi dini wa madhhabi
lines.english: add true guidance and insight to my belief and faith,
make the Scale of deeds always before my eyes,
make remembrance of You and exhortation to be my layer and cover,
make ponderation and learning lessons (from others) to be my entertainment and basis,
make my heart open it doors to conviction,
make it the most certain thing in myself,
make it prevail on my views and determinations,
add true direction to my deeds,
make my submission to Your decisions to be my bed and my support,

lines.arabic: وَٱلرِّضَا بِقَضَائِكَ وَقَدَرِكَ أَقْصَىٰ عَزْمِي وَنِهَايَتِي
lines.transliteration: walrrida biqada'ika wa qadarika aqsa `azmi wa nihayati
lines.english: and make my satisfaction with Your acts to be my utmost purpose, end result,
and the furthest of my reason and intention

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ لاَ أَتَّقِيَ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ بِدِينِي
lines.transliteration: hatta la attaqiya ahadan min khalqika bidini
lines.english: so that I shall not fear anybody in matters appertained to my religion,

lines.transliteration: wa la atluba bihi ghayra akhirati
lines.english: I shall intend for nothing other than success in my Next Life,

lines.transliteration: wa la astad`iya minhu itra'i wa madhi
lines.english: and I shall not hope for praise or approval for it.
And (please do) make my end result to be the best of all,
make my destiny to be the best of all,
make my livelihood to be the most luxurious of all,
lead me to the truest guidance,
make my portion to be the most abundant,

lines.transliteration: wa azala al-aqsami qismi wa nasibi
lines.english: make my share to be the largest,

lines.arabic: وَكُنْ لِي يَا رَبِّ مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ وَلِيّاً
lines.transliteration: wa kun li ya rabbi min kulli su'in waliyyan
lines.english: and (please), O my Lord, be my guardian against all evils,

lines.transliteration: wa ila kulli khayrin dalilan wa qa'idan
lines.english: my guide and leader to all decencies,

lines.arabic: وَمِنْ كُلِّ بَاغٍ وَحَسُودٍ ظَهِيراً وَمَانِعاً
lines.transliteration: wa min kulli baghin wa hasudin zahiran wa mani`an
lines.english: and my backer and protector against all oppressors and envious ones.
O Allah, to You do I resort, with You do I seek protection,
in You do I trust, from You do I seek success,
from You do I derive might and power,
in Your hands are my life and death,

lines.transliteration: wa fi qabdatika sukuni wa harakati
lines.english: under Your control are all my stillness and motions,

lines.transliteration: wa inna bi`urwatika alwuthqa istimsaki wa wuslati
lines.english: by Your Firmest Handle do I abide, to it do I connect,

lines.arabic: وَعَلَيْكَ فِي ٱلأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا ٱعْتِمَادِي وَتَوَكُّلِي
lines.transliteration: wa `alayka fi al-umuri kulliha i`timadi wa tawakkuli
lines.english: on You do I rely and depend in all of my affairs,

lines.arabic: وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمَسِّ سَقَرَ نَجَاتِي وَخَلاَصِي
lines.transliteration: wa min `adhabi jahannama wa massi saqara najati wa khalasi
lines.english: and from You do I seek salvation and redemption against the chastisement of Hell and the touch of Hellfire.

lines.arabic: وَفِي دَارِ أَمْنِكَ وَكَرَامَتِكَ مَثْوَايَ وَمُنْقَلَبِي
lines.transliteration: wa fi dari amnika wa karamatika mathwaya wa munqalabi
lines.english: So (please), decide my final house to be in the abode of Your security and honor

lines.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ أَيْدِي سَادَتِي وَمَوَالِيَّ آلِ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ فَوْزِي وَفَرَجِي
lines.transliteration: wa `ala aydi sadati wa mawaliyya ali almustafa fawzi wa faraji
lines.english: and my success and relief to be at the hands of my masters and chiefs the Household of the Chosen Prophet.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
forgive the believing men and women and Muslim men and women,

lines.transliteration: waghfir li wa liwalidayya wa ma walada
lines.english: forgive my parents, their descendants,
my family members, my neighbors,

lines.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ مَنْ قَلَّدَنِي يَداً مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
lines.transliteration: wa likulli man qalladani yadan min almu'minina walmu'minati
lines.english: and all the believing men and women for whom I concern.
Verily, You are the Lord of immense favor.

lines.transliteration: walssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

title: Ziyarat Jamia Saghira
description: Ziyarat Jamia Saghira (The Universal Salutation) is a shorter version of the comprehensive salutations of the Imams (as). It is highly recommended to be recited when visiting the shrines of the Imams or from a distance.

lines.english: Peace be upon Allah's friends and well-chosen ones!
Peace be upon Allah's trustees and beloved ones!
Peace be upon Allah's supporters and representatives!
Peace be upon the centers of the recognition of Allah!
Peace be upon the places of mentioning Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُظْهِرِي أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَنَهْيِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon the demonstrators of Allah's orders and prohibitions!
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala muzhiri amri allahi wa nahyihi

lines.english: Peace be upon the callers to Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمُسْتَقِرِّينَ فِي مَرْضَاتِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon those settling down at Allah's pleasure!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمُخْلِصِينَ فِي طَاعَةِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon those obeying Allah sincerely!
Peace be upon those guiding to Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلَّذِينَ مَنْ وَالاَهُمْ فَقَدْ وَالَىٰ ٱللَّهَ
lines.english: Peace be upon those the loyalty to whom is loyalty to Allah,
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala alladhina man walahum faqad wala allaha

lines.english: the hostility towards whom is hostility towards Allah,
the recognition of whom is recognition of Allah,
ignorance of whom is ignorance of Allah,
lines.transliteration: wa man jahilahum faqad jahila allaha

lines.arabic: وَمَنِ ٱعْتَصَمَ بِهِمْ فَقَدِ ٱعْتَصَمَ بِٱللَّهِ
lines.english: sticking to whom is sticking to Allah,
lines.transliteration: wa mani i`tasama bihim faqadi i`tasama billahi

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ تَخَلَّىٰ مِنْهُمْ فَقَدْ تَخَلَّىٰ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
lines.english: and abandonment of whom is abandonment of Allah the Almighty and All-majestic.
lines.transliteration: wa man takhalla minhum faqad takhalla min allahi `azza wa jalla

lines.arabic: وَأُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ أَنِّي سِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سَالَمْتُمْ
lines.english: And I call Allah to witness that I am at peace with those with whom you are at peace
lines.transliteration: wa ushhidu allaha anni silmun liman salamtum

lines.english: and at war with those with whom you are at war.
I believe in your secret and open affairs
and I am relegating all that to you.
May Allah curse the enemy of Muhammad's Household,
including the jinn and mankind,
and I disavow them in the presence of Allah.
May Allah bless Muhammad and his Household.
lines.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi

lines.english: You may then invoke Almighty Allah’s blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household, by mentioning their names respectively. You may also invoke Almighty Allah’s curse on their enemies and then pray Him for any thing you wish for yourself as well as the believing men and women.

In the last paragraph of the tradition, the Imam (peace be upon him) has ordered us to invoke blessings upon the Holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) and his Household and to mention their names one after another. It is therefore very fitting to say the form of invoking blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household, which is ascribed to Abu’l-Hasan al-Zarrab -

title: Ziyarat Third Jamea
description: This form of ziyarah has been reported by Sayyid Ibn Tawus within the supplicatory prayers of the Arafah Day from Imam al-Sadiq (as). It can be recited when visiting any shrine at any time.

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Messenger.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Prophet.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خِيَرَةَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s best choice among His creatures
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khiyarata allahi min khalqihi

lines.english: and His trustee on His revelations.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Commander of the Faithful.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya mawlaya ya amira almu'minina

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O my master.
You are Allah’s argument against His creatures,
the door to His knowledge,
the successor of His Prophet,
and the vicegerent after him among his nation.
May Allah curse the people who usurped your right
and took your place.
I repudiate them
and their partisans in your presence.
Peace be upon you, O Fatimah the chaste.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا زَيْنَ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O adornment of the women of the worlds.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Messenger of Allah the Lord of the worlds.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya binta rasuli rabbi al`alamina

lines.english: May Allah send blessings upon you and him.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O mother of al-Hasan and al-Husayn.
May Allah curse the people who usurped your right

lines.arabic: وَمَنَعَتْكِ مَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ لَكِ حَلاَلاًَ
lines.english: and deprived you of that which Allah has deemed lawful to you.
lines.transliteration: wa mana`atki ma ja`alahu allahu laki halalan

lines.arabic: أَنَا بَريءٌٌ إِِلَيْكِ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْ شِيعَتِهِمْ
lines.english: I repudiate them and their partisans in your presence.
lines.transliteration: ana bari' ilayki minhum wa min shi`atihim

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O my master
Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan the bright.
Peace be upon you, O my master.
May Allah curse the people who killed you,
swore allegiance to each other against you, and helped each other against you.
lines.transliteration: wa baya`at fi amrika wa shaya`at

lines.arabic: أَنَا بَرِيءٌ إِِلَيْكَ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْ شِيعَتِهِمْ
lines.english: I repudiate them and their partisans in your presence.
lines.transliteration: ana bari'un ilayka minhum wa min shi`atihim

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O my master

lines.arabic: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْحُسَيْنُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
lines.english: O Abu-`Abdullah al-Husayn the son of `Ali.
Allah’s blessings be upon you,
your father, and your grandfather Muhammad,
may Allah send blessings upon him and his Household.
May Allah curse the people who violated the shedding of your blood.
May Allah curse the people who slew you
and violated the sacredness of your women.
May Allah curse their partisans and followers.
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ashya`ahum wa atba`ahum

lines.english: May Allah curse those who paved the way to them
to fight against you.

lines.arabic: أَنَا بَرِيءٌ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَإِلَيْكَ مِنْهُمْ
lines.english: I repudiate them in the presence of Allah and you.
lines.transliteration: ana bari'un ila allahi wa ilayka minhum

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O my master

lines.arabic: يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلِيُّ بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.english: Abu-Muhammad `Ali the son of al-Husayn.
Peace be upon you, O my master

lines.arabic: يَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
lines.english: Abu-Ja`far Muhammad the son of `Ali.
Peace be upon you, O my master

lines.arabic: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ جَعْفَرُ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: Abu-`Abdullah Ja`far the son of Muhammad.
Peace be upon you, O my master

lines.arabic: يَا أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ مُوسَىٰ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ
lines.english: Abu’l-Hasan Musa ibn Ja`far.
lines.transliteration: ya aba alhasani musa bna ja`farin

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O my master

lines.arabic: يَا أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنَ موُسَىٰ
lines.english: Abu’l-Hasan `Ali ibn Musa.
Peace be upon you, O my master

lines.arabic: يَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
lines.english: Abu-Ja`far Muhammad the son of `Ali.
Peace be upon you, O my master

lines.arabic: يَا أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: Abu’l-Hasan `Ali the son of Muhammad.
Peace be upon you, O my master

lines.arabic: يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْحَسَنُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
lines.english: Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan the son of `Ali.
Peace be upon you, O my master

lines.arabic: يَا أَبَا ٱلْقَاسِمِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ ٱلْحَسَنِ
lines.english: Abu’l-Qasim Muhammad the son of al-Hasan
lines.transliteration: ya aba alqasimi muhammadu bna alhasani

lines.english: the patron of the age.
May Allah send blessings upon you
and upon your family, the immaculate and pure.
O my masters, be my intercessors
in the forgiveness of my burdens and sins.
I believe in Allah in what has been revealed to you.
lines.transliteration: amantu billahi wa bima unzila ilaykum

lines.english: I swear to the last of you the same loyalty that I swear to the first.
lines.transliteration: wa atawala akhirakum bima atawala awwalakum

lines.english: I repudiate all idols, false deities,
Idol Lat, and Idol al-`Uzza.

lines.arabic: يَا مَوَالِيَّ أَنَا سِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سَالَمَكُمْ
lines.english: O my masters, I am at peace with those who are at peace with you,
lines.transliteration: ya mawaliyya ana silmun liman salamakum

lines.english: I am at war against those who are at war against you,
I am the enemy of those who show enmity towards you,
and I am loyal to those who are loyalists to you
up to the Resurrection Day.
May Allah curse those who have wronged you and usurped your rights.
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu zalimikum wa ghasibikum

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أَشْيَاعَهُمْ وَأَتْبَاعَهُمْ وَأَهْلَ مَذْهَبِهِمْ
lines.english: May Allah curse their partisans, followers, and people of their sects.
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ashya`ahum wa atba`ahum wa ahla madhhabihim

lines.english: I repudiate them in the presence of Allah and you.
lines.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi wa ilaykum minhum

title: Ziyarat Rajabiyah
description: Ziyarat Rajabiyah is highly recommended to be recited when visiting any of the holy shrines of the Imams (as) during the month of Rajab. It is reported by Ibn Tawus and other scholars.

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي اشْهَدَنَا مَشْهَدَ اوْلِيَائِهِ فِي رَجَبٍ
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who has allowed us to visit the shrine of His Saints in Rajab
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi ashhadana mashhada awliya'ihi fi rajabin

lines.arabic: وَاوْجَبَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ حَقِّهِمْ مَا قَدْ وَجَبَ
lines.english: and made obligatory upon us fulfilling our duties towards them.
lines.transliteration: wa awjaba `alayna min haqqihim ma qad wajaba

lines.english: May Allah send blessings to Muhammad, the divinely selected,
and upon his Successors—the doors to Him.
O Allah, just as You have allowed us to visit their shrines,
please do fulfill for us the promises You have made with them,
include us with them,
and include us with those whom shall not be prevented from drinking from the (Divine) Pool
in the abode of eternity and perpetuity.
Peace be upon you all.
I have turned my face towards you and directed to you
carrying my request and need with me,
which is the release of my neck from Hellfire
lines.transliteration: wa hiya fakaku raqabati mina alnnari

lines.english: and the settlement with you in the Abode of Final Settlement
with your pious adherents (Shi`ah).
Peace be upon you all for that you persevered in patience.
Now how excellent is the final home!

lines.arabic: انَا سَائِلُكُمْ وَآمِلُكُمْ فِيمَا إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلتَّفْوِيضُ
lines.english: I hereby beg you and put my hope in you as regards the matters in which you have the right to act
lines.transliteration: ana sa'ilukum wa amilukum fima ilaykumu alttafwidu

lines.english: and recompense.
Truly, through you only are the hopeless restored to good condition,
the ailed healed,
and that which the wombs absorb and that which they grow.
lines.transliteration: wa ma tazdadu al-arhamu wa ma taghidu

lines.english: Verily, I have full faith in your Secret
and I am fully submissive to your words;
I thus beg you in the name of Allah
to make me return having my requests responded,
met, accepted,
given success, and settled,
and set aright all my needs and all my affairs towards you.
Peace be upon you from one who bids you farewell
and puts all his needs with you,
praying to Allah for another visit to you,
since his hope is never cut off from you.

lines.arabic: وَانْ يَرْجِعَنِي مِنْ حَضْرَتِكُمْ خَيْرَ مَرْجِعٍ
lines.english: I also pray Him to make my departure successful
lines.transliteration: wa an yarji`ani min hadratikum khayra marji`in

lines.english: to a productive place,
a fruitful area,
comfort, and luxurious up to the befalling of death.
lines.transliteration: wa da`atin wa mahalin ila hini al-ajali

lines.arabic: وَخَيْرِ مَصِيرٍ وَمَحَلٍّ فِي ٱلنَّعِيمِ ٱلازَلِ
lines.english: I also pray Him for the best destiny and abode in the Eternal Bliss,
lines.transliteration: wa khayri masirin wa mahallin fi alnna`imi al-azali

lines.english: the affluent living,
the perpetual fruit,
the drinking from the pure drink,

lines.arabic: وَعَلٍّ وَنَهَلٍ لا سَامَ مِنْهُ وَلاَ مَلَلَ
lines.english: and the divine spring whose drink is refreshing and thirst-quenching that is never bored or fed up.
lines.transliteration: wa `allin wa nahalin la sa'ama minhu wa la malala

lines.english: Allah’s mercy, blessings, and salutations be upon you incessantly
lines.transliteration: wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu wa tahiyyatuhu `alaykum

lines.english: until I return to your presence
and win the honor of visiting you again
and the honor of being resurrected with your group.

lines.arabic: وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَصَلَوَاتُهُ وَتَحِيَّاتُهُ
lines.english: Allah’s mercy, blessings, benedictions, and salutations be upon you,
lines.transliteration: wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu `alaykum wa salawatuhu wa tahiyyatuhu

lines.english: for Allah alone is Sufficient for us! Most Excellent is He in Whom we trust!
lines.transliteration: wa huwa hasbuna wa ni`ma alwakilu

title: Ziyarat of Ahlulbayt on Friday
description: Ziyarat of the Holy Prophet (saw) and the Holy Imams (as) recommended to be recited on Fridays.

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Prophet
and be upon you Allah’s mercy and blessings.
Peace be upon you, O missioned Prophet,
(and peace be upon you) O well-pleased successor (of the Prophet),
(and peace be upon you) O grand lady,
(and peace be upon you) O Luminous lady,
(and peace be upon you) O two elite grandsons (of the Prophet),
(and peace be upon you) O descendants—the elite signs
and the well-selected trustees.
Here I am devoting myself to you,
to your fathers, and to your son, the Successor
lines.transliteration: wa ila aba'ikum wa waladikum alkhalafi

lines.english: on the blessing of the truth.
My heart is thus subservient to you
and my support is prepared for you
until Allah will judge about His religion.
I am with you, verily with you
but not with your enemy.
I am one of them who believe in your superiority
and I acknowledge your Return.
I never deny the all-powerfulness of Allah

lines.arabic: وَلاَ أَزْعُمُ إِلاَّ مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ
lines.english: and I do not claim but that which Allah wills.
lines.transliteration: wa la az`umu illa ma sha'a allahu

lines.english: Glory be to Allah, Lord of kingdom and realm.
All His creatures glorify Allah by His Names.
Peace be upon your souls and your bodies.
Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you all.
lines.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alaykum wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu

title: Ziyarat of Imam Mahdi (atfs) on Friday
description: The specific Ziyarat of Imam of the Time, Imam Mahdi (atfs) for Friday, which is his day.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O argument of Allah in His lands!
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi fi ardihi

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ فِي خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O sight of Allah on His creatures!
Peace be upon you, O light of Allah
by which those who have been guided [to the true guidance] are guided
and by which the believers are relieved!
Peace be upon you, O polite and fearful!
Peace be upon you, O sincere patron!
Peace be upon you, O ark of salvation!
Peace be upon you, O essence of life!
Peace be upon you.
May Allah send blessings to you
and upon your Household,
the pure and immaculate.
Peace be upon you.
May Allah hasten that which He has promised you;
namely, victory and prevalence of your authority.
Peace be upon you, O my master.
I am a servant of you
and I recognize the first and the last of your affair.

lines.arabic: أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ بِكَ وَبِآلِ بَيْتِكَ
lines.english: I seek nearness to Allah, the Exalted, through your Household and you
lines.transliteration: ataqarrabu ila allahi ta`ala bika wa bi-ali baytika

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَظِرُ ظُهُورَكَ وَظُهُورَ ٱلْحَقِّ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْكَ
lines.english: and I am expecting your advent and the prevalence of the truth at your hands.
lines.transliteration: wa antaziru zuhuraka wa zuhura alhaqqi `ala yadayka

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: And I beseech Allah to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
lines.transliteration: wa as'alu allaha an yusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

lines.english: and to include me with those who are expecting you,
lines.transliteration: wa an yaj`alani mina almuntazirina laka

lines.english: those who follow you and support you against your enemies,

lines.arabic: وَٱلْمُسْتَشْهَدِينَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ فِي جُمْلَةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
lines.english: and those who will be martyred in front of you in the group of your loyalists.
lines.transliteration: walmustash-hadina bayna yadayka fi jumlati awliya'ika

lines.english: O my master, O Patron of the Age!
May Allah’s blessings be upon you
and upon your Household.
Today is Friday,
which is your day on which your advent is expected
lines.transliteration: wa huwa yawmuka almutawaqqa`u fihi zuhuruka

lines.english: to bring about relief to the believers at your hands,
and killing of the disbelievers with your sword.

lines.arabic: وَأَنَا يَا مَوْلاَيَ فِيهِ ضَيْفُكَ وَجَارُكَ
lines.english: On this day, O my master, I am your guest and in your vicinity
lines.transliteration: wa ana ya mawlaya fihi dayfuka wa jaruka

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ كَرِيمٌ مِنْ أَوْلاَدِ ٱلْكِرَامِ
lines.english: and you, my master, are generous and the descendant of the generous people,
lines.transliteration: wa anta ya mawlaya karimun min awladi alkirami

lines.english: and you are commanded to receive your guests and neighbors hospitably;
so, receive me as your guest and neighbor.
May Allah’s blessings be upon you
and upon your Household, the immaculate.

title: Ziyarat After Salat
description: Imam Reza (a.s.) was asked about the method of offering salutations to the Prophet (a.s.) and his Ahl al Bayt (a.s.) after the mandatory prayers. The Imam (a.s) asked one to say the following:

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خِيَرَةَ اللَّهِ، اَلسَّلا عَلَيْكَ يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صِفْوَةَ اللَّهِ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَمِينَ اللَّهِ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ نَصَحْتَ لِأُمَّتِكَ، وَ جَاهَدْتَ فِي سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ، وَ عَبَدُتَهُ حَتَّى أَتَاكَ الْيَقِينُ ، فَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفْضَلَ مَا جَزَى نَبِيًّا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَآلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of God, and God’s mercy and blessings. Peace be upon you, O Muhammad bin Abdullah. Peace be upon you, O the best of God. Peace be upon you, O Beloved of God, peace be upon you, O elite of God. Peace be upon you, O Trustee of God. I bear witness that you are the Messenger of God, and I bear witness that you are Muhammad bin Abdullah, I bear witness that you have been sincere towards your nation, and have striven in the path of your Lord, and have worshiped Him until certainty has come to you, so may God reward you, O Messenger of God, with the best. No prophet can be rewarded for his nation. O God, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad the best of all that You blessed Abraham and the family of Abraham. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.
lines.transliteration: As salaam alaika ya rasool allah wa rahmat ullahi wa barakatahu ya Mohammed bin Abdallah as salaamu alaika ya khairatillahe as salaamualaika ya Habeeb Allah as salaamualaika ya sifwat allahi as salaamualaika ya ameenallahi ashadu annaka Rasool allahi wa ashaduannaka Muhammad ibne Abdallahi wa ashaduannaka qad nashata leummeka wa jahadta fi sabeele rabbaka wa abdutahu hatta ataakal yaqeena fajazaakallaha ya rasool Allahi afzala ma jazaee nabiyan ummehi alla humma salle ala Muhammadin wa aale muhammedin afzale ma sallaita ala Ibraheema innaka hameedun majeed

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا الْفَضْلِ الْعَبَّاسِ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.english: Peace be upon thee, O Imam Hussain. Peace be upon Thee, O son of Holy prophet Peace be upon thee, O son of (Imam Ali) the Commander of Faithful Peace be upon thee, O son of Fatima Zahra Peace be upon thee-O Abbas (son of Imam Ali) Peace be upon thee, and the mercy of God and His Bounties
lines.transliteration: AS SALAAMU ALAIKA YA ABA ABDIL LAH AS SALAAMU ALAIKA YABNA RASOOL-UL-LAH AS SALAAMU ALAIKA YABNA AMIR UL MOMINEEN AS SALAAMU ALAIKA YABNA FATIMATUZ ZAHRA AS SALAAMU ALAIKA YA ABIL FAZLIL ABBAS AS SALAAMU ALAIKUM WA RAHMATUL LAHI WABARAKATUH.

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَاحِبَ الْعَصْرِ وَالزَّمَانِ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا إِمَامَ الْإِنْسِ وَالْجَانِّ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا شَرِيكَ الْقُرْآنِ الْأَمَانَ، الْأَمَانَ، الْأَمَانَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: Peace be upon thee O king of the times Peace be upon thee O Imam of men and jinn Peace be upon thee O Companion of Qur'an Keep us under your protection Peace be upon thee and the mercy of God and his Bounties O our God, bless Muhammad, and the Progeny of Muhammad
lines.transliteration: AS SALAAMU ALAIKA YA SAHIB UL ASR WAZ ZAMAN AS SALAAMU ALAIKA YA IMAM AL INSI WAL JANN AS SALAAMU ALAIKA YA SHARIK AL QURAN AL AMAAN, AL AMAAN, AL AMAAN AS SALAAMU ALAIKUM WA RAHMATUL LAHI WABARAKATUH ALLA HUMMA SALLI ALA MUHAMMADIN WA ALI MUHAMMAD

lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا غَرِيبَ الْغُرَبَاءِ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَلِيًّا ابْنَ مُوسَىٰ الرِّضَا السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.english: Peace be upon thee, who lies far away from his domain Peace be upon thee, O Ali son of Imam Musa ar Ridha Peace be upon thee and mercy of God and His Bounties
lines.transliteration: AS SALAAMU ALAIKA YA GHARIBUL GHURABA AS SALAAMU ALAIKA YA ALI IBNE MUSA AR RIDHA AS SALAAMU ALAIKUM WA RAHMATUL LAHI WABARAKATUH.

title: Ziyarat after Tasbih al-Zahra
description: Ibn Babawayh (i.e. Shaykh al-Saduq) mentions one should say the following litany immediately after reciting Tasbih al-Zahra':

lines.english: O Allah, You are the [source of] peace,
peace is coming from You,
peace is for You,
and to You does peace belong.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
lines.english: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Honor, above what they describe.
Peace be on the messengers.
All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
Peace be upon the Imams; the guides and well-guided.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَاءِ ٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon all Prophets, Messengers, and angels of Allah.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala jami`i anbya'i allahi wa rusulihi wa mala'ikatihi

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَىٰ عِبَادِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.
Peace be upon `Ali, the Commander of the Believers.
Peace be upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
the two chiefs of all the youth of Paradise.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ زَيْنِ ٱلْعَابِدِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon `Ali the son of al-Husayn, the Adornment of the Worshippers.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ بَاقِرِ عِلْمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon Muhammad the son of `Ali, the splitter of the knowledge of the Prophets.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلصَّادِقِ
lines.english: Peace be upon Ja`far the son of Muhammad, the veracious.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ٱلْكَاظِمِ
lines.english: Peace be upon Musa the son of Ja`far, the suppressor of rage.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَىٰ ٱلرِّضَا
lines.english: Peace be upon `Ali the son of Musa, the amiable.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلْجَوَادِ
lines.english: Peace be upon Muhammad the son of `Ali, the magnanimous.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْهَادِي
lines.english: Peace be upon `Ali the son of Muhammad, the guide.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلزَّكِيِّ ٱلْعَسْكَرِيِّ
lines.english: Peace be upon al-Hasan the son of `Ali, the bright and resident of `Askar.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحُجَّةِ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱلْقَائِمِ ٱلْمَهْدِيِّ
lines.english: Peace be upon the Argument (of Allah), the son of al-Hasan, the Assumer and the well-guided.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala alhujjati bni alhasani alqa'imi almahdiyyi

lines.english: Blessings of Allah be upon them all.

title: Ziyarat of the Holy Prophet (saw)
description: Comprehensive Ziyarat of the Holy Prophet (saw) including shrine visitation, distance recitation, and special salutations.

lines.english: Visiting the Shrine of the Holy Prophet (saw)
Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad the son of `Abdullah.
Peace be upon you, O Seal of the Prophets.
I bear witness that you conveyed the Mission,
performed the prayers,
gave alms,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

lines.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ اتَاكَ ٱليَقِينُ
lines.english: and served Almighty Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
lines.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu

lines.english: Blessings and mercy of Allah be upon you
and upon your Household, the Immaculate.

lines.arabic: اشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
lines.english: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, One and Only and having no associate,
lines.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu

lines.english: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu

lines.english: I bear witness that you are the messenger of Allah
and you are Muhammad the son of `Abdullah.

lines.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّكَ قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالاَتِ رَبِّكَ
lines.english: I bear witness that you have conveyed the messages of your Lord,
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka qad ballaghta risalati rabbika

lines.english: offered your people good advice,
striven hard in the way of Allah,
worshipped Allah -until death came upon you-
with wisdom and fair exhortation,
fulfilled the duty that was incumbent upon you,
acted compassionately to the believers,
and been firm of heart against the unbelievers.

lines.arabic: فَبَلَّغَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَ افْضَلَ شَرَفِ مَحَلِّ ٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ
lines.english: Therefore, Almighty Allah has exalted you to the most honorable position of the ennobled ones.
lines.transliteration: faballgha allahu bika afdala sharafi mahalli almukarramina

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَنْقَذَنَا بِكَ مِنْ ٱلشِّرْكِ وَٱلضَّلالَةِ
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who has saved us, through you, from polytheism and error.
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi istanqadhana bika min alshshirki walddalalati

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَٱجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَصَلَوَاتِ مَلائِكَتِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) pour Your blessings and the blessings of Your Archangels,
lines.transliteration: allahumma faj`al salawatika wa salawati mala'ikatika almuqarrabina

lines.english: Your commissioned Prophets,
Your righteous servants,
the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ سَبَّحَ لَكَ يَا رَبَّ ٱلعَالَمِينَ
lines.english: and all those who glorified You, O Lord of the Worlds,
lines.transliteration: wa man sabbaha laka ya rabba al`alamina

lines.english: from the past and the coming generations,
on Muhammad—Your servant, Your Messenger,
Your Prophet, Your Trustee,
Your Confidant, Your Most Beloved,
Your Choice, Your Select,
Your elite, and the best of Your creation.
lines.transliteration: wa safwatika wa khiyaratika min khalqika

lines.english: O Allah, (please do) confer upon him with the Elevated Rank,
grant him the right of intercession for entering Paradise,

lines.arabic: وَٱبْعَثْهُ مَقَاماً مَحْمُوداً يَغْبِطُهُ بِهِ ٱلاوَّلُونَ وَٱلآخِرُونَ
lines.english: and raise him to a Position of Glory that all the past and the coming generations will wish to have.
lines.transliteration: wab`athhu maqaman mahmudan yaghbituhu bihi al-awwaluna wal-akhiruna

lines.english: O Allah, You have said,

lines.arabic: «وَلَوْ انَّهُمْ إِذْ ظَلَمُوا انْفُسَهُمْ جَاؤُوكَ فَٱسْتَغْفَرُوٱ ٱللَّهَ
lines.english: “And had they, when they were unjust to themselves, come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah
lines.transliteration: walaw annahum idh zalamu anfusahum ja'uka fastaghfaru allaha

lines.english: and the Messenger had (also) asked forgiveness for them,
they would have found Allah Oft-returning (to mercy), Merciful.”

lines.arabic: وَإِنِّي اتَيْتُكَ مُسْتَغْفِراً تَائِباً مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
lines.english: Here I am, before you, asking Allah’s forgiveness, repenting from my sins,
lines.transliteration: wa inni ataytuka mustaghfiran ta'iban min dhunubi

lines.arabic: وَإِنِّي اتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكَ لِيَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي
lines.english: and seeking your intercession for me before Almighty Allah—your and my Lord—that He may forgive my sins.
lines.transliteration: wa inni atawajjahu bika ila allahi rabbi wa rabbika liyaghfira li dhunubi

lines.english: I pray Allah -Who has chosen you, selected you,
guided you, and guided (others) through you-
to bless You.
“Surely, Allah and His angels bless the Prophet;
lines.transliteration: inna allaha wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna `ala alnnabiyyi

lines.arabic: يَا ايُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوٱ صَلُّوٱ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوٱ تَسْلِيماً.»
lines.english: O you who believe! Call for (Divine) blessings on him and salute him with a (becoming) salutation.”
lines.transliteration: ya ayyuha alladhina amanu sallu `alayhi wa sallumu tasliman

lines.english: I beseech You, O All-magnanimous,
O All-generous,
O Nigh,
O Remote,
to renew Your boons to me.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ اللَّهَ وَ أَسْتَرْعِيكَ وَ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ السَّلاَمَ‏ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَ بِمَا جِئْتَ بِهِ وَ دَلَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنِّي لِزِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ‏ فَإِنْ تَوَفَّيْتَنِي قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنِّي أَشْهَدُ فِي مَمَاتِي عَلَى مَا شَهِدْتُ عَلَيْهِ فِي حَيَاتِي أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ‏ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ‏ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ لاَ جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ آخِرَ تَسْلِيمِي عَلَيْك
lines.english: Peace be on you, O Apostle of Allah I entrust you with Allah, I request Him to take care of I say “peace be on you”… I believe in Allah, and in that which you brought, and in that to which you guided. O Allah let not my this visitation to the grave of Your Prophet be my last. If You cause me to die before I come here again, then I, bear witness in my death upon what I testify in my lifetime, that there is no god save You, and that Mohammad is Your bondman and Your Apostle, blessing of Allah be on him and his progeny..
lines.transliteration: assalaamo a’layka yaa rasoolallaahe.. astawde-o’kallaaha wa astar-e’eka wa aqra-o a’laykas salaama aamanto billaahe wa bemaa jea-ta behi wa dalalta a’layhe allaahumma laa taj-a’lho aakheral a’hde minnee le zeyaarate qabre nabiyyeka fa-in tawaffaytanee qabla zaalekafa-innee ash-hado fee mamaatee a’laa maa shahidto a’layhe fee hayaatee an laa elaaha illaa anta wa anna mohammadan a’bdoka wa rasooloka sallallaaho a’layhe wa aalehi ..

lines.english: Seventeenth of Rabi` al-Awwal

lines.arabic: اشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
lines.english: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, alone without having any associate,
lines.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu

lines.english: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger,
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu

lines.english: that he is the chief of the ancient and the coming generations,
and that he is the chief of all Prophets and Messengers.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ ٱلائِمَةِ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings upon him and upon his Household—the Immaculate Imams.
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `alayhi wa `ala ahli baytihi al-a'immati alttayyibina

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Friend of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Choice of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Mercy of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Well-Chosen by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Most Beloved by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Selected by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Seal of the Prophets.
Peace be upon you, O Master of the Messengers.
Peace be upon you, O Maintainer of justice.
Peace be upon you, O introducer of goodliness.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَعْدِنَ ٱلوَحْيِ وَٱلتَّنْزِيلِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O core of Divine Inspiration and Revelation.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُبَلِّغاً عَنِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O conveyor on behalf of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O light-giving torch.
Peace be upon you, O conveyor of good tidings (to the believers).
Peace be upon you, O warner (against Allah’s chastisement).
Peace be upon you, O he who warns (against violating Allah’s commands).

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نُورَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُسْتَضَاءُ بِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Light that spreads luminosity.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya nura allahi alladhi yustada'u bihi

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِكَ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you and upon your Household—the pure, immaculate,
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa `ala ahli baytika alttayyibina alttahirina

lines.english: guides, and rightly guided.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ جَدِّكَ عَبْدِ ٱلْمُطَّلِبِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you and upon your grandfather, `Abd al-Muttalib,
and upon your father, `Abdullah.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ امِّكَ آمِنَةَ بِنْتِ وَهَبٍ
lines.english: peace be upon your mother, ªminah the daughter of Wahab.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَمِّكَ حَمْزَةَ سَيِّدِ ٱلشُّهَدَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be upon your (paternal) uncle, Hamzah, the master of martyrs.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَمِّكَ ٱلعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلْمُطَّلِبِ
lines.english: Peace be upon your uncle, al-`Abbas the son of `Abd al-Muttalib.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَمِّكَ وَكَفِيلِكَ ابِي طَالِبٍ
lines.english: Peace be upon your uncle and your guardian, Abu-Talib.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱبْنِ عَمِّكَ جَعْفَرٍ ٱلطَّيَّارِ فِي جِنَانِ ٱلْخُلْدِ
lines.english: Peace be upon your cousin, Ja`far the flying in the gardens of the Paradise of Eternity.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala ibni `ammika ja`farin alttayyari fi jinani alkhuldi

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad (the praised).
Peace be upon you, O Ahmad (the more praised).

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ اللَّهِ عَلَىٰ ٱلاوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Argument of Allah against the past and coming generations,
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi `ala al-awwalina wal-akhirina

lines.english: foremost to the obedience to the Lord of the worlds,
prevailing over His Messengers,
last of His Prophets,
witness over all His creatures,
interceder to Him,
firmly established with Him,
obeyed in His Kingdom,
winner of the most praised qualities,
holder of the most praised honors,
honored by the Lord,
addressee (by Almighty Allah) from behind the (Divine) Veils,
most advanced in position,
and unovertakable.
I greet you with the greeting of him who acknowledges your right (that is incumbent upon us),
who confesses of his shortcoming in carrying out his duty towards you,

lines.arabic: غَيْرِ مُنْكِرٍ مَا ٱنْتَهَىٰ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
lines.english: who does not discuss your limitless virtues,
lines.transliteration: ghayri munkirin ma intaha ilayhi min fadlika

lines.english: who is sure that you will have more rewards from your Lord,
who believes in the Book that was revealed to you,
who deems lawful all that which you deemed lawful,
and who deems unlawful all that which you deemed unlawful.

lines.arabic: اشْهَدُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ مَعَ كُلِّ شَاهِدٍ
lines.english: O Messenger of Allah, I bear witness—and I join everyone who bears witness
lines.transliteration: ashhadu ya rasula allahi ma`a kulli shahidin

lines.english: and also bear witness rather than everyone who may deny it—
that you conveyed the messages of your Lord (flawlessly),
offered your nation good advice,
strove in the way of your Lord,
expounded openly what you were commanded to convey,
stood harm for the sake of Him,

lines.arabic: وَدَعَوْتَ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِهِ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلْجَمِيلَةِ
lines.english: called to the way of Him with excellent wisdom and fair exhortation,
lines.transliteration: wa da`awta ila sabilihi bilhikmati walmaw`izati alhasanati aljamilati

lines.english: fulfilled the duty with which you were commissioned,
you, verily, were compassionate to the believers,
strong against the unbelievers,

lines.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ اتَاكَ ٱليَقِينُ
lines.english: and you worshipped Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
lines.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu

lines.arabic: فَبَلَغَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَ اشْرَفَ مَحَلِّ ٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ
lines.english: Therefore, Almighty Allah has exalted you to the most honorable position of the ennobled ones,
lines.transliteration: fabalagha allahu bika ashrafa mahalli almukarramina

lines.english: to the most elevated place of the intimate servants of Him,

lines.arabic: وَارْفَعَ دَرَجَاتِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ حَيْثُ لاَ يَلْحَقُكَ لاَحِقٌ
lines.english: and to the most exalted ranks of the Messengers where none can come up with you,
lines.transliteration: wa arfa`a darajati almursalina haythu la yalhaquka lahiqun

lines.english: none can excel you,
none can overtake you,
and none can even think of obtaining your rank.
lines.transliteration: wa la yatma`u fi idrakika tami`un

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَنْقَذَنَا بِكَ مِنَ ٱلْهَلَكَةِ
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who saved us from perdition through you,
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi istanqadhana bika min alhalakati

lines.english: Who guided us off misdirection through you,
and Who lit our darkness through you.

lines.arabic: فَجَزَاكَ ٱللَّهُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ مَبْعُوثٍ افْضَلَ مَا جَازَىٰ نَبِيّاً عَنْ امَّتِهِ
lines.english: O Messenger of Allah, may Allah reward you, for you are His envoy, with the best rewarding that He has ever conferred upon a prophet on behalf of his people
lines.transliteration: fajazaka allahu ya rasula allahi min mab`uthin afdala ma jaza nabiyyan `an ummatihi

lines.english: or a messenger on behalf of those to whom He has sent him.

lines.arabic: بِابِي انْتَ وَامِّي يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ زُرْتُكَ عَارِفاً بِحَقِّكَ
lines.english: May Allah accept my father and my mother as ransoms for you, O Messenger of Allah. I am visiting you for I acknowledge your right (that is incumbent upon us),
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya rasula allahi zurtuka `arifan bihaqqika

lines.english: I confess of your superiority,

lines.arabic: مُسْتَبْصِراً بِضَلالَةِ مَنْ خَالَفَكَ وَخَالَفَ اهْلَ بَيْتِكَ
lines.english: I know for sure about the straying off (from the right path) of those who dissent from you and from your Household,
lines.transliteration: mustabsiran bidalalati man khalafaka wa khalafa ahla baytika

lines.english: and I admit the true guidance that you follow (and lead to).

lines.arabic: بِابِي انْتَ وَامِّي وَنَفْسِي وَاهْلِي وَمَالِي وَوَلَدِي
lines.english: May Allah accept my father, my mother, me, my family, my property, and my sons as ransoms for you!
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi wa nafsi wa ahli wa mali wa waladi

lines.arabic: انَا اصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ كَمَا صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ
lines.english: Let me invoke Almighty Allah’s blessings upon you in the same way as Allah did send blessings upon you
and so did His angels, Prophets, and Messengers;
lines.transliteration: wa salla `alayka mala'ikatuhu wa anbiya'uhu wa rusuluhu

lines.english: such blessings that are consecutive, abundant,

lines.arabic: لاَ ٱنْقِطَاعَ لَهَا وَلاَ امَدَ وَلاَ اجَلَ
lines.english: continuous, incessant, infinite, and unlimited.
lines.transliteration: la inqita`a laha wa la amada wa la ajala

lines.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِكَ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ كَمَا انْتُمْ اهْلُهُ
lines.english: May Allah send blessings upon you and upon your Household, the pure and immaculate, as much as you deserve.
lines.transliteration: salla allahu `alayka wa `ala ahli baytika alttayyibina alttahirina kama antum ahluhu

lines.english: O Allah, (please do) make You complete blessings,
Your perfect benedictions,
Your most virtuous boons,
and Your most honorable greetings, salutations,
dignities, and mercy,
as well as the blessings of Your archangels,
your commissioned Prophets,
Your elite Imams,
Your righteous servants,
the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ سَبَّحَ لَكَ يَا رَبَّ ٱلعَالَمِينَ
lines.english: and (the blessings of) everyone who glorified You, O Lord of the worlds,
lines.transliteration: wa man sabbaha laka ya rabba al`alamina

lines.english: from the past and the coming generations—
make all these pour forth upon Muhammad; Your servant, Your messenger,
Your witness, Your Prophet,
Your warner, Your trustee,
Your firmly established (in truth), Your confidante,
Your elite, Your most beloved,
Your friend, Your choice,
Your notable, Your elect,
Your well-chosen, Your mercy,
the best of Your created beings,
the Prophet of mercy,
the storer of forgiveness,
the leader to goodliness and blessing,
the savior of the servants (of Almighty Allah) from perdition by Your permission,
lines.transliteration: wa munqidhi al`ibadi mina alhalakati bi'idhnika

lines.english: the caller of them to Your religion,
the custodian by Your order,
the first Prophet to make the covenant,
and the last Prophet to be sent (to humanity),
whom You have immersed in the ocean of virtue,
in the lofty rank,
in the elevated level,
and in the exalted position;
and whom You entrusted in the pure loins
and moved to the immaculate wombs
lines.transliteration: wa naqaltahu minha ila al-arhami almutahharati

lines.english: out of Your kindness to him
and Your compassion to him.
In order to safeguard, to shield,
to protect, and to defend him,
You assigned, out of Your omnipotence, a protective lookout over him
to keep him from the impurities of adultery
and from the defects of fornication;
thus, You raised the sights of the servants through him
and revived the derelict lands

lines.arabic: بِانْ كَشَفْتَ عَنْ نُورِ وِلادَتِهِ ظُلَمَ ٱلاسْتَارِ
lines.english: when You removed the screening murk by the light of his birth
lines.transliteration: bi'an kashafta `an nuri wiladatihi zulama al-astari

lines.english: and dressed Your Holy Precinct the garments of brightness through him.
lines.transliteration: wa albasta haramaka bihi hulala al-anwari

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا خَصَصْتَهُ بِشرَفِ هٰذِهِ ٱلْمَرْتَبَةِ ٱلكَرِيمَةِ
lines.english: O Allah, as You have given him exclusively the honor of this noble rank
lines.transliteration: allahumma fakama khasastahu bishrafi hadhihi almartabati alkarimati

lines.english: and the privilege of this great merit,
(please do) bless him for he fulfilled his covenant to You,
conveyed all Your messages,
fought against the infidels in order to prove Your Oneness,

lines.arabic: وَقَطَعَ رَحِمَ ٱلكُفْرِ فِي إِعْزَازِ دِينِكَ
lines.english: exterminated the womb of atheism in order to strengthen Your religion,
lines.transliteration: wa qata`a rahima alkufri fi i`zazi dinika

lines.arabic: وَلَبِسَ ثَوْبَ ٱلبَلْوَىٰ فِي مُجَاهَدَةِ اعْدَائِكَ
lines.english: and dressed himself the garb of misfortune in order to struggle against Your enemies.
lines.transliteration: wa labisa thawba albalwa fi mujahadati a`da'ika

lines.english: Hence, You have given him as recompense for any harm that inflicted him,
lines.transliteration: wa awjabta lahu bikulli adhan massahu

lines.english: any trickery that he faced
from the faction who tried to assassinate him;
a merit that excels all other merits
and due to which he possessed Your abundant gifts.
lines.transliteration: wa yamliku biha aljazila min nawalika

lines.english: In return, he hid his sadness,
concealed his grief,
swallowed the pang,

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ يَتَخَطَّ مَا مَثَّلَ لَهُ وَحْيُكَ
lines.english: and never did he violate the instructions of Your Revelation.
lines.transliteration: wa lam yatakhatta ma maththala lahu wahyuka

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ صَلاةً تَرْضَاهَا لَهُمْ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon him and his Household—blessings that You please for them,
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `alayhi wa `ala ahli baytihi salatan tardaha lahum

lines.english: and convey our abundant greetings and compliments to him,
lines.transliteration: wa balligh-hum minna tahiyyatan kathiratan wa salaman

lines.arabic: وَآتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فِي مُوَالاَتِهِمْ فَضْلاً وَإِحْسَاناً
lines.english: and give us - from You on account of our loyalty to them - favors, kindness,
lines.transliteration: wa atina min ladunka fi muwalatihim fadlan wa ihsanan

lines.english: mercy, and forgiveness.
Verily, You are the Lord of great favor.
O Allah, You have said to Your Prophet Muhammad—
may Allah bless him and his Household:
“And had they, when they were unjust to themselves,
come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah
and the Messenger had (also) asked forgiveness for them,
they would have found Allah Oft-returning (to mercy), Merciful.”

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ احْضُرْ زَمَانَ رَسُولِكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
lines.english: I was not present at the age of Your Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household.
lines.transliteration: wa lam ahdur zamana rasulika `alayhi wa alihi alssalamu

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَقَدْ زُرْتُهُ رَاغِباً تَائِباً مِنْ سَيِّءِ عَمَلِي
lines.english: O Allah, I have visited him desiring, repenting from my ill deeds,
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa qad zurtuhu raghiban ta'iban min sayyi'i `amali

lines.english: imploring forgiveness of my sins,

lines.arabic: وَمُقِرّاً لَكَ بِهَا وَانْتَ اعْلَمُ بِهَا مِنِّي
lines.english: confessing of my having committed these sins although You know them more than I do,
lines.transliteration: wa muqirran laka biha wa anta a`lamu biha minni

lines.english: and turning my face towards You in the name of Your Prophet, the Prophet of Mercy—
lines.transliteration: wa mutawajjihan ilayka binabiyyika nabiyyi alrrahmati

lines.english: may Your blessings be upon him and his Household.

lines.arabic: فَٱجْعَلْنِي ٱللَّهُمَّ بِمُحَمَّدٍ وَاهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عِنْدَكَ وَجِيهاً
lines.english: O Allah, in the name of Muhammad and his Household, (please do) make me illustrious
lines.transliteration: faj`alni allahumma bimuhammadin wa ahli baytihi `indaka wajihan

lines.english: in this world as well as the Next World and one of those brought near to You.
lines.transliteration: fi alddunya wal-akhirati wa min almuqarrabina

lines.english: O Muhammad!
O Messenger of Allah!
May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you!
O Prophet of Allah!
O chief of all created beings of Allah!

lines.arabic: إِنِّي اتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّكَ وَرَبِّي
