lines.english: In Your name do I turn my face towards Allah, my and your Lord,
lines.transliteration: inni atawajjahu bika ila allahi rabbika wa rabbi

lines.english: so that He may forgive my sins,
accept my deeds,
and settle my requests.

lines.arabic: فَكُنْ لِي شَفِيعاً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ وَرَبِّي
lines.english: Therefore, be my interceder before your and my Lord,
lines.transliteration: fakun li shafi`an `inda rabbika wa rabbi

lines.english: for my Lord, the Master, is the best besought
and You are the best interceder.
O Muhammad!
May peace be upon you and upon your Household.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَاوْجِبْ لِي مِنْكَ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةَ وَٱلرَّحْمَةَ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) confer upon me with forgiveness, mercy,
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa awjib li minka almaghfirata walrrahmata

lines.english: and sustenance that is outgoing, good, and beneficial from Your Presence

lines.arabic: كَمَا اوْجَبْتَ لِمَنْ اتَىٰ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّداً
lines.english: in the same way as You conferred upon him who came to Your Prophet, Muhammad, when he was alive,
lines.transliteration: kama awjabta liman ata nabiyyaka muhammadan

lines.english: may your blessings be upon him and his Household,
and confessed of his sins.
lines.transliteration: wa huwa hayyun fa'aqarra lahu bidhunubihi

lines.english: Thus, Your Messenger prayed You to forgive him.
May your blessings be upon him and his Household.

lines.arabic: فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا ارْحَمَ ٱلرَّاحِمِينَ
lines.english: And You did forgive him out of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
lines.transliteration: faghafarta lahu birahmatika ya arhama alrrahimina

lines.english: O Allah, I now put my hope in You, please You,
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa qad ammaltuka wa rajawtuka

lines.english: stand before You,
desire for You other than anyone else,
and hope for Your abundant reward
while I confess of my sins and I do not deny them,
I repent to You from whatever I have committed,
and I seek refuge with You from this position
against the deeds that I have committed

lines.arabic: ٱلَّتِي تَقَدَّمْتَ إِلَيَّ فِيهَا وَنَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهَا
lines.english: although You, firstly, had introduced them to me as prohibited, warned me against committing them,
lines.transliteration: allati taqaddamta ilayya fiha wa nahaytani `anha

lines.english: and threatened me with Your punishment if I would violate.
And I seek shelter with the nobility of Your Face
lest You impose upon me the situation of disgrace and humility
on the day when the veils will be exposed,
the secrets and scandals will be disclosed,
and the muscles will writhe with fear;
on the day of regret and remorse,
the day of exposing the liars,
the day of the approaching doom,
the day of assembling,
the day of separation,
the day of punishment,

lines.arabic: يَوْماً كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ الْفَ سَنَةٍ
lines.english: the day the measure of which is fifty thousand years,
lines.transliteration: yawman kana miqdaruhu khamsina alfa sanatin

lines.english: the day of the blowing,
the day on which the quaking land shall quake
followed by oft-repeated commotions,
the day of raising the dead,
the day of exposition before the Fire,
the day when all mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds,
the day when a man flees from his brother,
his mother, his father,
his wife, and his children,
the day when the earth and the sides of the heavens will split asunder,
lines.transliteration: yawma tashaqqaqu al-ardu wa aknafu alssama'i

lines.arabic: يَوْمَ تَاتِي كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهَا
lines.english: the day when every soul will come pleading for itself,
lines.transliteration: yawma ta'ti kullu nafsin tujadilu `an nafsiha

lines.arabic: يَوْمَ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوٱ
lines.english: the day when they will be relegated to Allah Who will inform them of what they did,
lines.transliteration: yawma yuradduna ila allahi fayunabbi'uhum bima `amilu

lines.arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلَىٰ عَنْ مَوْلَىٰ شَيْئاً
lines.english: the day when a friend can in naught avail his friend
lines.transliteration: yawma la yughni mawlan `an mawlan shay'an

lines.english: nor can they be helped
save him on whom Allah will have mercy.
Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful,

lines.arabic: يَوْمَ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَالِمِ ٱلغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَادَةِ
lines.english: the day when they will be returned to the Knower of the invisible and the visible,

lines.arabic: يَوْمَ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ اللَّهِ مَوْلاهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ
lines.english: the day when they will be restored to Allah, their Lord, the Just,
lines.transliteration: yawma yuradduna ila allahi mawlahumu alhaqqi

lines.english: the day when they come forth from the graves in haste,
as racing to a goal
and as locusts spreading abroad,
hastening toward the Summoner—
to Allah,
the day of the event inevitable
when the earth will be shaken with a shock,
the day when the sky will become as molten copper
and the hills become as flakes of wool
and no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend,
the day of the witness and that whereunto he bears testimony,
and they day when the angels will come rank on rank.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱرْحَمْ مَوْقِفِي فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ بِمَوْقِفِي فِي هٰذَا ٱليَوْمِ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) have mercy upon my situation on that day (when I will be stopped for interrogation) for my current situation,
lines.transliteration: allahumma irham mawqifi fi dhalika alyawmi bimawqifi fi hadha alyawmi

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تُخْزِنِي فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱلْمَوْقِفِ بِمَا جَنَيْتُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي
lines.english: and do not confound me at that situation for the wrongdoings that I have committed against myself.
lines.transliteration: wa la tukhzini fi dhalika almawqifi bima janaytu `ala nafsi

lines.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ يَا رَبِّ فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ مَعَ اوْلِيَائِكَ مُنْطَلَقِي
lines.english: O my Lord, (please do) group me, on that day, with Your intimate servants,
lines.transliteration: waj`al ya rabbi fi dhalika alyawmi ma`a awliya'ika muntalaqi

lines.arabic: وَفِي زُمْرَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مَحْشَرِي
lines.english: include me with the company of Muhammad and his Household—peace be upon them—
lines.transliteration: wa fi zumrati muhammadin wa ahli baytihi `alayhimu alssalamu mahshari

lines.english: make the Pond of him (i.e. the Holy Prophet) to be my arrival point,
make me a place among the honorable, white-forehead group,
and give me my Record (of deeds) in my right hand
so that I will succeed due to my rewards,
You will make my face white,
You will make easy for me my reckoning,
You will make my pan of the Scale (of deeds) outweigh,
and I will join the triumphant ones
among Your righteous servants
to Your Pleasure and gardens of Paradise.
O God of the Worlds!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ انْ تَفْضَحَنِي فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ
lines.english: O Allah, I do seek Your protection lest You may expose me on that day
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min an tafdahani fi dhalika alyawmi

lines.english: in the presence of Your creatures because of my sins,

lines.arabic: او اَنْ الْقَىٰ ٱلْخِزْيَ وَٱلنَّدَامَةَ بِخَطِيئَتِي
lines.english: or I may encounter disgrace and regret due to my wrongdoings,
lines.transliteration: aw an alqa alkhizya walnnadamata bikhati'ati

lines.arabic: اوْ انْ تُظْهِرَ فِيهِ سَيِّئَاتِي عَلَىٰ حَسَنَاتِي
lines.english: or You may make my evildoings outweigh my good deeds,
lines.transliteration: aw an tuzhira fihi sayyi'ati `ala hasanati

lines.arabic: اوْ انْ تُنَوِّهَ بَيْنَ ٱلْخَلاَئِقِ بِٱسْمِي
lines.english: or You may declare my name as loser amongst Your creatures.
lines.transliteration: aw an tunawwiha bayna alkhala'iqi bismi

lines.english: O All-generous, O All-generous,
(I beg You for) pardon, (I beg You for) pardon,
(I beg You for) covering (my evildoings), (I beg You for) covering (my evildoings).

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ انْ يَكُونَ فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ
lines.english: O Allah, I also seek Your protection against including me, on that day,
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa a`udhu bika min an yakuna fi dhalika alyawmi

lines.english: with the line of the evils
or add me to the row of the wretched ones.
When You shall distinguish between Your creatures
and drive each group –according to their deeds-
to their final abodes in groups,
(please do) line me up, in the name of Your mercy, with the group of Your righteous servants,
and drive me with the group of the Your pious, intimate servants
to the gardens of Your Paradise, O Lord of the Worlds!
Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O conveyor of good tidings (to the believers) and warner (against Allah’s chastisement).
Peace be upon you, O light-giving torch.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ايُّهَا ٱلسَّفِيرُ بَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ وَبَيْنَ خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O intercessor between Allah and His creatures.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ayyuha alssafiru bayna allahi wa bayna khalqihi

lines.arabic: اشْهَدُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ انَّكَ كُنْتَ نُوراً فِي ٱلاصْلاَبِ ٱلشَّامِخَةِ
lines.english: I bear witness, O Messenger of Allah, that You were light in the lofty loins
lines.transliteration: ashhadu ya rasula allahi annaka kunta nuran fi al-aslabi alshshamikhati

lines.english: and purified wombs.
The ignorance could not stain you with its impurities
or dress you its gloomy garbs.
lines.transliteration: wa lam tulbiska min mudlahimmati thiyabiha

lines.arabic: وَاَشْهَدُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ انِّي مُؤْمِنٌ بِكَ
lines.english: I also bear witness, O Messenger of Allah, that I have faith in you
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu ya rasula allahi anni mu'minun bika

lines.english: and in the Imams from your Household,
and I believe in all that which you have brought,
satisfactorily and faithfully.

lines.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّ ٱلائِمَّةَ مِنْ اهْلِ بَيْتِكَ اعْلامُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
lines.english: And I bear witness that the Imams from your Household are the signs of (true) guidance,
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu ann al-a'immata min ahli baytika a`lamu alhuda

lines.english: the Firmest Handle,
and the arguments against the inhabitants in this world.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ ٱلعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَةِ نَبِيِّكَ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) do not make it the last of my pilgrimage to (the tomb of) Your Prophet—
lines.transliteration: allahumma la taj`alhu akhira al`ahdi min ziyarati nabiyyika

lines.english: peace be upon him and his Household.

lines.arabic: وَإِنْ تَوَفَّيْتَنِي فَإِنِّي اشْهَدُ فِي مَمَاتِي
lines.english: If you decide to grasp my soul, I will bear witness in my death,
lines.transliteration: wa in tawaffaytani fa'inni ashhadu fi mamati

lines.arabic: عَلَىٰ مَا اشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِ فِي حَيَاتِي
lines.english: as same as I have born witness in my lifetime,

lines.arabic: انَّكَ انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ
lines.english: that Your are verily Allah; there is no god save You,
lines.transliteration: annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta

lines.english: alone without having any associate,
that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger,

lines.arabic: وَانَّ ٱلائِمَّةَ مِنْ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ اوْلِيَاؤُكَ وَانْصَارُكَ
lines.english: and that the Imams from his Household are Your intimate servants, Your supporters,
lines.transliteration: wa anna al-a'immata min ahli baytihi awliya'uka wa ansaruka

lines.english: Your Arguments against Your creatures,
Your representatives amongst Your servants,
Your signs in Your lands,
the custodians of Your knowledge,
the keepers of Your secret,
and the interpreters of Your Revelation.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

lines.english: and convey to the souls of Your Prophet, Muhammad, and his Household,
lines.transliteration: wa balligh ruha nabiyyika muhammadin wa alihi

lines.arabic: فِي سَاعَتِي هٰذِهِ وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ
lines.english: at this very hour as well as all times,
lines.transliteration: fi sa`ati hadhihi wa fi kulli sa`atin

lines.english: greetings and compliments from me.

lines.arabic: وَٱلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.english: O Messenger of Allah, peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
lines.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka ya rasula allahi wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu

lines.arabic: لاَ جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ تَسْلِيمِي عَلَيْكَ
lines.english: Allah may not decide this compliment of me to be the last.
O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad
as he bore Your revelations
and conveyed Your messages.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as he declared lawful that which You deemed lawful,
forbade that which You deemed unlawful,
and taught Your Book (to people).
And (please) bless Muhammad
as he performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
and called to Your religion.
And (please) bless Muhammad
for he gave credence to Your promise
and feared Your threat.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as You, for his sake, forgave sins,
concealed defects,
and relieved agonies.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as You, for his sake, warded off misery,
relieved grievances,
responded to prayers,
and saved from misfortunes.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as You, for his sake, had mercy on the servants,
restored lands into life,
trashed the tyrants,
and obliterated the despots.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as You, for his sake, multiplied fortunes,
protected against terrors,
broke the idols,
and had mercy upon the human beings.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as You sent him with the best of all religions,
strengthened the faith through him,
broke into pieces the idols though him,
and poured tribute on the Holy House.
And (please) bless Muhammad
and his Household the immaculate and virtuous
and send thorough benedictions on them.

title: Ziyarat of Syeda Fatima Zahra (sa)
description: Ziyarat of the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds, Lady Fatima al-Zahra (sa).

lines.english: O carefully examined (lady):
Allah Who created you had tried you
before He created you (for this worldly life),
and thus He found you successfully enduring in that trial.

lines.transliteration: wa za`amna anna laki awlya'un wa musaddiquna
lines.english: We claim being loyalists to you, believers in you,

lines.arabic: وَصَابِرُونَ لِكُلِّ مَا اتَانَا بِهِ ابُوكِ
lines.transliteration: wa sabiruna likulli ma atana bihi abuki
lines.english: and tolerant as regards all that which has been conveyed to us by your father,
peace of Allah be upon him and his Household,
and all that which his Successor has brought to us.
We, thus, ask you, if we have really believed you,
that you may include us with those who believe in both of them (i.e. the Holy Prophet and Imam `Ali),

lines.arabic: لِنُبَشِّرَ انْفُسَنَا بِانَّا قَدْ طَهُرْنَا بِوِلايَتِكِ
lines.transliteration: linubashshira anfusana bi'anna qad tahurna biwilayatiki
lines.english: so that we may feel happy that we have been purified on account of our loyalty to you.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Messenger of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Prophet of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ حَبِيبِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the most beloved of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَلِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Intimate Servant of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ صَفيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Choice of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ امِينِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Trustee of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَيْرِ خَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya binta khayri khalqi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the best of Allah’s creatures.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ افْضَلِ انْبِيَاءِ ٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya binta afdali anbiya'i allahi wa rusulihi wa mala'ikatihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the best of Allah’s Prophets, Messengers, and angels.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَيْرِ ٱلْبَرِّيَةِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the best of all created beings.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سِيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O doyenne of all women of the world,
including the past and the coming generations.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا زَوْجَةَ وَلِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O lady of the Intimate Servant of Allah

lines.transliteration: wa khayri alkhalqi ba`da rasuli allahi
lines.english: and the best of all created beings after the Messenger of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا امَّ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O mother of al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
the two chiefs of the youth of Paradise.
Peace be upon you, O veracious and martyr.
Peace be upon you, O content and pleased.
Peace be upon you, O virtuous and pure.
Peace be upon you, O Paradisiacal human being.
Peace be upon you, O pious and immaculate.
Peace be upon you, O one talked by the angels, O knowledgeable.
Peace be upon you, O oppressed lady whose right was usurped.
Peace be upon you, O persecuted and maltreated.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya fatimatu binta rasuli allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Fatimah the daughter of the Messenger of Allah.
So be upon you the mercy and blessings of Allah.
May Allah bless you,
your soul, and your body.

lines.arabic: اشْهَدُ انَّكِ مَضَيْتِ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكِ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu annaki madayti `ala bayyinatin min rabbiki
lines.english: I bear witness that you have spent your life with full awareness of your duty towards your Lord

lines.arabic: وَانَّ مَنْ سَرَّكِ فَقَدْ سَرَّ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa anna man sarraki faqad sarra rasula allahi
lines.english: and (I bear witness) that he who pleases you will have pleased the Messenger of Allah,
peace be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ جَفَاكِ فَقَدْ جَفَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa man jafaki faqad jafa rasula allahi
lines.english: and he who displeases you will have displeased the Messenger of Allah,
peace be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ آذَاكِ فَقَدْ آذَىٰ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa man adhaki faqad adha rasula allahi
lines.english: and he who harms you will have harmed the Messenger of Allah,
peace be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ وَصَلَكِ فَقَدْ وَصَلَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa man wasalaki faqad wasala rasula allahi
lines.english: and he who respects you will have respected the Messenger of Allah,
peace be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ قَطَعَكِ فَقَدْ قَطَعَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa man qata`aki faqad qata`a rasula allahi
lines.english: and he who disrespects you will have disrespected the messenger of Allah,
peace be upon him and his Household.
This is because you are an inseparable part of him (i.e. the Holy Prophet),
and you are his soul with which he lives.

lines.transliteration: ushhidu allaha wa rusulahu wa mala'ikatahu
lines.english: I ask Allah, His Messengers, and His angels to be the witnesses
that I am verily pleased with him whomever you accept,
I am displeased with him whomever you detest,
I disavow him whomever you disavow,
I am loyal to him whomever you support,
I am the enemy of him whomever you betake as enemy,
I am hateful to him whomever you hate,
and I like him whomever you like.

lines.transliteration: wa kafa billahi shahidan wa hasiban
lines.english: Verily, Allah is Sufficient as Witness, Reckoner,
Punisher, and Rewarder.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Messenger of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Prophet of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ حَبِيبِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the most beloved of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَلِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Intimate Servant of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ صَفيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Choice of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ امِينِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Trustee of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَيْرِ خَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya binta khayri khalqi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the best of Allah’s creatures.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ افْضَلِ انْبِيَاءِ ٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya binta afdali anbiya'i allahi wa rusulihi wa mala'ikatihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the best of Allah’s Prophets, Messengers, and angels.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَيْرِ ٱلْبَرِّيَةِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the best of all created beings.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سِيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O doyenne of all women of the world,
including the past and the coming generations.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا زَوْجَةَ وَلِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O lady of the Intimate Servant of Allah

lines.transliteration: wa khayri alkhalqi ba`da rasuli allahi
lines.english: and the best of all created beings after the Messenger of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا امَّ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O mother of al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
the two chiefs of the youth of Paradise.
Peace be upon you, O veracious and martyr.
Peace be upon you, O content and pleased.
Peace be upon you, O virtuous and pure.
Peace be upon you, O Paradisiacal human being.
Peace be upon you, O pious and immaculate.
Peace be upon you, O one talked by the angels, O knowledgeable.
Peace be upon you, O oppressed lady whose right was usurped.
Peace be upon you, O persecuted and maltreated.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya fatimatu binta rasuli allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Fatimah the daughter of the Messenger of Allah.
So be upon you the mercy and blessings of Allah.
May Allah bless you,
your soul, and your body.

lines.arabic: اشْهَدُ انَّكِ مَضَيْتِ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكِ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu annaki madayti `ala bayyinatin min rabbiki
lines.english: I bear witness that you have spent your life with full awareness of your duty towards your Lord;

lines.arabic: وَانَّ مَنْ سَرَّكِ فَقَدْ سَرَّ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa anna man sarraki faqad sarra rasula allahi
lines.english: and (I bear witness) that he who pleases you will have pleased the Messenger of Allah,
peace be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ جَفَاكِ فَقَدْ جَفَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa man jafaki faqad jafa rasula allahi
lines.english: he who displeases you will have displeased the Messenger of Allah,
peace be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ آذَاكِ فَقَدْ آذَىٰ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa man adhaki faqad adha rasula allahi
lines.english: he who harms you will have harmed the Messenger of Allah,
peace be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ وَصَلَكِ فَقَدْ وَصَلَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa man wasalaki faqad wasala rasula allahi
lines.english: he who respects you will have respected the Messenger of Allah,
peace be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ قَطَعَكِ فَقَدْ قَطَعَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa man qata`aki faqad qata`a rasula allahi
lines.english: and he who disrespects you will have disrespected the messenger of Allah,
peace be upon him and his Household.
This is because you are an inseparable part of him (i.e. the Holy Prophet),
and you are his soul with which he lives.
I ask Allah and His angels to be the witnesses
that I am the friend of him who adheres to you,
I am the enemy of him who makes an enemy of you,
and I am in war against him who wages war against you.

lines.transliteration: ana ya mawlati biki wa bi'abiki
lines.english: O my doyenne, I have full faith in you, your father,

lines.transliteration: wa ba`liki wal-a'immati min wuldiki muqinun
lines.english: your husband, and your sons—the Imams,
I believe in their (Divinely commissioned) leadership,
and I commit myself to the obedience to them.
I bear witness that their religion is the true religion,
their command is the true command,

lines.arabic: وَهُمْ قَدْ بَلَّغُوٱ عَنِ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
lines.transliteration: wa hum qad ballaghu `ani allahi `azza wa jalla
lines.english: they have conveyed on behalf of Almighty Allah (flawlessly),

lines.arabic: وَدَعَوْٱ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa da`aw ila sabili allahi bilhikmati walmaw`izati alhasanati
lines.english: and they have called to the Way of Allah with wisdom and fair exhortation.

lines.arabic: لاَ تَاخُذُهُمْ فِي ٱللَّهِ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
lines.transliteration: la ta'khudhuhum fi allahi lawmatu la'imin
lines.english: They have never feared the blame of anyone concerning carrying out their duty towards Almighty Allah.
Blessings of Allah be upon you
and upon your father, your husband,
and your descendants—the Immaculate Imams.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household
and send blessings upon the chaste, the immaculate,
the veracious, the infallible,
pious, pure,
amiable, well-pleased,
virtuous, right-minded,
oppressed, and wronged lady
whose right was usurped,
whose right of inheritance was violated,
whose rib was broken,
whose husband was persecuted,
and whose son was slain;
(she is) Fatimah: the daughter of Your Messenger,
the inseparable part of his flesh,
the essence of his heart,
the piece of his innermost,
the choice of You for him,
the gift that You have given exclusively to the Successor of him,
the most beloved of the Preferred Prophet,
the wife of the Pleased Successor,
the doyenne of all women,
the conveyor of good tidings to the intimate servants (of Almighty Allah),
the inseparable from piety and asceticism,
and the Apple of the Heaven and Eternity (in Paradise);
(she is) the lady through whose birth You have honored the women of Paradise,
from whom You have pulled the Lights of the Imams,
and fixed the Veil of Prophethood.
O Allah, (please do) confer upon her
with blessings that raise her standing
and honor with You,
raise her position from Your Pleasure,

lines.transliteration: wa ballighha minna tahiyyatan wa salaman
lines.english: convey to her our greetings and compliments,

lines.arabic: وَآتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فِي حُبِّهَا فَضْلاً وَإِحْسَاناً
lines.transliteration: wa atina min ladunka fi hubbha fadlan wa ihsanan
lines.english: and grant us, from You on account of our love for her, favor, kindness,
mercy, and forgiveness.
Verily, You are the All-generous Lord of pardon.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa binta rasoolil laahe

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ خَلِیْلِ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa binta khaleelil laahe

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ نَبِیِّ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa binta nabiyyill laahe

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ حَبِیْبِ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa binta habeebil laahe

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ صَفِیِّ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa binta safiyyil laahe

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ اَمِیْنِ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa binta ameenil laahe

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ خَیْرِ خَلْقِ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa binta khayre khalqil laahe

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ اَفْضَلِ اَنْبِیَآئِ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa binta afzale ambeyaaa-il laahe
wa rosolehi wa malaaa-ekatehi

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ خَیْرِ الْبَرِیَّۃِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa binta khayril bariyyate

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا سَیِّدَۃَ نِسَآئِ الْعَالَمِیْنَ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa sayyedata nesaaa-il a'alameena

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا زَوْجَۃَ وَلِیِّ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa zawjata waliyyil laahe

lines.arabic: وَ خَیْرِ الْخَلْقِ بَعْدَ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: wa khayril khalqe ba'da rasoolil laahe

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا اُمَّ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَیْنِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa ummal hasane wal-husayne
sayyeday shabaabe ahlil jannate
assalaamo a'layke ayyatohash shaheedatus siddeeqato
assalaamo a'layke ayyatohar raziyyatul marziyyato
assalaamo a'layke ayyatohal fazelatuz zakiyya
assalaamo a'alyke ayyatohal hawraaa-ul insiyyato

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ یَا فَاطِمَۃُ بِنْتَ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke yaa faatemato binta rasoolil laahe

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَیْكِ وَ عَلٰی بَعْلِكِ وَ بَنِیْكِ وَ رَحْمَۃُ اللّٰہِ وَ بَرَكَاتُہٗ
lines.english: assalaamo a'layke wa a'laa ba'leke wa baneeke wa rahmatul laahe wa barakaatohu

lines.arabic: صَلَّی اللّٰہُ عَلَیْكِ وَ عَلٰی رُوْحِكِ وَ بَدَنِكِ
lines.english: sallal laaho a'layke wa a'laa rooheke wa badaneke

lines.arabic: اَشْہَدُ اَنَّكِ مَضَیْتِ عَلٰی بَیِّنَۃٍ مِنْ رَبِّكِ
lines.english: ash-hado annake mazayte a'laa bayyenatin min rabbeka

lines.arabic: وَ اَنَّ مَنْ سَرَّكِ فَقَدْ سَرَّ رَسُوْلَ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: wa anna man sarrake faqad sarra rasoolal laahe

lines.arabic: وَ مَنْ جَفَاكِ فَقَدْ جَفَا رَسُوْلَ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: wa man jafaake faqad jafaa rasoolal laahe

lines.arabic: وَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ فَقَدْ قَطَعَ رَسُوْلَ اللّٰہِ
lines.english: wa man qata-a'ke faqad qata-a' rasoolal laahe

lines.arabic: لِاَنَّكِ بَضْعَۃٌ مِنْہُ وَ رُوْحُہُ الَّتِیْ بَیْنَ جَنْبَیْہِ
lines.english: le-annake baz-a'tum minho wa roohohul latee bayna jambayhe

lines.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ عَلَیْہِ اَفْضَلُ سَلاَمِ اللّٰہِ وَ اَفْضَلُ صَلَوَاتِہٖ
lines.english: kamaa qaala a'layhe afzalo sallamil laahe wa afzaol salawaatehi

lines.arabic: اُشْہِدُ اللّٰہَ وَ رَسُوْلَہٗ اَنِّیْ رَاضٍ عَمَّنْ رَضِیْتِ عَنْہُ
lines.english: ush-hedul laaha wa rasoolahu annee raazin a'mman razeete a'nho
saakhetun a'mman sha-khit-te a'layhe
motabarre-un mimman tabarrate minho mowalin
leman walayte moaadin leman ;a'adayte

lines.arabic: مُبْغِضٌ لِمَنْ اَبْغَضْتِ مُحِبٌّ لِمَنْ اَحْبَبْتِ
lines.english: mubghezun leman abghazte mohibbun leman ahbabte

lines.arabic: وَ كَفٰی بِاللّٰہِ شَہِیْدًا وَ حَسِیْبًا وَ جَازِیًا وَ مُثِیْبًا۔
lines.english: wa kafaa billaahe sha-heedan wa haseeban jaazeyan wa moseeban.

lines.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ عَلٰی عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُوْلِكَ
lines.english: allaahumma salle wa sallim a'laa a'bdeka wa rasooleka

lines.arabic: مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّٰہِ خَاتَمِ النَّبِیِّیْنَ
lines.english: mohammadibne a'bdil laahe khaatamin nabiyyeena
wa khayril khalqe ajma-e'ena

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلٰی وَصِیِّہٖ عَلِیِّ بْنِ اَبِیْ طَالِبٍ
lines.english: wa salle a'laa wasiyyehi a'liyyibne abee taalebin
ameeril moa-meneena wa emaamil muslemeena
wa khayril wasiyyeena

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلٰی فَاطِمَۃَ بِنْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: wa salle a'laa faatemata binte mohammadin

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلٰی سَیِّدَیْ شَبَابِ اَھْلِ الْجَنَّۃِ
lines.english: wa salle a'laa sayyeday sha-baabe ahlil jannate
al-hasane wal-husayne

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلٰی زَیْنِ الْعَابِدِیْنَ عَلِیِّ بْنِ الْحُسَیْنِ
lines.english: wa salle a'laa zaynil a'abedeena a'liyyibnil husayne

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ بَاقِرِ عِلْمِ الْنَّبِیِّیْنَ
lines.english: wa salle a'laa mohammadibne a'liyyenil baaqere i'lmin nabiyyeena

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلَی الصَّادِقِ عَنِ اللّٰہِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: wa salle a'las saadeqe a'nil laahe ja'faribne mohammadin

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلٰی كَاظِمِ الْغَیْظِ فِیْ اللّٰہِ مُوْسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ
lines.english: wa salle a'laa kaazemil ghayze fil laahe moosabne ja'farin

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلَی الرِّضَا عَلِیِّ بْنِ مُوْسٰی
lines.english: wa salle a'lar rezaa a'liyyibne moosaa

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلَی التَّقِیِّ مَحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ
lines.english: wa salle a'lat taqiyye mohammadibne a'liyyin

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلَی النَّقِیِّ عَلِیِّ بْنِ مَحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: wa salle a'lan naqiyye a'liyyibne mohammadin

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلَی الزَّكِیِّ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ
lines.english: wa salle a'laz zakiyyil hasanibne a'liyyin

lines.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلَی الْحُجَّۃِ الْقَآئِمِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ
lines.english: wa salle a'lal hujjatil qaaa-emibnil hasanibne a'liyyin

lines.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اَحْیِ بِہِ الْعَدْلَ وَ اَمِتْ بِہِ الْجَوْرَ
lines.english: allaahumma ahye behil a'dla wa amit behil jawra

lines.arabic: وَ زَیِّنْ بِبَقَآئِہِ الْاَرْضَ وَ اَظْہِرْ بِہٖ دِیْنَكَ
lines.english: wa zayyin be-baqaaa-ehil arza wa azhir behi deenaka

lines.arabic: وَ سُنَّۃَ نَبِیِّكَ حَتّٰی لاَ یَسْتَخْفِیَ بِشَیْئٍ مِنَ الْحَقِّ
lines.english: wa sunnata nabiyyeka hattaa laa yastakhfeya be-shayin menal haqqe

lines.arabic: مَخَافَۃَ اَحَدٍ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ وَ اجْعَلْنَا مِنْ اَشْیَآعِہٖ
lines.english: makhaafata ahadin menal khalqe waj-a'lnaa min ash-yaaa-e'hi

lines.arabic: وَ اَتْبَآعِہٖ وَ الْمَقْبُوْلِیْنَ فِیْ زُمْرَۃِ اَوْلِیَآئِہٖ
lines.english: wa atbaaa-e'hi wal-maqbooleena fee zumrate awleyaaa-ehi
yaa arhamar raahemeena

lines.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَھْلِ بَیْتِہٖ
lines.english: allaahumma salle a'laa mohammadin wa ahle baytehi

lines.arabic: اَلَّذِیْنَ اَذْہَبْتَ عَنْہُمُ الرِّجْسَ وَ طَہَّرْتَہُمْ تَطْہِیْرًا۔
lines.english: allazeena azhabta a'nhomur rijsa wa tahhartahum tatheeran.
O Allah; I do turn my face to You seeking the mediation of our Prophet,

lines.arabic: مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّی اللّٰہُ عَلَیْہِ وَ آلِہٖ
lines.transliteration: mohammadin sallal laaho a'layhe wa aalehi
lines.english: Muhammad, Allah's blessings be upon him and his Household,
and of his Household, Your blessings be upon them.

lines.arabic: وَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْعَظِیْمِ الَّذِیْ لاَ یَعْلَمُ كُنْہَہٗ سِوَاكَ
lines.transliteration: wa as-aloka be-haqqekal a'zeemil lazee laa ya'lamo kunhahu sewaaka
lines.english: And I beseech You in the name of Your Great Right that none can recognize its essence except You.

lines.arabic: وَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مَنْ حَقُّہٗ عِنْدَكَ عَظِیْمٌ
lines.transliteration: wa as-aloka be-haqqeka man haqqohu i'ndaka a'zeemun
lines.english: And I beseech in the name of everyone who enjoy great rights with You,

lines.arabic: وَ بِاَسْمَآئِكَ الْحُسْنَی الَّتِیْ اَمَرْتَنِیْ اَنْ اَدْعُوْكَ بِہَا
lines.transliteration: wa be-asmaaa-ekal husnal latee amartanee an ad-o'oka behaa
lines.english: and in the name of Your Most Excellent Names that You ordered me to pray You in their names.

lines.arabic: وَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْاَعْظَمِ الَّذِیْ اَمَرْتَ بِہٖ
lines.transliteration: wa as-aloka bismekal a-a'zamil lazee amarta behi
lines.english: And I beseech You in the name of Your Greatest Name, which You ordered
(Prophet) Abraham, peace upon him,
to call the birds by it and, as a result, they responded.

lines.arabic: وَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِیْمِ الَّذِیْ قُلْتَ لِلنَّارِ
lines.transliteration: wa bismekal a'zeemil lazee qulta lin-naare
lines.english: And (I beseech You) in the name of Your Great Name by which You said to the fire,

lines.arabic: كُوْنِیْ بَرْدًا وَّ سَلاَمًا عَلٰی اِبْرَاہِیْمَ
lines.transliteration: koonee bardawn wa salaaman a'laa ibraaheema
lines.english: "Be cold and peace for Abraham!"

lines.arabic: فَكَانَتْ بَرْدًا وَّ سَلاَمًا وَ بِاَحَبِّ الْاَسْمَآئِ اِلَیْكَ
lines.transliteration: fa-kaanat bardawn wa salaaman wa be-ahabbil asmaaa-e elayka
lines.english: So, the fire became cold and peace. And (I beseech You) in the dearest Your Names to You,

lines.arabic: وَ اَشْرَفِہَا وَ اَعْظَمِہَا لَدَیْكَ وَ اَسْرَعِہَا اِجَابَۃً
lines.transliteration: wa ash-rafehaa wa a-a'zamehaa ladayka wa as-ra-e'haa ejaabatan
lines.english: and the most honorable and the most illustrious of them to You and the swiftest in response

lines.arabic: وَ اَنْجَحِہَا طَلِبَۃً وَ بِمَا اَنْتَ اَھْلُہٗ وَ مُسْتَحِقُّہٗ
lines.transliteration: wa anjahehaa talebatan wa bemaa anta ahlohu wa mustahiqqohu
lines.english: and the most successful in granting the needs, and in the name of what You are worthy of, whatever You deserve,  and whatever is incumbent for You.

lines.arabic: وَ مُسْتَوْجِبُہٗ وَ اَتَوَسَّلُ اِلَیْكَ وَ اَرْغَبُ اِلَیْكَ
lines.transliteration: wa mustawjebohu wa atawassalo elayka wa arghabo elayka
lines.english: And I do beg You, desire for You, implore You,

lines.arabic: وَ اَتَضَرَّعُ وَ اُلِحُّ عَلَیْكَ وَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِكُتُبِكَ الَّتِیْ
lines.transliteration: wa atazarra-o' wa olehho a'layka wa as-aloka be-kotobekal latee
lines.english: humbly entreat You, and beseech You in the name of Your Books

lines.arabic: أَنْزَلْتَہَا عَلٰی اَنْبِیَآئِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَیْہِمْ
lines.transliteration: anzaltahaa a'laa ambeyaaa-eka wa rosoleka salawaatoka a'layhim
lines.english: that You revealed to Your Prophets and Messengers, Your blessings be upon them,

lines.arabic: مِنَ التَّوْرٰیۃِ وَ الْاِنْجِیْلِ وَ الزَّبُوْرِ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِیْمِ
lines.transliteration: menat tawraate wal-injeele waz-zaboore wal-qur-aaanil a'zeeme
lines.english: such as the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the Great Qur'an;

lines.arabic: فَاِنَّ فِیْہَا اسْمَكَ الْاَعْظَمَ وَ بِمَا فِیْہَا
lines.transliteration: fa-inna feehas-makal a-a'zama wa bemaa feehaa
lines.english: for in these Books lies Your Greatest Name, and (I beseech You)
in the name of Your Great and Names that are found therein,

lines.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّیَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: an tosalleya a'laa mohammadiwn wa aale mohammadin
lines.english: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

lines.arabic: وَ اَنْ تُفَرِّجَ عَنْ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ شِیْعَتِہِمْ وَ مُحِبِّیْہِمْ
lines.transliteration: wa an tofarreja a'n aale mohammadin wa shee-a'tehim wa mohibbeehim
lines.english: to relieve the Household of Muhammad, their adherents, devotees,

lines.arabic: وَ عَنِّیْ وَ تَفْتَحَ اَبْوَابَ السَّمَآئِ لِدُعَآئِیْ
lines.transliteration: wa a'nnee wa taftaha abwaabas samaaa-e le-do-a'aa-ee
lines.english: and me, to open wide the gates of the heavens to receive my prayers,

lines.arabic: وَ تَرْفَعَہٗ فِی عِلِّیِّیْنَ وَ تَأْذَنَ لِیْ فِیْ ہٰذَا الْیَوْمِ
lines.transliteration: wa tar-fa-a'hu fee i'lliyyeena wa taa-zana lee fee haazal yawme
lines.english: to raise my prayers to the ranks of (the Most High), and to allow, on this very day

lines.arabic: وَ فِیْ ہٰذِہِ السَّاعَۃِ بِفَرَجِیْ وَ اِعْطَائِ اَمَلِیْ
lines.transliteration: wa fee haazehis saa-a'te be-farajee wa i-a'taa-e amalee
lines.english: and at this very hour, granting me relief and giving me what I hope for

lines.arabic: وَ سُؤْلِیْ فِی الدُّنْیَا وَ الآْخِرَۃِ
lines.transliteration: wa so-oo-lee fid dunyaa wal aakherate
lines.english: as well as what I ask You for from the affairs of this world and the Hereafter.

lines.arabic: یَا مَنْ لاَ یَعْلَمُ اَحَدٌ كَیْفَ ہُوَ وَ قُدْرَتَہٗ اِلاَّ ہُوَ
lines.transliteration: yaa man laa ya'lamo ahadun kayfa howa wa qudratahu illaa howa
lines.english: O He except Whom none can realize how He is and how His omnipotence is !

lines.arabic: یَا مَنْ سَدَّ الْہَوَآئَ بِالسَّمَآئِ وَ كَبَسَ الْاَرْضَ
lines.transliteration: yaa man saddal hawaaa-a bis-samaaa-e wa kabasal arza
lines.english: O He Who blocked the air with the heavens, surfaced the earth

lines.arabic: عَلَی الْمَآئِ وَ اخْتَارَ لِنَفْسِہٖ اَحْسَنَ الْاَسْمَآئِ
lines.transliteration: a'lal maaa-e wakhtaara le-nafsehi ahsanal asmaaa-e
lines.english: over the water, and chose for Himself the most excellent names !

lines.arabic: یَا مَنْ سَمّٰی نَفْسَہٗ بِالْاِسْمِ الَّذِیْ تُقْضٰی بِہٖ حَاجَۃُ مَنْ یَدْعُوْہُ
lines.transliteration: yaa man sammaa nafsahu fil-ismil lazee tuq-zaa behi haajato man yad-o'oho
lines.english: O He Who gave Himself the Name by which the needs of those who pray Him are granted!

lines.arabic: اَسْئَلُكَ بِحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ الْاِسْمِ فَلاَ شَفِیْعَ اَقَوٰی لِیْ مِنْہُ
lines.transliteration: as-aloka be-haqqe zaalekal isme falaa sha-fee-a' aqwaa lee minho
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of that Name, for no intercessor is more effective for me than it,

lines.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّیَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: an tosalleya a'laa mohammadiwn wa aale mohammadin
lines.english: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Mulhammad,

lines.arabic: وَ اَنْ تَقْضِیَ لِیْ حَوَآئِجِیْ وَ تُسْمِعَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa an taqzeya lee hawaaa-ejee wa tusme-a' be-mohammadin
lines.english: to settle all my needs, to make Muhammad,

lines.arabic: وَ عَلِیٍّ وَ فَاطِمَۃَ وَ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَیْنِ
lines.transliteration: wa a'liyyin wa faatemata wal-hasane wal-husayne
lines.english: 'Ali, Fatimah, Al Hasan, al-Husayn,

lines.arabic: وَ عَلِیِّ بْنِ الْحُسَیْنِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ
lines.transliteration: wa a'liyyibnil husayne wa mohammadibne a'liyyin
lines.english: Ali ibn al- Husayn, Muhammad ibn Ali,

lines.arabic: وَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ مُوْسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ
lines.transliteration: wa ja'faribne mohammadin wa moosabne ja'farin
lines.english: Jaffer ibn Muhammad, Moosa ibn Jaffer,

lines.arabic: وَ عَلِیِّ بْنِ مُوْسٰی وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ
lines.transliteration: wa a'liyyibne moosaa wa mohammadibne a'liyyin
lines.english: Ali ibn Moosa, Muhammad ibn Ali,

lines.arabic: وَ عَلِیِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ
lines.transliteration: wa a'liyyibne mohammadin wal hasanibne a'liyyin
lines.english: Ali ibn Muhammad, al- Hasan ibn Ali,

lines.arabic: وَ الْحُجَّۃِ الْمُنْتَظَرِ لِاِذْنِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ وَ سَلاَمُكَ
lines.transliteration: wal-hujjatil muntazare le-izneka salawaatoka wa salaamoka
lines.english: and the Argument- Imam who is waiting for Your permission(to reappear), Your blessings, peace,

lines.arabic: وَ رَحْمَتُكَ وَ بَرَكَاتُكَ عَلَیْہِمْ صَوْ   تِیْ
lines.transliteration: wa rahmatoka wa barakaatoka a'layhim sawtee
lines.english: mercy, and benedictions be upon them – (to make them) hear my voice

lines.arabic: لِیَشْفَعُوْا لِیْ اِلَیْكَ وَ تُشَفِّعَہُمْ فِیَّ
lines.transliteration: le-yash-fa-o'o lee elayka wa to-shaffe-a'hum fiyya
lines.english: so that they will intercede for me before You, to allow them to intercede for me,

lines.arabic: وَ لاَ تَرُدَّنِیْ خَآئِبًا بِحَقِّ لاَ اِلٰہَ اِلاَّ اَنْتَ۔
lines.transliteration: wa laa taruddanee khaaa-eban be-haqqe laa elaaha illaa anta.
lines.english: and not to make me return with disappointment. (I beseech so) in the name of there being no god save You.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O doyenne of the women of the world!

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا وَالِدَةَ ٱلْحُجَجِ عَلَىٰ ٱلنَّاسِ اجْمَعِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya walidata alhujaji `ala alnnasi ajma`ina
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O mother of the Arguments on all people!

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ ايّتُهَا ٱلْمَظْلُومَةُ ٱلْمَمْنُوعَةُ حَقَّهَا
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O wronged one whose right was usurped.
O Allah, send blessings to Your lady servant,

lines.transliteration: wabnati nabiyyika wa zawjati wasiyyi nabiyyika
lines.english: the daughter of Your Prophet, the wife of the Successor of Your Prophet—

lines.arabic: صَلاَةً تُزْلِفُهَا فَوْقَ زُلْفَىٰ عِبَادِكَ ٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ
lines.english: such remarkable blessings that approach her nearer to You than the steps of Your honored servants

lines.transliteration: min ahli alssamawati wa ahli al-aradina
lines.english: among the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Messenger of Allah.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ نَبِيِّ اللّٰهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Prophet of Allah.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ حَبِيبِ اللّٰهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Beloved of Allah.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَلِيلِ اللّٰهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Friend of Allah.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ صَفِيِّ اللّٰهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Chosen one of Allah.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ اَمِينِ اللّٰهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Trustworthy of Allah.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَيْرِ خَلْقِ اللّٰهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the best of Allah's creation.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ اَفْضَلِ اَنْبِيَاءِ اللّٰهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَ مَلائِكَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: As-salāmu ‘alayki yā binta Afḍali Anbiyā’illāh wa Rusulihi wa Malā’ikatihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the most excellent of Allah’s prophets, messengers, and angels.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَيْرِ الْبَرِيَّةِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the best of creation.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ مِنَ الْاَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: As-salāmu ‘alayki yā Sayyidata Nisā’ al-‘Ālamīn min al-Awwalīn wa al-Ākhirīn
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O leader of the women of the worlds, from the first to the last.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا زَوْجَةَ وَلِيِّ اللّٰهِ وَ خَيْرِ الْخَلْقِ بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ
lines.transliteration: As-salāmu ‘alayki yā Zawjata Walīyyillāh wa Khayr al-Khalq ba‘da Rasūlillāh
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O spouse of the guardian of Allah and the best of creation after the Messenger of Allah.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ سَيِّدَيْ شَبَابِ اَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ
lines.transliteration: As-salāmu ‘alayki yā Umm al-Ḥasan wa al-Ḥusayn Sayyiday Shabāb Ahl al-Jannah
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O mother of Hasan and Husayn, the leaders of the youth of Paradise.
Peace be upon you, O truthful and martyred one.
Peace be upon you, O the contented and pleasing one.
Peace be upon you, O virtuous and pure one.
Peace be upon you, O heavenly maiden in human form.
Peace be upon you, O God-fearing and pure one.
Peace be upon you, O the one spoken to by angels, the knowledgeable one.
Peace be upon you, O the oppressed and wronged one.
Peace be upon you, O the persecuted and subdued one.

lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.transliteration: As-salāmu ‘alayki yā Fāṭimah binta Rasūlillāh wa Raḥmatullāhi wa Barakātuh
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Fāṭimah, daughter of the Messenger of Allah, and may Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

lines.arabic: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْكِ وَ عَلَى رُوحِكِ وَ بَدَنِكِ
lines.english: May Allah’s blessings be upon you, your soul, and your body.

lines.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكِ مَضَيْتِ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكِ
lines.transliteration: Ashhadu annaki maḍayti ‘alā bayyinatin min Rabbik
lines.english: I bear witness that you departed upon clear guidance from your Lord.

lines.arabic: وَ اَنَّ مَنْ سَرَّكِ فَقَدْ سَرَّ رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
lines.transliteration: Wa anna man sar-raki faqad sarra Rasūlallāh ṣallallāhu ‘alayhi wa ālih
lines.english: And whoever pleased you has indeed pleased the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family.

lines.arabic: وَ مَنْ جَفَاكِ فَقَدْ جَفَا رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
lines.transliteration: Wa man jafāki faqad jafā Rasūlallāh ṣallallāhu ‘alayhi wa ālih
lines.english: And whoever offended you has indeed offended the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family.

lines.arabic: وَ مَنْ آذَاكِ فَقَدْ آذَى رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
lines.transliteration: Wa man ādhāki faqad ādhā Rasūlallāh ṣallallāhu ‘alayhi wa ālih
lines.english: And whoever harmed you has indeed harmed the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family.

lines.arabic: وَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ فَقَدْ وَصَلَ رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
lines.transliteration: Wa man waṣalaki faqad waṣala Rasūlallāh ṣallallāhu ‘alayhi wa ālih
lines.english: And whoever connected with you has indeed connected with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family.

lines.arabic: وَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ فَقَدْ قَطَعَ رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
lines.transliteration: Wa man qaṭa‘aki faqad qaṭa‘a Rasūlallāh ṣallallāhu ‘alayhi wa ālih
lines.english: And whoever cut ties with you has indeed cut ties with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family.

lines.arabic: لِاَنَّكِ بَضْعَةٌ مِنْهُ وَ رُوحُهُ الَّذِي بَيْنَ جَنْبَيْهِ
lines.transliteration: Li’annaki baḍ‘atun minhu wa rūḥuhu alladhī bayna janbayhi
lines.english: For you are a part of him and his soul that resides within him.

lines.arabic: اُشْهِدُ اللّٰهَ وَ مَلائِكَتَهُ اَنِّي وَلِيٌّ لِمَنْ وَالاكِ وَ عَدُوٌّ لِمَنْ عَادَاكِ وَ حَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حَارَبَكِ
lines.transliteration: Ushhidu Allāha wa malā’ikatahu annī walīyyun liman wālāk wa ‘aduwwun liman ‘ādāk wa ḥarbun liman ḥārabak
lines.english: I call Allah and His angels to witness that I am a supporter of those who are loyal to you, an enemy to those who show enmity toward you, and at war with those who wage war against you.

lines.arabic: اَنَا يَا مَوْلاتِي بِكِ وَ بِاَبِيكِ وَ بَعْلِكِ وَ الْاَئِمَّةِ مِنْ وُلْدِكِ مُوقِنٌ وَ بِوِلايَتِهِمْ مُؤْمِنٌ وَ لِطَاعَتِهِمْ مُلْتَزِمٌ
lines.transliteration: Anā yā mawlātī biki wa bi-abīki wa ba‘lik wa al-a’immati min wuldiki mūqinun wa bi-wilāyatihim mu’minun wa li-ṭā‘atihim multazim
lines.english: O my mistress, I have certainty in you, your father, your spouse, and the Imams from your offspring. I believe in their authority and am committed to their obedience.

lines.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّ الدِّينَ دِينُهُمْ وَ الْحُكْمَ حُكْمُهُمْ وَ هُمْ قَدْ بَلَّغُوا عَنِ اللّٰهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ دَعَوْا اِلَى سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَ الْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ لا تَأْخُذُهُمْ فِي اللّٰهِ لَوْمَةُ لائِمٍ
lines.transliteration: Ashhadu anna ad-dīna dīnuhum wa al-ḥukma ḥukmuhum wa hum qad ballaghū ‘anillāhi ‘azza wa jalla wa da‘aw ilā sabīlillāh bil-ḥikmati wa al-maw‘iẓati al-ḥasanah lā ta’khudhuhum fīllāhi lawmatu lā’im
lines.english: I testify that the religion is their religion, the judgment is their judgment, and they delivered Allah’s message, invited toward His path with wisdom and good advice, and were not deterred by the reproach of any critic in Allah’s cause.

lines.arabic: وَ صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكِ وَ عَلَى اَبِيكِ وَ بَعْلِكِ وَ ذُرِّيَّتِكِ الْاَئِمَّةِ الطَّاهِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: Wa ṣalawātu Allāhi ‘alayki wa ‘alā abīki wa ba‘lik wa dhurriyyatik al-a’immati aṭ-ṭāhirīn
lines.english: And may Allah’s blessings be upon you, your father, your spouse, and your pure offspring, the Imams.

lines.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى الْبَتُولِ الطَّاهِرَةِ الصِّدِّيقَةِ الْمَعْصُومَةِ التَّقِيَّةِ النَّقِيَّةِ الرَّضِيَّةِ الْمَرْضِيَّةِ الزَّكِيَّةِ الرَّشِيدَةِ الْمَظْلُومَةِ الْمَقْهُورَةِ الْمَغْصُوبَةِ [الْمَغْضُوبِ‏] حَقُّهَا الْمَمْنُوعَةِ [الْمَمْنُوعِ‏] اِرْثُهَا الْمَكْسُورَةِ [الْمَكْسُورِ] ضِلْعُهَا الْمَظْلُومِ بَعْلُهَا الْمَقْتُولِ وَلَدُهَا
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa Ahl Baytihi wa ṣalli ‘alā al-Batūl aṭ-Ṭāhirah aṣ-Ṣiddīqah al-Ma‘ṣūmah at-Taqiyyah an-Naqiyyah ar-Raḍiyyah al-Marḍiyyah az-Zakiyyah ar-Rashīdah al-Maẓlūmah al-Maqhūrah al-Maghṣūbah [al-Maghḍūb] ḥaqqahā al-mamnū‘ah [al-Mamnū‘] irthahā al-maksūrah [al-Maksūr] ḍil‘ahā al-maẓlūm ba‘lahā al-maqtūl waladahā
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muḥammad and his family, and send blessings upon the pure and chaste Virgin, the truthful, the infallible, the pious, the pure, the contented, the pleasing, the virtuous, the guiding, the oppressed, the subdued, the usurped, whose rights were denied, whose inheritance was withheld, whose rib was broken, whose spouse was killed, and whose children were oppressed.

lines.arabic: فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِكَ وَ بَضْعَةِ لَحْمِهِ، وَ صَمِيمِ قَلْبِهِ وَ فِلْذَةِ كَبِدِهِ وَ النُّخْبَةِ مِنْكَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: Fāṭimah bint Rasūlik wa baḍ‘ata laḥmihi wa ṣamīma qalbihi wa fiḍḍata kabdihi wa an-nukhbata minka lahu
lines.english: Fāṭimah, daughter of Your Messenger, a part of his flesh, the essence of his heart, and the piece of his liver, chosen by You for him.

lines.arabic: وَ التُّحْفَةِ خَصَصْتَ بِهَا وَصِيَّهُ وَ حَبِيبَةِ الْمُصْطَفَى وَ قَرِينَةِ الْمُرْتَضَى
lines.transliteration: Wa at-tuḥfata khaaṣaṣta bihā waṣiyyahu wa ḥabībata al-Muṣṭafā wa qarīnatu al-Murtaḍā
lines.english: And a gift bestowed upon him, the beloved of al-Muṣṭafā (the Chosen One), and the companion of al-Murtaḍā (the Chosen One).

lines.arabic: وَ سَيِّدَةِ النِّسَاءِ وَ مُبَشِّرَةِ الْاَوْلِيَاءِ
lines.transliteration: Wa Sayyidati an-Nisā’ wa Mubash-shirati al-Awliyā’
lines.english: The leader of the women and the bearer of glad tidings to the righteous ones.

lines.arabic: حَلِيفَةِ الْوَرَعِ وَ الزُّهْدِ وَ تُفَّاحَةِ الْفِرْدَوْسِ وَ الْخُلْدِ
lines.transliteration: Ḥalīfata al-Wara‘ wa az-Zuhd wa Tuffāḥata al-Firdaws wa al-Khuld
lines.english: The companion of piety and asceticism, the apple of Paradise and eternity.

lines.arabic: الَّتِي شَرَّفْتَ مَوْلِدَهَا بِنِسَاءِ الْجَنَّةِ وَ سَلَلْتَ مِنْهَا اَنْوَارَ الْاَئِمَّةِ وَ اَرْخَيْتَ دُونَهَا حِجَابَ النُّبُوَّةِ
lines.transliteration: Allatī shar-rafta mawlidahā binisā’ al-Jannah wa salalta minhā anwāra al-a’immah wa arkhayta dūnahā ḥijāba an-Nubuwwah
lines.english: The one whose birth You honored with the women of Paradise, from whom You drew the lights of the Imams, and over whom You placed the veil of prophethood.

lines.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهَا صَلاةً تَزِيدُ فِي مَحَلِّهَا عِنْدَكَ وَ شَرَفِهَا لَدَيْكَ وَ مَنْزِلَتِهَا مِنْ رِضَاكَ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alayhā ṣalātan tazīdu fī maḥallihā ‘indak wa sharafihā ladayk wa manzilatihā min riḍāk
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings upon her, blessings that elevate her station with You, enhance her honor before You, and increase her status in attaining Your pleasure.

lines.arabic: وَ بَلِّغْهَا مِنَّا تَحِيَّةً وَ سَلاما وَ آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فِي حُبِّهَا فَضْلا وَ اِحْسَانا وَ رَحْمَةً وَ غُفْرَانا اِنَّكَ ذُو الْعَفْوِ الْكَرِيمِ
lines.transliteration: Wa balligh-hā minnā taḥiyyatan wa salāman wa ātinā min ladunka fī ḥubbihā faḍlan wa iḥsānan wa raḥmatan wa ghufrānan innaka Dhū al-‘Afwi al-Karīm
lines.english: And convey to her from us greetings and peace, and grant us from Yourself through our love for her bounty, kindness, mercy, and forgiveness. Truly, You are the Possessor of gracious pardon.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مُمْتَحَنَةُ امْتَحَنَكِ الَّذِي خَلَقَكِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَكِ وَ كُنْتِ لِمَا امْتَحَنَكِ بِهِ صَابِرَةً
lines.english: Peace be on you, O the carefully examined, tried and measured by Him who created you, and found you, in your test, cool and compact, steady and stable.

lines.arabic: وَ نَحْنُ لَكِ أَوْلِيَاءُ مُصَدِّقُونَ وَ لِكُلِّ مَا أَتَى بِهِ أَبُوكِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ سَلَّمَ
lines.english: We tell the truth about you; calm and quiet, with self control and composure (you) put up with all that which your father blessings of Allah be on him and on his family

lines.arabic: وَ أَتَى بِهِ وَصِيُّهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مُسَلِّمُونَ
lines.english: and his "Wasi" (successor) peace be on him came across.

lines.arabic: وَ نَحْنُ نَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِذْ كُنَّا مُصَدِّقِينَ لَهُمْ أَنْ تُلْحِقَنَا بِتَصْدِيقِنَا بِالدَّرَجَةِ الْعَالِيَةِ
lines.english: We beseech you, (If I have stated the truth), to bind us together with the testimony, concerning both of them, in order to give joy and satisfaction to my heart and soul.

lines.arabic: لِنُبَشِّرَ أَنْفُسَنَا بِأَنَّا قَدْ طَهُرْنَا بِوِلاَيَتِهِمْ (بِوَلاَيَتِهِمْ) عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ
lines.english: So bear witness that truly I, by heart, made evident your, and your children's "wilayat" (superintendent guardianship), blessings of Allah be on them all
O the Lady who was tested!
God Almighty tested You before You were born.
And found You patient and exalted in this test.
We believe that we are the ones who believe in Your love and Your guardianship.

lines.arabic: وَصابِرُونَ لِکُلِّ مَا ٲَتَانَا بِہِ ٲَ بُوکِ صَلَّی اللّهُ عَلَیْہِ وَآلِہِ، وَٲَتی بِہِ وَصِیُّہُ،
lines.english: And  will obey what Your father  and His Heir had brought.

lines.arabic: فَإنّا نَسْٲَلُکِ إنْ کُنَّا صَدَّقْناکِ إلاَّ ٲَلْحَقْتِنَا بِتَصْدِیقِنَا
lines.english: Thus we  accepted Your guardianship , then by the charity of Your guardianship make us accompany with the Prophet of Islam and His rightful successor,

lines.arabic: لَھُما لِنُبَشِّرَ ٲَنْفُسَنا بِٲَنَّا قَدْ طَھُرْنا بِوِلایَتِکِ
lines.english: so that we may announce to ourselves that we have become pious and pure as a result of Your guardianship .
Peace be upon you, O examined lady.
He Who created you has examined you
and found that you have passed the examination patiently.

lines.arabic: أَنَا لَكِ مُصَدِّقٌ صَابِرٌ عَلَىٰ مَا أَتَىٰ بِهِ أَبُوكِ وَوَصِيُّهُ صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا
lines.transliteration: ana laki musaddiqun sabirun `ala ma ata bihi abuki wa wasiyyuhu salawatu allahi `alayhima
lines.english: I verify that you were patient about what came upon your father and his his successor peace be upon both of

lines.transliteration: wa ana as'aluki in kuntu saddaqtuki
lines.english: I now beseech you by my belief in you
to attach & associate me with my belief in both of them
so that I will be delighted.
So, testify for me that I am totally loyal to you
and to your Household;
peace of Allah be upon them all.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلصِّدِّيقَةِ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّكِيَّةِ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon the veracious and immaculate lady Fatimah
the most beloved by Your dearest and Prophet
and the mother of Your dearest and choice ones.
You have selected, given preference to,
and chosen her from among the women of the worlds (i.e. ages).

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كُنِ ٱلطَّالِبَ لَهَا مِمَّنْ ظَلَمَهَا
lines.transliteration: allahumma kun alttaliba laha mimman zalamaha
lines.english: O Allah, be her representative against those who wronged her
and belittled her right.

lines.transliteration: wa kun alththa'ira allahumma bidami awladiha
lines.english: Be, O Allah, the One Who shall  revenge upon those who shed the blood of her descendants.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا جَعَلْتَهَا أُمَّ أَئِمَّةِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa kama ja`altaha umma a'immati alhuda
lines.english: O Allah, just as You have chosen her to be the mother of the Leaders of Guidance,
the wife of the Bearer of the Pennon,
and the most honored lady with the Highest Group,
so (please) do endow her and her mother
with such blessings that confer honor upon her father
Muhammad, Allah's blessings be upon him,
and delight the eyes of her offspring.
And (please) convey to them, at this very hour,
the most excellent greeting and salutation from me.

lines.arabic: اَلَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلىٰ فَاطِمَةَ وَ اَبِيْهَا وَ بَعْلِهَا وَ بَنِيْهَا وَ سِرِِّ الْمُسْتَوْدِعِ فِيْهَا بِعَدَدِ مَا اَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
lines.transliteration: ma Salle al Fatima wa abeeha wa baleha wa baneeha wa sirril mustaudaeh fiha beadada maa ahaata be
lines.english: Oh Allah send blessings on Fatima and her father, her husband and her sons, and by the secret installed in her (S)) which only is in YOUR know

lines.arabic: إِلَهِي بِحَقِّ فَاطِمَةَ وَأَبِيهَا، وَبَعْلِهَا وَبَنِيهَا وَالسِّرِّ الْمُسْتَوْدَعِ فِيهَا

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ فَاطِمَةَ وَأَبِيهَا، وَبَعْلِهَا وَبَنِيهَا وَالسِّرِّ الْمُسْتَوْدَعِ فِيهَا أَن تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَ أَن تَفْعَلَ بِي مَا أَنتَ أَهْلُهُ، وَلَا تَفْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ

اللَّهُمَّ بِفَاطِمَةَ وَأَبِيهَا وَبَعْلِهَا وَبَنِيهَا، وَالسِّرِّ الْمُسْتَوْدَعِ فِيهَا، بِعَدَدِ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ أَن تَقْضِيَ حَوَائِجَ حَامِلِ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ وَيَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
اَلَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلىٰ فَاطِمَةَ وَ اَبِيْهَا وَ بَعْلِهَا وَ بَنِيْهَا وَ سِرِِّ الْمُسْتَوْدِعِ فِيْهَا بِعَدَدِ مَا اَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
lines.transliteration: Allahumma Salle al Fatima wa abeeha wa baleha wa baneeha wa sirril mustaudaeh fiha beadada maa ahaata behi ilmuk
lines.english: Oh Allah send blessings on Fatima and her father, her husband and her sons, and by the secret installed in her (sa) which only is in YOUR knowledge

lines.arabic: يَا آمِنًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْكَ خَائِفٌ حَذِرٌ
lines.transliteration: Yā āminan min kulli shay'in wa kullu shay'in minka khā'ifun ḥadhirun
lines.english: O He who is safe from everything, while everything is fearful and cautious of You.

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَمْنِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَخَوْفِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مِنْكَ
lines.transliteration: As'aluka bi'amnika min kulli shay'in wa khawfi kulli shay'in minka
lines.english: I ask You by Your safety from everything, and by the fear everything has of You,

lines.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَنْ تُعْطِيَنِي أَمَانًا لِنَفْسِي وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي وَوَلَدِي
lines.transliteration: An tuṣalliya 'alá Muḥammadin wa an tu'ṭiyanī amānan li nafsī wa ahlī wa mālī wa waladī
lines.english: To bless Muhammad and to grant me safety for myself, my family, my wealth, and my children,

lines.arabic: حَتَّى لَا أَخَافَ أَحَدًا وَلَا أَحْذَرَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَبَدًا
lines.transliteration: Ḥattā lā akhāfa aḥadan wa lā aḥdhara min shay'in abadan
lines.english: So that I do not fear anyone, nor am I cautious of anything ever.
Indeed, You have power over all things.

lines.transliteration: Allahumma Salle ala Mohammed wa Aalehi
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

lines.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّ علَىٰ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
lines.transliteration: An tusslle `ala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammad
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

lines.arabic:
وَ اَنْ تَفْعَل بِىْ اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ
وَلاَ تَفْعَلْ بِىْ مَا اَنَا اَهْلُهُ

lines.english: Please act as per your stature and do not act based on what I deserve

title: Ziyarat of Imam Ali (as) Shrine
description: The comprehensive Ziyarat of the Commander of the Faithful, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) at his holy shrine in Najaf.

lines.english: Leaving House/ Reaching Najaf |
At the door
Shaykh al-Mufid, al-Shahid, Sayyid Ibn Tawus, and others have mentioned the following form of Ziyarah:
D0 Ghusl and While you are about to
leave your house,
you may say the following:

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي خَرَجْتُ مِنْ مَنْزِلِي أَبْغِي فَضْلَكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni kharajtu min manzili abghi fadlaka
lines.english: O Allah, I leave my house seeking Your bounties
and visiting the Viceroy of Your Prophet—peace of You be upon both of them.
So, O Allah, (please do) make it easy for me,
help me pay this visit to him,
and take my place, while I am away, in my affairs and possessions
in the best manner of taking place.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
You may then proceed, extolling Almighty Allah with the following doxology:
All praise be to Allah.
All glory be to Allah.
There is no god but Allah.
Once you reach the trench of al-Kufah, you may stop there and say the following words:
Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great.
O worthiest of exaltation, glorification, and grandeur.
Allah is the Most Great. O worthiest of being deemed Great, of sanctification,
of glorification, and of granting bounties.

lines.transliteration: allahu akbaru mimma akhafu wa ahdharu
lines.english: Allah is Greater than what I fear and what I worry about.
Allah is the Most Great; He is my support and on Him do I rely.

lines.transliteration: allahu akbaru raja'i wa ilayhi unibu
lines.english: Allah is the Most Great; He is my hope and to Him do I turn.
O Allah, You are indeed the source of my blessings
and You alone can respond to my request.
You know my neediness
and whatever is concealed by the premonitions of hearts
and the thoughts of inner selves.
I therefore beseech You in the name of Muhammad, the Chosen Prophet,
through whom You have stopped all the claims of those who may excuse
and the pretexts of those who may make apologies
and whom You have decided to be mercy to the peoples,

lines.arabic: أَنْ لاََ تَحْرِمَنِي ثَوَابَ زِيَارَةِ وَلِيِّكَ
lines.transliteration: an la tahrimani thawaba ziyarati waliyyika
lines.english: (I beseech You) not to deprive me of the rewards of my visiting Your intimate servant,

lines.transliteration: wa akhi nabiyyika amiri almu'minina wa qasdahu
lines.english: the brother of Your Prophet, and the Commander of the Believers and my directing to him,
and to include me with the virtuous delegation to him
and with his pious adherents;
(I beseech for that) in the name of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

lines.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا ٱخْتَصَّنِي بِهِ
lines.english: All praise be to Allah, for He has conferred upon me exclusively
the legitimacy of birth,
and for He has bestowed me, out of His honoring me,
with the loyalty to the pious,
immaculate representatives (of Him),
the best of all, and the most knowledgeable.
O Allah, (please do) accept my seeking for You
and my earnest imploration in Your Presence

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي لاََ تَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati la takhfa `alayka
lines.english: and (please do) forgive my sins that cannot be hidden from You.
Verily, You are Allah, the King, the All-forgiving.
When you reach at the fortress of Najaf (hisn al-najaf), you may say the following words:
All praise be to Allah Who has guided us to this;

lines.arabic: وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْلاَ أَنْ هَدَانَا ٱللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: wa ma kunna linahtadiya lawla an hadana allahu
lines.english: and we would not have found the way had it not been that Allah had guided us.

lines.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي سَيَّرَنِي فِي بِلاَدِهِ
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi sayyarani fi biladihi
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who has made me travel in His countries,
Who has caused me to ride His animals,
Who has made the distant space seem near for me,
Who has kept away from me what is dangerous,
and Who has held off against me what is unwanted
until He made me come up to the Precinct of the brother of His Messenger,
peace be upon him and his Household.
You may then enter the city, saying:

lines.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي أَدْخَلَنِي هٰذِهِ ٱلْبُقْعَةَ ٱلْمُبَارَكَةَ
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi adkhalani hadhihi albuq`ata almubarakata
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who has allowed me to enter this blessed zone,
which Allah has blessed
and has chosen for His Prophet’s Successor.
O Allah, (please do) make this zone witness for me.
When you reach at the first doorstep, you may say the following:
O Allah, I have stopped at Your door,
I have come to Your court,
to Your Cord do I cling,
Your mercy do I seek,
and by Your Intimate Servant—may Your blessings be upon him—do I beg You.
So, (please do) make it an admissible visit
and a responded supplication.
You may then stop at the gate of the courtyard, saying the following:
O Allah, this holy place is verily Yours,
this situation is Yours,
and I am entering here so as to confide to You
things that You are more knowledgeable than I am
as well as You are more knowledgeable than I am as regards my secrets and my confidential speech.
All praise be to Allah, the All-benevolent, the All-favorer, the All-munificent,

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذِي مِنْ تَطَوُّلِهِ سَهَّلَ لِي زِيَارَةَ مَوْلاَيَ بِإِحْسَانِهِ
lines.transliteration: alladhi min tatawwulihi sahhala li ziyarata mawlaya bi'ihsanihi
lines.english: Who, out of His munificence, has made it easy for me to visit my master,
Who has not made me banned from visiting him,
and Who has not included me with those who are prevented from being loyal to his (Divinely commissioned) leadership;
rather, He has bestowed upon me and donated me (this favor).
O Allah, just as You have conferred upon me with the favor of recognition of him,
so also (please do) include me with his adherents (Shi`ah)
and allow me to enter Paradise by means of his intercession,
O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
You may then enter the courtyard of the holy shrine and say the following words:
All praise be to Allah Who has honored me with the recognition of Him,
the recognition of His Messenger,
and the recognition of him the obedience to whom has been made incumbent upon me by Him
on account of His mercy to me,
His favor that He bestowed upon me,
and His conferral upon me with faith.

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي أَدْخَلَنِي حَرَمَ أَخِي رَسُولِهِ
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi adkhalani harama akhi rasulihi
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who has allowed me to enter the shrine of His Messenger’s brother
and has made me see this shrine while I enjoy good health.

lines.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَنِي مِنْ زُوَّارِ قَبْرِ وَصِيِّ رَسُولِهِ
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi ja`alani min zuwwari qabri wasiyyi rasulihi
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who has included me with the visitors of the tomb of His Messenger’s successor.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاََ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
lines.english: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah,
alone without having any associate,

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
lines.english: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
He has conveyed the truth from Allah.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ وَأَخُو رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna `aliyyan `abdu allahi wa akhu rasuli allahi
lines.english: And I bear witness that `Ali is the servant of Allah and the brother of Allah’s Messenger.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ٱللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ٱللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
lines.transliteration: allahu akbaru allahu akbaru allahu akbaru
lines.english: Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great.

lines.arabic: لاََ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
lines.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu wallahu akbaru
lines.english: There is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great.
All praise be to Allah for He has guided me

lines.arabic: وَتَوْفِيقِهِ لِمَا دَعَا إِلَيْهِ مِنْ سَبِيلِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa tawfiqihi lima da`a ilayhi min sabilihi
lines.english: and led me successfully to His course to which He has invited (us).
O Allah, You are verily the most excellent besought One
and the most honorable purposed One.
I thus have come to You, seeking nearness to You
in the name of Your Prophet, the Prophet of Mercy
and in the name of his brother, the Commander of the Faithful,

lines.arabic: عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَّلاَمُ
lines.english: `Ali the son of Abu-Talib—peace be upon them both.
So, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
do not disappoint my efforts,

lines.arabic: وَٱنْظُرْ إِلَيَّ نَظْرَةً رَحيمَةً تُنْعَشُنِي بِهَا
lines.transliteration: wanzur ilayya nazratan rahimatan tun`ishuni biha
lines.english: (please) grant me a merciful look from You through which You refresh me,

lines.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي عِنْدَكَ وَجِيهاً فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
lines.english: make me illustrious in Your view in this world as well as the world to come,
and make me of those brought near to You.
You may then walk until you stop at the door of the portico and say the following words:
Peace be upon Allah’s Messenger

lines.arabic: أَمِينِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ وَحْيِهِ وَعَزَائِمِ أَمْرِهِ
lines.english: whom Allah has entrusted with His Revelations and with His determined commandments,
who sealed the previous Messages,
paved the way to the coming blessings,
and who prevails over all that.
May the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon him, too.
Peace be upon the holder of tranquility.
peace be upon the one buried at al-Madinah.
Peace be upon the triumphed and supported (by Allah).

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ أَبِي ٱلْقَاسِمِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala abi alqasimi muhammadi bni `abdi allahi
lines.english: Peace be upon Abu’l-Qasim, Muhammad the son of `Abdullah.
May the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon him, too.([1])
You may then enter the portico with your right foot, stop at the door of the dome, and say these words seeking permission to enter:

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
lines.english: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

lines.arabic: جَاءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
lines.transliteration: ja'a bilhaqqi min `indihi wa saddaqa almursalina
lines.english: He has conveyed the truth from Him and verified the (past) Messengers.
Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حَبِيبَ ٱللَّهِ وَخِيَرَتَهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya habiba allahi wa khiyaratahu min khalqihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O most-beloved of Allah and best of His beings!
Peace be upon the Commander of the Faithful:
the servant of Allah and the brother of Allah’s Messenger.
O master, O Commander of the Faithful!
I, your slave and the son of your slave and your bondmaid,
have come to you seeking the refuge of your protection,
directing to your shrine,
turning my face toward your place,
and begging Almighty Allah in your name.
May I enter, O master?
May I enter, O Commander of the Faithful?
May I enter, O argument of Allah?
May I enter, O trustee of Allah?

lines.arabic: أَأَدْخُلُ يَا مَلاَئِكَةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُقِيمِينَ فِي هٰذَا ٱلْمَشْهَدِ
lines.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mala'ikata allahi almuqimina fi hadha almashhadi
lines.english: May I enter, O angels of Allah who reside in this shrine?
O master, may you permit me to enter

lines.arabic: أَفْضَلَ مَا أَذِنْتَ لأَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: afdala ma adhinta li'ahadin min awliya'ika
lines.english: in the best way of permission you have ever given to any of your devotees?

lines.arabic: فَإِنْ لَمْ أَكُنْ لَهُ أَهْلاًَ فَأَنْتَ أَهْلٌ لِذٰلِكَ
lines.transliteration: fa'in lam akun lahu ahlan fa'anta ahlun lidhlika
lines.english: If I am too little to deserve your permission, then You are too exalted to deprive me of it.
You  may then kiss the doorstep and enter there with your right foot, saying the following
In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),
on the way of Allah,
and on the norm of the Messenger of Allah (I proceed),
may Allah bless him and his Household.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱغْفِرْ لِي وَٱرْحَمْنِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ
lines.transliteration: allahumma ighfir li warhamni wa tub `alayya
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) forgive me
for You are verily the Oft-Returning.
First Main Form of Ziarat
When you face and are opposite to the holy tomb, stop there before reaching the tomb, and say the following:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu min allahi `ala muhammadin rasuli allahi
lines.english: Peace of Allah be upon Muhammad the Messenger of Allah,
the trustee of Allah over His Revelations, Messages,
and determined commandments,
the core of the Divine Inspiration and Revelation,
who sealed the previous Messages,
paved the way to the coming blessings,
who prevails over all that,
the witness over the creatures,
and the luminous torch.

lines.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayhi wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ ٱلْمَظْلُومِينَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi almazlumina
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household, the oppressed ones,
with the best, most perfect, most exalted,
and most honored blessings that You have ever showed on any

lines.transliteration: min anbiya'ika wa rusulika wa asfiya'ika
lines.english: of Your Prophets, Messengers, and Chosen servants.
O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon the Commander of the Faithful,
Your servant, the best of Your creatures after Your Prophet,
the brother of Your Messenger,
the Successor of Your most-beloved one,
whom You have selected from among Your beings,
the guide to those whom You sent with Your messages,
the establisher of the true religion by means of Your justice,
and the decisive judge among Your beings.

lines.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayhi wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon the Imams from his offspring,
(who are) the holders of Your commandments after him,
and the immaculate ones whom You have accepted as supporters of Your religion,
keepers of Your secret,
witnesses over Your created beings,
and signs (of example) for Your servants.
May Your blessings be upon them all.
Peace be upon the Commander of the Faithful,
`Ali the son of Abu-Talib,
the successor of Allah’s Messenger, his representative,
who managed his affairs after him,

lines.transliteration: sayyidi alwasiyyina wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: and the master of all Prophet’s successors. May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him, too.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon Fatimah, the daughter of Allah’s Messenger,
may Allah’s blessings be upon him,
(she is) the doyenne of all the women of this world.
Peace be upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn,

lines.arabic: سَيِّدَيْ شَبَابِ أَهْلِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ مِنَ ٱلْخَلْقِ أَجْمَعِينَ
lines.transliteration: sayyiday shababi ahli aljannati min alkhalqi ajma`ina
lines.english: the chiefs of the youth of Paradise among all beings.
Peace be upon the Guiding Imams.
Peace be upon the Prophets and the Messengers.
Peace be upon the Imams whom are entrusted (with the religion by Allah).

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ خَاصَّةِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon the elite creatures of Allah.
Peace be upon those who understand by tokens.
Peace be upon the faithful believers
who have carried out His orders,
supported the saints of Allah,
