and have feared for their fear.
Peace be upon the Favorite Angels.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَىٰ عِبَادِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصَالِحِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.
You may then draw near the tomb, face it, make the kiblah direction behind you, and say the following words:
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful.
Peace be upon you, O beloved by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O choice of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O intimate servant of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Argument of Allah (against His creatures).
Peace be upon you, O leader of true guidance.
Peace be upon you, O sign of piety.
Peace be upon you, O successor,
religious, pious,
pure, and loyal.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O father of al-Hasan and al-Husayn.
Peace be upon you, O pillar of the religion.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the successors (of Prophets),
trustee of the Lord of the worlds,
judge on the Judgment Day,
best of the believers,
chief of the most truthful ones,
elite of the Prophets’ lineage,
door to the wisdom of the Lord of the worlds,
keeper of His Revelation,
container of His knowledge,
advisor of His Prophet’s people,
next to His Messenger,
who sacrificed himself for him (i.e. for the Messenger),
speaker with his arguments,
inviter to his principles,
and steadfast on his instructions.
O Allah, I do bear witness

lines.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَلَّغَ عَنْ رَسُولِكَ مَا حُمِّلَ
lines.transliteration: annahu qad ballagha `an rasulika ma hummila
lines.english: that he carried out the mission conveyed to him by Your Messenger,
achieved what he was ordered to keep,
kept what has been stored with him,
deemed lawful that which You deem lawful,
deemed unlawful that which You deem unlawful,
put into practice Your laws,
strove against the contraveners for Your sake,
against the wrongdoers according to Your laws,
and against the apostates from Your decree,
did all that with steadfastness, expecting Your reward,
and no blame of any blamer could ever influence him.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon him with the best way
You have ever blessed any of Your intimate servants, Your choicest ones,
and Your Prophet’s successors.
O Allah, this is the tomb of Your representative
the obedience to whom has been made by You incumbent (upon us),
the loyalty to whom has been made by You in the necks of Your servants,

lines.transliteration: wa khalifatika alladhi bihi ta'khudhu wa tu`ti
lines.english: and (it is the tomb of) Your viceroy through whom You will give and take,
and through whom You will reward and punish.

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ قَصَدْتُهُ طَمَعاً لِمَا أَعْدَدْتَهُ لأَوْلِيَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa qad qasadtuhu tama`an lima a`dadtahu li'awliya'ika
lines.english: I have directed to him, seeking for what You have prepared for Your intimate servants.
So, (I beseech You) in the name of his eminent standing with You,
in the name of his great status in Your view,
and in the name of the closeness of his position to You,
to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and to do to me that which is expected from You,
for You are verily worthy of honoring and generous granting.
Peace be upon you, O my master,
and upon your partners in the place, (Prophet) Adam and (Prophet) Noah.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you, too.
You may then kiss the tomb from the head’s side and say the following words:
O my master, to You is my coming
and in your name do I beseech my Lord
so that I may achieve my goal.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ ٱلْمُتَوَسِّلَ بِكَ غَيْرُ خَائِبٍ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna almutawassila bika ghayru kha'ibin
lines.english: I bear witness that he who beseeches (Allah) in your name shall never be disappointed
and he who implores (Allah) in your name, with full cognizance,
shall never be rejected; rather, all his needs shall be settled.
So, (please) be my interceder to Allah—

lines.transliteration: rabbika wa rabbi fi qada'i hawa'iji
lines.english: my and your Lord—for purpose of settling my needs,
making easy my affairs,
relieving my depressions,
forgiving my sins,
expanding my sustenance sources,
extending my lifetime,

lines.transliteration: wa i`ta'i su'li fi akhirati wa dunyaya
lines.english: and granting me all my requests for the world to come as well as this world.
O Allah, curse the killers of the Commander of the Faithful.
O Allah, curse the killers of al-Hasan and al-Husayn.
O Allah, curse the killers of the Imams,
and subject them to such a painful chastisement
that You have never subjected any of Your creatures to it,
such an enormous chastisement that never ceases,

lines.transliteration: wa la ajala wa la amada
lines.english: nor comes to an end, nor reaches a deadline,
for what they contended against Your authorities.
And (please do) prepare for them such an intense torture
that You have not decided for any of Your creatures.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَأَدْخِلْ عَلَىٰ قَتَلَةِ أَنْصَارِ رَسُولِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa adkhil `ala qatalati ansari rasulika
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) impose upon the killers of Your Messenger’s supporters,
the killers of the Commander of the Faithful,
the killers of al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
the killers of the supporters of al-Hasan and al-Husayn,

lines.arabic: وَقَتَلَةِ مَنْ قُتِلَ فِي وِلاَيَةِ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ أَجْمَعِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa qatalati man qutila fi wilayati ali muhammadin ajma`ina
lines.english: and the killers of all those whom were killed because of their loyalty to the Household of Muhammad,
a painful, cyclic punishment
in the lowest class of Hellfire
that the punishment shall not be lightened for them
and they shall lay therein in utter despair and endless curse;
they shall be hanging down their heads before their Lord
after they shall find out with certainty regret and long-lasting disgrace,
for they killed the members of the household of Your Prophets and Messengers
and the righteous servants from their followers.
O Allah, (do) curse them in the most concealed secrecy
and in the most apparent openness,
in Your lands and in Your heavens.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ لِي قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ فِي أَوْلِيَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma ij`al li qadama sidqin fi awliya'ika
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) decide for me a truthful step with Your intimate servants

lines.transliteration: wa habbib ilayya mashahidahum wa mustaqarrahum
lines.english: and make me long for their shrines and their residing-places
until You include me with them

lines.arabic: وَتَجْعَلَنِي لَهُمْ تَبَعاً فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa taj`alani lahum taba`an fi alddunya wal-akhirati
lines.english: and make me among their followers in this world as well as the world to come.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
You may then kiss the tomb, face the tomb of Imam al-Husayn ibn `Ali (‘a), make the kiblah direction seem to be between your shoulders, and say the following words:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah, the luminous lady,
the doyenne of all women of the worlds.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا ٱلأَئِمَّةِ ٱلْهَادِينَ ٱلْمَهْدِيِّينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya aba al-a'immati alhadina almahdiyyina
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O father of the Imams—the guides and well-guided.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَرِيعَ ٱلدَّمْعَةِ ٱلسَّاكِبَةِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O victim of the pouring tears.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَاحِبَ ٱلْمُصِيبَةِ ٱلرَّاتِبَةِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O man of the disastrous misfortune.
Peace be upon you and upon your grandfather and father.
Peace be upon you and upon your mother and brother.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ ٱلأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ ذُرِيَّتِكَ وَبَنِيكَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa `ala al-a'immati min dhurriyyatika wa banika
lines.english: Peace be upon you and upon the Imams from your offspring and descendants.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ لَقَدْ طَيَّبَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَ ٱلتُّرَابَ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu laqad tayyaba allahu bika altturaba
lines.english: I bear witness that Allah has purified the soil (on which you fell down) through you,
has made clear His Book through you,

lines.transliteration: wa ja`alaka wa abaka wa jaddaka
lines.english: and has made you, your father, your grandfather,

lines.transliteration: wa akhaka wa banika `ibratan li'uli al-albabi
lines.english: your brother, and your descendants examples for the owners of intellects.
O son of the blessed, purified ones
who recite (and apply) the Book utterly,
I direct my greetings to you.
May Allah make His peace and blessings to be upon you

lines.arabic: وَجَعَلَ أَفْئِدَةً مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: wa ja`ala af'idatan min alnnasi tahwi ilayka
lines.english: and may He make the hearts of some people yearn toward you.

lines.arabic: مَا خَابَ مَنْ تَمَسَّكَ بِكَ وَلَجَأَ إِلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: ma khaba man tamassaka bika wa laja'a ilayka
lines.english: Disappointment shall never chase him who adheres to you and resorts to you.
You may then move to the side of the feet and say the following words:
Peace be upon the father of the Imams,
the intimate friend of Prophethood,
and the marked, exclusively, by fraternity (with the Holy Prophet).
Peace be upon the head of the religion and faith,
and the word of the All-beneficent Lord.
Peace be upon the Scale of the deeds
the turner over of manners,
the sword of the Lord of Majesty,
and who supplies with the fresh water of Salsabil.
Peace be upon the most righteous of the believers,
the inheritor of the Prophet’s knowledge,
and the judge on the Judgment Day.
Peace be upon the tree of piety
and the hearer of hidden and confidential speeches.
Peace be upon Allah’s conclusive argument,
His flowing boon,
and His forceful punishment.
Peace be upon the clear-cut path,
the patent star,
the advising leader,
and the igniting firelock.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.
You may then say the following:
`Ali the son of Abu-Talib:
the brother, ally,

lines.transliteration: wa nasirihi wa wasiyyihi wa wazirihi
lines.english: supporter, successor, and patron of Your Prophet,
the store of his knowledge,
the depot of his secrets,
the door to his wisdom,
the spokesman with his arguments,
the caller to his code of law,
his viceroy in his community,
the reliever of agony from his face,
the terminator of the infidels,
the conqueror on the wicked ones,
whom You have made, with regard to his position to Your Prophet,
to occupy the same position that (Prophet) Aaron enjoyed with (Prophet) Moses.
O Allah, (please do) give support to any one who supports him,
be the enemy of every one who antagonizes him,
give victory to any one who gives him his victory,
disappoint every one who disappoints him,
and lay curse on any one who incurs the hostility of him
from the past and the coming generations.
And (please do) bless him with the best blessings
that You have ever poured on any of Your Prophet’s successors.
O Lord of the worlds!
Ziyarat of Adam (as) & Noah (as)
You may then return to your place at the side of the head for visiting Prophet Adam and Prophet Noah, peace be upon them.
Visiting Prophet Adam(as)
Peace be upon you, O choice of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O beloved by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O trustee of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَلِيفَةَ ٱللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khalifata allahi fi ardihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O representative of Allah in His lands.
Peace be upon you, O father of all mankind.
Peace be upon you and upon your soul and body,

lines.transliteration: wa `ala alttahirina min wuldika wa dhurriyyatika
lines.english: and upon the pure ones from your sons and descendants.

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ صَلاَةً لاََ يُحْصيهَا إِلاَّ هُوَ
lines.transliteration: wa salla allahu `alayka salatan la yuhsiha illa huwa
lines.english: May Allah pour upon you such innumerable blessings that none can count save Him.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
Visiting Prophet Noah(as) say the following
Peace be upon you, O intimate servant of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Messengers.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَمِينَ ٱللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya amina allahi fi ardihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O trustee of Allah in His lands.

lines.arabic: صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ وَسَلاَمُهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ روُحِكَ وَبَدَنِكَ
lines.transliteration: salawatu allahi wa salamuhu `alayka wa `ala ruhika wa badanika
lines.english: May Allah’s peace and blessings be upon you, upon your soul and body,
and upon the pure ones from among your sons.
Salat -Dua after Ziarat
Offer a
six unit prayer
In the
first two units,

which are intended for visiting the tomb of Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (‘a), you may recite Surah al-Fatihah and Surah al-Rahman (No. 55) at the first unit, and recite Surah al-Fatihah and Surah Yasin (No. 36) in the second.
you may then say the famous Tasbih al-Zahra' (sa), implore for Almighty Allah’s forgiveness (istighfar), pray Him to grant you your personal needs, and then say the following
O Allah, I have offered these two units of prayer,

lines.transliteration: hadiyyatan minni ila sayyidi wa mawlaya
lines.english: as present from me to my master and chief:
Your intimate servant, the brother of Your Messenger,
the Commander of the Faithful
and the chief of the Prophets’ successors;
namely, `Ali the son of Abu-Talib,
may Allah’s blessings be upon him and his household.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma fasalli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: So, O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
accept that prayer from me,
and confer upon me with the reward that You give to the good-doers.
O Allah, to You have I offered prayer,
genuflected,
and prostrated myself;
to You alone without associating anyone with You,
because prayers,
genuflections, and prostrations are submitted to none save You,

lines.arabic: لأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاََ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
lines.transliteration: li'annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: because You are Allah; there is no god save You.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
admit my visit,
and respond to my requests
in the name of Muhammad and his Household—the immaculate ones.
You may then provide
the other four units
as present to Prophet Adam(as) and Prophet Noah.(as)
You may then prostrate yourself for thanksgiving
(sajdat al-shukr)
and say the following words:
O Allah, to You do I direct my face,
to You do I resort,
and on You do I rely.
O Allah, You are my trust and my hope;

lines.arabic: فَٱكْفِنِي مَا أَهَمَّنِي وَمَا لاََ يُهِمُّنِي
lines.transliteration: fakfini ma ahammani wa ma la yuhimmuni
lines.english: so, (please do) save me from whatever concerns me, whatever does not concern me,

lines.transliteration: wa ma anta a`lamu bihi minni
lines.english: and whatever You know more than I do.
Certainly, protected is he who lies under Your protection,
glory be to Your praise,
and there is no deity save You.
(Please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and hasten their Relief.
You may then
put your right cheek on the ground
(Please do) have mercy on my humiliation before You,
on my earnest imploring to You,
on my loneliness among people,
and on my amiability with You.

lines.arabic: يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
lines.transliteration: ya karimu ya karimu ya karimu
lines.english: O All-generous! O All-generous! O All-generous!
You may then put your
left cheek on the ground

lines.arabic: لاََ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي حَقّاً حَقّاً
lines.transliteration: la ilaha illa anta rabbi haqqan haqqan
lines.english: There is no god save You, my Lord; truly, truly.

lines.arabic: سَجَدْتُ لَكَ يَا رَبِّ تَعَبُّداً وَرِقّاً
lines.transliteration: sajadtu laka ya rabbi ta`abbudan wa riqqan
lines.english: O Lord, I prostrate myself before You as sign of my worshipfulness and servitude to You.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ عَمَلِي ضَعيفٌ فَضَاعِفْهُ لِي
lines.english: O Allah, my deed is certainly feeble; so, (please do) grant it strength by increasing it many times,
You may then return to the state of ordinary prostration and
repeat "shukran" one hundred times:
Thanks.

Recite Dua After Ziarat - Allhumma La Budda 
Dua Alqama

You are also recommended to implore Almighty Allah for forgiveness as sincerely as possible, because the place you are in is the zone of forgiveness. You are recommended to beseech Almighty Allah for settling your needs as seriously as possible, because the place you are in is the zone of responding to the needs.

In his book of al-Mazar, Sayyid ibn Tawus says: Whenever you offer an obligatory or a supererogatory prayer during your presence in the holy shrine of Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (‘a), you are recommended to say the following supplication:
O Allah, Your determination is surely unavoidable,
Your destiny is unavoidable,
Your act is unavoidable,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa bika
lines.english: and there is no power and no might except with You.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَمَا قَضَيْتَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ قَضَاءٍ
lines.english: So, O Allah, whatever act You decide on us
and whatever decree You make on us,

lines.transliteration: fa'a`tina ma`ahu sabran yaqharuhu wa yadmaghuhu
lines.english: (please do) grant us along with it patience that repels and fends it off
and make it ascend for our good toward Your Pleasure
so that it shall grow up our rewards, favors,
tributes, honor,
glory, boon,
and dignity in this world as well as the world to come.
And (please) do not lessen our rewards.
O Allah, whatever donation You give us,
whatever virtue You confer on us,
whatever endowment You bestow on us,

lines.transliteration: fa'a`tina ma`ahu shukran yaqharuhu wa yadmaghuhu
lines.english: (please) grant us with it thanksgiving that repels and fends it off.
And make it ascend for our good toward Your Pleasure,
and ascend in our rewards, tribute,
honor, Your boon,
and Your honoring (us) in this world as well as the world to come.

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْهُ لَنَا أَشَراً وَلاَ بَطَراً
lines.transliteration: wa la taj`alhu lana asharan wa la bataran
lines.english: And (please) do not make it to be for us a source of evil, ungratefulness,

lines.transliteration: wa la fitnatan wa la maqtan
lines.english: seditious matter, hatred,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ عَذَاباً وَلاَ خِزْياً فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa la `adhaban wa la khizyan fi alddunya wal-akhirati
lines.english: torture, or disgrace in this world as well as the world to come.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَثْرَةِ ٱللِّسَانِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inna na`udhu bika min `athrati allisani
lines.english: O Allah, we do seek Your protection against slips of tongues,
evil situations,
and lightness of the Scale.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
make us meet our the rewards of good deeds at the hours of our death,
do not show us the fruits of our deeds as nothing but regrets,
do not disgrace us when You judge us,

lines.transliteration: wa la tafdahna bisayyi'atina yawma nalqaka
lines.english: do not expose us because of our evildoings on the Day when we shall meet You,

lines.transliteration: waj`al qulubana tadhkuruka wa la tansaka
lines.english: make our hearts remember You always and never forget You,

lines.transliteration: wa takhshaka ka'annaha taraka hatta talqaka
lines.english: make our hears fear You as if they can see You until we meet You,

lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
change our evildoings into good deeds,
make our good deeds to be grades,
change our grades into chambers (in Paradise),
and make our chambers high.
O Allah, (please do) expand the source of sustenance for our poor people

lines.arabic: مِنْ سَعَةِ مَا قَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِكَ
lines.english: from the expansion that You have taken upon Yourself to make.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and endue us with true guidance as long as You grant us life,
with honor as long as You keep us alive,
with forgiveness when You decide to cease our lifetime,

lines.arabic: وَٱلْحِفْظِ فِي مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمْرِنَا
lines.english: with protection in the rest of our lifetime,
with blessings in the sustenance that You give us,
with help to carry out what You have burdened us with,
and with steadfastness against what You have imposed on us.
And do not punish us for our wrongdoings,
do not treat us on basis of our lack of knowledge,
do not draw us near to destruction gradually on account of our sins,

lines.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ أَحْسَنَ مَا نَقُولُ ثَابِتاً فِي قُلُوبِنَا
lines.transliteration: waj`al ahsana ma naqulu thabitan fi qulubina
lines.english: make the best of our words to be firm in our hearts,
make us to be great persons in Your view
but humble ones in our own views,
make that which You have taught us to benefit us,
and increase us with useful knowledge.

lines.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لاََ يَخْشَعُ
lines.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min qalbin la yakhsha`u
lines.english: And I seek Your protection against a heart that does not submit (to You),
an eye that does not shed tears (for fear of You),
and a prayer that is not admitted (by You).
(Please do) rescue us from the evil seditious matters,
O Manager of this world and the world to come.
Ziarat Imam Hussain(as) from Imam Ali(as) Shrine

It is also recommended to visit the head of Imam al-Husayn (‘a) from the tomb of Imam `Ali (‘a). In the two books of al-Wasa'il and al-Mustadrak, an entire chapter has been dedicated to mentioning the forms of such Ziyarah.

The author of al-Mustadrak has reported from the book of al-Mazar by Muhammad ibn al-Mashhadi that Imam al-Sadiq (as) said this while he was at the head’s side of the tomb of Imam `Ali (‘a) where he offered four units of prayer and said the following form of Ziyarah:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ ٱلصِّديقَةِ ٱلطَّاهِرَةِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the veracious and pure
doyenne of all women of the world.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O my master, Abu-`Abdullah.
So be upon you Allah’s mercy and blessings.
I bear witness that you offered the prayers,
gave alms (zakat),
you enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,
recited the Book as it ought to be read,

lines.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
lines.english: strove for the sake of Allah as it ought to be striven,
and stood harm for His sake,
seeking His reward, until death came upon you.

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna alladhina khalafuka wa harabuka
lines.english: And I witness that those who dissented with you, those who fought against you,

lines.transliteration: wa anna alladhina khadhaluka walladhina qataluka
lines.english: those who disappointed you, and those who slew you—
all those are accused in the words of the Ummi (i.e. inhabitant of Umm al-Qura, Makkah) Prophet.
And the forger must suffer frustration!
May Allah curse those who prosecuted you
from the past and the coming generations
and may He double for them the painful chastisement.

lines.arabic: أَتَيْتُكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: ataytuka ya mawlaya yabna rasuli allahi
lines.english: O my master and son of Allah’s Messenger,
I have come visiting you and recognizing your status,
showing loyalty to your adherents,
incurring the hostility of your enemies,
acknowledging the true guidance that you follow,
and understanding the deviation (from the right path) of any one who disagrees with you.
So, (please) intercede for me with your Lord.

sections.title: Third Form of Ziarat by Imam Jaffer as Sadiq(as)

lines.english: Third form of Ziyarah
Sayyid `Abd al-Karim ibn Tawus has reported the following from Safwan al-Jammal:

During my journey with him to al-Kufah for meeting Abu-Ja`far al-Mansur the `Abbasid ruler, Imam Ja`far al-Sadiq (‘a) asked me to make our camels kneel down at a certain place, saying, “This is the tomb of my grandfather, the Commander of the Faithful.”

As I made the camels kneel down there, he rode off, bathed himself, changed his clothes, took off his shoes, and ordered me to imitate him in everything. He then directed towards the hillock of Najaf (al-dhakwah), saying, “If you walk in short steps and nod your head to the ground, you shall be given one hundred thousand rewards for each step, one hundred thousand sins shall be erased from your sins, you shall be elevated one hundred thousand ranks, one hundred thousand of your requests shall be granted, and you shall be granted the rewards of all veracious individuals who died and all martyrs whom were slain.”

Imam al-Sadiq (‘a) then walked with tranquility and gravity, and I followed him, pronouncing statements of glorification and sanctification of Almighty Allah and confession of His Oneness until we reached the hillocks there. He stopped there, looked to the right and the left, sketched something on the ground with his stick, and asked me to look for the signs of the tomb. As I did, I could notice the traces of the tomb of Imam `Ali (‘a). Imam al-Sadiq (‘a) immediately shed tears down his face and said these words:

lines.transliteration: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji`una
lines.english: To Allah we belong and to Him is our return.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ﭐلْوَصِيُّ ﭐلْبَرُّ ﭐلتَّقِيُّ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O successor (of the Prophet), righteous, and pious.
Peace be upon you, O Great News.
Peace be upon you, O veracious and right-directing one.
Peace be upon you, O righteous and pure.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَصِيَّ رَسُولِ رَبِّ ﭐلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya wasiyya rasuli rabbi al`alamina
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Successor of the Messenger of the Lord of the worlds.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خِيَرَةَ ﭐللَّهِ عَلَىٰ ﭐلْخَلْقِ أَجْمَعِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khiyarata allahi `ala alkhalqi ajma`ina
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O choice of Allah over all creatures.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ حَبيبُ ﭐللَّهِ وَخَاصَّةُ ﭐللَّهِ وَخَالِصَتُهُ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu annaka habibu allahi wa khassatu allahi wa khalisatuhu
lines.english: I bear witness that you are verily Allah’s beloved, elite, and select.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ﭐللَّهِ وَمَوْضِعَ سِرِّهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waliyya allahi wa mawdi`a sirrihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O intimate servant of Allah, center of His secrets,
store of His knowledge, and keeper of His Revelation.
Imam al-Sadiq (‘a) then threw himself on the tomb and said these words:

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا أَمِيرَ ﭐلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya amir almu'minina
lines.english: May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you, O Commander of the Faithful!

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا حُجَّةَ ﭐلْخِصَامِ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya hujjata alkhisami
lines.english: May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you, O argument in controversies!

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا بَابَ ﭐلْمَقَامِ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya baba almaqami
lines.english: May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you, O door to the (elevated) position!

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا نُورَ ﭐللَّهِ ﭐلتَّامَّ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya nura allahi alttamma
lines.english: May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you, O utter light of Allah!

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ عَنِ ﭐللَّهِ
lines.english: I bear witness that you have conveyed all that which you were ordered to convey from Allah
and from Allah’s Messenger,

lines.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ﭐللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ مَا حُمِّلْتَ
lines.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi ma hummilta
lines.english: may Allah’s peace be upon him and his Household,
attended to that which was kept with you,
kept that which was stored with you,
decided as lawful all that which Allah has deemed lawful,
decided as unlawful all that which Allah has deemed unlawful,
carried out the decrees of Allah,
never exceeded the limits of Allah,
and worshipped Allah sincerely
until death came upon you.
May Allah send blessings upon you
and upon the Imams who came after you!

Imam al-Sadiq (‘a) then stood up and offered a number of units of prayer at the side of the Imam’s head. He then said to me (i.e. Safwan), “Whoever visits Amir al-Mu'minin with this form of Ziyarah and then offers the like of this prayer shall return home while all his sins are forgiven, all his efforts are accepted, and will have the rewards of all the angels who visit this tomb recorded for him.”
I asked, “Do you mean the reward of all the angels who visit this tomb?”
The Imam (‘a) answered, “Yes, I do. Each night, this tomb is visited by seventy thousand tribes of angels.”
“How many is a tribe of angels?” asked I.
“Each tribe consists of one hundred thousand angels,” answered the Imam (‘a).
The Imam (‘a) then left the place waling back but his face was still to the grave direction, uttering the following words:
O grandfather! O master!
O pure! O infallible!

lines.arabic: لاََ جَعَلَهُ ﭐللَّهُ آخِرَ ﭐلْعَهْدِ مِنْكَ
lines.transliteration: la ja`alahu allahu akhira al`ahdi minka
lines.english: May Allah not cause this (visit of mine) to be the last of my compliments to you.
May He grant me the opportunity to visit you again,
to reside at your holy shrine,
and to be included with you
and with the righteous ones among your sons!
and upon the angels surrounding you!

I then said to him, “O master! May I inform our acquaintances in al-Kufah about this and lead them to this tomb?”
The Imam (‘a) answered in the affirmative and gave me a sum of money to construct the tomb.

sections.title: Fourth Form of Ziarat by Imam Jaffer as Sadiq(as)

lines.english: Fourth form of Ziyarah
In Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, the following narration has been quoted from the book of al-Mazar al-Qadim on the authority of our master, Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (‘a):
Accompanying my father, I went for visiting the tomb of my grandfather, Amir al-Mu'minin `Ali ibn Abi-Talib (‘a), in al-Najaf. My father stopped at the holy tomb, wept, and said the following:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ أَبِي ﭐلأَئِمَّةِ وَخَلِيلِ ﭐلنُّبُوَّةِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala abi al-a'immati wa khalili alnnubuwwati
lines.english: Peace be upon the father of the Imams, the friend of the Prophethood,
and the one exclusively granted the fraternity (of the Holy Prophet).
Peace be upon the chief of true faith,
the Scale of the deeds
and the sword of the Lord of Majesty.
Peace be upon the most righteous of the believers,
the inheritor of the knowledge of the Prophets,
and the judge on the Judgment Day.
Peace be upon the Tree of Piety.
Peace be upon Allah’s conclusive argument,
His flowing boon,
and His forceful punishment.
Peace be upon the clear-cut path,
the patent star,
and the advising leader.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.
My father (‘a) then added the following:

lines.transliteration: anta wasilati ila allahi wa dhari`ati
lines.english: You are verily my means and my course to Allah.

lines.transliteration: wa li haqqu muwalati wa ta'mili
lines.english: And I enjoy the right of my loyalty to you and my hoping for you.

lines.arabic: فَكُنْ لِي شَفيعِي إِلَىٰ ﭐللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
lines.transliteration: fakun shafi`i ila allahi `azza wa jalla
lines.english: So, (please) be my intercessor before Allah—the Almighty and All-majestic—
as regards the settlement of my request,

lines.transliteration: wa hiya fakaku raqabati min alnnari
lines.english: which is the release of my neck from Hellfire.
And (please) seal my current situation with success

lines.transliteration: wa bima sa'altuhu kullahi birahmatihi wa qudratihi
lines.english: and with response to all that which I have asked for, out of His mercy and power.
O Allah, (please do) grant me an utter intellect,
sharp aptitude,
pure heart,
much deed,
and fabulous courtesy,
and make all that for my good
and do not make it against me,
[I beseech You] in the name of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

sections.title: Fifth Form of Ziarat by Imam Ali Naqi(as)

lines.english: Fifth form of Ziyarah
Shaykh al-Kulayni has reported that Imam `Ali ibn Muhammad al-Naqi (al-Hadi) instructed the following:
At the tomb of Amir al-Mu'minin (‘a), you may say the following:
Peace be upon you, O intimate servant of Allah.
You are the first to have been oppressed
and the first to have had his right usurped.
You, nevertheless, acted patiently, seeking the reward of Allah,
until death came upon you.

lines.arabic: فَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ لَقِيتَ ﭐللَّهَ وَأَنْتَ شَهِيدٌ
lines.transliteration: fa'ashhadu annaka laqita allaha wa anta shahidun
lines.english: I thus bear witness that you met Allah as martyr.
May Allah torture him who killed you with the various kinds of torture
and may He renew torture for him ceaselessly.
I have come to you, recognizing your right,
acknowledging your position,
and bearing enmity against your enemies and against those who wronged you.

lines.arabic: أَلْقَىٰ عَلَىٰ ذٰلِكَ رَبِّي إِنْ شَاءَ ﭐللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: alqa `ala dhalika rabbi in sha'a allahu
lines.english: I, by Allah’s willing, will meet my Lord carrying these principles.
O intimate servant of Allah,
I have (committed) numerous sins;
so, (please) intercede for me before your Lord,

lines.arabic: فَإِنَّ لَكَ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ مَقَاماً مَعْلُوماً
lines.english: for you verily enjoy a famous rank with Allah

lines.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكَ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ جَاهاً وَشَفَاعَةً
lines.transliteration: wa inna laka `inda allahi jahan wa shafa`atan
lines.english: and you have verily enjoyed a high status and intercession with Allah.

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ: ”وَلاَ يَشْفَعُونَ إِلاَّ لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ.“
lines.transliteration: wa qad qala allahu ta`ala wa la yashfa`una illa liman irtada
lines.english: Allah, the All-exalted, has said (in this respect), “And they do not intercede except for him whom He accepts.”
Sixth form of Ziyarah

The following form of Ziyarah has been mentioned by a number of our scholars among whom is Shaykh Muhammad ibn al-Mashhadi who quotes that Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tayalisi has reported Sayf ibn `Umayrah to have related the following:

A group of our acquaintances and I accompanied Safwan al-Jammal to al-Ghari for the purpose of visiting the tomb of Amir al-Mu'minin (‘a). When we accomplished ziyarah, Safwan turned his face toward the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (‘a) and instructed that we should visit Imam al-Husayn ibn `Ali (‘a) from this place at the head’s side of Imam `Ali’s tomb. He then told us that he, once, accompanied Imam al-Sadiq (‘a) to this very place where the Imam (‘a) did the same thing that Safwan had just done and said the same supplication. Safwan added, “The Imam (‘a) then advised me to persist in this method and form of Ziyarah and to visit Imam `Ali and Imam al-Husayn (‘a) with this form, for he would guarantee, on behalf of Almighty Allah, that any one who visits them with this form of ziyarah and says this supplication, be it from close or far distance, will have his ziyarah accepted, his efforts rewarded, his greetings conveyed (to the Imams) without any barrier, and his requests granted by Almighty Allah whatever they are.”

The entire text of this narration about the merits of saying this form of ziyarah, along with all of its etiquettes, and saying this supplication will be cited after the famous form known as Ziyarah of Ashura' and the famous prayer known as
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Messenger.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s select.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s trustee.
Peace be upon him whom Allah chose,
selected, and preferred from amongst His creatures.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s friend
whenever night darkens and becomes dusk
and whenever daylight shines and gleams.
Peace be upon you whenever one keeps silent,

lines.transliteration: wa nataqa natiqun wa dharra shariqun
lines.english: whenever one utters something, and whenever a new day begins.
So also be Allah’s mercy and blessings upon you.
Peace be upon our master: the Commander of the Faithful,
`Ali the son of Abu-Talib,
the owner of unprecedented virtues, merits, and relief,
the terminator of the phalanxes of the infidels,
the all-courageous,
the all-powerful,
the deep-rooted,
who will serve the believers with water in a cup
from the Pond of the Messenger—the honorable, the honest.
Peace be upon the owner of perspicacity, favors,
bestowals, honors, and incentives.
Peace be upon the knight of the believers,
the lion of the monotheists,
the slayer of the polytheists,
and the successor of the Messenger of the Lord of the words.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him, too.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ أَيَّدَهُ ٱللَّهُ بَجِبْرَئِيلَ
lines.english: Peace be upon him whom Allah supported with (Archangel) Gabriel,
backed with (Archangel) Michael,
whom Allah has bestowed a close degree in both this abode and the abode to come,

lines.arabic: وَحَبَاهُ بِكُلِّ مَا تَقَرُّ بِهِ ٱلْعَيْنُ
lines.transliteration: wa habahu bikulli ma taqarru bihi al`aynu
lines.english: and whom Allah has granted all things that act as delight for an eye.
May Allah send blessings upon him
upon his Household the immaculate,
upon his descendants the choicest ones,
and upon the right-directing Imams,
who enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,
explained to us the duty of prayers,
ordered us to give alms,
made clear for us the observance of fasting during the month of Ramadan,
and taught us the true recitation of the Qur'an.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful,
chief of the religion,
and leader of the white-forehead, marked believers.
Peace be upon you, O door to Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاظِرَةَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O sighting Eye of Allah,
extending Hand of Him,
listening Ear of Him,
Allah’s conclusive argument,
His flowing boon,
and His forceful punishment.
Peace be upon the decider between people of Paradise and people of Hellfire.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ نِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ ٱلأَبْرَارِ
lines.english: Peace be upon Allah’s benefaction for the righteous ones
and Allah’s wrath on the wicked ones.
Peace be upon the leader of the pious good-doers.
Peace be upon the brother of Allah’s Messenger,
the cousin of him, the husband of his daughter,
and the one created from the same clay of him.
Peace be upon the eternal origin
and the noble branch.
Peace be upon the prolific fruit.
Peace be upon Abu’l-Hasan, `Ali.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ طُوبَىٰ وَسِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنْتَهَىٰ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala shajarati tuba wa sidrati almuntaha
lines.english: Peace be upon the Tree of Tuba (bliss) and the lote-tree of the utmost boundary.
Peace be upon Adam the choice of Allah,
upon Noah the Prophet of Allah,
upon Abraham the friend of Allah,
upon Moses the spoken by Allah,
upon Jesus the Spirit of Allah,
upon Muhammad the most beloved by Allah,

lines.transliteration: wa man baynahum min alnnabiyyina walssiddiqina
lines.english: and upon the Prophets, the veracious ones,
the martyrs, and the upright ones who came among them.
How excellent is the company of these!
Peace be upon the light of lights,
the descendant of the pure ones,
and the originally righteous ones.
Peace be upon the father of the virtuous Imams.
Peace be upon the firm cord of Allah
and the strong side of Him.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ أَمِينِ ٱللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon Allah’s trustee on His land,
Allah’s viceroy and the judge with His laws,
the custodian over His religion,
the spokesman of His wisdom,
the actor upon His Book,
the brother of the Messenger,
the husband of the Chaste Lady,
and the unsheathed sword of Allah.
Peace be upon the owner of the indications,
the magnificent signs,
and the overcoming miracles,
the redeemer from perdition,

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذِي ذَكَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ فِي مُحْكَمِ ٱلآيَاتِ
lines.transliteration: alladhi dhakarahu allahu fi muhkami al-ayati
lines.english: and whom Allah has mentioned in the decisive verses,

lines.arabic: فَقَالَ تَعَالَىٰ ”وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَابِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيُّ حَكيمٌ.“
lines.transliteration: faqala ta`ala wa innahu fi ummi alkitabi ladayna la`aliyyun hakimun
lines.english: saying, “And surely, in the original of the Book with Us, it is written that `Ali is wise.”
Peace be upon Allah’s pleased Name,
His Brilliant Face,
and His most elevated side.
Peace be upon Allah’s Arguments, successors,
prominent people, and choices,
selects, and trustees.
I have come to you, O master,
O Allah’s trustee and argument,
visiting (your tomb), acknowledging your right,
acceding to your adherents,
incurring the hostility of your enemies,
and seeking Allah’s nearness through my visit to you.

lines.arabic: فَٱشْفَعْ لِي عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ رَبّي وَرَبِّكَ
lines.transliteration: fashfa` li `inda allahi rabbi wa rabbika
lines.english: So, (please) intercede for me before Allah—your and my Lord—
so that He may save me from Hellfire

lines.transliteration: wa qada'i hawa'iji hawa'iji alddunya wal-akhirati
lines.english: and respond to my requests of this world and the Next World.
You may then throw yourself on the tomb, kiss it, and say the following:

lines.transliteration: salamu allahi wa salamu mala'ikatihi almuqarrabina
lines.english: Salutations of Allah and salutations of His Archangels,
and those who heartily yield to you,
O Commander of the Faithful,
and those who speak of your virtue

lines.arabic: وَٱلشَّاهِدِينَ عَلَىٰ أَنَّكَ صَادِقٌ أَمِينٌ صِدِّيقٌ
lines.english: and those who bear witness that you are surely honest, faithful, and veracious;
salutations as well as Allah’s mercy and blessings of all those be upon you.
I bear witness that you are verily pure, immaculate, and purified
and you are the descendant of the pure, immaculate, and purified ones.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ لَكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَوَلِيَّ رَسُولِهِ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu laka ya waliyya allahi wa waliyya rasulihi
lines.english: I bear witness for you, O Intimate servant of Allah and loyal to Allah’s Messenger,
that you did convey and carry out (your mission).

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka janbu allahi wa babuhu
lines.english: I also bear witness that you are the duty that Allah has imposed (upon us) and the door to Him,
you are the beloved of Allah
and the direction from which Allah is reached,
you are the path to Allah,
and you are the servant of Allah

lines.arabic: وَأَخُو رَسُولِهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa akhu rasulihi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: and the brother of His Messenger—may Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household.

lines.arabic: أَتَيْتُكَ مُتَقَرِّباً إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بِزِيَارَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: ataytuka mutaqarriban ila allahi `azza wa jalla biziyaratika
lines.english: I have come to you seeking nearness to Allah, to Whom belong all might and majesty, through my visit to you,
seeking your intercession for me,

lines.arabic: أَبْتَغِي بِشَفَاعَتِكَ خَلاَصَ رَقَبَتِي مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
lines.transliteration: abtaghi bishafa`atika khalasa raqabati min alnnari
lines.english: through which I hope for saving of myself from Hellfire,
seeking your protecting of myself from the Fire,

lines.arabic: هَارِباً مِنْ ذُنوُبِيَ ٱلَّتِي ٱحْتَطَبْتُهَا عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِي
lines.transliteration: hariban min dhunubiya allati ihtatabtuha `ala zahri
lines.english: escaping my sins with which I have burdened my back,
and having recourse to you in the hope for my Lord’s mercy.
O my master, I have come to you seeking your intercession for me
and I seek nearness to Allah through you
so that He may grant me all of my requests.

lines.arabic: فَٱشْفَعْ لِي يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: fashfa` li ya amira almu'minina ila allahi
lines.english: So, O Commander of the Faithful, (please) intercede for me before Allah,

lines.transliteration: fa'inni `abdu allahi wa mawlaka wa za'iruka
lines.english: for I am the servant of Allah, and I am your associate and visitor,
and you enjoy with Allah a praiseworthy standing,
as well as a great esteem,
a high superiority,
and an acceptable right of intercession.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and send blessings upon the Commander of the Faithful—
your well-pleased servant,
your most faithful trustee,
your firmest handle,
your highest hand,
your uppermost side,
your most excellent word,
your claim on the creatures,
your prime all-veracious,
the master of the Prophets’ successors,
the pillar of the saints,
the support of the elite ones,
the commander of the faithful,
the leader of the religion,
the example of the righteous ones,
the chief of the choice ones,
the protected against defects,
the precluded against flaws,
the purified from fault,
the saved from doubt,
the brother of Your Prophet,
the successor of Your Messenger,
the one who sacrificed himself for Your Prophet [when he took his place on his bed],
the one who gave up his soul for Your Prophet,
the one who removed agonies from Your Prophet,
the one whom You chose to be the sword of Your Prophet’s prophethood,
the sign of his Messengership,
the witness over his people,
the indication of his evidences,
the bearer of his pennon,
the shield against his heart,
the guide of his people,
the powerful hand of his might,
the crown of his head,
the door to his secrets,
and the key to his victory,
until he defeated the armies of polytheism by Your permission,
annihilated the forces of infidelity by Your order,

lines.transliteration: wa badhala nafsahu fi mardati rasulika
lines.english: devoted himself to the pleasure of Your Messenger,
and dedicated it to the obedience to him.

lines.arabic: فَصَلِّ ٱللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً دَائِمَةً بَاقِيَةً
lines.english: So, O Allah, (please do) send upon him with endless, nonstop blessings.
You may then add the following:
Peace be upon you, O intimate servant of Allah,
the shining brightness,
and the endless light.
O descendant of the pure ones!
O secret of Allah!

lines.arabic: إِنَّ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ ذُنُوباً
lines.transliteration: inna bayni wa bayna allahi ta`ala dhunuban
lines.english: Verily, there are between Allah and me sins
that have burdened my back
and nothing can ease them except His pleasure;
so, (I beg you) in the Name of Him Who has entrusted you with His secret
and assigned you to manage the affairs of His creatures
to (please) be the interceder for me before Allah,
to be my savoir from the Fire,
and to be my supporter against the vicissitudes of my time,

lines.transliteration: fa'inni `abdu allahi wa waliyyuka wa za'iruka
lines.english: for I am the servant of Allah and I am your loyalist and visitor.
May Allah send blessings upon you.
You may then offer
a six-unit prayer,
which is the Ziyarah Prayer, and supplicate for whatever you want. Then, you may say the following:
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful!
Peace of Allah be upon you forever

lines.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
lines.english: as long as I am alive and as long as days and nights come after each other.
You may then turn your
face towards the tomb of Imam al-Husayn (‘a),
point to it, and say the following:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.
I have come to both of you visiting and begging you to be mediators

lines.transliteration: ila allahi ta`ala rabbi wa rabbikuma
lines.english: between me and Allah, the All-exalted, your and my Lord,
and I am turning my face to Allah in your names,

lines.arabic: وَمُسْتَشْفِعاً بِكُمَا إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ فِي حَاجَتِي هٰذِهِ…
lines.transliteration: wa mustashfi`an bikuma ila allahi fi hajati hadhihi…
lines.english: and seeking your intercession for me before Allah to grant me this request of mine, which is…
You may then say the famous supplicatory prayer known as Du`a’ Safwan (or Du`a’ `Alqamah), which will be cited after the famous Ziyarah of `ªshura', up to its end; i.e. up to this paragraph:
He is verily All-nigh, All-responding.
You may then face the kiblah direction and say the same Du`a’ Safwan from its beginning:

lines.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
lines.english: O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!
O He who gives answer to the cries of the persecuted!
O He who pulls out the grief-stricken from agony
and up to the following statements:
…and make me leave having my requests granted
and having all my agonies relieved,
including those of this world and those of the world to come.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
You may then turn your face toward the tomb of Amir al-Mu'minin (‘a) and say the following words:
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful!

lines.arabic: وَٱلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.english: And peace be upon Abu-`Abdullah al-Husayn,

lines.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
lines.english: as long as I am alive and as long as day and night endure.

lines.arabic: لاََ جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ ٱلْعَهْدِ مِنِّي لِزِيَارَتِكُمَا
lines.transliteration: la ja`alahu allahu akhira al`ahdi minni liziyaratikuma
lines.english: May Allah not make this visit of mine to be the last of my visit to both of you!

lines.transliteration: wa la farraqa allahu bayni wa baynakuma
lines.english: And may Allah never separate me from you!
SEVENTH form of ZIYARAH -
This form of Ziyarah has been reported by Sayyid Ibn Tawus, in his book entitled Misbah al-Za'ir, who, instructing the method of this ziyarah, says:
When you stop at the bab al-salam: the gate of Imam `Ali’s holy shrine where you can see the holy tomb, you may say
Allahu Akbar forty-three times
:then say the foll:

lines.transliteration: salamu allahi wa salamu mala'ikatihi almuqarrabina
lines.english: Peace of Allah and peace of His Archangels,
His missioned Prophets, and His righteous saints,
and [peace of] all the martyrs and the veracious
be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful.
Peace be upon Adam the choice of Allah.
Peace be upon Noah the prophet of Allah.
Peace be upon Abraham the intimate friend of Allah.
Peace be upon Moses the spoken to by Allah.
Peace be upon Jesus the Spirit of Allah.
Peace be upon Muhammad the beloved by Allah.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon them, too.
Peace be upon the pleased name of Allah,
His most elevated Face,
and His straight path.
Peace be upon the refined, purified one.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ أَبِي ٱلْحَسَنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala abi alhasani `aliyyi bni abi talibin
lines.english: Peace be upon Abu’l-Hasan, `Ali the son of Abu-Talib.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him, too.
Peace be upon the choicest friend.
Peace be upon the one particularly married to the doyenne of the women [of the world].
Peace be upon the one born in the Ka`bah
and married in the heavens.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ أَسَدِ ٱللَّهِ فِي ٱلْوَغَىٰ
lines.english: Peace be upon the lion of Allah in battlefields.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ شُرِّفَتْ بِهِ مَكَّةُ وَمِنَىٰ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala man shurrifat bihi makkatu wa mina
lines.english: Peace be upon the one by whom Makkah and Mina have been honored.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ صَاحِبِ ٱلْحَوْضِ وَحَامِلِ ٱللِّوَاءِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala sahibi alhawdi wa hamili alliwa'i
lines.english: Peace be upon the one in charge of the Divine Pond and the bearer of the pennon [on the Resurrection Day].
Peace be upon the fifth of the Cloak Members.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْبَائِتِ عَلَىٰ فِرَاشِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ
lines.english: Peace be upon the one who replaced the Prophet in his bed
and thus sacrificed himself for the Prophet against the enemies.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ قَالِعِ بَابِ خَيْبَرَ وَٱلدَّاحِي بِهِ فِي ٱلْفَضَاءِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala qali`i babi khaybara walddahi bihi fi alfada'i
lines.english: Peace be upon the one who plucked up the gate of Khaybar city and threw it far away in the air.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُكَلِّمِ ٱلْفِتْيَةِ فِي كَهْفِهِمْ بِلِسَانِ ٱلأَنْبِيَاءِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala mukallimi alfityati fi kahfihim bilisani al-anbiya'i
lines.english: Peace be upon the one who spoke to the Seven Sleepers of Ephesus in their cave with the language of the Prophets.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُنْبِعِ ٱلْقَلِيبِ فِي ٱلْفَلاَ
lines.english: Peace be upon the one who caused a ruined well in the desert to spring forth with water.
Peace be upon the one who moved a rock
after strong men could not even move it.
Peace be upon the one who spoke to a serpent
from the minbar (pulpit) of al-Kufah Mosque with an eloquent language.
Peace be upon the one who spoke to a wolf
and spoke to a skull
whose bones were decayed in al-Nahrawan.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ صَاحِبِ ٱلشَّفَاعَةِ فِي يَوْمِ ٱلْوَرَىٰ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala sahibi alshshafa`ati fi yawmi alwara
lines.english: Peace be upon the one granted the right of intercession on the Assembly Day.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلإِمَامِ ٱلزَّكِيِّ حَلِيفِ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ
lines.english: Peace be upon the pure leader who stuck to the mihrab (prayer niche).
Peace be upon the owner of astounding miracles
and who speaks with wisdom and sagacity.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ عِنْدَهُ تَأْوِيلُ ٱلْمُحْكَمِ وَٱلْمُتَشَابِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon the one who holds the interpretation of the decisive and the allegorical [verses of the Holy Qur'an]
and holds the Basis of the [Holy] Book.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ رُدَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلشَّمْسُ
lines.english: Peace be upon the one to whom the sun was returned
after it had disappeared beyond the veils of night.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُحْيِي ٱللَّيْلِ ٱلْبَهِيمِ بِٱلتَّهَجُّدِ وَٱلِٱكْتِئَابِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala muhyi allayli albahimi bilttahajjudi wal'ikti'abi
lines.english: Peace be upon the one who spent the dark nights with acts of worship and ponderation.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ خَاطَبَهُ جَبْرَئِيلُ بِإِمْرَةِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِغَيْرِ ٱرْتِيَابٍ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala man khatabahu jabra'ilu bi'imrati almu'minina bighayri irtiyabin
lines.english: Peace be upon the one who was addressed by Archangel Gabriel as the Commander of the Faithful, without any doubt.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him, too.
Peace be upon the master of masters.
Peace be upon the owner of miracles.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ عَجِبَ مِنْ حَمَلاتِهِ فِي ٱلْحُرُوبِ مَلائِكَةُ سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتٍ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala man `ajiba min hamalatihi fi alhurubi mala'ikatu sab`i samawatin
lines.english: Peace be upon the one whose campaigns in the battles were a source of astonishment for the angels of seven heavens.
Peace be upon the one who, when he consulted the Holy Messenger,
offered something in charity before his consultation.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ أَمِيرِ ٱلْجُيُوشِ وَصَاحِبِ ٱلْغَزَوَاتِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala amiri aljuyushi wa sahibi alghazawati
lines.english: Peace be upon the commander of the armies and the leader of the battles.
Peace be upon the one who spoke to a wolf in the desert.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ نُورِ ٱللَّهِ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَاتِ
lines.english: Peace be upon the light of Allah in murk.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ رُدَّتْ لَهُ ٱلشَّمْسُ
lines.english: Peace be upon the one to whom the sun was returned
so that he could made up the prayer that he had missed.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him, too.
Peace be upon the Commander of the Faithful.
Peace be upon the chief of the Prophets’ successors.
Peace be upon the example of the pious ones.
Peace be upon the inheritor of the Prophets’ knowledge.
Peace be upon the head of the religion.
Peace be upon the shelter of the believers.
Peace be upon the pattern of the veracious ones.
Peace be upon the argument of the upright ones.
Peace be upon the father of the Immaculate Imams.
Peace be upon the one whom was given [the sword of] Dhu’l-Faqar exclusively.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ سَاقِي أَوْلِيَائِهِ مِنْ حَوْضِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ ٱلْمُخْتَارِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala saqi awliya'ihi min hawdi alnnabiyyi almukhtari
lines.english: Peace be upon the one who shall water his adherents from the Pond of the Chosen Prophet,

lines.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ مَا ٱطَّرَدَ ٱللَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ
lines.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi ma ittarada allaylu walnnaharu
lines.english: may Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household as long as there is night and day coming after one another.
Peace be upon the Great News.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ أَنْزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فِيهِ:
lines.english: Peace be upon the one about whom the following verse was revealed by Almighty Allah:

lines.arabic: ”وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَابِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ.“
lines.transliteration: wa innahu fi ummi alkitabi ladayna la`aliyyun hakimun
lines.english: “And, indeed, in the origin of the Book with Us, it is decided that `Ali is wise.”
Peace be upon the straight path of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمَنْعُوتِ فِي ٱلتَّوْرَاةِ وَٱلإِنْجِيلِ وَٱلْقُرْآنِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala alman`uti fi alttawrati wal-injili walqur'ani alhakimi
lines.english: Peace be upon the one whose characteristics are mentioned in the Torah, the Bible, and the Wise Qur'an.
You may then throw yourself on the tomb, kiss it, and say the following:
O trustee of Allah!
O argument of Allah!
O saint of Allah!
O path to Allah!
I, your servant and adherent, have visited you,
resorted to you tomb,
resided in your courtyard,
sought nearness to Allah the Almighty and All-majestic in the name of you,
and sought your intercession for me before Allah,
I am visiting you so sincerely that I have deserted my friends for so
and I have relied upon you after Almighty Allah.
I bear witness that you are the Mountain Tur (mount of revelation),
the Written Book,
the outstretched fine parchment,
and the swollen ocean of knowledge.

lines.arabic: إِنَّ لِكُلِّ مَزُورٍ عِنَايَةً فِي مَنْ زَارَهُ وَقَصَدَهُ وَأَتَاهُ
lines.transliteration: inna likulli mazurin `inayatan fi man zarahu wa qasadahu wa atahu
lines.english: Indeed, each visited person is expected to pay special attention to the one who visits and comes to him.

lines.arabic: وَأَنَا وَلِيُّكَ وَقَدْ حَطَطْتُ رَحْلِي بِفِنَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa ana waliyyuka wa qad hatattu rahli bifina'ika
lines.english: I, your adherent, have resided in your courtyard,
resorted to your holy precinct,
and had recourse to your tomb,

lines.transliteration: li`ilmi bi`azimi manzilatika wa sharafi hadratika
lines.english: because I have full acquaintance with the great standing that you enjoy and the gear honor that you hold.
My sins have overburdened my back
and deprived me of sleep.

lines.transliteration: fama ajidu hirzan wa la ma`qilan
lines.english: Therefore, I can find no shelter, no haven,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ مَلْجَأَ أَلْجَأُ إِلَيْهِ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa la malja'an alja'u ilayhi illa allahu ta`ala
lines.english: and no refuge to which I resort save Almighty Allah,
my begging you to be my mediator to Him,
and my seeking your intercession for me before Him.
I am thus residing in your courtyard
and you enjoy a great standing with Almighty Allah
as well as an honorable position;

lines.arabic: فَٱشْفَعْ لِي عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ
lines.transliteration: fashfa` li `inda allahi rabbika ya mawlaya
lines.english: therefore, (please) intercede for me before your Lord, O master!
You may then kiss the tomb, turn your face towards the kiblah direction, and say the following supplicatory words:
O Allah, I do seek nearness to You,
O most Hearing of all those who can hear!
O most Seeing of all those who can see!
O quickest in reckon!
O most Generous of all those who are generous,
(I seek nearness to You) in the name of Muhammad, the seal of the Prophets
and Your Messengers to all created beings,
and in the name of his brother and cousin,
the hero and erudite,
the manifestly knowledgeable,
`Ali, the Commander of the Faithful,
and (in the names of) al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the two martyred Imams,

lines.transliteration: wa bi`aliyyi bni alhusayni zayni al`abidina
lines.english: and (in the name of) `Ali ibn al-Husayn, the adornment of the worshippers,

lines.arabic: وَبِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ بَاقِرِ عِلْمِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
lines.english: and (in the name of) Muhammad ibn `Ali, the one who split the knowledge of the old ages,

lines.transliteration: wa bija`fari bni muhammadin zakiyyi alssiddiqina
lines.english: and (in the name of) Ja`far ibn Muhammad, the purest among the veracious ones,

lines.arabic: وَبِمُوسَىٰ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ٱلْكَاظِمِ ٱلْمُبِينِ وَحَبِيسِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa bimusa ibni ja`farin alkazimi almubini wa habisi alzzalimina
lines.english: and (in the name of) Musa ibn Ja`far, the manifestly suppressor (of rage) and the imprisoned by the oppressors,

lines.transliteration: wa bi`aliyyi bni musa alrrida al-amini
lines.english: and (in the name of) `Ali ibn Musa, the pleased and trusted,

lines.arabic: وَبِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلْجَوَادِ عَلَمِ ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
lines.english: and (in the name of) Muhammad ibn `Ali, the magnanimous and the epitome of the guided ones (to the true path),

lines.arabic: وَبِعَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْبَرِّ ٱلصَّادِقِ سَيِّدِ ٱلْعَابِدِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa bi`aliyyi bni muhammadin albarri alssadiqi sayyidi al`abidina
lines.english: and (in the name of) `Ali ibn Muhammad, the upright, the veracious, and the master of worshippers,

lines.arabic: وَبِٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلْعَسْكَرِيِّ وَلِيِّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa bilhasani bni `aliyyin al`askariyyi waliyyi almu'minina
lines.english: and (in the name of) al-Hasan ibn `Ali al-`Askari, the chief of the believers,

lines.arabic: وَبِٱلْخَلَفِ ٱلْحُجَّةِ صَاحِبِ ٱلأَمْرِ مُظْهِرِ ٱلْبَرَاهِينِ
lines.transliteration: wa bilkhalafi alhujjati sahibi al-amri muzhiri albarahini
lines.english: and (in the name of) the Successor, the Argument, the Patron of the Affair, and the Demonstrator of Proofs,

lines.arabic: أَنْ تَكْشِفَ مَا بِي مِنَ ٱلْهُمُومِ
lines.transliteration: an takshifa ma bi min alhumumi
lines.english: (I beseech You in the name of all these) to relieve the grievances that I experience,
to save me from the evils of predetermined ordeals,

lines.transliteration: wa tujirani min alnnari dhati alssamumi
lines.english: and to release me from the hot-winded fire,
(I beseech You) in the name of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
Then, you may pray Almighty Allah to grant you your personal requests, bid farewell to the Imam (‘a), and leave.

In his book of Farhat al-Ghari, Sayyid `Abd al-Karim ibn Tawus has reported that when Imam Zayn al-`ªbidin (‘a) visited al-Kufah city and entered the famous mosque therein, he offered a two-unit prayer and then uttered a supplicatory prayer. Abu-Hamzah al-Thumali, one of the chiefs and ascetic people of al-Kufah, narrated that he heard an excellent accent from the Imam (‘a); he therefore approached him to listen to what he was saying. The Imam (‘a) thus was saying the famous supplicatory prayer that begins with the following statement:
O my God, If I have disobeyed You,

lines.arabic: فَإِنِّي قَدْ أَطَعْتُكَ فِي أَحَبِّ ٱلأَشْيَاءِ إِلَيْكَ…
lines.transliteration: fa'inni qad ata`tuka fi ahabbi al-ashya'i ilayka…
lines.english: I have indeed obeyed You in the nearest thing to You…
This famous supplicatory prayer will be mentioned in the coming chapter of the Recommended Acts in al-Kufah Mosque.([1])

Back to the narration, Abu-Hamzah al-Thumali continued: The Imam (‘a) then left and I followed him. At the public stall of the city, I found a black servant holding the reins of a camel and a she-camel. When I asked him about the man, the servant answered, “Do you really not know him? Have you not realized him from his noble characters? He is `Ali the son of al-Husayn, peace be upon both of them.”
Immediately, I threw myself on the Imam’s feet kissing them. The Imam (‘a) raised my head with his hand and said, “No, Abu-Hamzah! Prostration must be done to none except Almighty Allah.”
I said, “Son of Allah’s Messenger, what has caused you to come to us?”

The Imam (‘a) answered, “As you have seen (I came here to offer prayers at the al-Kufah Mosque). If people realize the great favor that is obtained due to visiting this mosque, they shall visit it even crawling.”
The Imam (‘a) then offered me to accompany him for visiting the tomb of his grandfather, Imam `Ali ibn Abi-Talib (‘a).

I, of course, responded. Hence, I walked in the shadow of his riding camel while listening to his words until we arrived in al-Ghariyyayn (i.e. Najaf), which was a white area that shone with light. The Imam (‘a) then rode off the camel, rolled his cheeks with the soil of that area, and said, “Abu-Hamzah, this is the tomb of my grandfather, `Ali ibn Abi-Talib.”
The Imam (‘a) then visited Imam `Ali (‘a) with a form of ziyarah that begins with the following statement:
Peace be upon the pleased name of Allah
and the light of His Brilliant Face…
The Imam (‘a) then bid farewell and returned to al-Madinah, while I also returned to al-Kufah.

Unfortunately, the author of Farhat al-Ghariyy has not mentioned this form of ziyarah; therefore, I, the author of this book, have searched for it in all forms of ziyarah that are decided for Imam `Ali’s holy shrine, but I could not find any one beginning with the aforementioned statement except this one, which begins with the same statement but differs from it in the second statement. However, it is probable that this form of ziyarah is the same as the one Imam Zayn al-`ªbidin (‘a) said, because such insignificant difference between the two is usually disregarded.

Some people may object that there is another difference between the two forms of ziyarah, since the earlier begins with salamullahi wa salamu mala’ikatihi… etc. while the latter begins with al-salamu `alasmil-lahir-radiyyi… etc.

To answer, the statement that precedes the one involved is regarded as form of asking for permission to enter (isti’dhan), while the form of the ziyarah begins with the statement involved. Our evidence on this claim proves itself when a comparison between this form of ziyarah and the other form, which is dedicated to the birthday of Imam `Ali (‘a) is made, since these two forms are similar to great extent. Hence, please refer to the form involved so that you will discover the difference yourself.

Besides, the same opening statement of this form of ziyarah is mentioned in the beginning of the sixth form and the form that is dedicated to the birthday of the Imam (‘a), with little difference in the second sentence.

To sum it up, I will mention no more general forms of ziyarah of Imam `Ali’s holy shrine, since these seven forms are enough. However, one who desires for more may refer to the all-comprehensive forms of ziyarah (i.e. al-ziyarah al-Jami`ah) as well as the following form, which is dedicated to the Ghadir Day.

A za'ir must seize the opportunity of his/her presence in the holy shrine of Imam `Ali (‘a) to offer as many prayers as possible, for one prayer in that place is equal (in reward) to two hundred thousand prayers that are offered at other places. Imam al-Sadiq (‘a) is reported to have said, “One who offers a four-unit prayer at the tomb of an obligatorily obeyed Imam shall have the reward of one time of hajj and one time of `umrah.”

Furthermore, in my book of Hadiyyat al-Za'ir, I have alluded to the reward of being in the vicinity of Imam `Ali’s tomb. I have also concentrated on the point that it is obligatory to observe one’s neighborhood, which is a difficult duty that can be hardly carried out. However, to elaborate on this matter leads us to lengthiness; therefore, one who desires to read about this matter is advised to see the book of Kelimeh Teyyibeh that is published in Persian.

([1]) In this chapter, we will mention that Abu-Hamzah al-Thumali reported that Imam Zayn al-`ªbidin (`a) approached the Seventh Column of the mosque, took off his shoes, stopped, raised his hands to the level of his ears, and uttered one takbir statement due to which the entire body of the reporter shuddered. The Imam (`a) then offered a four-unit prayer with excellent genuflection and prostration. Upon accomplishment, he uttered the supplicatory prayer involved.
Bidding Farewell to Imam `Ali (as)
One who intends to leave the holy shrine of Imam `Ali (‘a) may say the following form of bidding farewell, which has been mentioned by the scholars after the previously cited fifth form of ziyarah:

lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

lines.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ ٱللَّهَ وَأَسْتَرْعِيكَ وَأَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ ٱلسَّلاَمَ
lines.transliteration: astawdi`uka allaha wa astar`ika wa aqra'u `alayka alssalama
lines.english: I entrust you with Allah and ask Him to keep you under His custody and to send blessings upon you.

lines.arabic: آمَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلرُّسُلِ وَبِمَا جَاءَتْ بِهِ
lines.transliteration: amanna billahi wa bilrrusuli wa bima ja'at bihi
lines.english: We believe in Allah, in the Messengers, and in what they have conveyed to us,
in that to which they have called, and in that to which they have guided.
So, (please, our Lord,) include us with the witnesses.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي إِيَّاهُ
lines.transliteration: allahumma la taj`alhu akhira al`ahdi min ziyarati iyyahu
lines.english: O Allah, (please) do not decide this visit of mine to him (i.e. the Imam) to be the last,
and if you cause me to die before that,
then I bear witness in my death

lines.arabic: عَلَىٰ مَا شَهِدْتُ عَلَيْهِ فِي حَيَاتِي
lines.english: to the same things to which I have born witness in my lifetime:
I bear witness that `Ali the Commander of the Faithful,
and al-Hasan, al-Husayn,
`Ali ibn al-Husayn,
Muhammad ibn `Ali,
Ja`far ibn Muhammad,
Musa ibn Ja`far,
`Ali ibn Musa,
`Ali ibn Muhammad,
al-Hasan ibn `Ali,
and al-Hujjah (the Argument of Allah) ibn al-Hasan—
may Your blessings be upon all of them—are my Imams.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مَنْ قَتَلَهُمْ وَحَارَبَهُمْ مُشْرِكُونَ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna man qatalahum wa harabahum mushrikuna
lines.english: I also bear witness that all of those who have slain and fought against them are polytheists

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ رَدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي أَسْفَلِ دَرَكٍ مِنَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
lines.transliteration: wa man radda `alayhim fi asfali darakin min aljahimi
lines.english: and that all of those who reject them shall be in the lowest class of Hellfire.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مَنْ حَارَبَهُمْ لَنَا أَعْدَاءٌ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna man harabahum lana a`da'un
lines.english: I also bear witness that those who have fought against the Imams are our enemies
and we disavow them,
because they are indeed the party of Satan.

lines.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ مَنْ قَتَلَهُمْ لَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلائِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa `ala man qatalahum la`natu allahi walmala'ikati walnnasi ajma`ina
lines.english: The curse of Allah, His angels and all the peoples be upon those who killed the Imams,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ شَرِكَ فِيهِمْ وَمَنْ سَرَّهُ قَتْلُهُمْ
lines.transliteration: wa man sharika fihim wa man sarrahu qatluhum
lines.english: and upon those who had any role in killing them and those who were pleased for their having been killed.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بَعْدَ ٱلصَّلاَةِ وَٱلتَّسْلِيمِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka ba`da alssalati walttaslimi
lines.english: O Allah, as I begin with invoking Your peace and blessings upon them,
I pray you to bless Muhammad, `Ali,
Fatimah, al-Hasan, al-Husayn,

lines.transliteration: wa `aliyyin wa muhammadin wa ja`farin wa musa
lines.english: `Ali, Muhammad, Ja`far, Musa,

lines.transliteration: wa `aliyyin wa muhammadin wa `aliyyin walhasani walhujjati
lines.english: `Ali, Muhammad, `Ali, al-Hasan, and al-Hujjah,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ ٱلْعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la taj`alhu akhira al`ahdi min ziyaratihi
lines.english: and not to decide this visit of me to his tomb to be the last,

lines.arabic: فَإِنْ جَعَلْتَهُ فَٱحْشُرْنِي مَعَ هٰؤُلاَءِ ٱلْمُسَمَّيْنَ ٱلأَئِمَّةِ
lines.transliteration: fa'in ja`altahu fahshurni ma`a ha'ula'i almusammayna al-a'immati
lines.english: and if you decide so, then (please) include me with these Imams to whom I have referred.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَذَلِّلْ قُلُوبَنَا لَهُمْ بِٱلطَّاعَةِ وَٱلْمُنَاصَحَةِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa dhallil qulubana lahum biltta`ati walmunasahati
lines.english: O Allah, (please) cause our hearts to be subservient to them by showing obedience to them, well-wishing,
love for them, support, and submission.

In his book of al-Mazar, Sayyid ibn Tawus says: Whenever you offer an obligatory or a supererogatory prayer during your residence in the holy shrine of Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (‘a), you are recommended to say the following supplication:
O Allah, Your determination is surely unavoidable,
Your destiny is unavoidable,
Your act is unavoidable,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa bika
lines.english: and there is no power and no might except with You.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَمَا قَضَيْتَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ قَضَاءٍ
lines.english: So, O Allah, whatever act You decide on us
and whatever decree You make on us,

lines.transliteration: fa'a`tina ma`ahu sabran yaqharuhu wa yadmaghuhu
lines.english: (please do) grant us along with it patience that repels and fends it off
and make it ascend for our good toward Your Pleasure
so that it shall grow up our rewards, favors,
tributes, honor,
glory, boon,
and dignity in this world as well as the world to come.
And (please) do not lessen our rewards.
O Allah, whatever donation You give us,
whatever virtue You confer on us,
whatever endowment You bestow on us,

lines.transliteration: fa'a`tina ma`ahu shukran yaqharuhu wa yadmaghuhu
lines.english: (please) grant us with it thanksgiving that repels and fends it off.
And make it ascend for our good toward Your Pleasure,
and ascend in our rewards, tribute,
honor, Your boon,
and Your honoring (us) in this world as well as the world to come.

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْهُ لَنَا أَشَراً وَلاَ بَطَراً
lines.transliteration: wa la taj`alhu lana asharan wa la bataran
lines.english: And (please) do not make it to be for us a source of evil, ungratefulness,

lines.transliteration: wa la fitnatan wa la maqtan
lines.english: seditious matter, hatred,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ عَذَاباً وَلاَ خِزْياً فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa la `adhaban wa la khizyan fi alddunya wal-akhirati
lines.english: torture, or disgrace in this world as well as the world to come.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَثْرَةِ ٱللِّسَانِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inna na`udhu bika min `athrati allisani
lines.english: O Allah, we do seek Your protection against slips of tongues,
evil situations,
and lightness of the Scale.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
make us meet our the rewards of good deeds at the hours of our death,
do not show us the fruits of our deeds as nothing but regrets,
do not disgrace us when You judge us,

lines.transliteration: wa la tafdahna bisayyi'atina yawma nalqaka
lines.english: do not expose us because of our evildoings on the Day when we shall meet You,

lines.transliteration: waj`al qulubana tadhkuruka wa la tansaka
lines.english: make our hearts remember You always and never forget You,

lines.transliteration: wa takhshaka ka'annaha taraka hatta talqaka
lines.english: make our hears fear You as if they can see You until we meet You,

lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
change our evildoings into good deeds,
make our good deeds to be grades,
change our grades into chambers (in Paradise),
and make our chambers high.
O Allah, (please do) expand the source of sustenance for our poor people

lines.arabic: مِنْ سَعَةِ مَا قَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِكَ
lines.english: from the expansion that You have taken upon Yourself to make.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and endue us with true guidance as long as You grant us life,
with honor as long as You keep us alive,
with forgiveness when You decide to cease our lifetime,

lines.arabic: وَٱلْحِفْظِ فِي مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمْرِنَا
lines.english: with protection in the rest of our lifetime,
