with blessings in the sustenance that You give us,
with help to carry out what You have burdened us with,
and with steadfastness against what You have imposed on us.
And do not punish us for our wrongdoings,
do not treat us on basis of our lack of knowledge,
do not draw us near to destruction gradually on account of our sins,

lines.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ أَحْسَنَ مَا نَقُولُ ثَابِتاً فِي قُلُوبِنَا
lines.transliteration: waj`al ahsana ma naqulu thabitan fi qulubina
lines.english: make the best of our words to be firm in our hearts,
make us to be great persons in Your view
but humble ones in our own views,
make that which You have taught us to benefit us,
and increase us with useful knowledge.

lines.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لاََ يَخْشَعُ
lines.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min qalbin la yakhsha`u
lines.english: And I seek Your protection against a heart that does not submit (to You),
an eye that does not shed tears (for fear of You),
and a prayer that is not admitted (by You).
(Please do) rescue us from the evil seditious matters,
O Manager of this world and the world to come.

title: Ziyarat of Imam Ali (as) on 17th Rabi al-Awwal

lines.english: There is high recommendation on visiting the holy tomb of Imam `Ali (peace be upon him) on occasions related to the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) such as his birthday & Besat.This is because of the firm connection between these two great individuals and because of the perfect union between these two personalities.

Al-Shahid, Shaykh a-Mufid, and Sayyid Ibn Tawus—all those have reported that Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) visited the holy tomb of Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) on the seventeenth of Rabi` al-Awwal, which is the birthday of the Holy Prophet (peace and blessings upon him and his family), with the following form of ziyarah:
Teaching the lofty, trustworthy scholar Muhammad ibn Muslim al-Thaqafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said   :

When you approach the holy shrine of Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), you may first wash yourself before visiting, put on the cleanest of your clothes, use a perfume, and walk towards the shrine with tranquility.
When you stop at the door of peace (bab al-salam), which is the gate of the holy shrine, you may face the kiblah direction and repeat three times:
Allah is the Most Great.
You may then say the following:
Peace be upon the Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon the elite select of Allah.
Peace be upon the bearer of glad tidings, the warner (against Allah’s chastisement),
and the shining lantern.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.
Peace be upon the pure, the immaculate.
Peace be upon the luminous epitome.
Peace be upon the one given victory and aid (by Almighty Allah).
Peace be upon Abu’l-Qasim Muhammad.
Peace be upon the missioned Prophets of Allah
and upon the righteous servants of Allah.
Peace be upon the angels of Allah
who surround this sanctuary
and this tomb to which they are resorting.
You may then approach the tomb and say the following:
Peace be upon you, O successor of the Prophets’ successors.
Peace be upon you, O reliance of the pious ones.
Peace be upon you, O best saint among all saints.
Peace be upon you, O master of martyrs.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا آيَةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعُظْمَىٰ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O grandest sign of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَامِسَ أَهْلِ ٱلْعَبَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O fifth of the People of the Cloak.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا قَائِدَ ٱلْغُرِّ ٱلْمُحَجَّلِينَ ٱلأَتْقِيَاءِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya qa'ida alghurri almuhajjalina al-atqiya'i
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O leader of the white-forehead, pious group.
Peace be upon you, O shelter of the saints.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا زَيْنَ ٱلْمُوَحِّدِينَ ٱلنُّجَبَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O adornment of the noble monotheists.
Peace be upon you, O select of the best friends.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَالِدَ ٱلأَئِمَّةِ ٱلأُمَنَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O father of the trusted Imams.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَاحِبَ ٱلْحَوْضِ وَحَامِلَ ٱللِّوَاءِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya sahiba alhawdi wa hamila alliwa'i
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O director of the (Divine) pond and bearer of the Pennon.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا قَسِيمَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَلَظَىٰ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya qasima aljannati wa laza
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O decider of Paradise and Hellfire—the flaming.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ شُرِّفَتْ بِهِ مَكَّةُ وَمِنَىٰ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man shurrifat bihi makkatu wa mina
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O one by whom Makkah and Mina have been honored.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَحْرَ ٱلْعُلُومِ وَكَنَفَ ٱلْفُقَرَاءِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya bahra al`ulumi wa kanafa alfuqara'i
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O ocean of knowledge and haven of the poor.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ وُلِدَ فِي ٱلْكَعْبَةِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man wulida fi alka`bati
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O one who was born in the Ka`bah,

lines.transliteration: wa zuwwija fi alssama'i bisayyidati alnnisa'i
lines.english: married in the heavens to the Doyenne of Women;
and the witnesses were the elite angels.
Peace be upon you, O lantern of light.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ خَصَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيُّ بِجَزِيلِ ٱلْحِبَاءِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man khassahu alnnabiyyu bijazili alhiba'i
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O one whom was exclusively awarded abundant favors by the Prophet.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ بَاتَ عَلَىٰ فِرَاشِ خَاتَمِ ٱلأَنْبِيَاءِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man bata `ala firashi khatami al-anbiya'i
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O one who replaced the Seal of the Prophets in his bed
and protected him with his soul against the evil of the enemies.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ رُدَّتْ لَهُ ٱلشَّمْسُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man ruddat lahu alshshamsu
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O one to whom the sun was returned
and he thus became the match of Sham`un al-Safa (Simon the Zealot).

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ أَنْجَىٰ ٱللَّهُ سَفِينَةَ نُوحٍ بِٱسْمِهِ وَٱسْمِ أَخِيهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man anja allahu safinata nuhin bismihi wasmi akhihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O one in whose name and in the name of whose brother, Allah saved the Ark of Noah

lines.transliteration: haythu iltatama alma'u hawlaha wa tama
lines.english: when the waves of water collided and clashed around it.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ تَابَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِ وَبِأَخِيهِ عَلَىٰ آدَمَ إِذْ غَوَىٰ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man taba allahu bihi wa bi-akhihi `ala adama idh ghawa
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O one in whose name and in the name of whose brother, Allah accepted the repentance of Adam after he had allowed himself to be seduced.
Peace be upon you, O ark of redemption;
he who embarks on it will have saved himself (from perdition),
but he who leaves it will have perished.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ خَاطَبَ ٱلثُّعْبَانَ وَذِئْبَ ٱلْفَلاَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man khataba alththu`bana wa dhi'ba alfala
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he who spoke to a serpent and to a wolf in the desert.
Peace be upon you, O commander of the faithful.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَنْ كَفَرَ وَأَنَابَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi `ala man kafara wa anaba
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O argument of Allah against both those who disbelieved and those who believed.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا إِمَامَ ذَوِي ٱلأَلْبَابِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O chief of people of understanding.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَعْدِنَ الْحِكْمَةِ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya ma`dina alhikmati wa fasla alkhitabi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O essence of wisdom and clear judgment.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ ٱلْكِتَابِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O one having the knowledge of the Books.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مِيزَانَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O criterion on the Judgment Day.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا فَاصِلَ ٱلْحُكْمِ ٱلنَّاطِقَ بِٱلصَّوَابِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya fasila alhukmi alnnatiqa bilssawabi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O solver of all quarrels and spokesman of truth.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُتَصَدِّقُ بِٱلْخَاتَمِ فِي ٱلْمِحْرَابِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ayyuha almutasaddiqu bilkhatami fi almihrabi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he who gave his ring as alms while being in the prayer niche.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ كَفَىٰ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man kafa allahu almu'minina
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he through whom Allah sufficed the believers
in fighting on the Battle of al-Ahzab (the Allies).

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ أَخْلَصَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَحْدَانِيَّةَ وَأَنَابَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man akhlasa lillahi alwahdaniyyata wa anaba
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he who worshipped Allah alone with sincerity and always turned to Him.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا قَاتِلَ خَيْبَرَ وَقَالِعَ ٱلْبَابِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya qatila khaybara wa qali`a albabi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O warrior of Khaybar and plucker of the gate (of the fortress).

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ دَعَاهُ خَيْرُ ٱلأَنَامِ لِلْمَبِيتِ عَلَىٰ فِرَاشِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man da`ahu khayru al-anami lilmabiti `ala firashihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O one who, when the Best of Creatures (i.e. the Prophet) ordered him to spend that night at his place instead of him,
submitted to death and responded.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ لَهُ طُوبَىٰ وَحُسْنُ مَآبٍ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man lahu tuba wa husnu ma'abin
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he to whom is Tuba (bliss) and goodly return are decided.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ عِصْمَةِ ٱلدِّينِ وَيَا سَيِّدَ ٱلسَّادَاتِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waliyya `ismati alddini wa ya sayyida alssadati
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O director of the safety of the religion and chief of the chiefs.
Peace be upon you, O owner of miracles.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ نَزَلَتْ فِي فَضْلِهِ سُورَةُ ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man nazalat fi fadlihi suratu al`adiyati
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he about whose merits Surah al-`ªdiyat was revealed.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ كُتِبَ ٱسْمُهُ فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ عَلَىٰ ٱلسُّرَادِقَاتِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man kutiba ismuhu fi alssama'i `ala alssuradiqati
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he whose name is written in the heavens on the canopies (of the Divine Throne).

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُظْهِرَ ٱلْعَجَائِبِ وَٱلآيَاتِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O manifester of marvels and signs.
Peace be upon you, O commander in campaigns.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُخْبِراً بِمَا غَبَرَ وَبِمَا هُوَ آتٍ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya mukhbiran bima ghabara wa bima huwa atin
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he who accounted the bygone and predicted the future.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُخَاطِبَ ذِئْبِ ٱلْفَلَوَاتِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O speaker to a wolf in the desert.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَاتِمَ ٱلْحَصَىٰ وَمُبَيِّنَ ٱلْمُشْكِلاَتِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khatima alhasa wa mubayyina almushkilati
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O reckoner of pebbles and expounder of problems.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ عَجِبَتْ مِنْ حَمَلاتِهِ فِي ٱلْوَغَىٰ مَلائِكَةُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man `ajibat min hamalatihi fi alwagha mala'ikatu alssamawati
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he whose attacks in battlefields astonished the angels in the heavens.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ نَاجَىٰ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدَّمَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاهُ ٱلصَّدَقَاتِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man naja alrrasula faqaddama bayna yaday najwahu alssadaqati
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he who offered something in charity when he talked confidentially with the Messenger.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَالِدَ ٱلأَئِمَّةِ ٱلْبَرَرَةِ ٱلسَّادَاتِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya walida al-a'immati albararati alssadati
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O father of the Imams, the virtuous masters.
Peace be upon you, O one coming immediately after the Messenger.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِلْمِ خَيْرِ مَوْرُوثٍ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the knowledge of the most favorable inherited being.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Prophets’ successors.
Peace be upon you, O head of the pious ones.
Peace be upon you, O aid of the aggrieved ones.
Peace be upon you, O shelter of the believers.
Peace be upon you, O provider of evidences.
Peace be upon you, O Ta-Ha and Ya-Sin.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حَبْلَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَتِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O firm rope (taking) to Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ تَصَدَّقَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ بِخَاتَمِهِ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man tasaddaqa fi salatihi bikhatamihi `ala almiskini
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he who gave his ring as alms, while he was offering prayer, to a poor.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا قَالِعَ ٱلصَّخْرَةِ عَنْ فَمِ ٱلْقَلِيبِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya qali`a alssakhrati `an fami alqalibi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O he who removed the rock from the open of the well,
and he thus caused the pure water to flow.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاظِرَةَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O observing eye of Allah,
His extended Hand,

lines.arabic: وَلِسَانَهُ ٱلْمُعَبِّرَ عَنْهُ فِي بَرِيَّتِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa lisanahu almu`abbira `anhu fi bariyyatihi ajma`ina
lines.english: and His spokesman who conveys His affairs to all of His created beings.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِلْمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O heir of the Prophets’ knowledge,
keeper of the knowledge of the past and coming generations,
bearer of the Pennon of Praise (liwa’ al-hamd),

lines.arabic: وَسَاقِيَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ مِنْ حَوْضِ خَاتَمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
lines.transliteration: wa saqiya awliya'ihi min hawdi khatami alnnabiyyina
lines.english: and one who shall serve his adherents with water from the (Divine) Pond of the Seal of the Prophets.
Peace be upon you, O head of the religion,
leader of the white-forehead group,
and father of the well-pleased Imams.
Peace be upon the pleased name of Allah,
His radiant Face,
His strong Side,
and His straight Path.
Peace be upon the pious Imam,
the select and elite.
Peace be upon the brightly shining star.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلإِمَامِ أَبِي ٱلْحَسَنِ عَلِيٍّ
lines.english: Peace be upon the Imam Abu’l-Hasan `Ali.
Peace be upon the leaders to true guidance,
the lanterns in murk,
the epitomes of piety,
the lights of true guidance,
and owners of thought,
the havens of people,
the firmest handles,
and the arguments against the inhabitants of this world.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon them.
Peace be upon the light of lights,
the argument of the Omnipotent Lord,
the father of the immaculate Imams,
the decider of Paradise and Hellfire,
the narrator of past events,
the destroyer of the unbelievers,

lines.arabic: مُسْتَنْقِذِ ٱلشِّيعَةِ ٱلْمُخْلِصِينَ مِنْ عَظِيمِ ٱلأَوْزَارِ
lines.english: and the savior of the faithful Shi`ah from their grand sins.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمَخْصُوصِ بِٱلطَّاهِرَةِ ٱلتَّقِيَّةِ ٱبْنَةِ ٱلْمُخْتَارِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala almakhsusi bilttahirati alttaqiyyati ibnati almukhtari
lines.english: Peace be upon the one married to the pure, pious daughter of the Chosen Prophet,
the one born in the House of curtains,
the one married in the heavens to the reverent, immaculate,
content, and well-pleased lady—
the mother of the immaculate Imams.
Peace be upon the Great News,
about whom they differ,
before whom they shall be stood,
and about whom they shall be asked.
Peace be upon the most shining light of Allah
and the most luminous brightness of Him.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَحُجَّتَهُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waliyya allahi wa hujjatahu
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s friend and argument
and Allah’s select and choice.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَحُجَّتَهُ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu annaka ya waliyya allahi wa hujjatahu
lines.english: I bear witness that you, being Allah’s friend and argument,

lines.arabic: لَقَدْ جَاهَدْتَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ
lines.transliteration: laqad jahadta fi sabili allahi haqqa jihadihi
lines.english: strove in Allah’s way in the most appropriate way,

lines.arabic: وَٱتَّبَعْتَ مِنْهَاجَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: wattaba`ta minhaja rasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: followed the course of Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household,
enjoined that which Allah has deemed lawful,
forbade that which Allah has deemed unlawful,
carried out His laws,
offered the prayers,
paid the zakat,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

lines.arabic: وَجَاهَدْتَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ صَابِراً نَاصِحاً
lines.transliteration: wa jahadta fi sabili allahi sabiran nasihan
lines.english: and strove in Allah’s way with steadfastness and well-wishing,

lines.arabic: مُجْتَهِداً مُحْتَسِباً عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمَ ٱلأَجْرِ حَتَّىٰ أَتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
lines.transliteration: mujtahidan muhtasiban `inda allahi `azima al-ajri hatta ataka alyaqinu
lines.english: and with painstakingness and with the intention of seeking the great reward of Allah until death came upon you.

lines.arabic: فَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ دَفَعَكَ عَنْ حَقِّكَ
lines.english: So, Allah’s curse be upon those who deprived you of your right
and upon those who took you away from your position.

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ ذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَ بِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man balaghahu dhalika faradiya bihi
lines.english: Allah’s curse be upon every one who, when informed about this, accepted it.

lines.transliteration: ushhidu allaha wa mala'ikatahu wa anbiya'ahu wa rusulahu
lines.english: I call Allah, His angels, His Prophets, and His Messengers to witness for me that
I am the friend of him who is loyal to you
and the enemy of him who antagonizes you.

lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
You may then throw yourself on the tomb, kiss it, and say the following words:
I bear witness that you can hear my words
and see my place.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ لَكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ بِٱلْبَلاَغِ وَٱلأَدَاءِ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu laka ya waliyya allahi bilbalaghi wal-ada'i
lines.english: And I testify to you, O Allah’s friend, that you conveyed and fulfilled.
O my master! O Allah’s argument!

lines.arabic: يَا أَمِينَ ٱللَّهِ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: ya amina allahi ya waliyya allahi
lines.english: O Allah’s trustee! O Allah’s friend!

lines.arabic: إِنَّ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ذُنُوباً
lines.transliteration: inna bayni wa bayna allahi `azza wa jalla dhunuban
lines.english: Between me and Allah, to Whom all might and majesty belong, there are sins
that have overburdened my back
and deprived me of sleep;
whenever I remember them, even my insides shiver.

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ هَرَبْتُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَإِلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: wa qad harabtu ila allahi `azza wa jalla wa ilayka
lines.english: I thus flee to Allah, to Whom all might and majesty belong, and to you.
I beg you in the name of Him Who has entrusted you with His secrets,
appointed you as the supervisor over the affairs of His creatures,
matched the obedience to you to the obedience to Him,
and matched the loyalty to you to the loyalty to Him
that you may intercede for me before Allah,
rescue me from Hellfire,
and aid me against the vicissitudes of my time.
You may then throw yourself on the tomb again, kiss it, and say the following words:
O Allah’s friend!
O Allah’s argument!
O Allah’s door of forgiveness!
I, your adherent, visitor,
seeker of refuge with your tomb,
residing in your courtyard,
staying in your vicinity,

lines.arabic: يَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَشْفَعَ لَهُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ فِي قَضَاءِ حَاجَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: yas'aluka an tashfa`a lahu ila allahi fi qada'i hajatihi
lines.english: (I) beg you to intercede for me before Allah that He may grant my needs

lines.transliteration: wa nujhi talibatihi fi alddunya wal-akhirati
lines.english: and may respond to my requests for this life as well as the life to come,

lines.arabic: فَإِنَّ لَكَ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْجَاهَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
lines.english: because you enjoy an enormous position with Allah,
as well as admitted right of intercession.
So, O my master, include me with those for whom you care
and include me with your party.

lines.arabic: وَٱلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ ضَجِيعَيْكَ آدَمَ وَنُوحٍ
lines.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka wa `ala daji`ayka adama wa nuhin
lines.english: Peace be upon you and upon your partners in place; Adam and Noah.

lines.arabic: وَٱلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ وَلَدَيْكَ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka wa `ala waladayka alhasani walhusayni
lines.english: Peace be upon you and upon your two sons; al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
and upon the immaculate Imams from your progeny.

You may then offer a six-unit prayer of ziyarah; two for visiting Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), two for visiting Prophet Adam (peace be upon him), and two for visiting Prophet Noah (peace be upon him). You may also supplicate Almighty Allah as earnestly as possible, for your prayers are responded at this place, Allah willing.
Farewell Ziyarat - Iqbal Aamal

lines.arabic:
وَ هُوَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ اللَّهَ وَ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ 
السَّلَامَ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَ بِالرَّسُولِ وَ بِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ وَ دَعَا إِلَيْهِ وَ دَلَّ عَلَيْهِ 
اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي إِيَّاهُ 
اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا ثَوَابَ مَزَارِهِ وَ ارْزُقْنَا الْعَوْدَ وَ إِنْ تَوَفَّيْتَنِي قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنِّي أَشْهَدُ فِي مَمَاتِي بِمَا شَهِدْتُ عَلَيْهِ فِي حَيَاتِي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُمْ أَعْلَامُ الْهُدَى وَ نُجُومُ الْعُلَى وَ الْقَدْرُ الْبَالِغُ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ خَلْقِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مَنْ رَدَّ ذَلِكَ هُوَ فِي دَرْكِ الْجَحِيمِ 
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ تُسَمِّي الْأَئِمَّةَ وَاحِداً وَاحِداً وَ أَنْ لَا تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ وِفَادَتِهِ وَ الِانْقِضَاءِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِهِ وَ إِنْ جَعَلْتَهُ فَاجْعَلْنِي مَعَ هَؤُلَاءِ الْأَئِمَّةِ الْهُدَاةِ 
اللَّهُمَّ ذَلِّلْ قَلْبِي بِالطَّاعَةِ وَ الْمُنَاصَحَةِ وَ الْمُوَالاةِ وَ حُسْنِ الْمُوَازَرَةِ وَ الْمَوَدَّةِ وَ التَّسْلِيمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَكْمِلَ بِذَلِكَ طَاعَتُكَ وَ يَبْلُغَ بِهَا مَرْضَاتَكَ وَ يَسْتَوْجِبَ بِهَا ثَوَابَكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ 
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ بِالْوَلَايَةِ لِمَنْ وَالَيْتَ وَ وَالَتْ رُسُلُكَ وَ أَنْبِيَاؤُكَ وَ مَلَائِكَتُكَ وَ أُشْهِدُكَ بِالْبَرَاءَةِ مِمَّنْ بَرِئْتَ أَنْتَ مِنْهُ وَ بَرِئَتْ مِنْهُ رُسُلُكَ وَ أَنْبِيَاؤُكَ وَ مَلَائِكَتُكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ وَ السَّفَرَةُ الْأَبْرَارُ 
اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْنِي لِكُلِّ مَقَامٍ مَحْمُودٍ وَ أَقْلِبْنِي مِنْ هَذَا الْحَرَمِ بِخَيْرٍ مَوْجُودٍ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ
lines.english:
May God‟s Peace, Mercy and Blessings be upon you. I entrust you with God, and I say peace be on you. We believe in God and the Messenger, what he has brought, what he has invited to and what he has reasoned. O‟ my God! Please do not make this the last time I visit here. O‟ my God! Please do not deprive us from the reward of visiting his shrine. O‟ God! Please bless us with the return. However, if You take away my life before this, I bear witness to what I testify in my life. I bear witness that they are the signs of guidance, stars high above, and means of connection between You and Your Creatures. I bear witness that whoever rejects this shall reside in the depth of Hell. O‟ my God! I ask You to bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny.”
 Then name the Divine Leaders one by one and continue as follows, “Please do not make this the last time that I go to him and the termination of my visiting him. I ask You to intercede on my behalf near God for fulfilling my needs and demands for this world and the Hereafter. Please let me be with these Divine Leaders of guidance.
 O‟ my God! Please smooth my heart with obedience, advice, friendship, love and submission until I complete Your Obedience with
this and attain Your Good Pleasure and deserve Your Reward and Mercy. O‟ my God! I bear witness to the Mastery of him whom Your Prophet, Your Messengers and Your angels declared as Master. I bear witness near You that I disown whoever You disown, and whoever Your Messengers, Prophets, nearby-stationed angels and Your Good Ambassadors disown. O‟ my God! Please grant me success in all praised ranks and let me return from here with the best benefits earned. O‟ Lord of Majesty, Bounty and Honor! 


السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا تَاجَ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ
 السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَأْسَ الصِّدِّيقِينَ 
 السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ الْأَحْكَامِ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رُكْنَ الْمَقَامِ [يَا صَاحِبَ الرُّكْنِ وَ الْمَقَامِ‌]
 اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْ وَفْدِهِ الْمُبَارَكِينَ وَ زُوَّارِهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ وَ شِيعَتِهِ الصَّادِقِينَ وَ مَوَالِيهِ النَّاصِحِينَ وَ أَنْصَارِهِ الْمُكْرَمِينَ وَ أَصْحَابِهِ الْمُؤَيَّدِينَ وَ اجْعَلْنِي أَكْرَمَ وَافِدٍ وَ أَفْضَلَ وَارِدٍ وَ أَنْبَلَ قَاصِدٍ فِي هَذَا الْحَرَمِ الْكَرِيمِ وَ الْمَقَامِ الْعَظِيمِ وَ الْمَوْرِدِ النَّبِيلِ وَ الْمَنْهَلِ الْجَلِيلِ الَّذِي أَوْجَبْتَ فِيهِ غُفْرَانَكَ وَ رَحْمَتَكَ وَ أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ وَ مَنْ حَضَرَ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِهِ فِي هَذَا الْحَرَمِ الَّذِي هُمْ بِهِ [فيه‌] مُحْدِقُونَ حَافُّونَ أَنَّ مَنْ سَكَنَ رَمْسَهُ وَ حَلَّ ضَرِيحَهُ طُهْرٌ مُقَدَّسٌ صِدِّيقٌ مُنْتَجَبٌ وَ وَصِيٌّ مُرْتَضًى وَاهاً لَكَ مِنْ تُرْبَةٍ ضَمِنَتْ [ضمت‌] نُوراً مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَ شِهَاباً مِنَ النُّورِ وَ يَنْبُوعَ الْحِكْمَةِ وَ عَيْناً مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَ إِبْلَاغَ الْحُجَّةِ أَنَا أَبْرَأُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ قَاتِلِيكَ وَ ظَالِمِيكَ وَ النَّاصِبِينَ لَكَ وَ الْمُعِينِينَ عَلَيْكَ وَ الْمُحَارِبِينَ لَكَ وَ أُوَدِّعُكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَدَاعَ الْمَحْزُونِ لِفِرَاقِكَ الْمُكْتَئِبِ بِالزَّوَالِ عَنْ حَرَمِكَ الْمُتَفَجِّعِ عَلَيْكَ لَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْكَ وَ لَا مِنْ زِيَارَتِنَا لَكَ إِنَّهُ [إنك‌] سَمِيعٌ مُجِيبٌ.
Peace be on you, O‟ crown of the Trustees! Peace be on you, O‟ chief of the truthful ones! Peace be on you, O‟ inheritor of the decrees! Peace be on you, O‟ Company of Rukn and Maqam1. O‟ my God! Please let me be amongst his blessed pilgrims, sincere visitors, true followers, good companions, noble friends and certified companions.
Please let me be of the noblest ones to come to this Sacred Noble House with the exalted position and the Majestic Spring2 which You have ensured Your Forgiveness and Mercy in it. I take God and the angels that circulate around this shrine as witness that the one who is buried here in this shrine is pure, holy, honest, chosen and a Trustee that You are pleased with. Woe be upon the dirt which has housed such a good light, such a brilliant meteorite, source of wisdom, spring of mercy, and an advocate of proof in it. I disown your murderer near God. I disown those who oppressed you, those who opposed you, those who assisted them and those who fought with you. O‟ my Guardian! O‟ Commander of the Faithful! I say farewell to you like one who is sad about departing from you, sorry about having to leave your shrine with his heart in pain for this. May God not make this be my last occasion for visiting you and pilgrimage to your shrine. For indeed He is All-hearing, the Fulfiller!”

title: Ziyarat of Imam Ali (as) on 27th Rajab
description: This long ziyarat is a chronicle of the supreme position of Imam Ali(as) and the various events in his life in defense of the Prophet (saws) and Islam. Recited on the Night and Day of Maba'th (27th Rajab).

lines.english: The ziyarah has been mentioned by Shaykh al-Mufid, Sayyid Ibn Tawus, and al-Shahid in the following form:

When you intend to visit the holy shrine of Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) on the Divine Mission Day or the night before it, you may stop at the gate of the holy dome, facing the holy tomb, and say the following:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ خَلِيفَةِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam the vicegerent of Allah.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha adama khalifati allahi

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوحٍ صِفْوَةِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah the choice of Allah.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha nuhin sifwati allahi

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham the intimate friend of Allah.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ibrahima khalili allahi

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ كَلِيمِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses the spoken by Allah.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa kalimi allahi

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيسَىٰ رُوحِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus the spirit of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ رُسُلِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad the chief of Allah’s Messengers.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha muhammadin sayyidi rusuli allahi

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O commander of the faithful.
Peace be upon you, O epitome of the pious ones.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Prophets’ successors.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَصِيَّ رَسُولِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O successor of the Messenger of the Lord of the worlds.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya wasiyya rasuli rabbi al`alamina

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِلْمِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the knowledge of the past and the coming generations.
Peace be upon you, O Great News.
Peace be upon you, O Straight Path.
Peace be upon you, O noble, refined one.
Peace be upon you, O pious successor (of the Prophet).
Peace be upon you, O well-pleased, pure one.
Peace be upon you, O shining full moon.
Peace be upon you, O grandest veracious one.
Peace be upon you, O greatest distinguisher (between the right and the wrong).
Peace be upon you, O glowing lantern.
Peace be upon you, O leader to the true guidance.
Peace be upon you, O pattern of piety.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O grand argument of Allah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَاصَّةَ ٱللَّهِ وَخَالِصَتَهُ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O select and elite of Allah,
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khassata allahi wa khalisatahu

lines.english: trustee and choice of Allah,
door to and argument of Allah,
source and secret of Allah’s judgment,
lines.transliteration: wa ma`dina hukmi allahi wa sirrahu

lines.english: guardian and keeper of Allah’s knowledge,
and envoy of Allah among His creatures.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
paid the zakat,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,
followed the Messenger,
recited the Book as exactly as it must be recited,
conveyed the messages of Allah,
fulfilled your covenant with Allah,
the Words of Allah were accomplished by you,
strove in Allah’s way in the best manner,
lines.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi

lines.arabic: وَنَصَحْتَ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.english: advised for the sake of Allah and for the sake of His Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household,
lines.transliteration: wa nasahta lillahi wa lirasulihi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi

lines.english: and sacrificed yourself with steadfastness, seeking Allah’s reward,
struggling for the defense of Allah’s religion,

lines.arabic: مُوَقِّياً لِرَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.english: protecting Allah’s Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household,
lines.transliteration: muwaqqiyan lirasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi

lines.english: seeking for that which is with Allah,
and desiring for that which Allah has promised.
You also sealed your life as martyr,
a witness, and witnessed;
so, may Allah reward you
on behalf of His Messenger, Islam, and the people of Islam
with the most favorite reward, for you are veracious.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ كُنْتَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْقَوْمِ إِسْلاَماً
lines.english: I bear witness that you were the first to embrace Islam,
lines.transliteration: ashhadu annaka kunta awwala alqawmi islaman

lines.english: the most sincere in faith,
the most confident,
and you were the most Allah-fearing,
the most steadfast (against ordeals for the sake of Islam),

lines.arabic: وَأَحْوَطَهُمْ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.english: the most watchful for Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household,
lines.transliteration: wa ahwatahum `ala rasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi

lines.english: endowed with the most favorable merits,
the foremost of everyone else in everything,
the owner of the most elevated rank,
the owner of the most honorable position,
and the most respected (by Almighty Allah and His Messenger).
Thus, you became stronger when they became weak

lines.arabic: وَلَزِمْتَ مِنْهَاجَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.english: and you abode by the course of Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household.
lines.transliteration: wa lazimta minhaja rasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi

lines.english: I also bear witness that you were the true vicegerent of him (i.e. the Holy Prophet);
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka kunta khalifatahu haqqan

lines.english: no one could ever compete with you in this position in spite of the existence of hypocrites,
the despise of the unbelievers,
and the malice of the wicked.
You also managed the matters when they failed to do so,
you spoke (the truth) when they stammered,
and you carried on with the light of Allah when they stopped.
lines.transliteration: wa madayta binuri allahi idh waqafu

lines.english: Hence, he who follows you has actually been led to the true guidance.
You were the first to speak,
the firmest in refuting the rivals,
the most eloquent of them,
the most apposite in opinions,
the most courageous,
the most confident of them,
the best of them in deeds,
and the most learned in affairs.
For the believers, you were merciful father,
and they were thus your dependants;
so, you carried the burdens that they were too weak to carry,
preserved that which they forfeited,
conserved that which they neglected,
prepared yourself for facing that which they were too coward to face,
advanced when they were dismayed,
and acted steadfastly when they became anxious.
You were thus incessant torment on the unbelievers,
and you were also rude and furious (on them).
You rained (with mercy) on the believers, and you were fertile and source of knowledge for them.
lines.transliteration: wa lilmu'minina ghaythan wa khisban wa `ilman

lines.english: Your argument was never weak,
your heart never deviated,
your sagacity was never feeble,
and your determination never cowered.
You were as firm as mountain, since storms could never displace you
and misfortunes could never move you.

lines.arabic: كُنْتَ كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.english: You were as exactly as described by Allah’s Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household—who said about you
lines.transliteration: kunta kama qala rasulu allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi

lines.english: that you are strong in your body,
modest in yourself,
great in the view of Allah,
imposing in the earth,
and lofty in the heavens.
None could ever find fault with you,
none could ever speak evil of you,
you never desired for any of the created beings,
and you were never lenient (unfairly) to anyone.

lines.arabic: يُوجَدُ ٱلضَّعِيفُ ٱلذَّلِيلُ عِنْدَكَ قَوِيّاً عَزِيزاً حَتَّىٰ تَأْخُذَ لَهُ بِحَقِّهِ
lines.english: The weak, humble one was strong and mighty in your view until you give him back his right,
lines.transliteration: yujadu aldda`ifu aldhdhalilu `indaka qawiyyan `azizan hatta ta'khudha lahu bihaqqihi

lines.arabic: وَٱلْقَوِيُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ عِنْدَكَ ضَعِيفاً حَتَّىٰ تَأْخُذَ مِنْهُ ٱلْحَقَّ
lines.english: and the strong, mighty one was weak in your view until you take the others’ rights from him.
lines.transliteration: walqawiyyu al`azizu `indaka da`ifan hatta ta'khudha minhu alhaqqa

lines.arabic: الْقَرِيبُ وَٱلْبَعِيدُ عِنْدَكَ فِي ذٰلِكَ سَوَاءٌ
lines.english: The near and the remote were equal in your view.
Your habit was to be true, honest, and kind,
your words were ruling and determination,
your custom was forbearance and fortitude,
and your view was knowledge and firmness.
At your hands, the religion became even,
the difficult became easy,
the fires were extinguished,
the faith became strong,
Islam became steady,
and the calamity of losing you undermined all people.
Surely, we are Allah's and to Him we shall surely return.
lines.transliteration: fa'inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji`una

lines.english: Curse of Allah be upon him who slew you,
curse of Allah be upon him who mutinied against you,
curse of Allah be upon him who forged lies against you,

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ ظَلَمَكَ وَغَصَبَكَ حَقَّكَ
lines.english: curse of Allah be upon him who wronged you and usurped your right,
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man zalamaka wa ghasabaka haqqaka

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ ذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَ بِهِ
lines.english: and curse of Allah be upon him who, when was informed about this, was pleased with it.
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man balaghahu dhalika faradiya bihi

lines.english: Verily, we disavow all those before Allah.
Curse of Allah be upon the group that disagreed with you,
denied your (Divinely commissioned) leadership,
aided each other against you, slew you,
deviated from you, and disappointed you.

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلنَّارَ مَثْوَاهُمْ
lines.english: All praise be to Allah, for Hellfire is the abode of those
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi ja`ala alnnara mathwahum

lines.english: and evil the place to which they are brought.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ لَكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَوَلِيَّ رَسُولِهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِٱلْبَلاَغِ وَٱلأَدَاءِ
lines.english: I bear witness for you, O Intimate servant of Allah and loyalist of Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household, that you did convey and carry out (your mission).
lines.transliteration: ashhadu laka ya waliyya allahi wa waliyya rasulihi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi bilbalaghi wal-ada'i

lines.english: And I bear witness that you are the beloved of Allah and the door to Him,
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka habibu allahi wa babuhu

lines.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ جَنْبُ ٱللَّهِ وَوَجْهُهُ ٱلَّذِي مِنْهُ يُؤْتَىٰ
lines.english: you are the Side of Allah and His Face from which one can come to Allah,
lines.transliteration: wa annaka janbu allahi wa wajhuhu alladhi minhu yu'ta

lines.english: you are Allah’s way,
you are Allah’s servant,

lines.arabic: وَأَخُو رَسُولِهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.english: and you are the brother of His Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household.
lines.transliteration: wa akhu rasulihi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi

lines.arabic: أَتَيْتُكَ زَائِراً لِعَظِيمِ حَالِكَ وَمَنْزِلَتِكَ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ رَسُولِهِ
lines.english: I have thus come to visit you because you enjoy a magnificent position and standing with Allah and with His Messenger.
lines.transliteration: ataytuka za'iran li`azimi halika wa manzilatika `inda allahi wa `inda rasulihi

lines.english: So, I seek nearness to Allah through my visit to you
and I desire that you will intercede for me.
Through your intercession for me, I hope for redemption of myself,
I seek refuge with you against Hellfire,

lines.arabic: هَارِباً مِنْ ذُنُوبِيَ ٱلَّتِي ٱحْتَطَبْتُهَا عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِي
lines.english: I am fleeing from my sins that I have overburdened myself with them,
lines.transliteration: hariban min dhunubiya allati ihtatabtuha `ala zahri

lines.english: and I resort to you in the hope of my Lord’s mercy.

lines.arabic: أَتَيْتُكَ أَسْتَشْفِعُ بِكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: I have come to you, O my master, seeking your intercession for me before Allah
lines.transliteration: ataytuka astashfi`u bika ya mawlaya ila allahi

lines.arabic: وَأَتَقَرَّبُ بِكَ إِلَيْهِ لِيَقْضِيَ بِكَ حَوَائِجِي
lines.english: and seeking nearness to Him through you so that He may settle my needs;
lines.transliteration: wa ataqarrabu bika ilayhi liyaqdiya bika hawa'iji

lines.english: so, (please) intercede for me, O Commander of the Faithful.
Verily, I am the slave of Allah and your servant and visitor,
lines.transliteration: fa'inni `abdu allahi wa mawlaka wa za'iruka

lines.english: and you enjoy a distinguished position with Allah,
a great rank,
a big standing,
and an admitted right of intercession.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

lines.english: and send blessings upon Your servant, Your most faithful trustee,
Your firmest handle,
Your highest Hand,
Your excellent Word,
Your argument on the people,
Your grandest veracious one,
the chief of the Prophets’ successors,
the reliance of the saints,
the support of the elite ones,
the commander of the faithful,
the leader of the pious ones,
the example of the veracious ones,
the pattern of the righteous ones,
the one protected against flaws,
the one saved from defects,
the one cleared from faults,
the one purified from doubts,
the brother of Your Prophet,
the successor of Your Messenger,
the one who replaced him when he spent that night instead of him,
the one who sacrificed his soul for him,
the one who always relieved him in harsh situations,
and the one whom You chose to be the sword of his (i.e. the Prophet) Prophethood,
the miracle of his (Divine) mission,
the lucid indication of his arguments,
the bearer of his pennon,
the protector of his soul,
the guide of his nation,
the power of his might,
the crown of his head,
the door to his victory,
and the key to his triumph,
until he defeated the armies of polytheism by Your aid,
terminated the warriors of atheism by Your permission,

lines.arabic: وَبَذَلَ نَفْسَهُ فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ وَمَرْضَاةِ رَسُولِكَ
lines.english: exerted all efforts to win the pleasure of You and Your Messenger,
lines.transliteration: wa badhala nafsahu fi mardatika wa mardati rasulika

lines.english: devoted all of his efforts to the obedience to him,
and made of himself armor to protect him from any misfortune,

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ فَاضَتْ نَفْسُهُ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي كَفِّهِ
lines.english: until the soul of the Prophet, peace be upon him and his Household, departed his body while his face was in the hand of `Ali,
lines.transliteration: hatta fadat nafsuhu salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi fi kaffihi

lines.english: who thus felt its coldness,
and rubbed his face therewith.
And Your angels helped him bathe and prepare his body for burial.
lines.transliteration: wa a`anat-hu mala'ikatuka `ala ghuslihi wa tajhizihi

lines.english: He then performed [the ritual] prayer for him, buried his body,
settled his debts,
fulfilled his promises,
made his covenants,
followed his example,
and abode by his will.

lines.arabic: وَحِينَ وَجَدَ أَنْصَاراً نَهَضَ مُسْتَقِلاًّ بِأَعْبَاءِ ٱلْخِلاَفَةِ
lines.english: When he could find supporters, he undertook the burdens of the position of leadership (caliphate)
lines.transliteration: wa hina wajada ansaran nahada mustaqillan bi'a`ba'i alkhilafati

lines.english: and assumed the loads of Imamate.
He thus hoisted the flag of true guidance among Your servants,
spread the dress of security in Your lands,
lines.transliteration: wa nashara thawba al-amni fi biladika

lines.english: extended justice among Your creatures,
judged according to Your Book among your beings,
executed the laws,
suppressed unbelief,
rectified the deviation,
mollified the criticism,
eradicated lethargy,
blocked the gap,
killed the preachers, the wrongdoers, and the apostates,

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ يَزَلْ عَلَىٰ مِنْهَاجِ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَوَتِيرَتِهِ
lines.english: kept on following the course and tradition of Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household,
lines.transliteration: wa lam yazal `ala minhaji rasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa watiratihi

lines.english: kept on following his excellent pattern,
kept on following his superb practice,
he imitated his convention,
held fast to his morale,
and copied his way (of treating with matters).
And he always noticed the Prophet’s deeds as if they were before his eyes;
he thus ordered Your servants to copy these deeds
and invited them to imitate them

lines.arabic: إِلَىٰ أَنْ خُضِبَتْ شَيْبَتُهُ مِنْ دَمِ رَأْسِهِ
lines.english: until his white beard was dyed with the blood of his head.
lines.transliteration: ila an khudibat shaybatuhu min dami ra'sihi

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا لَمْ يُؤْثِرْ فِي طَاعَتِكَ شَكّاً عَلَىٰ يَقِينٍ
lines.english: O Allah, as he never preferred a dubious matter to a certain one for the sake of obeying You
lines.transliteration: allahumma fakama lam yu'thir fi ta`atika shakkan `ala yaqinin

lines.english: and never associated any one with You even for a winking of an eye,
please send upon him growing and increasing blessings

lines.arabic: يَلْحَقُ بِهَا دَرَجَةَ ٱلنُّبُوَّةِ فِي جَنَّتِكَ
lines.english: due to which he may join the position of Prophethood in Your Paradise,
lines.transliteration: yalhaqu biha darajata alnnubuwwati fi jannatika

lines.english: and (please) convey our greetings and compliments to him
lines.transliteration: wa ballighhu minna tahiyyatan wa salaman

lines.arabic: وَآتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فِي مُوَالاَتِهِ فَضْلاً وَإِحْسَاناً
lines.english: and, on account of our allegiance to his leadership, please grant us from You favor, kindness,
lines.transliteration: wa atina min ladunka fi muwalatihi fadlan wa ihsanan

lines.english: forgiveness, and pleasure.
You are verily the Lord of enormous favor.
[please do that] in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
You may then put your right and then left cheeks on the tomb, turn to the kiblah direction, offer the Prayer of Ziyarah, and supplicate for anything you want.
Then, you may recite the (famous) Tasbih al-Zahra' and say the following:
O Allah, You have conveyed to me glad tidings
through Your Prophet and Messenger
Muhammad, Your peace be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: فَقُلْتَ: «وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوٱ أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ.»
lines.english: as You said, “And give good news to those who believe that theirs is a footing of firmness with their Lord.”
lines.transliteration: faqulta wa bashshir alladhina amanu anna lahum qadama sidqin `inda rabbihim

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَإِنِّي مُؤْمِنٌ بِجَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ
lines.english: O Allah, I indeed believe in all Your Prophets and Messengers, Your blessings be upon them.
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa inni mu'minun bijami`i anbiya'ika wa rusulika salawatuka `alayhim

lines.english: So, (please) do not cause me, after my recognition of them, to be in a situation
due to which You expose me in the presence of the Witnesses;

lines.arabic: بَلْ قِفْنِي مَعَهُمْ وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلَىٰ ٱلتَّصْدِيقِ بِهِمْ
lines.english: rather, (please) include me with them and make me die while I give them credence.
lines.transliteration: bal qifni ma`ahum wa tawaffani `ala alttasdiqi bihim

lines.english: O Allah, You have also bestowed upon them exclusive honor from You
and You have ordered me to follow them.
O Allah, I am Your slave and visitor,
seeking Your nearness through visiting the brother of Your Messenger.

lines.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ مَأْتِيٍّ وَمَزُورٍ حَقٌّ لِمَنْ أَتَاهُ وَزَارَهُ
lines.english: Indeed, each visited person is expected to pay attention to his duty towards the one who visits and comes to him.
lines.transliteration: wa `ala kulli ma'tiyyin wa mazurin haqqun liman atahu wa zarahu

lines.english: And You are the Best One to Whom one may come
and You are the most Generous One to be visited;

lines.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّّهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحِيمُ
lines.english: I therefore beseech You, O Allah, O All-beneficent, O All-merciful,
lines.transliteration: fa-as'aluka ya allahu ya rahmanu ya rahimu

lines.english: O All-magnanimous, O All-glorious,
O One, O Besought of all,

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
lines.english: O He Who never begets nor is He begotten,
lines.transliteration: ya man lam yalid wa lam yulad

lines.english: and the like of Whom is none,
lines.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun

lines.english: O He Who has not betaken wife or child,
lines.transliteration: wa lam yattakhidh sahibatan wa la waladan

lines.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (I beseech You) to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

lines.arabic: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَ تُحْفَتَكَ إِيَّايَ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي أَخَا رَسُولِكَ
lines.english: to choose the gift that You present to me on account of my visiting Your Messenger’s brother
lines.transliteration: wa an taj`ala tuhfataka iyyaya min ziyarati akha rasulika

lines.english: to be release of me from Hellfire,

lines.arabic: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي مِمَّنْ يُسَارِعُ فِي ٱلْخَيْرَاتِ
lines.english: to include me with those who strive with one another in hastening to good deeds
lines.transliteration: wa an taj`alani mimman yusari`u fi alkhayrati

lines.english: and those who call on You with love and reverence,
and to make me of those who are humble before You.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ مَنَنْتَ عَلَيَّ بِزِيَارَةِ مَوْلاَيَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
lines.english: O Allah, You have indeed conferred upon me with the favor of visiting my master `Ali the son of Abu-Talib
lines.transliteration: allahumma innaka mananta `alayya biziyarati mawlaya `aliyyi bni abi talibin

lines.english: and with the favor of my being loyal to his (Divinely commissioned) leadership and recognition of him;
so, (please) make me of those whom You give victory and whom You choose to triumph through them.
lines.transliteration: faj`alni mimman yansuruhu wa yantasiru bihi

lines.english: And (please) bestow me with the favor of making me support Your religion.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلَىٰ دِينِهِ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) include me with the adherents of him and cause me to die following his doctrine.
lines.transliteration: allahumma waj`alni min shi`atihi wa tawaffani `ala dinihi

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَوْجِبْ لِي مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَٱلرِّضْوَانِ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) cause me to deserve mercy, pleasure,
lines.transliteration: allahumma awjib li min alrrahmati walrridwani

lines.english: forgiveness, favor,
and sustenance that is growing, legally gotten, and pleasant,

lines.arabic: مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ يَا أَرْحمَ ٱلرَّاحِمِينَ
lines.english: (and make it) suitable to Your favoring, O most merciful of all those who show mercy!
lines.transliteration: ma anta ahluhu ya arhma alrrahimina

lines.english: All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds.

title: Ziyarat of Imam Ali (as) on 21st Ramadan
description: Recited on the 21st of Ramadan, the day of the martyrdom of Imam Ali (as). It is narrated that Hazrat Khidr (as) came to Imam Ali's (as) house on this day, weeping and reciting these words.

lines.english: May Allah have mercy upon you, O Abu’l-hasan.

lines.arabic: كُنْتَ أَوَّلَ الْقَوْمِ إسْلاَماً وَأَخْلَصَهُمْ إيمَاناً
lines.english: You were the first of all in accepting Islam and the most sincere of all in faith,
lines.transliteration: kunta awwalal-qawmi islaman wa akhlasahum imana

lines.english: And you were the firmest in conviction and the most Allah-fearing,
lines.transliteration: wa ashaddahum yaqinan wa akhwafahum lillah

lines.arabic: وَأَعْظَمَهُمْ عَناءً وَأَحْوَطَهُمْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.english: And you were the most steadfast (against ordeals for the sake of Islam) and the most watchful for Allah’s Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household,
lines.transliteration: wa a’zamahum ‘ana-an wa ahwatahum ‘ala rasulil-lahi sallal-lahum ‘alayhi wa alih

lines.english: And you were the most careful for his companions and you were endowed with the most favorable merits,
lines.transliteration: wa amanahum ‘ala ashabihi wa afdalahum manaqib

lines.english: And you were the foremost of everyone else in everything, and the owner of the most elevated rank,
lines.transliteration: wa akramahum sawabiqa wa arfa’ahum darajah

lines.arabic: وَأَقْرَبَهُمْ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.english: And you were the closest of them to Allah’s Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household,
lines.transliteration: wa aqrabahum min rasulil-lahi sallal-lahu ‘alayhi wa alih

lines.arabic: وَأَشْبَهَهُمْ بِهِ هَدْياً وَخُلُقاً وَسَمْتاً وَفِعْلاً
lines.english: And you were the most similar to him in guidance, morals, manners, and deeds,
lines.transliteration: wa ashbahahum bihi hadyan wa khuluqan wa samtan wa fi’la

lines.english: And you were the owner of the most honorable position, and the most respected (by Almighty Allah and His Messenger).

lines.arabic: فَجَزَاكَ اللهُ عَنِ الإسْلاَمِ وَعَنْ رَسُولِهِ وَعَنِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ خَيْراً.
lines.english: May Allah reward you on behalf of Islam, the His Messenger, and the Muslims with the best rewarding.
You became stronger when his companions became weak,
And you advanced when they surrendered,
And you stood up (to face difficulties) when they became showed weak-heartedness,

lines.arabic: وَلَزَمْتَ مِنْهَاجَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ إذْ هُمْ أَصْحَابُهُ
lines.english: And you abode by the course of Allah’s Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household—as they were his companions,
lines.transliteration: wa lazamta minhaja rasulil-lahi sallal-lahu ‘alayhi wa alihi idh hum ashabuh

lines.english: And you were truly his vicegerent.
No one could ever compete with you or vie with you in this position
In spite of the existence of hypocrites and the despise of the unbelievers,
And the malice of the enviers and the disgrace of the wicked ones.
You thus managed the matters when they failed to do so
And you spoke (the truth) when they stammered,
And you carried on with the light of Allah when they stopped.
As they followed you, they were guided (to the true path),
You voice was the lowest (out of politeness) and was the highest in supplication,
lines.transliteration: wakunta akhfadahum sawtan wa a’lahum qunuta

lines.english: And you were the least in speaking and the you were the most eloquent of them,
lines.transliteration: wa aqallahum kalaman wa aswabahum nutqa

lines.english: And you were the most apposite in opinions and the most courageous,
lines.transliteration: wa akbarahum ra-yan wa ashja’ahum qalba

lines.arabic: وَأَشَدَّهُمْ يَقِيناً وَأَحْسَنَهُمْ عَمَلاً وَأَعْرَفَهُمْ بِالأُمُورِ.
lines.english: And you were the firmest in conviction, the best of them in deeds, and the most learned in questions.
lines.transliteration: wa ashaddahum yaqinan wa ahsanahum ‘amalan wa a’rafahum bil-umur

lines.arabic: كُنْتَ وَاللهِ يَعْسُوباً لِلدِّينِ أَوَّلاً وَآخِراً:
lines.english: By Allah (I swear), you were the true leader of the religion first and last:
lines.transliteration: kunta wallahi ya’suban liddini awwalan wa akhira

lines.arabic: اَلأوَّلَ حِينَ تَفَرَّقَ النَّاسُ وَالآخِرُ حِينَ فَشِلُوا
lines.english: You were thus the first (of the enduring ones) when the other people departed, and you were the last (in steadfastness) when they failed.
lines.transliteration: al-awwala hina tafarraqan-nasu wal-akhiru hin fashilu

lines.arabic: كُنْتَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أباً رَحِيماً إذْ صَارُوا عَلَيْكَ عِيَالاً
lines.english: For the believers, you were merciful father, as they were your dependants;
lines.transliteration: kunta lil-mu`minina aban rahiman idh saru ‘alayka ‘iyala

lines.english: So, you carried the burdens that they were too weak to carry,

lines.arabic: وَحَفِظْتَ مَا أَضَاعُوا وَرَعَيْتَ مَا أَهْمَلُوا
lines.english: And you preserved that which they forfeited, and you conserved that which they neglected,
lines.transliteration: wa hafizta ma ada’u wa ra’ayta ma ahmalu

lines.arabic: وَشَمَّرْتَ إذْ اجْتَمَعُوا وَعَلَوْتَ إذْ هَلَعُوا
lines.english: And you prepared yourself for facing those who allied (against Islam) and you advanced when they were dismayed,
lines.transliteration: wa shammarta idhij-tama’u wa ‘alawta idh hala’u

lines.arabic: وَصَبَرْتَ إذْ أَسْرَعُوا وَأَدْرَكْتَ أَوْتَارَ مَا طَلَبُوا
lines.english: And you resisted when they hurried (in absconding) and you achieved the goals for which they fought,
lines.transliteration: wa sabarta idh asra’u wa adrakta awtara ma talabu

lines.english: And they tasted at your hands that which they had not expected.
lines.transliteration: wa nalu bika ma lam tahtasibu

lines.arabic: كُنْتَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ عَذَاباً صَبّاً وَنَهْباً
lines.english: You were thus incessant and relentless torment on the unbelievers
And you were support and shelter for the believers.
Thus, I swear by Allah that you won its bliss and gained its reward,
And you attained its merits and prevailed on its worth.
lines.transliteration: wa ahrazta sawabighaha wa dhahabta bifada`iliha

lines.arabic: لَمْ تَفْلُلْ حُجَّتُكَ وَلَمْ يَزِغْ قَلْبُكَ
lines.english: Your argument was never weak and your heart never deviated,
lines.transliteration: lan taflul hujjatuka walam yazigh qalbuk

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ تَضْعُفْ بَصِيرَتُكَ وَلَمْ تَجْبُنْ نَفْسُكَ وَلَمْ تَخُنْ
lines.english: And your sagacity was never feeble, and your determination never cowered, and you never betrayed.
lines.transliteration: walam tad-‘uf basiratuka walam tajbun nafsuka walam takhun

lines.english: You were as firm as mountain, as storms could never displace you,

lines.arabic: وَكُنْتَ كَمَا قَالَ: أَمِنَ النَّاسُ فِي صُحْبَتِكَ وَذَاتِ يَدِكَ.
lines.english: And you were as exactly as what was said about you: People felt secure under your government and in what was entrusted with you.
lines.transliteration: wakunta kama qala aminan-nasu fi suhbatika wadhati yadik

lines.arabic: وَكُنْتَ كَمَا قَالَ: ضَعِيفاً فِي بَدَنِكَ قَوِيّاً فِي أَمْرِ اللهِ
lines.english: You were also as exactly as what was said about you: modest in your body and strong in carrying out the orders of Allah,
lines.transliteration: wakunta kama qala da’ifan fi badanika qawiyyan fi amrillah

lines.arabic: مُتَوَاضِعاً فِي نَفْسِكَ عَظِيماً عِنْدَ اللهِ
lines.english: Humble in yourself and enjoying a great standing with Allah,

lines.arabic: كَبِيراً في الأرْضِ جَلِيلاً عِنْدَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Great in the earth and lofty in the view of the believers.

lines.arabic: لَمْ يَكُنْ لأِحَدٍ فِيكَ مَهْمِزٌ وَلا لِقَائِلٍ فِيكَ مَغْمَزٌ
lines.english: None could ever find fault with you, and none could ever speak evil of you,
lines.transliteration: lam yakun li-ahadin fika mahmazun wala liqa`ilin fika maghmaz

lines.arabic: وَلا لأِحَدٍ فِيكَ مَطْمَعٌ وِلا لأحَدٍ عِنْدَكَ هَوَادَةٌ.
lines.english: And you never desired for anyone, And you were never lenient (unfairly) to anyone.
lines.transliteration: wala li-ahadin fika matma’un wala li-ahadin ‘indaka hawadah

lines.arabic: الضَّعِيفُ الذَّلِيلُ عِنْدَكَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ حَتَّى تَأخُذَ لَهُ بِحَقِّهِ
lines.english: The weak, humble one was strong and mighty in your view until you give him back his right,
lines.transliteration: ad-da’ifudh-dhalilu ‘indaka qawiyyun ‘azizun hatta ta`khudha lahu bihaqqih

lines.arabic: وَالْقَوِيُّ العَزيزُ عِنْدَكَ ضَعِيفٌ ذَلِيلٌ حَتَّى تَأخُذَ مِنْهُ الْحَقَّ
lines.english: And the strong, mighty one was weak in your view until you take the others’ rights from him.
lines.transliteration: wal-qawiyyul-‘azizu ‘indaka da’ifun dhalilun hata ta`khudha minhul-haqq

lines.arabic: وَالْقَرِيبُ وَالْبَعِيدُ عِنْدَكَ فِي ذَلِكَ سَوَاءٌ.
lines.english: The near and the remote were equal in your view.
You habit was to be right, honest, and kind,
And your words were ruling and determination,
And your custom was forbearance and fortitude,

lines.arabic: وَرَأْيُكَ عِلْمٌ وَعَزْمٌ فِي مَا فَعَلْتَ
lines.english: And your view was knowledge and firmness in whatever you did.
lines.transliteration: wa ra`yuka ‘ilmun wa ‘azmun fi ma fa’alt

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ نُهِجَ بِكَ السَّبِيلُ وَسُهِّلَ بِكَ الْعَسِيرُ
lines.english: Through you, the right path was taken and the difficult was made easy,
lines.transliteration: waqad nuhija bikas-sabilu wa sahhala bikal-‘asir

lines.arabic: وَأُطْفِئَتِ النِّيرَانُ وَاعْتَدَلَ بِكَ الدِّينُ وَقَوِيَ بِكَ الإسْلاَمُ وَالمُؤمِنُونَ
lines.english: Fires were also extinguished by you and the religion became even at your hands, and Islam and the believers because mighty because of you,
lines.transliteration: wa utfi`atin-niran wa’tudila bikad-dinu waqawiya bikal-islamu wal-mu`minun

lines.arabic: وَسَبَقْتَ سَبْقاً بَعِيداً وَأتْعَبْتَ مَنْ بَعْدَكَ تَعَباً شَدِيداً
lines.english: You thus advanced in great strides and stopped and curbed the wrongdoings of those who came after you.
lines.transliteration: wasabaqta sabqan ba’idan wa at-‘abta man ba'daka ta’aban shadida

lines.arabic: فَجَلَلْتَ عَنِ الْبُكَاءِ وَعَظُمَتْ رَزِيَّتُكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ
lines.english: You are thus too lofty to be mourned and the calamity (of losing you) was so astounding for the inhabitants of the heavens,
And this calamity undermined all people.
Surely, we are Allah's and to Him we shall surely return.

lines.arabic: رَضِينَا عَنِ اللهِ قَضَائَهُ وسَلَّمْنا للهِ أمْرَهُ
lines.english: We succumb to Allah’s acts and to His matters do we submit.

lines.arabic: فَواللهِ لَمْ يُصَبِ المُسْلِمونَ بِمِثْلِك أبَداً.
lines.english: By Allah I swear, the calamity of losing you is the ever most catastrophic for the Muslims.

lines.arabic: كُنْتَ لِلمُؤمِنِينَ كَهْفاً وَحِصْناً وَقُنَّةً رَاسِياً
lines.english: You were haven, shelter, and unshakable fortress of the believers.
lines.transliteration: kunta lil-mu`minina kahfan wa hisnan wa qunnatan rasiya

lines.english: And you were, at the same time, firm and furious on the opposing unbelievers.

lines.arabic: فَألْحَقَكَ اللهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ وَلاَ حَرَمَنا أجْرَكَ ولا أَضَلَّنا بَعْدَكَ.
lines.english: May Allah join you to His Prophet and may He never deprive us of the reward of our grief for you, and may He never mislead us after you.
lines.transliteration: fa alhaqakal-lahu binabiyyihi wala haramana ajraka wala adallana ba’dak

title: Ziyarah of Imam Ali (as) on Ghadeer Day
description: Though authoritative chains of authority, It is narrated that Imam `Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi (peace be upon him) said the following form of ziyarah at the holy tomb of Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) on the Ghadir day when he was summoned by the `Abbasid ruler, al-Mu`tasim, to be present before him in Iraq. (It contains a full overview of events in his life.)

lines.english: Peace be upon Muhammad the Messenger of Allah,
the seal of the Prophets,
the chief of the Messengers,
and the choice of the Lord of the worlds,
whom Allah has entrusted with His Revelations
and with His determined commandments,
who sealed the previous Messages,
paved the way to the coming blessings,
and Who prevails over all that.
May the mercy, blessings, peace,
benedictions, and greetings of Allah be upon him, too.
Peace be upon the Prophets and Messengers of Allah,
and upon His favorite angels
and righteous saints.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful,
the chief of the Prophets’ successors,
the heir of the Prophets’ knowledge,
the friend of the Lord of the worlds,
and my master as well as the master of all of the believers.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you, too.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya mawlaya ya amira almu'minina
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Commander of the Faithful,
the trustee of Allah on His lands,
the envoy of Him amongst His creatures,
and His conclusive argument against His servants.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا دِينَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْقَوِيمَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O true religion of Allah
and the straight path of Him.
Peace be upon you, O the Great News
about whom they differ
and they shall be asked.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful.
You believed in Allah while they were polytheists,

lines.transliteration: wa saddaqta bilhaqqi wa hum mukadhdhibuna
lines.english: accepted the truth while they belied it,

lines.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi wa hum muhjimuna
lines.english: strove for the sake of Allah while they refrained,
and worshipped Allah with full sincerity to Him in obedience
while you were steadfast, depending upon Him totally, until death came upon you.
Verily, curse of Allah be upon the wrongdoers.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Muslims,
head of the believers,
guide of the pious ones,
and leader of the white-forehead ones.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
I bear witness that you are indeed the brother of Allah’s Messenger,
the successor of him, the heir of his knowledge,
his trustee on his laws,
his representative in his nation,
and the first to believe in Allah
and to accept as true all that which was revealed to Allah’s Prophet.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَلَّغَ عَنِ ٱللَّهِ مَا أَنْزَلَهُ فِيكَ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annahu qad ballagha `an allahi ma anzalahu fika
lines.english: I also bear witness that he (i.e. the Prophet) conveyed all that which Allah revealed to him concerning you;
so, he expounded openly what he was commanded (to expound),

lines.arabic: وَأَوْجَبَ عَلَىٰ أُمَّتِهِ فَرْضَ طَاعَتِكَ وَوِلاَيَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa awjaba `ala ummatihi farda ta`atika wa wilayatika
lines.english: declared to his nation the duty of obedience and loyalty to you,
ordered them to swear allegiance to you,

lines.transliteration: wa ja`alaka awla bilmu'minina min anfusihim
lines.english: and declared you as enjoying more priority on the believers than that which they enjoy on themselves
in the same was as Allah has made him enjoy the same.
He then asked Allah the All-exalted to be the witness on them (in this respect),
saying, “Have I conveyed?”
They answered, “Yes, you have. We swear to it by Allah.”
He thus said, “O Allah, be the witness

lines.arabic: وَكَفَىٰ بِكَ شَهِيداً وَحَاكِماً بَيْنَ ٱلْعِبَادِ.“
lines.transliteration: wa kafa bika shahidan wa hakiman bayna al`ibadi
lines.english: and You are sufficient Witness and Judge between the servants (0f Yours).”

lines.arabic: فَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ جَاحِدَ وِلاَيَتِكَ بَعْدَ ٱلإِقْرَارِ
lines.transliteration: fala`ana allahu jahida wilayatika ba`da al-iqrari
lines.english: Hence, curse of Allah be upon him who denied the allegiance to you after he had confessed of it
and upon him who breached his pledge to you after he had taken it.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ وَفَيْتَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wafayta bi`ahdi allahi ta`ala
lines.english: I also bear witness that you have indeed observed your pledge to Almighty Allah

lines.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَعَالَىٰ مُوفٍ لَكَ بِعَهْدِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa anna allaha ta`ala mufin laka bi`ahdihi
lines.english: and that Almighty Allah, in return, shall observe His pledge to you.

lines.arabic: ”وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْراً عَظِيماً.“
lines.transliteration: wa man awfa bima `ahada `alayhu allaha fasayu'tihi ajran `aziman
lines.english: “Therefore, whoever fulfills what he has covenanted with Allah, He will grant him a mighty reward.”

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka amiru almu'minina alhaqqu
lines.english: I also bear witness that you are truly the commander of the faithful,
the Divine Revelation did declare your commissioned leadership,

lines.arabic: وَأَخَذَ لَكَ ٱلْعَهْدَ عَلَىٰ ٱلأُمَّةِ بِذٰلِكَ ٱلرَّسُولُ
lines.transliteration: wa akhadha laka al`ahda `ala al'ummati bidhalika alrrasulu
lines.english: and the Messenger made a covenant with the people (that they would be under your leadership).

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wa `ammaka wa akhaka
lines.english: I also bear witness that you, along with your uncle and brother,
traded with Allah in your souls;
He therefore revealed about you this:

lines.arabic: «إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱشْتَرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ
lines.transliteration: inna allaha ishtara min almu'minina anfusahum wa amwalahum
lines.english: “Surely, Allah has bought of the believers their persons and their property for this,
that they shall have Paradise;

lines.arabic: يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقْتُلُونَ وَيُقْتَلُونَ
lines.transliteration: yuqatiluna fi sabili allahi fayaqtuluna wa yuqtaluna
lines.english: they fight in Allah's way, so they slay and are slain;

lines.arabic: وَعْداً عَلَيْهِ حَقّاً فِي ٱلتَّوْرَاةِ وَٱلإِنْجِيلِ وَٱلْقُرْآنِ
lines.transliteration: wa`dan `alayhi haqqan fi alttawrati wal-injili walqur'ani
lines.english: a promise which is binding on Him in the Torah and the Bible and the Qur'an;

lines.transliteration: wa man awfa bi`ahdihi min allahi
lines.english: and who is more faithful to his covenant than Allah?
Rejoice therefore in the pledge which you have made;
and that is the mighty achievement.
They who turn to Allah, who serve Him,
who praise Him, who fast,
who bow down, who prostrate themselves,
who enjoin what is good and forbid what is evil,

lines.transliteration: walhafizuna lihududi allahi wa bashshir almu'minina
lines.english: and who keep the limits of Allah; and give good news to the believers.”
O Commander of the Faithful, I bear witness

lines.arabic: أَنَّ ٱلشَّاكَّ فِيكَ مَا آمَنَ بِٱلرَّسُولِ ٱلأَمِينِ
lines.transliteration: anna alshshakka fika ma amana bilrrasuli al-amini
lines.english: that whoever doubts about you has never believed in the Trusted Messenger,

lines.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْعَادِلَ بِكَ غَيْرَكَ عَانِدٌ عَنِ ٱلدِّينِ ٱلْقَوِيمِ
lines.transliteration: wa anna al`adila bika ghayraka `anidun `an alddini alqawimi
lines.english: and whoever leaves you to choose another (as his leader) has indeed diverted the true religion,
that the Lord of the worlds has chosen for us,
and that He completed it on the Ghadir Day through (declaring) the Divinely commissioned leadership of you.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ ٱلْمَعْنِيُّ بِقَوْلِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ:
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka alma`niyyu biqawli al`azizi alrrahimi
lines.english: And I bear witness that you are the one intended in the following saying of the Almighty, All-merciful Lord:

lines.transliteration: wa anna hadha sirati mustaqiman fattabi`uhu
lines.english: “And this is My path, the right one; therefore, follow it,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تَتَّبِعُوا ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ.“
lines.transliteration: wa la tattabi`u alssubula fatafarraqa bikum `an sabilihi
lines.english: and follow not other ways, for they will lead you away from His way.”

lines.arabic: ضَلَّ وَٱللَّهِ وَأَضَلَّ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ سِوَاكَ
lines.transliteration: dalla wallahi wa adalla man ittaba`a siwaka
lines.english: I swear by Allah that whoever follows any one other than you has in fact strayed off the right way and misled others (i.e. those who imitate him),
and that whoever incurs the hostility of you has undoubtedly rejected the right.
O Allah, we have listened to Your command
obeyed, and followed Your straight path;
therefore, (please do) guide us, O our Lord!

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا إِلَىٰ طَاعَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la tuzigh qulubana ba`da idh hadaytana ila ta`atika
lines.english: And do not cause our hearts to deviate after You have guided us to the obedience to You,
and include us with those who always thank You for Your bounties.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَزَلْ لِلْهَوَىٰ مُخَالِفاً
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka lam tazal lilhawa mukhalifan
lines.english: And I also bear witness that you have always been at variance with whimsical desires
as you have always been in line with piety,
you have always been capable of suppressing your rage,
you have always forgiven and pardoned people,
and when Allah is disobeyed, you have always been furious,
and when He is obeyed, you have always been pleased,
and you have always carried out what Allah has commissioned you to do,
you have always observed what has been entrusted with you,
you have always kept what has been confided to you,
you have always conveyed what you were ordered to convey,
and you have always expected that which you were promised.

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka ma ittaqayta dari`an
lines.english: And I bear witness that as you sometimes conceded some things, you did not do that on account of humiliation,
and as you sometimes did not demand with your right, you did not do that on account of fear,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ أَحْجَمْتَ عَنْ مُجَاهَدَةِ غَاصِبِيكَ نَاكِلاً
lines.transliteration: wa la ahjamta `an mujahadati ghasibika nakilan
lines.english: and as you sometimes stopped combating those who usurped your right, you did not do so on account of weakness,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ أَظْهَرْتَ ٱلرِّضَا بِخِلاَفِ مَا يُرْضِي ٱللَّهَ مُدَاهِناً
lines.transliteration: wa la azharta alrrida bikhilafi ma yurdi allaha mudahinan
lines.english: and as you (on a certain occasion) showed contentment to things to which Allah is not pleased, you did not do so on account of flattery,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ وَهَنْتَ لِمَا أَصَابَكَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la wahanta lima asabaka fi sabili allahi
lines.english: and you have never been weakened by what befell you for the sake of Allah,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ ضَعُفْتَ وَلاَ ٱسْتَكَنْتَ عَنْ طَلَبِ حَقِّكَ مُرَاقِباً
lines.transliteration: wa la da`ufta wa la istakanta `an talabi haqqika muraqiban
lines.english: and you have never been feeble and you have never abased yourself as regards demanding with your rights on account of fear.
I seek Allah’s refuge against such claims;
rather, when you were wronged, you relied upon your Lord in these questions
and entrusted your affair to Him,
and as you reminded them (of their allegiance to you), they did not regard it,
and as you preached them, they did not accept from you,
and as you instructed them to fear Allah, they did not mind.

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka ya amira almu'minina
lines.english: I also bear witness, O Commander of the Faithful,
that you strove in the way of Allah in the most appropriate way
until Allah summoned you to be in His vicinity,
chose to grasp you,

lines.transliteration: wa alzama a`da'aka alhujjata biqatlihim iyyaka
lines.english: and established the argument against your enemies who killed you,
so that you should have argument against them,

lines.arabic: مَعَ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱلْحُجَجِ ٱلْبَالِغَةِ عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِهِ
lines.transliteration: ma`a ma laka min alhujaji albalighati `ala jami`i khalqihi
lines.english: although you enjoy conclusive arguments against all of His creatures.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful.
You have worshipped Allah sincerely,
striven in the way of Allah steadfastly,
sacrificed yourself, seeking Allah’s judgment,
acted upon His Book,
followed His Prophet’s instructions,
performed the prayers,
paid the zakat,
enjoined what is right,
and forbidden what is wrong as much as you could,
seeking what is possessed by Allah
and desiring for that which Allah has promised.
You have never cared for misfortunes,
never yielded to the hardships,
and never stopped fighting against any warrior on account of fear.

lines.arabic: أَفِكَ مَنْ نَسَبَ غَيْرَ ذٰلِكَ إِلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: afika man nasaba ghayra dhalika ilayka
lines.english: Indeed, whoever claims anything opposite to this to you is actually fabricating
and is forging lies to you,
and whoever leaves your path is drawing himself near to destruction.

lines.arabic: لَقَدْ جَاهَدْتَ فِي ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ ٱلْجِهَادِ
lines.transliteration: laqad jahadta fi allahi haqqa aljihadi
lines.english: You have certainly striven in the way of Allah as exactly as required,
stood harm for the sake of Allah,

lines.transliteration: wa anta awwalu man amana billahi
lines.english: have been the foremost to believe in Allah,
the first to offer prayer and to strive,

lines.transliteration: wa abda safhatahu fi dari alshshirki
lines.english: and the first to expose himself in the land of the polytheists,
while the lands were suffocated with deviation,
Satan was worshipped openly,

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ ٱلْقَائِلُ: ”لاَ تَزِيدُنِي كَثْرَةُ ٱلنَّاسِ حَوْلِي عِزَّةً
lines.transliteration: wa anta alqa'ilu la taziduni kathratu alnnasi hawli `izzatan
lines.english: and (in the midst of this) you said, “The big number of people that surround me shall never increase my might,
nor shall their departing me make me feel lonely.

lines.arabic: وَلَوْ أَسْلَمَنِيَ ٱلنَّاسُ جَمِيعاً لَمْ أَكُنْ مُتَضَرِّعاً.“
lines.transliteration: wa law aslamani alnnasu jami`an lam akun mutadarri`an
lines.english: I thus shall never submit even if all peoples desert me.”
Because you resorted to Allah, you were the mightiest,
and because you preferred the Next World to this worldly life, you have been ascetic.
Thus, Allah supported, guided,
chose, and selected you.
Your deeds were never contradictory,
your words were never paradoxical,
your situations were never fickle,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ ٱدَّعَيْتَ وَلاَ ٱفْتَرَيْتَ عَلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ كَذِباً
lines.transliteration: wa la idda`ayta wa la iftarayta `ala allahi kadhiban
lines.english: you have never claimed falsely or forged lies against Allah,
