you have never been greedy for the wreckage of this world,
you have never been defiled by sins,

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ تَزَلْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكَ
lines.transliteration: wa lam tazal `ala bayyinatin min rabbika
lines.english: you have always had manifest proof from your Lord,
and you have always been certain of what you do,

lines.arabic: تَهْدِي إِلَىٰ ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
lines.transliteration: tahdi ila alhaqqi wa ila siratin mustaqimin
lines.english: as you used to guide to the right and to a straight path.
I bear true witness
and I truly swear by Allah

lines.arabic: أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً وَآلَهُ صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ سَادَاتُ ٱلْخَلْقِ
lines.transliteration: anna muhammadan wa alahu salawatu allahi `alayhim sadatu alkhalqi
lines.english: that Muhammad and his Household—may Allah’s blessings be upon them—are the masters of all creatures

lines.transliteration: wa annaka mawlaya wa mawla almu'minina
lines.english: and you are indeed my master and the master of all believers,
the servant and friend of Allah,

lines.transliteration: wa akhu alrrasuli wa wasiyyuhu wa warithuhu
lines.english: the brother, successor, and heir of the Messenger,
who used to say to you,

lines.arabic: ”وَٱلَّذِي بَعَثَنِي بِٱلْحَقِّ مَا آمَنَ بِي مَنْ كَفَرَ بِكَ
lines.transliteration: walladhi ba`athani bilhaqqi ma amana bi man kafara bika
lines.english: “I swear this by Him Who sent me with the truth: whoever denies you has never believed in me,

lines.transliteration: wa la aqarra billahi man jahadaka
lines.english: whoever rejects you has never confessed of Allah’s existence,
whoever abandons you has actually strayed off,

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ يَهْتَدِ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَلاَ إِلَيَّ مَنْ لاَ يَهْتَدِي بِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa lam yahtadi ila allahi wa la ilayya man la yahtadi bika
lines.english: and whoever is not guided be you has never found the way to Allah or to me.

lines.transliteration: wa huwa qawlu rabbi `azza wa jalla
lines.english: Confirming this, my Lord the the Almighty and All-majestic says,

lines.arabic: «وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارٌ لِمَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحاً
lines.transliteration: wa inni laghaffarun liman taba wa amana wa `amila salihan
lines.english: ‘Most surely, I am most Forgiving to him who repents and believes and does good,
then follows the right path.’ To follow the right path is to adhere to your Divinely commissioned leadership.”
O master, your favor cannot be concealed
and your light cannot be extinguished.

lines.transliteration: wa anna man jahadaka alzzalumu al-ashqa
lines.english: Verily, he who rejects you shall be the most misfortunate wrongdoer.
O master, you are the (Divine) claim against the servants,
the guiding to uprightness,
and our means on the Promised Day.

lines.arabic: مَوْلاَيَ لَقَدْ رَفَعَ ٱللَّهُ فِي ٱلأُولَىٰ مَنْزِلَتَكَ
lines.transliteration: mawlaya laqad rafa`a allahu fi al'ula manzilataka
lines.english: O master, Allah has indeed elevated your standing in this world,
raised your rank in the Hereafter,

lines.arabic: وَبَصَّرَكَ مَا عَمِيَ عَلَىٰ مَنْ خَالَفَكَ
lines.english: and led you to that which has not been seen by those who antagonized you,

lines.arabic: وَحَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مَوَاهِبِ ٱللَّهِ لَكَ
lines.transliteration: wa hala baynaka wa bayna mawahibi allahi laka
lines.english: those who stood between you and Allah’s gifts to you.
So, curse of Allah be upon those who violated your sanctity
and those who prevented you from taking your right.
I do bear witness that these are the biggest losers
whose faces shall be scorched by Hellfire
and they therein shall be in severe affliction.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ مَا أَقْدَمْتَ وَلاَ أَحْجَمْتَ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka ma aqdamta wa la ahjamta
lines.english: And I bear witness that whenever you did something or you avoided doing something,

lines.transliteration: wa la nataqta wa la amsakta
lines.english: whenever you spoke or you remained silent,
and most ascetic.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
So be His peace and compliments.

lines.arabic: أَنْتَ مُطْعِمُ ٱلطَّعَامِ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِيناً وَيَتِيماً وَأَسِيراً
lines.transliteration: anta mut`imu altta`ami `ala hubbihi miskinan wa yatiman wa asiran
lines.english: It is you who served a poor man, an orphan, and a prisoner with food on account of your love for Him,

lines.arabic: لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لاَ تُرِيدُ مِنْهُمْ جَزَاءً وَلاَ شُكُوراً
lines.transliteration: liwajhi allahi la turidu minhum jaza'an wa la shukuran
lines.english: (you did so) for the sake of Allah, while you did not ask for reward or thanks.
Hence, Almighty Allah has revealed the following about you:

lines.arabic: ”وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ
lines.transliteration: wa yu'thiruna `ala anfusihim wa law kana bihim khasasatun
lines.english: “And they prefer them to themselves though poverty may afflict them.

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ.“
lines.transliteration: wa man yuqa shuhha nafsihi fa'ula'ika hum almuflihuna
lines.english: And whoever is preserved from the niggardliness of his soul, these it is that are the successful ones.”
Verily, it is you who is the suppressor of rage
and it is you who is the pardoner of people,
and Allah loves the good-doers.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ ٱلصَّابِرُ فِي ٱلْبَأْسَاءِ وَٱلضَّرَّاءِ وَحِينَ ٱلْبَأْسِ
lines.transliteration: wa anta alssabiru fi alba'sa'i walddarra'i wa hina alba'si
lines.english: It is also you who is the steadfast in distress and affliction, as well as in times of conflicts.
And it is you who distributes things completely equally,
who is just among the subjects,

lines.arabic: وَٱلْعَالِمُ بِحُدُودِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
lines.transliteration: wal`alimu bihududi allahi min jami`i albariyyati
lines.english: and the one having full acquaintance with the laws of Allah among all people.

lines.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ أَخْبَرَ عَمَّا أَوْلاَكَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ بِقَوْلِهِ:
lines.transliteration: wallahu ta`ala akhbara `amma awlaka min fadlihi biqawlihi
lines.english: Informing about the favors that He has conferred upon you, Allah the All-exalted says,

lines.transliteration: afaman kana mu'minan kaman kana fasiqan
lines.english: “Is he then who is a believer like him who is a transgressor?
They are not equal.
As for those who believe and do good,

lines.arabic: فَلَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلاً بِمَا كَانُوٱ يَعْمَلُونَ.“
lines.transliteration: falahum jannatu alma'wa nuzulan bima kanu ya`maluna
lines.english: the gardens of Paradise are their abiding-place; an entertainment for what they did.”
It is you to whom the knowledge of the Divine Revelation is given exclusively
as well as the laws of true interpretation (of the Holy Qur'an)
and the words of the Messenger.
You are known for your unforgettable situations,
renowned positions,
and memorable events,
in the Battle of Badr and the Battle of the Allies (al-Ahzab):

lines.transliteration: idh zaghat al-absaru wa balaghat alqulubu alhanajira
lines.english: “When the eyes turned dull, and the hearts rose up to the throats,
and you began to think diverse thoughts of Allah.

lines.arabic: هُنَالِكَ ٱبْتُلِيَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوٱ زِلْزَالاً شَدِيداً.
lines.transliteration: hunalika ibtuliya almu'minuna wa zulzilu zilzalan shadidan
lines.english: There, the believers were tried and they were shaken with severe shaking.

lines.arabic: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَافِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ:
lines.transliteration: wa idh yaqulu almunafiquna walladhina fi qulubihim maradun
lines.english: And when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was a disease began to say:

lines.arabic: مَا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلاَّ غُرُوراً.
lines.transliteration: ma wa`adana allahu wa rasuluhu illa ghururan
lines.english: ‘Allah and His Messenger did not promise us (victory) but only to deceive.’
And when a party of them said,

lines.arabic: يَا أَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لاَ مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَٱرْجِعُوٱ
lines.transliteration: ya ahla yathriba la muqama lakum farji`u
lines.english: ‘O people of Yathrib! There is no place to stand for you here; therefore, go back.’
And a party of them asked permission of the prophet,
saying: ‘Surely, our houses are exposed.’

lines.arabic: وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ إِنْ يُرِيدُونَ إِلاَّ فِرَاراً.“
lines.transliteration: wa ma hiya bi`awratin in yuriduna illa firaran
lines.english: And they were not exposed; they only desired to fly away.”
Almighty Allah has also said:

lines.transliteration: wa lamma ra'a almu'minuna al-ahzaba qalu
lines.english: “And when the believers saw the allies, they said:

lines.transliteration: hadha ma wa`adana allahu wa rasuluhu
lines.english: ‘This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us.
And Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth.’

lines.transliteration: wa ma zadahum illa imanan wa tasliman
lines.english: And it only increased them in faith and submission.”
On that day, you (O `Ali) killed their knight, `Amr (ibn `Abd-Wadd)
and defeated their allies:

lines.transliteration: wa radda allahu alladhina kafaru bighayzihim
lines.english: “And Allah turned back the unbelievers in their rage.
They did not obtain any advantage.
And Allah sufficed the believers in fighting.
And Allah is Strong, Mighty.”

lines.arabic: وَيَوْمَ أُحُدٍ: ”إِذْ يُصْعِدُونَ وَلاَ يَلْوُونَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa yawma uhudin idh yus`iduna wa la yalwuna `ala ahadin
lines.english: On the Battle of Uhud: “When they ran off precipitately and did not wait for any one
and the Messenger was calling them from their rear.”

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ تَذُودُ بِهِمُ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ
lines.transliteration: wa anta tadhudu bihim almushrikina `an alnnabiyyi
lines.english: And you were engaged in preventing the polytheists from reaching the Prophet,
on both sides—the right and the left,

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ رَدَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ عَنْكُمَا خَائِفِينَ
lines.english: until Almighty Allah drove them back, full of fear.
Hence, He gave victory, by means of you, to the disappointing ones.

lines.arabic: وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ عَلَىٰ مَا نَطَقَ بِهِ ٱلتَّنْزِيلُ:
lines.transliteration: wa yawma hunaynin `ala ma nataqa bihi alttanzilu
lines.english: On the Battle of Hunayn, as is accounted by the Divine Revelation:

lines.arabic: ”إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنْكُمْ شَيْئاً
lines.transliteration: idh a`jabatkum kathratukum falam tughni `ankum shay'an
lines.english: “When your great numbers made you vain, but they availed you nothing.
And the earth became strait to you notwithstanding its spaciousness,
then you turned back retreating.

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنْزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَىٰ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ.“
lines.transliteration: thumma anzala allahu sakinatahu `ala rasulihi wa `ala almu'minina
lines.english: Then, Allah sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers.”
“The believers” were you and your party.
You uncle, al-`Abbas, was calling at the defeated party:
“O companions of Surah al-Baqarah!
O owners of the Allegiance of the Tree!”

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ ٱسْتَجَابَ لَهُ قَوْمٌ قَدْ كَفَيْتَهُمُ ٱلْمَؤُونَةَ
lines.transliteration: hatta istajaba lahu qawmun qad kafaytahum alma'unata
lines.english: He still shouted until a group responded to him, and it was you who replaced them in fighting,
and it was you who aided the Prophet instead of them.
They therefore returned free from reward,
and hoping for repentance, as was promised by Almighty Allah.

lines.transliteration: wa dhalika qawlu allahi jalla dhikruhu
lines.english: He, majestic be His mention, says,

lines.arabic: ”ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ ٱللَّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ عَلَىٰ مَنْ يَشَاءُ.“
lines.transliteration: thumma yatubu allahu min ba`di dhalika `ala man yasha'u
lines.english: “Then will Allah, after this, turn mercifully to whom He pleases.”
As for you, you were awarded the rank of steadfastness
and prized the great reward.

lines.arabic: وَيَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ إِذْ أَظْهَرَ ٱللَّهُ خَوَرَ ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa yawma khaybara idh azhara allahu khawara almunafiqina
lines.english: On the Battle of Khaybar, when Allah exposed the cowardice of the hypocrites
and cut off the roots of the atheists,
so, all praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds (for that):

lines.arabic: ”وَلَقَدْ كَانُوٱ عَاهَدُوٱ ٱللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ لاَ يُوَلُّونَ ٱلأَدْبَارَ
lines.transliteration: wa laqad kanu `ahadu allaha min qablu la yuwalluna al-adbara
lines.english: “And, certainly, they had made a covenant with Allah before, that they would not turn their backs.
And Allah's covenant shall be inquired of.”
O master, you are the conclusive argument (of Allah),
the clear course,
the poured grace,
and the radiant evidence.

lines.arabic: فَهَنِيئاً لَكَ بِمَا آتَاكَ ٱللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلٍ
lines.transliteration: fahani'an laka bima ataka allahu min fadlin
lines.english: So, congratulations, for the favors that Allah has given you.
perdition overtake your enemies, the ignorant!

lines.arabic: شَهِدْتَ مَعَ ٱلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: shahidta ma`a alnnabiyyi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: You presented yourself with the Prophet—peace be upon him and his Household—
during all battles and expeditions that he led;
you always carried the pennon with him
and stroke (the enemies) with your sword before him.
Then, due to your prominent determination
and your sagacity in all affairs,
he (i.e. the Prophet) appointed you as the commander on all occasions,
and you were never under the commandment of another.

lines.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ أَمْرٍ صَدَّكَ عَنْ إِمْضَاءِ عَزْمِكَ فِيهِ ٱلتُّقَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa kam min amrin saddaka `an imda'i `azmika fihi alttuqa
lines.english: On many occasions, your piety prevented you from doing what you had decided about a matter,
while your rival followed his (personal) lust and committed that matter.

lines.arabic: فَظَنَّ ٱلْجَاهِلُونَ أَنَّكَ عَجَزْتَ عَمَّا إِلَيْهِ ٱنْتَهَىٰ
lines.english: Thus, the ignorant ones thought that you were incapable of doing that which had been done by your rival!

lines.arabic: ضَلَّ وَٱللَّهِ الظَّانُّ لِذٰلِكَ وَمَا ٱهْتَدَىٰ
lines.transliteration: dalla wallahi alzzannu lidhalika wa ma ihtada
lines.english: I swear by Allah that any one who thought so had missed the right thing and had never found the true guidance.

lines.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْضَحْتَ مَا أَشْكَلَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ تَوَهَّمَ وَٱمْتَرَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa laqad awdahta ma ashkala min dhalika liman tawahhama wamtara
lines.english: However, you clarified the misunderstanding in which those who fancied and doubted fell
by your saying—may Allah’s peace be upon you:

lines.transliteration: qad yara alhuwwalu alqullabu wajha alhilati
lines.english: “One who has been through thick and thin of life finds the excuses

lines.transliteration: wa dunaha hajizun min taqwa allahi
lines.english: to be preventing him from orders and prohibitions of Allah,
but he disregards them despite capability (to succumb to them and instead follows the commands of Allah),

lines.arabic: وَيَنْتَهِزُ فُرْصَتَهَا مَنْ لاَ حَرِيجَةَ لَهُ فِي ٱلدِّينِ.“
lines.transliteration: wa yantahizu fursataha man la harijata lahu fi alddini
lines.english: while one who has no restraints of religion seizes the opportunity (and accepts the excuses for not following the commands of Allah).”
You have said the very truth; I swear it by Allah, and the followers of vanity are indeed losers.
And when the two preachers (of their allegiance) tried to deceive you;
and said, “We want to go on `umrah!”

lines.arabic: فَقُلْتَ لَهُمَا: لَعَمْرُكُمَا مَا تُرِيدَانِ ٱلْعُمْرَةَ
lines.transliteration: faqulta lahuma la`amrukuma ma turidani al`umrata
lines.english: You thus answered them, “I swear by your lives; you do not want to go on `umrah;
rather, you want to betray me!”
Hence, you made covenant with them again
and you renewed their allegiance to you;
but they exerted all efforts to act hypocritically.

lines.arabic: فَلَمَّا نَبَّهْتَهُمَا عَلَىٰ فِعْلِهِمَا أَغْفَلاَ وَعَادَا وَمَا ٱنْتَفَعَا
lines.transliteration: falamma nabbahtahuma `ala fi`lihima aghfala wa `ada wa ma intafa`a
lines.english: And when you drew their attentions to this act, they neglected, redid it again, and did not follow your advice.
Thus, their end result was loss.
After them, the people of Syria (mutinied)!
So, you went to fight them after you had provided all excuses,

lines.transliteration: wa hum la yadinuna dina alhaqqi
lines.english: while they did not follow the true religion
neither did they understand the Qur'an.
They were rabble, rot, and deviants,

lines.arabic: وَبِٱلَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ فِيكَ كَافِرُونَ
lines.transliteration: wa billadhi unzila `ala muhammadin fika kafiruna
lines.english: and they were unbelievers in what was revealed to Muhammad about your leadership,
and they were supporters of those who antagonized you.

lines.transliteration: wa qad amara allahu ta`ala bittiba`ika
lines.english: While, Almighty Allah ordered everyone to follow you
and instructed the believers to support you.
He, the Almighty and All-majestic, has said in this respect:
“O you who believe!

lines.transliteration: ittaqu allaha wa kunu ma`a alssadiqina
lines.english: Be careful of your duty to Allah, and be with the truthful.”
O master, through you did the right manifest itself,
but the people discarded it.

lines.transliteration: wa awdahta alssunana ba`da alddurusi walttamsi
lines.english: And you made clear the (Prophetic) traditions after they had been eradicated and confused.

lines.arabic: فَلَكَ سَابِقَةُ ٱلْجِهَادِ عَلَىٰ تَصْدِيقِ ٱلتَّنْزِيلِ
lines.english: Hence, you enjoy the priority of struggling for the sake of confirming the Divine Revelation,

lines.arabic: وَلَكَ فَضِيلَةُ ٱلْجِهَادِ عَلَىٰ تَحْقِيقِ ٱلتَّأْوِيلِ
lines.transliteration: wa laka fadilatu aljihadi `ala tahqiqi altta'wili
lines.english: and you enjoy the virtue of struggling for the sake of confirming the true interpretation (of the Divine Revelation).

lines.arabic: وَعَدُوُّكَ عَدُوُّ ٱللَّهِ جَاحِدٌ لِرَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Your enemy is in fact the enemy of Allah and the denier of Allah’s Messenger.
Your enemy thus calls for vanity, judges unfairly,

lines.arabic: وَيَتَأَمَّرُ غَاصِباً وَيَدْعُو حِزْبَهُ إِلَىٰ ٱلنَّارِ
lines.transliteration: wa yata'ammaru ghasiban wa yad`u hizbahu ila alnnari
lines.english: usurps the position of rule, and drives his fans to Hellfire.

lines.transliteration: wa `ammarun yujahidu wa yunadi bayna alssaffayni
lines.english: While `Ammar (ibn Yasir) strove and called at the two parties (of the battle):
“How eager I am to join Paradise!”

lines.arabic: وَلَمَّا ٱسْتَسْقَىٰ فَسُقِيَ ٱللَّبَنَ كَبَّرَ وَقَالَ:
lines.transliteration: wa lamma istasqa fasuqiya allabana kabbara wa qala
lines.english: When he then asked for a drink, he was served with a drink of milk; he thus shouted, glorifying Allah, and said:

lines.arabic: ”قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:
lines.transliteration: qala li rasulu allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: “The Messenger of Allah—peace of Allah be upon him and his Household—did say to me:

lines.arabic: ’آخِرُ شَرَابِكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ضَيَاحٌ مِنْ لَبَنٍ
lines.transliteration: akhiru sharabika min alddunya dayahun min labanin
lines.english: ‘The last drink that you will have in this world is a cup of milk,
and the transgressing party will kill you.’”
Thus, Abu’l-`ªdiyah al-Fazari faced and killed him.
The curse of Allah

lines.transliteration: wa la`natu mala'ikatihi wa rusulihi ajma`ina
lines.english: and the curse of all His angels and Messengers be upon this Abu’l-`ªdiyah,
upon any one who unsheathed a sword against you,
and upon any one against whom you unsheathed your sword—
O Commander of the Faithful—

lines.arabic: مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
lines.transliteration: min almushrikina walmunafiqina ila yawmi alddini
lines.english: (Curse be upon) the polytheists and the hypocrites up to the Religion Day.
Curse be also upon any one whom is pleased by whatever upsets you,

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكْرَهْهُ وَأَغْمَضَ عَيْنَهُ وَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ
lines.transliteration: wa lam yakrahhu wa aghmada `aynahu wa lam yunkir
lines.english: and curse be upon any one who is not passive for whatever upsets you and upon any one who bypasses and does not deny,

lines.arabic: أَوْ أَعَانَ عَلَيْكَ بِيَدٍ أَوْ لِسَانٍ
lines.english: and upon any one who supports your rivals by deeds or words,
and upon any one who fails to support you,
and upon any one who slackens to fight with you,
and upon any one who despises your merits,
and upon any one who denies your right,

lines.arabic: أَوْ عَدَلَ بِكَ مَنْ جَعَلَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَوْلَىٰ بِهِ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ
lines.transliteration: aw `adala bika man ja`alaka allahu awla bihi min nafsihi
lines.english: and upon any one who leaves you and joins one upon whom Almighty Allah has given you priority.

lines.arabic: وَصَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.transliteration: wa salawatu allahi `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Allah’s peace, mercy, and blessings,
compliments, and greetings
be upon you and upon the Imams from your Immaculate Household.
Verily, Allah is Praised and Glorious.
What is more astounding
and more horrible than usurping your right

lines.arabic: غَصْبُ ٱلصِّدِّيقَةِ ٱلطَّاهِرَةِ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ سَيِّدَةِ ٱلنِّسَاءِ فَدَكاً
lines.transliteration: ghasbu alssiddiqati alttahirati alzzahra'i sayyidati alnnisa'i fadakan
lines.english: is the usurpation of Fadak from the veracious, pure, and luminous Lady, the doyenne of the women of the world!

lines.transliteration: wa raddu shahadatika wa shahadati alssayyidayni sulalatika
lines.english: As well as the rejection of your testimony and the testimonies of the two masters—your descendants,
and the Household of the Chosen Prophet, may Allah’s peace be upon you all.

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ أَعْلَىٰ ٱللَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ عَلَىٰ ٱلأُمَّةِ دَرَجَتَكُمْ
lines.transliteration: wa qad a`la allahu ta`ala `ala al-ummati darajatakum
lines.english: Whereas Almighty Allah has elevated you in rank over the nation,
raised your positions,

lines.transliteration: wa abana fadlakum wa sharafakum `ala al`alamina
lines.english: and demonstrated your preference and honorable favorability over all the created beings.
He thus removed away filth from you and purified you with the most thorough purification.
Allah the Almighty and All-majestic says:
“Indeed, man is created of a hasty temperament.
Being greatly grieved when evil afflicts him
and niggardly when good befalls him,
except those who pray.”
Hence, Almighty Allah has excluded His Chosen Prophet

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ يَا سَيِّدَ ٱلأَوْصِيَاءِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ ٱلْخَلْقِ
lines.transliteration: wa anta ya sayyida al-awsiya'i min jami`i alkhalqi
lines.english: you, the chief of the Prophets’ successors, from among all His beings.

lines.arabic: فَمَا أَعْمَهَ مَنْ ظَلَمَكَ عَنِ ٱلْحَقِّ
lines.english: How deviant from the right he who has wronged you is!

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ أَفْرَضُوكَ سَهْمَ ذَوِي ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ مَكْراً
lines.transliteration: thumma afraduka sahma dhawi alqurba makran
lines.english: They then deceptively decided the share of ‘Near of Kin’ to be for you,
after they wrongly deprived its meritorious people of it.

lines.arabic: فَلَمَّا آلَ ٱلأَمْرُ إِلَيْكَ أَجْرَيْتَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا أَجْرَيَا
lines.transliteration: falamma ala al-amru ilayka ajraytahum `ala ma ajraya
lines.english: When the matter (of rule) was returned to you, you continued carrying out what they had decided,

lines.arabic: رَغْبَةً عَنْهُمَا بِمَا عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ لَكَ
lines.english: because you desired for what is stored by Allah for you.

lines.arabic: فَأَشْبَهَتْ مِحْنَتُكَ بِهِمَا مِحَنَ ٱلأَنْبِيَاءِ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
lines.transliteration: fa'ashbahat mihnatuka bihima mihana al-anbiya'i `alayhimu alssalamu
lines.english: Your ordeals are thus similar to the ordeals encountered by the Prophets, peace be upon them,
who also faced loneliness and absence of supporters.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْبَهْتَ فِي ٱلْبَيَاتِ عَلَىٰ الْفِرَاشِ ٱلذَّبِيحَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
lines.transliteration: wa ashbahta fi albayati `ala alfirashi aldhdhabiha `alayhi alssalamu
lines.english: As you replaced the Prophet by spending that night on his bed instead of him, this situation was similar to the situation of the self-sacrificing Prophet, peace be upon him.
Because you responded (to the Prophet’s order) in the same way as he (i.e. Prophet Isma`il) responded (to his father’s request),

lines.arabic: وَأَطَعْتَ كَمَا أَطَاعَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ صَابِراً مُحْتَسِباً
lines.transliteration: wa ata`ta kama ata`a isma`ilu sabiran muhtasiban
lines.english: and you obeyed the Prophet in the same way as (Prophet) Isma`il obeyed with steadfastness and reliance upon Allah.

lines.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ: يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ
lines.transliteration: idh qala lahu ya bunayya inni ara fi almanami anni adhbahuka
lines.english: Hence, when his father said to him, ‘O my son! Surely, I have seen in a dream that I should sacrifice you;
consider then what you see.’

lines.arabic: قَالَ: يَا أَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ
lines.transliteration: qala ya abati if`al ma tu'maru
lines.english: He said, ‘O my father! Do what you are commanded;

lines.arabic: سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّابِرِينَ.
lines.transliteration: satajiduni in sha'a allahu min alssabirina
lines.english: if Allah please, you will find me of the patient ones.’

lines.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ لَمَّا أَبَاتَكَ ٱلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa kadhalika anta lamma abataka alnnabiyyu salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: The same situation with you, when the Prophet—peace be upon him and his Household—chose you to replace him,

lines.transliteration: wa amaraka an tadja`a fi marqadihi
lines.english: and ordered you to sleep in his bed instead of him
so that you should protect him by sacrificing yourself for him,
you quickly responded to his request with obedience,
by exposing yourself to killing fearlessly.
So, Allah the All-exalted appreciated this obedience to him

lines.arabic: وَأَبَانَ عَنْ جَمِيلِ فِعْلِكَ بِقَوْلِهِ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ:
lines.transliteration: wa abana `an jamili fi`lika biqawlihi jalla dhikruhu
lines.english: and He, majestic be His mention, declared your excellent deed by saying:

lines.arabic: ”وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْرِي نَفْسَهُ ٱبْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاةِ ٱللَّهِ.“
lines.transliteration: wa min alnnasi man yashri nafsahu ibtigha'a mardati allahi
lines.english: “And among men is he who sells himself to seek the pleasure of Allah.”
Then, your ordeal on the Battle of Siffin,

lines.transliteration: wa qad rufi`at almasahifu hilatan wa makran
lines.english: when books of the Qur'an were raised (on spearheads) out of trickery and deception,
causing doubt to be aroused,
the truth to be neglected,
and conjecture to be followed,

lines.arabic: أَشْبَهَتْ مِحْنَةَ هَارُونَ إِذْ أَمَّرَهُ مُوسَىٰ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَتَفَرَّقُوٱ عَنْهُ
lines.transliteration: ashbahat mihnata haruna idh ammarahu musa `ala qawmihi fatafarraqu `anhu
lines.english: this ordeal was similar to the ordeal of (Prophet) Aaron when (Prophet) Moses appointed him as the leader of his people, but they left him alone,

lines.transliteration: wa harunu yunadi bihim wa yaqulu
lines.english: while (Prophet) Aaron was calling at them, saying:

lines.arabic: يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمٰنُ
lines.transliteration: ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wa inna rabbakum alrrahmanu
lines.english: ‘O my people! You are only tried by it, and surely your Lord is the Beneficent Allah.
Therefore, follow me and obey my order.’

lines.arabic: قَالُوٱْ: لَنْ نَبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ.
lines.transliteration: qalu lan nabraha `alayhi `akifina hatta yarji`a ilayna musa
lines.english: They said, ‘We will by no means cease to keep to its worship until Moses returns to us.’

lines.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ لَمَّا رُفِعَتِ ٱلْمَصَاحِفُ قُلْتَ:
lines.transliteration: wa kadhalika anta lamma rufi`at almasahifu qulta
lines.english: Similarly, when the books of the Qur'an were raised (on spearheads), you said:

lines.arabic: يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهَا وَخُدِعْتُمْ
lines.transliteration: ya qawmi innama futintum biha wa khudi`tum
lines.english: ‘O my people, you are only tried by this and you have been surely cheated.’
Nevertheless, they disobeyed you and did the opposite.
And when they demanded with nominating two arbitrators (one from each party),

lines.arabic: فَأَبَيْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَتَبَرَّأْتَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ وَفَوَّضْتَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ
lines.transliteration: fa'abayta `alayhim wa tabarra'ta ila allahi min fi`lihim wa fawwadtahu ilayhim
lines.english: you rejected and declared your disavowal of this act before Allah, and then asked them to do whatever they wanted.
Thus, when the truth manifested itself
the wrong was proven as futile,
and they confessed of their flaw and deviation from the right thing,
they also mutinied after that

lines.arabic: وَأَلْزَمُوكَ عَلَىٰ سَفَهِ ٱلتَّحْكِيمِ ٱلَّذِي أَبَيْتَهُ وَأَحَبُّوهُ
lines.transliteration: wa alzamuka `ala safahi alttahkimi alladhi abaytahu wa ahabbuhu
lines.english: and obliged you to commit to the nonsensical result of the arbitration that you had rejected and they had accepted,

lines.transliteration: wa hazartahu wa abahu dhanbahumu alladhi iqtarafuhu
lines.english: and you had forbidden it, and they then confessed of the sin that they had committed.

lines.transliteration: wa anta `ala nahji basiratin wa hudan
lines.english: While you were following the course of sagacity and true guidance,
they were following the courses of deviation and blindness.
Nonetheless, they insisted on hypocrisy
and involved themselves in seduction
until Allah made them taste the evil result of their conduct.

lines.arabic: فَأَمَاتَ بِسَيْفِكَ مَنْ عَانَدَكَ فَشَقِيَ وَهَوَىٰ
lines.transliteration: Fa'amata bisayfika man `anadaka fashaqiya wa hawa
lines.english: He thus deadened, through your sword, those who mutinied against you, causing them eternal misery and perdition,

lines.transliteration: wa ahya bihujjatika man sa`ada fahudiya
lines.english: and He gave life, through your acting as His argument, to those whom He decided as happy; therefore, they were guided (to the true choice).
Allah’s blessings be upon you, coming and going,
and still and moving.
Certainly, no one praising you can ever cover your actual characteristics
and no one criticizing you can ever belittle your merits.
You are verily the best worshipper of all created beings,
the most sincere in asceticism,
and the most enthusiastic defender of the religion.
You executed the laws of Allah with exceptional efforts
and damaged the armies of the apostates with your sword.
You can extinguish the flames of battles with your finger,
tear out the curtains of seditions with your eloquent language,

lines.arabic: وَتَكْشِفُ لَبْسَ ٱلْبَاطِلِ عَنْ صَرِيحِ ٱلْحَقِّ
lines.transliteration: wa takshifu labsa albatili `an sarihi alhaqqi
lines.english: and distinguish the confusing wrong from the plain right.

lines.arabic: لاَ تَأْخُذُكَ فِي ٱللَّهِ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
lines.transliteration: la ta'khudhuka fi allahi lawmatu la'imin
lines.english: You are never influenced by any censure as long as you work for the sake of Allah.

lines.arabic: وَفِي مَدْحِ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ لَكَ غِنَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa fi madhi allahi ta`ala laka ghinan
lines.english: The praising of Allah the All-exalted to you suffices
from the praising of any other one and from the approval of the depicters.
Almighty Allah says:

lines.arabic: ”مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوٱ مَا عَاهَدُوٱ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ
lines.transliteration: min almu'minina rijalun sadaqu ma `ahadu allaha `alayhi
lines.english: “Of the believers are men who are true to the covenant which they made with Allah.

lines.arabic: فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ وَمَا بَدَّلُوٱ تَبْدِيلاً.“
lines.transliteration: faminhum man qada nahbahu wa minhum man yantaziru wa ma baddlu tabdilan
lines.english: So, of them is he who accomplished his vow, of them is he who yet waits, and they have not changed in the least.”

lines.arabic: وَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ أَنْ قَتَلْتَ ٱلنَّاكِثِينَ وَٱلْقَاسِطِينَ وَٱلْمَارِقِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa lamma ra'ayta an qatalta alnnakithina walqasitina walmariqina
lines.english: After you felt that you had killed the preachers, the wrongdoers, and the apostates,

lines.arabic: وَصَدَقَكَ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَعْدَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa sadaqaka rasulu allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa`dahu
lines.english: the predictions of Allah’s Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household—came true,
and you had fulfilled your promise to him, you then said:

lines.arabic: أَمَا آنَ أَنْ تُخْضَبَ هٰذِهِ مِنْ هٰذِهِ؟
lines.transliteration: ama ana an tukhdaba hadhihi min hadhihi
lines.english: “Has time not come yet so that this (beard) shall be dyed with the blood of this (head)?
When will the most unfortunate of them be sent (to slay me)?”

lines.arabic: وَاثِقاً بِأَنَّكَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكَ
lines.english: You were always confident that you were proceeding on clear proof from your Lord,
you were acting with sure knowledge of what you do,
you were on your way to Allah,
and you were rejoicing in the bargain that you had made with Him;
and that is the supreme triumph.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ قَتَلَةَ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَأَوْصِيَاءِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma il`an qatalata anbiya'ika wa awsiya'i anbiya'ika
lines.english: O Allah, curse the murderers of your Prophets and the murderers of Your Prophets’ successors
with the variant curses (that You have prepared for them),
and make those slayers to taste the heat of Your fire.
And also curse those who usurped the right of Your friend,
those who denied their allegiance to him,

lines.arabic: وَجَحَدَهُ بَعْدَ ٱلْيَقِينِ وَٱلإِقْرَارِ بِٱلْوِلاَيَةِ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa jahadahu ba`da alyaqini wal-iqrari bilwilayati lahu
lines.english: and those who rejected him after they had witnessed and declared their loyalty to him
on the day when you completed your religion through him.
O Allah, curse those who slew the Commander of the Faithful,

lines.transliteration: wa man zalamahu wa ashya`ahum wa ansarahum
lines.english: curse those who wronged him, and curse their adherents and supporters.

lines.transliteration: allahumma il`an zalimi alhusayni wa qatilihi
lines.english: O Allah, curse those who wronged and slew al-Husayn,
and curse those who adhered to his enemies and those who supported them,

lines.transliteration: walrradina biqatlihi wa khadhilihi la`nan wabilan
lines.english: and curse those who were pleased by the murder of killing al-Husayn and those who disappointed him, with violent cursing.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ ظَلَمَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma il`an awwala zalimin zalama ala muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, curse the first one to invent the wronging against the Household of Muhammad
and curse those who deprived them of their rights.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ خُصَّ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ وَغَاصِبٍ لآِلِ مُحَمَّدٍ بِٱللَّعْنِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma khussa awwala zalimin wa ghasibin li'ali muhammadin billa`ni
lines.english: O Allah, pour violent curses upon the first one who wronged and usurped the rights of the Household of Muhammad,

lines.arabic: وَكُلَّ مُسْتَنٍّ بِمَا سَنَّ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa kulla mustannin bima sanna ila yawmi alqiyamati
lines.english: and curse all those who followed those wrongdoers up to the Resurrection Day.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, the seal of the Prophets,

lines.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ عَلِيٍّ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa `ala `aliyyin sayyidi alwasiyyina wa alihi alttahirina
lines.english: and upon `Ali, the chief of the Prophets’ successors, and upon his immaculate Household,
(please do) make us adhere to them firmly,
and include us with those who shall be winners and secured because they abode by their leadership;

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
lines.transliteration: alladhina la khawfun `alayhim wa la hum yahzanuna
lines.english: those upon whom there shall come no fear, nor shall they grieve.
O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Your friend,
the brother of Your Prophet,

lines.transliteration: wa wazirihi wa habibihi wa khalilihi
lines.english: his vizier, dear one, intimate friend,
his trustee on his secrets,
the favorite one among his family members,

lines.transliteration: wa wasiyyihi wa safwatihi wa khalisatihi
lines.english: his successor, his choice, his dignitary,
his courier, his best friend,
the most honorable of the members of his household who believed in him,
the father of his progeny,
the door to his wisdom,
his spokesman who speaks with his argument,
the inviter to his code of law,
the follower of his instructions,
his representative on his people,
the master of Muslims,
the commander of the faithful,
and the leader of the white-forehead group;

lines.arabic: أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
lines.transliteration: afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min khalqika
lines.english: (please, bless him) with the best blessings that You have ever bestowed upon any of Your creatures
and upon Your select ones and Your Prophets’ successors.
O Allah, I bear witness

lines.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَلَّغَ عَنْ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ مَا حُمِّلَ
lines.transliteration: annahu qad ballagha `an nabiyyika salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi ma hummila
lines.english: that he conveyed all that which has been entrusted with him on behalf of Your Prophet, peace be upon him and his Household,
conformed to that which has been kept with him,
held that which has been commended to him,
observed that which You have deemed lawful,
forbade that which You have deemed unlawful,
carried out Your laws,
called unto Your course,
he assisted Your saints,
incurred the hostility of Your enemies,
and strove against those who preached Your path,
those who acted wrongly, and those who apostatized Your affair.
In all these, he was steadfast, seeking Your pleasure,
advancing, and never neglectful.

lines.arabic: لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ فِي ٱللَّهِ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
lines.transliteration: la ta'khudhuhu fi allahi lawmatu la'imin
lines.english: No censure has ever precluded him from what he would do for Your sake
until he attained Your satisfaction,
relegated all matters to You,
worshipped You sincerely,
and acted sincerely and painstakingly for Your sake
until death came upon him.
So, You grasped his soul to You while he was happy martyr,
saint, pious, pleased,
pure, guide, and well-guided.
O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and bless him

lines.arabic: أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَأَصْفِيَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min anbiya'ika wa asfiya'ika
lines.english: with the best blessings You have ever bestowed upon any of Your Prophets and select ones,
O Lord of the worlds.

title: Ziyarah of Imam Hassan Mujtaba (as)
description: Ziyahat of Imam Hassan (as) including the general Baqi Ziyarah and special Monday Ziyarah.

lines.english: Permission to Enter- Izn e Dukhool

lines.arabic: يَا مَوَالِيَّ يَا ابْنَاءَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: ya mawaliyya ya abna'a rasuli allahi
lines.english: O my masters, sons of the Messenger of Allah,
I—your servant and the son of your maid
who stand submissively before you,
who is worth nothing in comparison with your elevated esteem,
and who admits your right (that is incumbent upon us)—
have come to you, seeking your shelter,
heading for your sanctuary,
seeking nearness to Your statuses,
and beseeching Allah in your names.
May I enter, O my masters?
May I enter, O intimate servants of Allah?

lines.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَلاَئِكَةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُحْدِقينَ بِهٰذَا ٱلْحَرَمِ
lines.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mala'ikata allahi almuhdiqina bihadha alharami
lines.english: May I enter, O Allah’s angels who surround this sanctuary
and reside in this shrine?
After you attain reverence, submission, and tenderheartedness, you may enter the shrine with your right foot, and say the following:
Allah is greatly the Greatest.
All praise be to Allah abundantly.

lines.transliteration: wa subhana allahi bukratan wa asilan
lines.english: Glory be to Allah in morns and eves.
All praise be to Allah, the Single, the Absolute,
the Glorious, the One and Only,
the All-obliging, the All-benefactor,
the Donor, the All-compassionate,
Who conferred (upon us) with His bequests,
Who has made easy for me to visit my masters out of His beneficence,
Who has not included me with those who are prevented from visiting them;
rather, He has bestowed upon me and donated me (this favor).
You may then move toward their tombs, face them, turn the back to the kiblah direction, and say the following:
Peace be upon you, O Leaders of true guidance.
Peace be upon you, O people of piety.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ ايُّهَا ٱلْحُجَجُ عَلَىٰ اهْلِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Arguments against the inhabitants of this world.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ ايُّهَا ٱلْقُوَّامُ فِي ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ بِٱلْقِسْطِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ayyuha alquwwamu fi albariyyati bilqisti
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O maintainers of justice on people.
Peace be upon you, O choicest people.
Peace be upon you, O members of the Household of Allah’s Messenger.
Peace be upon you, O people of confidential talks (of the angels).

lines.transliteration: ashhadu annakum qad ballaghtum wa nasahtum
lines.english: I bear witness that you did convey, offer advice,
endure for the sake of Allah,

lines.transliteration: wa kudhdhibtum wa usi'a ilaykum faghafartum
lines.english: and forgive when you were belied and maltreated.

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annakumu al-a'immatu alrrashiduna almuhtaduna
lines.english: I also bear witness that you are the orthodox, well-guided Leaders,
that the obedience to you is obligatory,
that your words are true,
that you had called (to Allah) but you were not answered,
that you had enjoined (the right) but you were not obeyed,

lines.transliteration: wa annakum da`a'imu alddini wa arkanu al-ardi
lines.english: and that you are the supports of the religion and the poses of the earth.
You were always under the sight of Allah
Who moved you from the loins of purified men
to the wombs of purified women.
The benighted ignorance could not stain you

lines.transliteration: wa lam tashrak fikum fitanu al-ahwa'i
lines.english: and the whimsical sedition could not attract you.
Pleased be you as your origin has been pleased.
The King of the religion has conferred upon us with the grace of our acknowledgment of you;
He therefore caused you to be in houses
which He (i.e. Allah) has permitted to be exalted
and that His Name may be mentioned therein,
and He has decided our invocations of blessings upon you
to be mercy on us and to be granting remission of our sins.
Allah has chosen you for us

lines.arabic: وَطَيَّبَ خَلْقَنَا بِمَا مَنَّ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ وِلاَيَتِكُمْ
lines.transliteration: wa tayyaba khalqana bima manna `alayna min wilayatikum
lines.english: and has purified our creation through the grace of our loyalty to your (Divinely commissioned) Leadership with which He has conferred upon us.
We have thus become nominated with Him due to our acknowledgement of you
and our giving credence to you.

lines.transliteration: wa hadha maqamu man asrafa wa akhta'a
lines.english: So, this is the situation of him who has committed mistakes and sins,
shown submission (to you), and confessed of what he had committed.
Hence, being in this situation, I hope for redemption

lines.arabic: وَانْ يَسْتَنْقِذَهُ بِكُمْ مُسْتَنْقِذُ ٱلْهَلْكَىٰ مِنَ ٱلرَّدَىٰ
lines.english: and I hope that the Savior of the perishing ones from perdition may save me in your names.
So, (please) be my interceders,
for I have come to you
when the people of this world abandoned you,
took the Signs of Allah for a jest,
and turned away from them haughtily.
You may then raise your head toward the sky and say the following:

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ لاََ يَسْهُو
lines.transliteration: ya man huwa qa'imun la yashu
lines.english: O He Who is Self-Subsisting and never forgets,
Who is Ever-living and never becomes heedless,
and Who encompasses all things!
To You is all gratitude for that You have guided me (to this)
and You have introduced to me that on which I rest,
when Your servants diverted from it,
ignored the recognition of it,
belittled its right,
and inclined to elsewhere.
Hence, You have conferred upon me with this favor

lines.arabic: مَعَ اقْوَامٍ خَصَصْتَهُمْ بِمَا خَصَصْتَنِي بِهِ
lines.transliteration: ma`a aqwamin khasastahum bima khasastani bihi
lines.english: as well as upon other people whom You have granted exclusively the same.
So, all praise be to You, for I have been
mentioned and written with You due to the situation in which I am now.
Hence, (please) do not deprive me of what I long for,

lines.transliteration: wa la tukhayyibni fi ma da`awtu
lines.english: and do not disappoint me as regards my supplication;
(please do so) in the name of the sanctity of Muhammad and his immaculate Household.

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: May Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
You may now pray Almighty Allah for anything you want.
In Tahdhib al-Ahkam, Shaykh al-Tusi says: You may then offer the Ziyarah Prayer (salat al-ziyarah) in eight units; each two units are for one of the (four) Imams.
Shaykh al-Tusi and Sayyid Ibn Tawus say that if you want to bid farewell to the four Imams, you may say the following:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ ائِمَّةَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum a'immata alhuda wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you, O leaders to the true guidance.
I entrust you with Allah([1]) and send salutations to you.
We believe in Allah and in the Messenger

lines.transliteration: wa bima ji'tum bihi wa dalaltum `alayhi
lines.english: and in that which you have conveyed and that to which you have guided.
O Allah, then write us down among those who bear witness.
First Section of Monday Ziarat

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ رَبِّ  لْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya ibna rasuli rabbi al`alamina
lines.english: Peace be on you, O son of the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O son of the Commander of the Believers!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O son of Fatimah, the luminous lady!
Peace be on you, O beloved of Allah!
Peace be on you, O choice of Allah!
Peace be on you, O trustee of Allah!
Peace be on you, O Argument of Allah!
Peace be on you, O Light of Allah!
Peace be on you, O Path of Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَيَانَ حُكْمِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O elucidation of the rule of Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَاصِرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O supporter of the religion of Allah!
Peace be on you, O pure master!
Peace be on you, O self-righteous and truthful!
Peace be on you, O practiser (of God’s commands) and trustee!
Peace be on you, O well-experienced in the interpretation (of the Qur'an)!
Peace be on you, O guide and well-guided!
Peace be on you, O immaculate and pure!
Peace be on you, O pious and infallible!
Peace be on you, O veritable truth!
Peace be on you, O martyr and veracious!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابَا مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya aba muhammadin alhasana ibna `aliyyin
lines.english: Peace be on you, O Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan, the son of `Ali!
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you!
Invocation of Blessings upon Imam Hassan(as)& Imam Hussain(as)
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
Your two servants and friends,
the two sons of Your Messengers, the two grandsons of Mercy,
and the two chiefs of the youth of Paradise,

lines.arabic: أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْلاَدِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ وَٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
lines.transliteration: afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min awladi alnnabiyyina walmursalina
lines.english: with the most excellent blessings that You have ever sent upon any of the sons of the Prophets and the Messengers.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱبْنِ سَيِّدِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala alhasani ibni sayyidi alnnabiyyina
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Hasan the son of the chief of the Prophets
and the successor of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah's Messenger.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the Prophets’ successors.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: I bear witness that you are verily the son of the Commander of the Faithful,
the trustee of Allah, and the son of His trustee.
You lived upright and persecuted
and passed away as martyr.
And I bear witness that you are verily the pure,
guiding, and well-guided leader.
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon him
and convey to his soul and body

lines.arabic: فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَفْضَلَ ٱلتَّحِيَّةِ وَٱلسَّلاَمِ
lines.transliteration: fi hadhihi alssa`ati afdala alttahiyyati walssalami
lines.english: at this hour the best greeting and salutation from me.
Salawat on Imam Hussain (as)

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Husayn the son of `Ali,
the oppressed, the martyr,
the slain by the unbelievers, and the thrown down by the sinful people.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah's Messenger.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ مُوقِناً أَنَّكَ أَمِينُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنُ أَمِينِهِ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu muqinan annaka aminu allahi wabnu aminihi
lines.english: I bear witness with full conviction that you are verily the trustee of Allah and the son of His trustee.
You were killed wrongly and you passed away as martyr.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَعَالَىٰ ٱلطَّالِبُ بِثَأْرِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna allaha ta`ala alttalibu bitha'rika
lines.english: I also bear witness that Allah the All-exalted is the One Who shall avenge You

lines.arabic: وَمُنْجِزٌ مَا وَعَدَكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّصْرِ وَٱلتَّأْيِيدِ
lines.transliteration: wa munjizun ma wa`adaka min alnnasri waltta'yidi
lines.english: and shall fulfill His promise to You of support and victory
through exterminating your enemies and demonstrating your call (to the true guidance).

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wafayta bi`ahdi allahi
lines.english: I also bear witness that you fulfilled your covenant with Allah,
strove hard for His sake,

lines.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ أَتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
lines.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu
lines.english: and served Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
May Allah curse the people who killed you.
May Allah curse the people who disappointed you.
May Allah curse the people who incited people against you.

lines.arabic: وَأَبْرَأُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ مَمَّنْ كَذَّبَكَ
lines.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi ta`ala mamman kadhdhabaka
lines.english: I release myself before Allah the All-exalted from those who belied you,

lines.transliteration: wa istakhaffa bihaqqika wa istahalla damaka
lines.english: belittled your right, and allowed themselves to shed your blood.

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya aba `abdi allahi
lines.english: May my father and mother be ransoms for you.
Allah's curse be on those who killed you.
Allah's curse be on those who let you down.

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ سَمِعَ وَاعِيَتَكَ فَلَمْ يُجِبْكَ وَلَمْ يَنْصُرْكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man sami`a wa`iyataka falam yujibka wa lam yansurka
lines.english: Allah's curse be on those who heard your call (for help), but they refrained from responding to you or supporting you.

lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man saba nisa'aka
lines.english: Allah's curse be on those who captured your women.

lines.arabic: أَنَا إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ بَرِيءٌ وَمِمَّنْ وَالاَهُمْ
lines.transliteration: ana ila allahi minhum bari'un wa mimman walahum
lines.english: I disavow them all before Allah and disavow those who adhered to them,
those who kept up with them, and those who helped them against you.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ وَٱلأَئِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ كَلِمَةُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wal-a'immata min wuldika kalimatu alttaqwai
lines.english: I also bear witness that you and the Imams from your descendants are the word of piety,
the door to true guidance, the firmest handle,
and the argument against the inhabitants of this world.
I also bear witness that I have full faith in you,
I have conviction in your standing,
and I always follow you in myself,
in the laws of my religion, in my sealing deeds,

lines.transliteration: wa munqalabi wa mathwaya fi dunyaya wa akhirati
lines.english: in my tour, and in my settlement in this worldly life and the Hereafter.
